Query_Text_en: Where the goods have been carried on deck contrary to the provisions of paragraph 1 of this article or where the carrier may not under paragraph 2 of this article invoke an agreement for carriage on deck , the carrier , notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of article 5 , is liable for loss of or damage to the goods , as well as for delay in delivery , resulting solely from the carriage on deck , and the extent of his liability is to be determined in accordance with the provisions of article 6 or article 8 of this Convention , as the case may be .
Translation: 若货物装载于甲板违反本条第一款规定，或承运人依据本条第二款不得援引甲板运输协议，则尽管第五条第1款另有规定，承运人仍应对纯粹因甲板运输造成的货物灭失、损坏或交付迟延承担赔偿责任，其责任范围应视情况适用本公约第六条或第八条规定予以确定。

Query_Text_en: Carriage of goods on deck contrary to express agreement for carriage under deck is deemed to be an act or omission of the carrier within the meaning of article 8 .
Translation: 违反明示约定将货物装于甲板而非舱内运输的行为，应视为第八条所指的承运人作为或不作为。

Query_Text_en: Where the performance of the carriage or part thereof has been entrusted to an actual carrier , whether or not in pursuance of a liberty under the contract of carriage by sea to do so , the carrier nevertheless remains responsible for the entire carriage according to the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 凡将运输或部分运输委托实际承运人履行时，不论是否根据海上运输合同赋予的权限，承运人仍须根据本公约规定对全部运输负责。

Query_Text_en: The carrier is responsible , in relation to the carriage performed by the actual carrier , for the acts and omissions of the actual carrier and of his servants and agents acting within the scope of their employment .
Translation: 就实际承运人履行的运输而言，承运人应当对实际承运人及其受雇人、代理人在受雇或受委托范围内的作为与不作为负责。

Query_Text_en: All the provisions of this Convention governing the responsibility of the carrier also apply to the responsibility of the actual carrier for the carriage performed by him .
Translation: 本公约中所有关于承运人责任的规定，均适用于实际承运人对其所履行运输的责任。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of article 7 and of paragraph 2 of article 8 apply if an action is brought against a servant or agent of the actual carrier .
Translation: 如对实际承运人的受雇人或代理人提起诉讼，应适用第七条第2款、第3款及第八条第2款之规定。

Query_Text_en: Any special agreement under which the carrier assumes obligations not imposed by this Convention or waives rights conferrred by this Convention affects the actual carrier only if agreed to by him expressly and in writing .
Translation: 凡承运人根据任何特殊协议承担本公约未予规定的义务，或放弃本公约赋予的权利，必须经实际承运人以书面形式明示同意，方可对其产生效力。

Query_Text_en: Whether or not the actual carrier has so agreed , the carrier nevertheless remains bound by the obligations or waivers resulting from such special agreement .
Translation: 无论实际承运人是否同意，其仍须受该特别协议所产生义务或豁免的约束。

Query_Text_en: Where and to the extent that both the carrier and the actual carrier are liable , their liability is joint and several .
Translation: 凡承运人与实际承运人均负有赔偿责任时，二者应承担连带责任。

Query_Text_en: The aggregate of the amounts recoverable from the carrier , the actual carrier and their servants and agents shall not exceed the limits of liability provided for in this Convention .
Translation: 可向承运人、实际承运人及其受雇人和代理人追偿的总额，不得超过本公约规定的责任限额。

Query_Text_en: Nothing in this article shall prejudice any right of recourse as between the carrier and the actual carrier .
Translation: 本条规定不影响承运人与实际承运人之间的任何追偿权利。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of article 10 , where a contract of carriage by sea provides explicitly that a specified part of the carriage covered by the said contract is to be performed by a named person other than the carrier , the contract may also provide that the carrier is not liable for loss , damage or delay in delivery caused by an occurrence which , takes place while the goods are in the charge of the actual carrier during such part of the carriage .
Translation: 虽有第十条第一款之规定，如海上运输契约中明确约定该契约所包含的某一特定运输部分应由承运人以外的指定人员履行，则该契约亦可规定，对于货物在实际承运人掌管期间因事故造成的灭失、损坏或交付迟延，承运人不负赔偿责任。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , any stipulation limiting or excluding such liability is without effect if no judicial proceedings can be instituted against the actual carrier in a court competent under paragraph 1 or 2 of article 21 .
Translation: 然而，若无法根据第二十一条第一款或第二款规定向实际承运人具有管辖权的法院提起诉讼，则任何限制或免除该责任的条款均属无效。

Query_Text_en: The burden of proving that any loss , damage or delay in delivery has been caused by such an occurrence rests upon the carrier .
Translation: 承运人须举证证明货物的灭失、损坏或交付迟延系因该事件所致。

Query_Text_en: The actual carrier is responsible in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of article 10 for loss , damage or delay in delivery caused by an occurrence which takes place while the goods are in his charge .
Translation: 根据第十条第二款规定，实际承运人应对货物在其掌管期间发生的事故所导致的灭失、损坏或交付迟延承担责任。

Query_Text_en: The shipper is not liable for loss sustained by the carrier or the actual carrier , or for damage sustained by the ship , unless such loss or damage was caused by the fault or neglect of the shipper , his servants or agents .
Translation: 托运人对承运人或实际承运人所遭受的损失或船舶所遭受的损坏不负赔偿责任，除非这种损失或损坏是由于托运人、其受雇人或代理人的过失或疏忽所造成。

Query_Text_en: Nor is any servant or agent of the shipper liable for such loss or damage unless the loss or damage was caused by fault or neglect on his part .
Translation: 托运人的任何雇员或代理人对该损失或损害概不负责，除非该损失或损害系由其过失或疏忽所致。

Query_Text_en: The shipper must mark or lable in a suitable manner dangerous goods as dangerous .
Translation: 托运人须以适当方式对危险货物作出危险标识或标签。

Query_Text_en: Where the shipper hands over dangerous goods to the carrier or an actual carrier , as the case may be , the shipper must inform him of the dangerous character of the goods and , if necessary , of the precautions to be taken .
Translation: 当托运人将危险货物交付承运人或实际承运人时，必须告知其货物的危险性质，必要时还应说明需采取的预防措施。

Query_Text_en: If the shipper fails to do so and such carrier or actual carrier does not otherwise have knowledge of their dangerous character :
Translation: 若托运人未履行此项义务，且承运人或实际承运人并不知晓货物的危险性质：

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the goods may at any time be unloaded , destroyed or rendered innocuous , as the circumstances may require , without payment of compensation .
Translation: [b] 货物可随时根据实际情况予以卸货、销毁或无害化处理，且无需支付赔偿。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of paragraph 2 of this article may not be invoked by any person if during the carriage he has taken the goods in his charge with knowledge of their dangerous character .
Translation: 若承运人在运输过程中明知货物危险特性仍接收货物，则不得援引本条第二款规定。

Query_Text_en: If , in cases where the provisions of paragraph 2 , subparagraph [ b ] , of this article do not apply or may not be invoked , dangerous goods become an actual danger to life or property , they may be unloaded , destroyed or rendered innocuous , as the circumstances may require , without payment of compensation except where there is an obligation to contribute in general average or where the carrier is liable in accordance with the provisions of article 5 .
Translation: 如本条第2款第(二)项规定不适用或无法援引，而危险货物对生命或财产构成实际危险时，可依实际情况需要将其卸下、销毁或使之无害，且无需赔偿。但共同海损分摊义务或承运人根据第5条规定应承担赔偿责任的情形除外。

Query_Text_en: When the carrier or the actual carrier takes the goods in his charge , the carrier must , on demand of the shipper , issue to the shipper a bill of lading .
Translation: 当承运人或实际承运人接管货物时，应托运人要求，承运人必须向托运人签发提单。

Query_Text_en: The bill of lading may be signed by a person having authority from the carrier .
Translation: 提单可由承运人授权之人签署。

Query_Text_en: A bill of lading signed by the master of the ship carrying the goods is deemed to have been signed on behalf of the carrier .
Translation: 经承运货物船舶船长签署的提单，视为代表承运人签发。

Query_Text_en: The signature on the bill of lading may be in handwriting , printed in facsimile , perforated , stamped , in symbols , or made by any other mechanical or electronic means , if not inconsistent with the law of the country where the bill of lading is issued .
Translation: 提单上的签字可以手写、印刷、打孔、盖章、使用符号，或采用其他任何机械或电子方式完成，只要不违反提单签发地所在国的法律。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the general nature of the goods , the leading marks necessary for identification of the goods , an express statement , if applicable , as to the dangerous character of the goods , the number of packages or pieces , and the weight of the goods or their quantity otherwise expressed , all such particulars as furnished by the shipper ;
Translation: 货物的通用名称、识别货物所需的主要标记，如适用，应明确声明货物的危险性质、包装件数或件数，以及货物的重量或以其他方式表示的数量，所有此类细节均由托运人提供；

Query_Text_en: [ 0 ] any increased limit or limits of liability where agreed in accordance with paragraph 4 of article 6 .
Translation: [ 0 ] 根据第六条第4款商定的任何责任限额提高。

Query_Text_en: After the goods have been loaded on board , if the shipper so demands , the carrier must issue to the shipper a `` shipped '' bill of lading which , in addition to the particulars required under paragraph 1 of this article , must state that the goods are on board a named ship or ships , and the date or dates of loading .
Translation: 货物装船后，如托运人提出要求，承运人必须向托运人签发"已装船"提单。该提单除载明本条第一款规定的事项外，还须注明货物已装上指定船舶及装船日期。

Query_Text_en: If the carrier has previously issued to the shipper a bill of lading or other document of title with respect to any of such goods , on request of the carrier the shipper must surrender such document in exchange for a `` shipped '' bill of lading .
Translation: 若承运人此前已就相关货物向托运人签发提单或其他物权凭证，经承运人要求，托运人须交还该等单据以换取"已装船"提单。

Query_Text_en: The carrier may amend any previously issued document in order to meet the shipper 's demand for a `` shipped '' bill of lading if , as amended , such document includes all the information required to be contained in a `` shipped '' bill of lading .
Translation: 承运人可应托运人要求修改先前签发的运输单据，使其转为"已装船"提单，但修改后的单据须包含"已装船"提单所要求的全部信息。

Query_Text_en: The absence in the bill of lading of one or more particulars referred to in this article does not affect the legal character of the document as a bill of lading provided that it nevertheless meets the requirements set out in paragraph 7 of article 1 .
Translation: 提单中缺少本条所指的一项或多项记载事项，并不影响其作为提单的法律性质，但该单据须符合第一条第7款所规定的要求。

Query_Text_en: If the bill of lading contains particulars concerning the general nature , leading marks , number of packages or pieces , weight or quantity of the goods which the carrier or other person issuing the bill of lading on his behalf knows or has reasonable grounds to suspect do not accurately represent the goods actually taken over or , where a `` shipped '' bill of lading is issued , loaded , or if he had no reasonable means of checking such particulars , the carrier or such other person must insert in the bill of lading a reservation specifying these inaccuracies , grounds of suspicion or the absence of reasonable means of checking .
Translation: 如承运人或代其签发提单的其他人确知或有合理根据怀疑提单所载有关货物的品类、主要标志、包数或件数、重量或数量等事项，未能准确代表实际接管的货物，或在签发"已装船"提单时上述项目未能准确代表实际装船的货物，或无适当方法核对上述事项时，该承运人或其代理人必须在提单上作出保留，注明不符之处、怀疑根据或无适当核对方法。

Query_Text_en: If the carrier or other person issuing the bill of lading on his behalf fails to note on the bill of lading the apparent condition of the goods , he is deemed to have noted on the bill of lading that the goods were in apparent good condition .
Translation: 如承运人或代其签发提单的其他人未在提单上批注货物表面状况，则应视为其已在提单上注明货物表面状况良好。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] proof to the contrary by the carrier is not admissible if the bill of lading has been transferred to a third party , including a consignee , who in good faith has acted in reliance on the description of the goods therein .
Translation: 若提单已转让给善意信赖提单所载货物描述而采取行动的第三方（包括收货人），则承运人提出的相反证据不予采信。

Query_Text_en: A bill of lading which does not , as provided in paragraph 1 , subparagraph [ k ] , of article 15 , set forth the freight or otherwise indicate that freight is payable by the consignee or does not set forth demurrage incurred at the port of loading payable by the consignee , is prima facie evidence that no freight or such demurrage is payable by him .
Translation: 如提单未按第十五条第一款第（十一）项规定载明运费，或以其他方式表明运费由收货人支付，且未载明装货港发生的滞期费由收货人承担，则该提单即为收货人无须支付运费或滞期费的初步证据。

Query_Text_en: However , proof to the contrary by the carrier is not admissible when the bill of lading has been transferred to a third party , including a consignee , who in good faith has acted in reliance on the absence in the bill of lading of any such indication .
Translation: 但当提单已转让给善意信赖提单上无此类批注的第三方（包括收货人）时，承运人提出的相反证据不予采信。

Query_Text_en: The shipper is deemed to have guaranteed to the carrier the accuracy of particulars relating to the general nature of the goods , their marks , number , weight and quantity as furnished by him for insertion in the bill of lading .
Translation: 托运人应被视为已向承运人保证，由其提供的、为载入提单而申报的货物一般性质、标志、件数、重量及数量等各项细节均属准确无误。

Query_Text_en: The shipper must indemnify the carrier against the loss resulting from inaccuracies in such particulars .
Translation: 托运人须就此类信息不准确所导致的损失向承运人作出赔偿。

Query_Text_en: The shipper remains liable even if the bill of lading has been transferred by him .
Translation: 即使提单已由托运人转让，其仍须承担相应责任。

Query_Text_en: The right of the carrier to such indemnity in no way limits his liability under the contract of carriage by sea to any person other than the shipper .
Translation: 承运人享有的此项赔偿权利，绝不减轻其根据海上运输合同对托运人以外的任何其他当事人所应承担的赔偿责任。

Query_Text_en: Any letter of guarantee or agreement by which the shipper undertakes to indemnify the carrier against loss resulting from the issuance of the bill of lading by the carrier , or by a person acting on his behalf , without entering a reservation relating to particulars furnished by the shipper for insertion in the bill of lading , or to the apparent condition of the goods , is void and of no effect as against any third party , including a consignee , to whom the bill of lading has been transferred .
Translation: 凡属托运人向承运人保证赔偿其因未就托运人提供载入提单的事项或货物表面状况批注保留而签发提单所引起损失的保函或协议，对包括受让提单的收货人在内的第三方一概无效。

Query_Text_en: Such letter of guarantee or agreement is valid as against the shipper unless the carrier or the person acting on his behalf , by omitting the reservation referred to in paragraph 2 of this article , intends to defraud a third party , including a consignee , who acts in reliance on the description of the goods in the bill of lading .
Translation: 此类保函或协议对托运人有效，但承运人或其代理人若故意遗漏本条第二款所述保留事项，意图欺诈包括信赖提单所载货物描述的收货人在内的第三方时除外。

Query_Text_en: In the latter case , if the reservation omitted relates to particulars furnished by the shipper for insertion in the bill of lading , the carrier has no right of indemnity from the shipper pursuant to paragraph 1 of this article .
Translation: 在后一种情况下，若所涉保留事项与托运人提供并载入提单的细节有关，则承运人无权依据本条第一款向托运人追偿。

Query_Text_en: In the case of intended fraud referred to in paragraph 3 of this article , the carrier is liable , without the benefit of the limitation of liability provided for in this Convention , for the loss incurred by a third party , including a consignee , because he has acted in reliance on the description of the goods in the bill of lading .
Translation: 如发生本条第三款所述的蓄意欺诈行为，承运人不得援引本公约规定的责任限制，须对第三方（包括收货人）因信赖提单所载货物描述而遭受的损失承担赔偿责任。

Query_Text_en: Where a carrier issues a document other than a bill of lading to evidence the receipt of the goods to be carried , such a document is prima facie evidence of the conclusion of the contract of carriage by sea and the taking over by the carrier of the goods as therein described .
Translation: 承运人签发提单以外的单证用以证明收到待运货物的，此类单证即为订立海上运输合同和承运人接管该单证中所载货物的初步证据。

Query_Text_en: Unless notice of loss or damage , specifying the general nature of such loss or damage , is given in writing by the consignee to the carrier not later than the working day after the day when the goods were handed over to the consignee , such handing over is prima facie evidence of the delivery by the carrier of the goods as described in the document of transport or , if no such document has been issued , in good condition .
Translation: 收货人须以书面形式将货物灭失或损坏的一般性质通知承运人，且该通知不得迟于货物交付收货人之日的次日工作日。若未按时提交此类通知，则货物交付即构成承运人已按运输单据所载状况交付货物的初步证据；如未签发此类单据，则视为货物已完好交付。

Query_Text_en: Where the loss or damage is not apparent , the provisions of paragraph 1 of this article apply correspondingly if notice in writing is not given within 15 consecutive days after the day when the goods were handed over to the consignee .
Translation: 若灭失或损坏不明显，在货物交付收货人之日起连续十五日内未提交书面通知的，则本条第1款规定相应适用。

Query_Text_en: If the state of the goods at the time they were handed over to the consignee has been the subject of a joint surveyor inspection by the parties , notice in writing need not be given of loss or damage ascertained during such surveyor inspection .
Translation: 若货物交付收货人时的状态已由双方共同检验，则检验期间确定的货损无需另行书面通知。

Query_Text_en: In the case of any actual or apprehended loss or damage , the carrier and the consignee must give all reasonable facilities to each other for inspecting and tallying the goods .
Translation: 如发生实际或可能发生的灭失或损坏，承运人与收货人须相互提供一切合理便利，以便对方检验和核对货物。

Query_Text_en: No compensation shall be payable for loss resulting from delay in delivery unless a notice has been given in writing to the carrier within 60 consecutive days after the day when the goods were handed over to the consignee .
Translation: 承运人对迟延交付造成的损失不予赔偿，除非在货物交付收货人之日起连续六十日内已向承运人提交书面通知。

Query_Text_en: If the goods have been delivered by an actual carrier , any notice given under this article to him shall have the same effect as if it had been given to the carrier , and any notice given to the carrier shall have effect as if given to such actual carrier .
Translation: 如货物已由实际承运人交付，根据本条款向其发出的任何通知，其效力等同于向承运人发出；而向承运人发出的任何通知，其效力亦等同于向该实际承运人发出。

Query_Text_en: Unless notice of loss or damage , specifying the general nature of the loss or damage , is given in writing by the carrier or actual carrier to the shipper not later than 90 consecutive days after the occurrence of such loss or damage or after the delivery of the goods in accordance with paragraph 2 of article 4 , whichever is later , the failure to give such notice is prima facie evidence that the carrier or the actual carrier has sustained no loss or damage due to the fault or neglect of the shipper , his servants or agents .
Translation: 承运人或实际承运人未在货物灭失或损坏发生之日起连续90日内，或按照第4条第2款规定交付货物之日起（以较迟发生者为准），向托运人提交载明灭失或损坏一般性质的书面通知，则未提交该通知即构成初步证据，表明承运人或实际承运人未因托运人、其受雇人或代理人的过失或疏忽而遭受任何灭失或损坏。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of this article , notice given to a person acting on the carrier 's or the actual carrier 's behalf , including the master or the officer in charge of the ship , or to a person acting on the shipper 's behalf is deemed to have been given to the carrier , to the actual carrier or to the shipper , respectively .
Translation: 就本条而言，向承运人或实际承运人的受雇人、代理人（包括船长或船舶负责人）以及托运人的受雇人、代理人发出的通知，视为已分别向承运人、实际承运人或托运人发出。

Query_Text_en: Any action relating to carriage of goods under this Convention is time-barred if judicial or arbitral proceedings have not been instituted within a period of two years .
Translation: 根据本公约，与货物运输相关的任何诉讼或仲裁程序若未在两年期限内提起，则相关权利即告时效消灭。

Query_Text_en: The limitation period commences on the day on which the carrier has delivered the goods or part thereof or , in cases where no goods have been delivered , on the last day on which the goods should have been delivered .
Translation: 诉讼时效自承运人交付货物或部分货物之日起算；在货物未交付情形下，自货物应交付之最后日起算。

Query_Text_en: The day on which the limitation period commences is not included in the period .
Translation: 时效期间的起算日不计入该期间。

Query_Text_en: The person against whom a claim is made may at any time during the running of the limitation period extend that period by a declaration in writing to the claimant .
Translation: 被索赔方可在时效期间内的任何时间，以书面声明方式向索赔方提出延长该时效期限。

Query_Text_en: This period may be further extended by another declaration or declarations .
Translation: 该期限可通过一项或多项声明进一步延长。

Query_Text_en: An action for indemnity by a person held liable may be instituted even after the expiration of the limitation period provided for in the preceding paragraphs if instituted within the time allowed by the law of the State where proceedings are instituted .
Translation: 即使前款规定的时效期限已届满，被追责者仍可在提起诉讼地国家法律允许的时限内提起损害赔偿之诉。

Query_Text_en: However , the time allowed shall not be less than 90 days commencing from the day when the person instituting such action for indemnity has settled the claim or has been served with process in the action against himself .
Translation: 但该时限自提起追偿诉讼的一方解决索赔或收到对其本人提起诉讼的传票之日起算，不得少于90日。

Query_Text_en: In judicial proceedings relating to carriage of goods under this Convention the plaintiff , at his option , may institute an action in a court which according to the law of the State where the court is situated , is competent and within the jurisdiction of which is situated one of the following places :
Translation: 根据本公约提起的货物运输司法程序中，原告有权选择向法院提起诉讼，该法院依照其所在国法律应具有管辖权，且下列地点之一位于其管辖范围内：

Query_Text_en: [ d ] any additional place designated for that purpose in the contract of carriage by sea .
Translation: [ d ] 海上运输合同中为此目的指定的任何其他地点。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this article , an action may be instituted in the courts of any port or place in a Contracting State at which the carrying vessel or any other vessel of the same ownership may have been arrested in accordance with applicable rules of the law of that State and of international law .
Translation: 虽有本条前述规定，仍可在承运船舶或同一船东所属其他船舶根据该缔约国法律和国际法相关规则被扣押的任何港口或地点的缔约国法院提起诉讼。

Query_Text_en: However , in such a case , at the petition of the defendant , the claimant must remove the action , at his choice , to one of the jurisdictions referred to in paragraph 1 of this article for the determination of the claim , but before such removal the defendant must furnish security sufficient to ensure payment of any judgement that may subsequently be awarded to the claimant in the action .
Translation: 然而，在此情形下，经被告申请，原告须自行选择将诉讼移交至本条第一款所列任一管辖地以裁决索赔请求；但在移交前，被告须提供足额担保，以确保后续可能判给原告的任何赔偿得以支付。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] All questions relating to the sufficiency or otherwise of the security shall be determined by the court of the port or place of the arrest .
Translation: 有关担保是否充分的一切问题，应由实施扣押的港口或地点的法院裁定。

Query_Text_en: No judicial proceedings relating to carriage of goods under this Convention may be instituted in a place not specified in paragraph 1 or 2 of this article .
Translation: 凡与本公约项下货物运输相关的司法程序，均不得在本条第1款或第2款未列明的地点提起。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of this paragraph do not constitute an obstacle to the jurisdiction of the Contracting States for provisional or protective measures .
Translation: 本款规定不妨碍缔约国采取临时或保全措施的管辖权。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Where an action has been instituted in a court competent under paragraph 1 or 2 of this article or where judgement has been delivered by such a court , no new action may be started between the same parties on the same grounds unless the judgement of the court before which the first action was instituted is not enforceable in the country in which the new proceedings are instituted ;
Translation: 若诉讼已依本条第一款或第二款于有管辖权的法院提起，或该法院已作出判决，则相同当事人不得基于相同事由再次提起诉讼，除非首次诉讼受理法院所作判决在新诉讼提起国境内无法执行。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] For the purpose of this article , the institution of measures with a view to obtaining enforcement of a judgement is not to be considered as the starting of a new action ;
Translation: [ b ] 就本文而言，为执行判决而采取的措施不视为提起新的诉讼；

Query_Text_en: [ c ] For the purpose of this article , the removal of an action to a different court within the same country , or to a court in another country , in accordance with paragraph 2 [ a ] of this article , is not to be considered as the starting of a new action .
Translation: 就本条而言，依据本条第2款第a项将诉讼移转至同一国家内另一法院或另一国家法院的行为，不应视为提起新的诉讼。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraphs , an agreement made by the parties , after a claim under the contract of carriage by sea has arisen , which designates the place where the claimant may institute an action , is effective .
Translation: 虽有前款规定，在海上货物运输索赔发生后，当事人就索赔诉讼管辖地另行达成协议的，该协议具有效力。

Query_Text_en: Subject to the provisions of this article , parties may provide by agreement evidenced in writing that any dispute that may arise relating to carriage of goods under this Convention shall be referred to arbitration .
Translation: 根据本条规定，当事人可以书面协议约定，将本公约货物运输中可能产生的任何争议提交仲裁。

Query_Text_en: Where a charter-party contains a provision that disputes arising thereunder shall be referred to arbitration and a bill of lading issued pursuant to the charter-party does not contain a special annotation providing that such provision shall be binding upon the holder of the bill of lading , the carrier may not invoke . such provision as against a holder having acquired the bill of lading in good faith .
Translation: 凡租船合同载有相应纠纷应提交仲裁的条款，而依据该合同签发的提单并未特别注明该条款对提单持有人具有约束力时，承运人不得援引该条款对抗善意取得提单的持有人。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] any place designated for that purpose in the arbitration clause or agreement .
Translation: [ b ] 仲裁条款或协议中为此目的指定的任何地点。

Query_Text_en: The arbitrator or arbitration tribunal shall apply the rules of this Convention .
Translation: 仲裁员或仲裁庭应适用本公约之规定。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of paragraphs 3 and 4 of this article are deemed to be part of every arbitration clause or agreement , and any term of such clause or agreement which is inconsistent therewith is null and void .
Translation: 本条第3款和第4款之规定应视为仲裁条款或协议之一部分，凡与该等条款相抵触之约定概属无效。

Query_Text_en: Nothing in this article affects the validity of an agreement relating to arbitration made by the parties after the claim under the contract of carriage by sea has arisen .
Translation: 本条不影响海上运输合同索赔发生后各方达成的仲裁协议的效力。

Query_Text_en: Any stipulation in a contract of carriage by sea , in a bill of lading , or in any other document evidencing the contract of carriage by sea is null and void to the extent that it derogates , directly or indirectly , from the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 海上货物运输合同、提单或其他运输单证中的任何条款，凡直接或间接背离本公约规定的，概属无效。

Query_Text_en: The nullity of such a stipulation does not affect the validity of the other provisions of the contract or document of which it forms a part .
Translation: 该条款无效不影响其所属合同或文件其他条款的效力。

Query_Text_en: A clause assigning benefit of insurance of goods in favor of the carrier , or any similar clause , is null and void .
Translation: 任何将货物保险利益转让给承运人的条款，或任何类似条款，均属无效。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of this article , a carrier may increase his responsibilities and obligations under this Convention .
Translation: 虽有本条第一款规定，承运人仍可依据本公约增加其责任和义务。

Query_Text_en: Where a bill of lading or any other document evidencing the contract of carriage by sea is issued , it must contain a statement that the carriage is subject to the provisions of this Convention which nullify any stipulation derogating therefrom to the detriment of the shipper or the consignee .
Translation: 凡签发提单或证明海上运输合同的其他单证时，此类单证必须载明运输受本公约各项规定约束的条款，任何有损于托运人或收货人利益的背离本公约的免责条款均属无效。

Query_Text_en: Where the claimant in respect of the goods has incurred loss as a result of a stipulation which is null and void by virtue of the present article , or as a result of the omission of the statement referred to in paragraph 3 of this article , the carrier must pay compensation to the extent required in order to give the claimant compensation in accordance with the provisions of this Convention for any loss of or damage to the goods as well as for delay in delivery .
Translation: 若货物索赔人因本条规定而无效的条款或因本条第三款所述声明之遗漏遭受损失，承运人须按本公约规定就货物灭失、损坏及交付迟延支付赔偿，以使索赔人获得足额补偿。

Query_Text_en: The carrier must , in addition , pay compensation for costs incurred by the claimant for the purpose of exercising his right , provided that costs incurred in the action where the foregoing provision is invoked are to be determined in accordance with the law of the State where proceedings are instituted .
Translation: 此外，承运人还须赔偿索赔人为行使权利所支出的费用。但援引前款规定提起诉讼时产生的费用，应按照诉讼受理地国家的法律予以确定。

Query_Text_en: Nothing in this Convention shall prevent the application of provisions in the contract of carriage by sea or national law regarding the adjustment of general average .
Translation: 本公约概不影响有关共同海损理算之海上运输合同条款或国内法规定之适用。

Query_Text_en: With the exception of article 20 , the provisions of this Convention relating to the liability of the carrier for loss of or damage to the goods also determine whether the consignee may refuse contribution in general average and the liability of the carrier to indemnify the consignee in respect of any such contribution made or any salvage paid .
Translation: 除第二十条外，本公约关于承运人对货物灭失或损坏应负赔偿责任的规定，亦适用于收货人能否拒绝共同海损分摊及承运人就收货人所作任何此项分摊或所付救助费用应否给予赔偿的情形。

Query_Text_en: This Convention does not modify the rights or duties of the carrier , the actual carrier and their servants and agents provided for in international conventions or national law relating to the limitation of liability of owners of seagoing ships .
Translation: 本公约不改变承运人、实际承运人及其受雇人或代理人在有关海运船舶所有人责任限制的国际公约或国内法中所规定的权利与义务。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of articles 21 and 22 of this Convention do not prevent the application of the mandatory provisions of any other multilateral convention already in force at the date of this Convention relating to matters dealt with in the said articles , provided that the dispute arises exclusively between parties having their principal place of business in States members of such other convention .
Translation: 本公约第二十一条和第二十二条的规定，不妨碍在公约生效时已生效的任何其他多边公约中有关上述条款处理事项的强制性规定的适用，但以争议仅发生在该其他公约成员国境内设有主要营业地的各方之间为限。

Query_Text_en: However , this paragraph does not affect the application of paragraph 4 of article 22 of this Convention .
Translation: 但本段规定不影响本公约第二十二条第四款的适用。

Query_Text_en: No liability shall arise under the provisions of this Convention for damage caused by a nuclear incident if the operator of a nuclear installation is liable for such damage :
Translation: 根据本公约条款，如核设施运营者须对核事故造成的损害承担责任，则本公约不产生任何赔偿责任。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] by virtue of national law governing the liability for such damage , provided that such law is in all respects as favourable to persons who may suffer damage as is either the Paris Convention or the Vienna Convention .
Translation: [ b ] 依据管辖此类损害责任的国家法律，但该法律须在所有方面对可能遭受损害的人员至少与《巴黎公约》或《维也纳公约》同等有利。

Query_Text_en: No liability shall arise under the provisions of this Convention for any loss of or damage to or delay in delivery of luggage for which the carrier is responsible under any international convention or national law relating to the carriage of passengers and their luggage by sea .
Translation: 根据本公约规定，承运人对旅客及其海上行李运输所适用的任何国际公约或国内法项下应负责的行李灭失、损坏或交付迟延，概不承担赔偿责任。

Query_Text_en: Nothing contained in this Convention prevents a Contracting State from applying any other international convention which is already in force at the date of this Convention and which applies mandatorily to contracts of carriage of goods primarily by a mode of transport other than transport by sea .
Translation: 本公约之任何规定，均不妨碍缔约国在本公约生效之日已生效且强制适用于以海运以外运输方式为主的货物运输合同的任何其他国际公约的适用。

Query_Text_en: This provision also applies to any subsequent revision or amendment of such international convention .
Translation: 本条款同样适用于对该国际公约的任何后续修订或修正。

Query_Text_en: The unit of account referred to in article 6 of this Convention is the special drawing right as defined by the International Monetary Fund .
Translation: 本公约第六条所述记账单位，系国际货币基金组织所定义的特别提款权。

Query_Text_en: The amounts mentioned in article 6 are to be converted into the national currency of a State according to the value of such currency at the date of judgement or the date agreed upon by the parties .
Translation: 第六条所述金额应按判决当日或当事人双方约定之日的汇率折算为缔约国本国货币。

Query_Text_en: The value of a national currency , in terms of the special drawing right , of a Contracting State which is a member of the International Monetary Fund is to be calculated in accordance with the method of valuation applied by the International Monetary Fund in effect at the date in question for its operations and transactions .
Translation: 作为国际货币基金组织成员国的缔约国，其本国货币与特别提款权的折算比率，应按照国际货币基金组织在该日期实际适用的业务交易计价方法计算。

Query_Text_en: The value of a national currency , in terms of the special drawing right , of a Contracting State which is not a member of the International Monetary Fund is to be calculated in a manner determined by that State .
Translation: 对于非国际货币基金组织成员国的缔约国，其国家货币与特别提款权的折算比率，应由该国自行确定计算方式。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , those States which are not members of the International Monetary Fund and whose law does not permit the application of the provisions of paragraph 1 of this article may , at the time of signature , or at the time of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession or at any time thereafter , declare that the limits of liability provided for in this Convention to be applied in their territories shall be fixed as 12,500 monetary units per package or other shipping unit or 37.5 monetary units per kilogram of gross weight of the goods .
Translation: 然而，非国际货币基金组织成员国且其国内法不允许适用本条第一款规定的国家，可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入本公约时或其后的任何时间声明：本公约规定的责任限额在其领土内适用时，应确定为每件或其他货运单位12,500货币单位，或按货物毛重每公斤37.5货币单位。

Query_Text_en: The monetary unit referred to in paragraph 2 of this article corresponds to sixty-five and a half milligrams of gold of millesimal fineness nine hundred .
Translation: 本条第2款所述货币单位相当于纯度为千分之九百的六十五点五毫克黄金。

Query_Text_en: The conversion of the amounts referred to in paragraph 2 into the national currency is to be made according to the law of the State concerned .
Translation: 第二款所述金额折算为本国货币时，应依照相关国家法律执行。

Query_Text_en: The calculation mentioned in the last sentence of paragraph 1 and the conversion mentioned in paragraph 3 of this article is to be made in such a manner as to express in the national currency of the Contracting State as far as possible the same real value for the amounts in article 6 as is expressed there in units of account .
Translation: 本条第1款末句所述计算及第3款所述折算，应尽可能使第6条所列数额以缔约国本国货币表示时，与其以记账单位表示的实值相同。

Query_Text_en: Contracting States must communicate to the depositary the manner of calculation pursuant to paragraph 1 of this article , or the result of the conversion mentioned in paragraph 3 of this article , as the case may be , at the time of signature or when depositing their instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , or when availing themselves of the option provided for in paragraph 2 of this article and whenever there is a change in the manner of such calculation or in the result of such conversion .
Translation: 缔约国须在签署、交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，或根据本条第二款行使选择权时，以及每当计算方式或换算结果发生变更时，视情况向保存人通报本条第一款所述的计算方法，或第三款所述的换算结果。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General of the United Nations is hereby designated as the depositary of this Convention .
Translation: 兹指定联合国秘书长为本公约保管人。

Query_Text_en: This Convention is open for signature by all States until 30 April 1979 at the Headquarters of the United Nations , New York .
Translation: 本公约自即日起至1979年4月30日止，在纽约联合国总部开放供所有国家签署。

Query_Text_en: This Convention is subject to ratification , acceptance or approval by the signatory States .
Translation: 本公约须经签署国批准、接受或核准。

Query_Text_en: After 30 April 1979 , this Convention will be open for accession by all States which are not signatory States .
Translation: 1979年4月30日后，本公约将开放供所有非签署国加入。

Query_Text_en: Instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval and accession are to be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 批准书、接受书、核准书及加入书应交存联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: No reservations may be made to this Convention .
Translation: 本公约不得作出任何保留。

Query_Text_en: This Convention enters into force on the first day of the month following the expiration of one year from the date of deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 本公约自第二十份批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存之日起满一年后的次月首日生效。

Query_Text_en: For each State which becomes a Contracting State to this Convention after the date of the deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , this Convention enters into force on the first day of the month following the expiration of one year after the deposit of the appropriate instrument on behalf of that State .
Translation: 对于在本公约第二十份批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书交存之日后成为缔约国的国家，本公约自该国交存适当文书之日起满一年后的次月首日对其生效。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting State shall apply the provisions of this Convention to contracts of carriage by sea concluded on or after the date of the entry into force of this Convention in respect of that State .
Translation: 各缔约国应将本公约的各项规定适用于在本公约对该国生效之日或其后签订的海上运输合同。

Query_Text_en: Upon becoming a Contracting State to this Convention , any State Party to the International Convention for the Unification of certain Rules relating to Bills of Lading signed at Brussels on 25 August 1924 [ 1924 Convention ] must notify the Government of Belgium as the depositary of the 1924 Convention of its denunciation of the said Convention with a declaration that the denunciation is to take effect as from the date when this Convention enters into force in respect of that State .
Translation: 任何国家在成为本公约缔约国时，若已为1924年8月25日在布鲁塞尔签署的《统一提单若干法律规则国际公约》（《1924年公约》）的缔约国，必须通知比利时政府——即《1924年公约》保管机关——其退出该公约，并声明此项退出自本公约对该国生效之日起实施。

Query_Text_en: Upon the entry into force of this Convention under paragraph 1 of article 30 , the depositary of this Convention must notify the Government of Belgium as the depositary of the 1924 Convention of the date of such entry into force , and of the names of the Contracting States in respect of which the Convention has entered into force .
Translation: 本公约依照第三十条第1款生效后，保管人须将生效日期及公约对其生效的缔约国名单通知1924年公约保管机关比利时政府。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this article apply correspondingly in respect of States Parties to the Protocol signed on 23 February 1968 to amend the International Convention for the Unification of certain Rules relating to Bills of Lading signed at Brussels on 25 August 1924 .
Translation: 本条第1款和第2款的规定同样适用于1968年2月23日签署的《修订1924年8月25日在布鲁塞尔签订的关于统一提单若干规则的国际公约的议定书》的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding article 2 of this Convention , for the purposes of paragraph 1 of this article , a Contracting State may , if it deems it desirable , defer the denunciation of the 1924 Convention and of the 1924 Convention as modified by the 1968 Protocol for a maximum period of five years from the entry into force of this Convention .
Translation: 虽有本公约第二条规定，就本条第一款而言，缔约国若认为必要，可推迟对1924年公约及经1968年议定书修订的1924年公约的退出，推迟期限自本公约生效之日起最长不超过五年。

Query_Text_en: It will then notify the Government of Belgium of its intention .
Translation: 比利时政府将收到相关意向通知。

Query_Text_en: During this transitory period , it must apply to the Contracting States this Convention to the exclusion of any other one .
Translation: 在此过渡期内，本公约应仅适用于缔约国，排除其他任何公约的适用。

Query_Text_en: At the request of not less than one third of the Contracting States to this Convention , the depositary shall convene a conference of the Contracting States for revising or amending it .
Translation: 应本公约不少于三分之一缔约国要求，保存人应召集缔约国会议，以修订或修正本公约。

Query_Text_en: Any instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession deposited after the entry into force of an amendment to this Convention is deemed to apply to the Convention as amended .
Translation: 在本公约修正案生效后交存的任何批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书，应视为适用于修正后的公约。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of article 32 , a conference only for the purpose of altering the amount specified in article 6 and paragraph 2 of article 26 , or of substituting either or both of the units defined in paragraphs 1 and 3 of article 26 by other units is to be convened by the depositary in accordance with paragraph 2 of this article .
Translation: 虽有第三十二条规定，但若仅为修改第六条及第二十六条第二款所述金额，或以其他单位替代第二十六条第一款及第三款所述单位而召开会议时，应由保存人依照本条第二款之规定予以召集。

Query_Text_en: An alteration of the amounts shall be made only because of a significant change in their real value .
Translation: 仅当其实际价值发生重大变化时，方可调整金额。

Query_Text_en: A revision conference is to be convened by the depositary when not less than one fourth of the Contracting States so request .
Translation: 当不少于四分之一缔约国提出请求时，保存人应召开修订会议。

Query_Text_en: The deep sea is one of the newest and most exciting frontiers of the offshore construction industry .
Translation: 深海是海洋工程领域最新颖且最具发展潜力的前沿阵地。

Query_Text_en: The discovery of giant fields for oil and gas in deep water has presented a major challenge to the industry , resulting in remarkable developments in the way of equipment , procedures , instrumentation , and remote operations .
Translation: 深水区大型油气田的发现给石油工业带来了重大挑战，由此推动了设备、作业流程、仪器仪表及远程操控技术的显著革新。

Query_Text_en: When the first edition of this book was written in 1986 , the demarcation had risen and the term Deep Sea was being applied to platforms and pipelines in 500 m.
Translation: 1986年本书首版问世时，这一界定标准已有所提升，"深海"概念开始适用于500米水深的海上平台与管道设施。

Query_Text_en: By the year 2000 , the second edition was able to report that bottom-supported platforms were being constructed in over 500 m water depth , and subsea operations , supported by floating production , storage and offloading [ FPSO ] spars , Tension-Leg Platforms [ TLPs ] , and drilling vessels , were in place in 1600 m.
Translation: 截至2000年第二版报告发布时，海底支撑式平台的建设水深已突破500米，而依托浮式生产储卸油装置（FPSO）、张力腿平台（TLP）及钻井船等设施的水下作业系统，其作业水深更达到1600米。

Query_Text_en: ROVs capable of 2500 m and even 3000 m were then available .
Translation: 当时已具备2500米甚至3000米作业能力的遥控潜水器。

Query_Text_en: Drill ships were being constructed to work in 3000 m , which is almost the maximum depth of the Gulf of Mexico .
Translation: 钻探船正在建造中，可在3000米水深作业，这一深度已接近墨西哥湾的最大深度。

Query_Text_en: Currently , the previous limits are being exceeded on all fronts .
Translation: 当前，各项原有限制正被全面突破。

Query_Text_en: Deep water operations are now being carried out in the Gulf of Mexico , West Africa , Brazil , and indeed worldwide .
Translation: 目前，墨西哥湾、西非、巴西乃至全球范围内均已开展深水作业。

Query_Text_en: a. Tension leg semi-submersible , Magnolia , in 1425 m
Translation: a. 张力腿半潜式平台"木兰号"，作业水深1425米

Query_Text_en: b. Fixed Jacket-Pin Pile , Bullwinkle , 412 m
Translation: b. 固定式导管架桩基结构"布尔温克尔"，高度412米

Query_Text_en: c. Compliant Piled Towers , Petronius , in 534 m
Translation: c. 合规桩基式塔架，如"彼得罗尼乌斯"平台，高度达534米

Query_Text_en: e. Semi-submersibles , Independence Head [ moored with slightly inclined legs ] , 2438 m. Thunder Horse is in 1844 m.
Translation: e. 半潜式平台"独立号"（采用轻微倾斜桩腿系泊），作业水深2438米。"雷马"平台作业水深为1844米。

Query_Text_en: f. Blind Faith will be in 2100 m depth .
Translation: f. "盲目信仰"号将下潜至2100米深度。

Query_Text_en: Pipelines , flow lines , and risers have been installed to subsea completions such as the Mensa project [ 1700 m ] and for the Exxon Spar project in 1600 m.
Translation: 海底完井项目如门萨油田（水深1700米）和埃克森公司斯帕项目（水深1600米）已铺设管道管线、出油管及立管系统。

Query_Text_en: Discoveries have been made in depths of 2000-2400 m.
Translation: 在2000至2400米深度范围内已取得重大发现。

Query_Text_en: Military activities , such as the deployment of acoustic sensors for recovery of armament and equipment , including retrieval of parts of a Soviet submarine , have been carried out at depths up to 6000 m.
Translation: 军事活动已在深达6000米的海域展开，包括部署声学传感器以回收武器装备，甚至打捞苏联潜艇残骸部件。

Query_Text_en: Test facilities for ocean thermal energy conversion [ OTEC ] have included pipelines suspended to a depth of 600 m.
Translation: 海洋热能转换（OTEC）的测试设施包括下潜至600米深度的管道系统。

Query_Text_en: Tests of manganese nodule mining equipment have been conducted at a depth of 2000 m.
Translation: 多金属结核采矿设备已在2000米水深完成测试。

Query_Text_en: The deep-sea frontier is rapidly emerging as an area of great potential .
Translation: 深海疆域正迅速崛起为极具发展潜力的战略要地。

Query_Text_en: Exploratory drilling for oil and gas has already been carried out at depths of over 3000 m.
Translation: 油气勘探钻井的深度已突破3000米。

Query_Text_en: The Deep Sea Drilling Project included the successful drilling and reentry of a hole at a depth of 6000 m.
Translation: 深海钻探计划成功实现了在6000米深度钻孔并重新进入的作业。

Query_Text_en: Potential exploitation of the polysulfide mineral deposits from midocean rifts will require specialized dredging operations , with equipment and materials capable of operating in hot brine .
Translation: 开发大洋中脊多金属硫化物矿床需采用特种采掘作业，所用设备材料须能在高温卤水环境中正常运行。

Query_Text_en: Manganese nodules are concentrated on plateaus and basins lying at 2000-4000 m depth , requiring efficient dredging systems capable of operating at such depths .
Translation: 锰结核富集于2000至4000米深的台地与海盆区域，需配备能在此深度作业的高效采集系统。

Query_Text_en: OTEC systems are generally based on the utilization of the cold water from 1000 m depth .
Translation: 海洋温差能发电系统通常利用1000米深处的冷水进行能量转换。

Query_Text_en: The floating structures for this concept may require mooring in 4000 m.
Translation: 该方案中的浮动结构可能需要系泊于4000米水深海域。

Query_Text_en: The deployment of sensor devices with cable moorings and of large surface and subsurface buoys has been carried out throughout almost the entire range of ocean depths .
Translation: 几乎在所有海洋深度范围内，均已部署带缆系泊的传感器装置以及大型水面和水下浮标。

Query_Text_en: Cables and pipelines have been installed for crossings of straits where the water depths range from 300 to 600 m.
Translation: 在300至600米水深的跨海峡区域，已铺设电缆与管道设施。

Query_Text_en: A bridge across the Strait of Gibraltar , for which the feasibility studies have been recently completed , will require piers in from 300 to 500 m of depth .
Translation: 近期完成可行性研究的直布罗陀海峡跨海大桥，其桥墩需建在水深300至500米的海域。

Query_Text_en: In 2001 , a gas line was laid across this same route .
Translation: 2001年，一条天然气管道沿相同路线铺设完成。

Query_Text_en: Studies and tests have been carried out by the U.S. Navy for mass concrete placements in the deep ocean .
Translation: 美国海军已就深海大体积混凝土浇筑开展了相关研究与测试。

Query_Text_en: Scientific exploration , such as that proposed to identify the existence of neutrinos , will require extensive deployment of cables , sensors , and moorings at extreme water depths .
Translation: 为探测中微子等前沿科学探索项目，需在极深海域大规模布设电缆、传感器及系泊设备。

Query_Text_en: The Deep Undersea Muon and Neutrino Detection [ DUMAND ] Project will involve the placement of an array of sensors 250 × 250 × 500 m in plan at a depth of 4500 m.
Translation: 深海μ介子与中微子探测（DUMAND）项目计划在4500米深的海底布设一个水平尺寸为250×250×500米的传感器阵列。

Query_Text_en: The Offshore Oil Industry has formed a study group to identify the problems of operations in Ultra Deep Water , defined as 1500-3000 m.
Translation: 离岸石油工业已成立专项研究小组，旨在识别超深水作业（定义为1500-3000米水深）中的技术难题。

Query_Text_en: Not only does the hydrostatic pressure double as the depth increases from 1500 to 3000 m , but there are increased problems from cold water and riser fatigue .
Translation: 随着水深从1500米增至3000米，不仅静水压力翻倍，冷水环境与立管疲劳引发的作业难题也更为突出。

Query_Text_en: Abandonment and recovery operations have been carried out in water depths of 500 m.
Translation: 弃置与回收作业已在500米水深海域完成。

Query_Text_en: For the purposes of this chapter , the deep sea will be defined as those depths at which manned intervention appears to be no longer economically practicable [ i.e. , 500 m and over ] and where hydrostatic pressures dominate design and construction , so that special-ized equipment , systems , and procedures become necessary .
Translation: 本章所述深海区域，系指载人作业在经济上已不可行（即水深500米及以上）、且静水压力成为设计与建造主导因素的海域。在此类海域作业需配备专用设备、系统及操作程序。

Query_Text_en: Extreme hydrostatic pressures
Translation: 极端静水压力

Query_Text_en: Density changes in liquids , including seawater , due to high pressure and low temperature
Translation: 高压低温条件下液体（包括海水）的密度变化

Query_Text_en: Reduction in volume of solids due to bulk modulus effects [ usually important only for low-modulus materials such as polyurethane foam ]
Translation: 体积模量效应导致的固体体积缩减[通常仅对低模量材料（如聚氨酯泡沫）有显著影响]

Query_Text_en: Absorption of water into concrete and other solids
Translation: 混凝土及其他固体材料的吸水性能

Query_Text_en: Absorption of gases into solids
Translation: 气体在固体中的吸收

Query_Text_en: Miscibility of water and other fluids
Translation: 水与其他流体的互溶性

Query_Text_en: Change in strength of materials due to high triaxial stress states
Translation: 高围压应力状态下材料强度的变化

Query_Text_en: Density and other currents at depths of 1000 m the currents may be of the following order : density currents : 0.2-0 .5 kt. ; internal wave-generated currents : up to 0.6 kt. ; tsunami currents : up to 0.6 kt .
Translation: 在1000米深度海域，各类海流流速大致如下：密度流0.2-0.5节；内波流最高达0.6节；海啸流最高达0.6节。

Query_Text_en: Currents may produce vortex shed-ding resulting in dynamic responses in long risers and strumming vibrations in long cables
Translation: 洋流可能引发涡旋脱落现象，导致长立管产生动态响应，并引发长电缆的流致振动。

Query_Text_en: Internal waves
Translation: 内波

Query_Text_en: Density layers [ stratification ] of the water column
Translation: 水体的密度分层

Query_Text_en: Leaks in seals of hydraulic systems , electrical connectors , etc. , due to high pressure
Translation: 液压系统密封件、电气连接器等部件因高压作用发生泄漏

Query_Text_en: Difficulty of control as a result of time lag in response of hydraulic systems due to the long length of lines .
Translation: 由于管线长度导致液压系统响应存在时滞，进而造成控制困难。

Query_Text_en: For this reason , deep sea well control devices use electro-hydraulic operation
Translation: 因此，深水井控装置采用电液联动操作。

Query_Text_en: Static and dynamic strains [ stretch ] in cables , casing , rods , etc. , due to long length ;
Translation: 由于长度较长，电缆、套管、杆件等会承受静态和动态应变[拉伸]。

Query_Text_en: Buoyant weight of mooring lines and risers
Translation: 系泊缆与立管的浮力重量

Query_Text_en: Remote sensing and control requirements for positioning , orientation , guidance , etc.
Translation: 定位、定向、制导等遥感测控要求

Query_Text_en: Interaction of pressure and temperature on highly compressed gases , with rise in temperature when pressurized and sudden drop [ even below freezing ] when pressure is released
Translation: 高压与温度对高度压缩气体的交互作用表现为：加压时温度上升，而压力骤降时温度会急剧下降（甚至低于冰点）。

Query_Text_en: The seafloor , usually level and smooth in the coastal plane , has steep slopes and rugged topography .
Translation: 海底在沿海平原通常平坦光滑，但存在陡坡和崎岖地形。

Query_Text_en: Landslides , mud flows , hydrate accumulations , active faults , salt domes , seafloor erosion , and chemo-synthetic communities abound in the deep water of the Gulf of Mexico .
Translation: 墨西哥湾深水区遍布滑坡、泥流、水合物堆积、活动断层、盐丘、海底侵蚀及化能合成群落等地质特征。

Query_Text_en: Pipeline routing becomes of major importance .
Translation: 管道线路规划至关重要。

Query_Text_en: Deep-sea ROVs capable of carrying out investigations and survey , and performing tasks with manipulators adapted to specific tasks .
Translation: 可执行调查勘测的深海遥控潜水器，配备针对特定任务设计的机械手以完成作业。

Query_Text_en: Autonomous ROVs are increasingly used .
Translation: 自主式遥控潜水器的应用日益广泛。

Query_Text_en: Electronic and acoustic sensing devices that enable accurate measurement and control of orientation and positions , both true and relative .
Translation: 可实现方位与位置精确测量控制的电子及声学传感装置，兼具绝对与相对定位功能。

Query_Text_en: These include gyros , Differential Global Positioning System [ DGPS ] , inertial guidance , photographic and acoustic imaging , video , and sonic devices , this latter including side-scan sonar .
Translation: 其中包括陀螺仪、差分全球定位系统（DGPS）、惯性制导装置、光学与声学成像设备、视频装置以及声呐设备（含侧扫声呐系统）。

Query_Text_en: For locating and exploring the remains of the Titanic , ultra-high-resolution photography and strobe lights were employed , based on technology originally developed for space missions .
Translation: 为定位和探索泰坦尼克号残骸，采用了基于太空任务技术研发的超高分辨率摄影与频闪照明系统。

Query_Text_en: Photography can reveal features on the seafloor which have been missed by acoustic imaging .
Translation: 摄影技术能够捕捉到声学成像所遗漏的海底地貌特征。

Query_Text_en: Many devices that can be effectively deployed from ROVs or work submersibles using fiber optics for transmission of information .
Translation: 许多设备可通过光纤传输信息，由遥控潜水器或作业潜水器有效布放。

Query_Text_en: They can also be deployed on the structure itself .
Translation: 它们也可直接部署在建筑结构上。

Query_Text_en: A number of these were successfully employed on the Cognac platform during its installation .
Translation: 在"科尼亚克"平台安装期间，多项技术方案成功获得应用。

Query_Text_en: Suitable systems have been field-proven in deep exploratory drilling operations , including reentry , by the Glomar Challenger at 20,000 ft. [ 6000 m ] .
Translation: "格洛玛·挑战者号"在深达2万英尺（6000米）的勘探钻井作业（包括再入井作业）中，已验证了该系统的适用性。

Query_Text_en: Sparker and geophysical methods can be used to reveal anomalies and strata below the mud line .
Translation: 火花地震与地球物理勘探方法可用于揭示泥线以下的地层异常情况。

Query_Text_en: Dynamic positioning , both at the surface of the sea , where propeller-driven thrusters are usually employed , and at depth , where jet thrusters are more applicable .
Translation: 动态定位既适用于海面（通常采用螺旋桨推进器），也适用于深海（更适合使用喷射推进器）。

Query_Text_en: These can be computer-controlled to maintain positions as determined by input data from satellites on the surface , inertial guidance and acoustic trans-ponders in the sea and on the seafloor .
Translation: 这些装置可由计算机控制，根据卫星、惯性制导系统以及海中和海底声学应答器输入的定位数据，自动调整并保持预定位置。

Query_Text_en: Use of de-aerated seawater as a hydraulic fluid .
Translation: 使用脱气海水作为液压工作介质

Query_Text_en: Use of low-density fluids which still possess low compressibility and hence permit balancing of fluid pressures .
Translation: 使用低密度流体，这类流体仍具备低压缩性，因而可实现流体压力平衡。

Query_Text_en: These include gasolines , pentane , propane , oil , and solvents .
Translation: 其中包括汽油、戊烷、丙烷、石油和溶剂等。

Query_Text_en: Several solvents are available which are safe to handle , have minimal miscibility with water , and have specific gravities in the range of 0.55-0 .60 .
Translation: 现有多种溶剂符合安全操作标准，其水溶性极低，且比重范围在0.55至0.60之间。

Query_Text_en: After use , these solvents can be displaced by seawater and recovered to a tanker [ Proceedings , Offshore Technology Conference , OTC , 8670 , 1998 ] .
Translation: 使用后，这些溶剂可被海水置换并回收到油轮中【摘自1998年《近海技术会议论文集》OTC 8670号文献】。

Query_Text_en: Syntactic foams [ closed-cell ] , possessing low density but capable of resisting hydrostatic pressures up to 6000 m and more .
Translation: 闭孔结构泡沫材料具有低密度特性，同时可承受6000米及以上深度的静水压力。

Query_Text_en: High-density materials for weight control .
Translation: 用于配重的高密度材料

Query_Text_en: These include barite-weighted drilling mud and iron ore slurry .
Translation: 其中包括重晶石加重钻井泥浆和铁矿石浆料。

Query_Text_en: Development of near-neutral buoyancy materials of high strength and stiffness for mooring lines , such as polyester Kevlar and carbon fiber .
Translation: 开发用于系泊缆绳的高强度高刚度近中性浮力材料，如聚酯纤维、凯夫拉和碳纤维。

Query_Text_en: Use of drill casing and drill string for lowering of heavy objects .
Translation: 利用钻套管与钻柱下放重型设备

Query_Text_en: These can then also be used for transmission of fluids .
Translation: 这些装置还可用于流体输送。

Query_Text_en: A casing maintained empty may partially offset its deadweight by buoyancy .
Translation: 保持空置状态的套管可借助浮力部分抵消其自重。

Query_Text_en: Use of steel tubular pipe for vertical moorings of Tension-Leg Platforms [ TLP ] .
Translation: 张力腿平台（TLP）垂直系泊系统采用钢管构件。

Query_Text_en: Development of supporting techniques such as arc-flame cutting .
Translation: 配套技术开发，如电弧火焰切割。

Query_Text_en: Recent studies have been made of the effectiveness of underwater arcs and flames at great depths .
Translation: 最新研究对深海环境下的水下电弧与火焰效能进行了深入探讨。

Query_Text_en: Underwater flames involve an arc to ignite the preheating flames , the use of premixed flames fueled by hydrogen or methane , and an oxygen jet to burn away the preheated material .
Translation: 水下燃烧过程包括：通过电弧引燃预热火焰，使用氢气或甲烷作为燃料的预混火焰，以及利用氧气射流烧蚀预热材料。

Query_Text_en: Underwater flames seem to have no inherent depth limitations and in fact may perform even better in deep water than in shallow water .
Translation: 水下火焰似乎不存在固有的深度限制，事实上其在深水中的表现可能比浅水更为优异。

Query_Text_en: Underwater arcs are more adversely affected by the pressure , water chemistry and heat sink .
Translation: 水下电弧受压力、水质化学特性和散热条件的不利影响更为显著。

Query_Text_en: It appears possible to strike and maintain an arc , but further research and development will be needed to ensure efficient operations at great depths .
Translation: 目前看来，电弧的引燃与维持虽可实现，但需进一步开展研发工作，以确保在极深海域实现高效作业。

Query_Text_en: Development of self-contained power sources such as nickel-hydrogen , silver-hydrogen , and lithium thionyl chloride batteries , which are pressure-compensated .
Translation: 研制出镍氢电池、银氢电池和锂亚硫酰氯电池等压力补偿式自持电源。

Query_Text_en: An abrasive water jet cutting system to cut pipe or piles in deep water .
Translation: 深水管道或桩基切割用高压水射流切割系统。

Query_Text_en: Suction anchors .
Translation: 吸力锚

Query_Text_en: Lowering objects such as suction anchors and templates to the sea floor must consider the dynamics that occur due to the heave of the lowering vessel at the surface .
Translation: 将吸力锚和模板等物体下放至海底时，必须考虑海面下放船舶升沉运动所产生的动态影响。

Query_Text_en: This can set up resonance in the long lowering line , resulting in increasingly high peak forces .
Translation: 这会在长距离下降的线路上引发共振效应，导致峰值压力持续攀升。

Query_Text_en: Intramoor has developed a system in which a large steel tank is placed in the lowering system .
Translation: 英穆尔公司研发了一套系统，将大型钢制储罐置于下放装置内。

Query_Text_en: This tank is pressurized by nitrogen gas to a pressure determined by a computer program which takes into account the mass of the object , the mass of the lowering vessel , the sea state , the characteristics of the lowering , line and the depth of water .
Translation: 该储罐通过氮气加压，其压力值由计算机程序确定。该程序综合考虑了物体质量、下放装置质量、海况、下放缆绳特性以及水深等因素。

Query_Text_en: The high hydrostatic pressures experienced with increasing depth cause the densities and other properties of many materials , such as fluids , to change from those associated with more normal , near-surface operations .
Translation: 随着深度增加而产生的高静水压力，会导致流体等许多材料的密度及其他特性发生变化，使其有别于常规近地表作业环境下的材料属性。

Query_Text_en: In this new environment , these properties become important for construction operations .
Translation: 在新形势下，这些特性对施工运营至关重要。

Query_Text_en: Table 22.1 gives the properties of seawater at various depths .
Translation: 表22.1列出了不同深度海水的特性参数。

Query_Text_en: Propane , crude oil , gasoline , diesel oil , and solvents are fluids possessing buoyancy in seawater , and thus are capable of reducing the effective weight of large structures during installation .
Translation: 丙烷、原油、汽油、柴油及溶剂等液体在海水环境中具有浮力特性，可在大型结构物安装过程中有效降低其自重负荷。

Query_Text_en: Their properties at various depths are given in Table 22.2 through Table 22.6 .
Translation: 各深度特性数据详见表22.2至表22.6。

Query_Text_en: Attention is directed to the fact that these fluids have different degrees of miscibility with seawater .
Translation: 需注意的是，这些流体与海水具有不同程度的互溶性。

Query_Text_en: Table 22.7 gives the properties of syntactic foam .
Translation: 表22.7列出了合成泡沫塑料的性能参数。

Query_Text_en: Both syntectic and syntactic are used in the technical literature , but syntactic is adopted in this book .
Translation: 在技术文献中，"syntectic"和"syntactic"均有使用，但本书采用"syntactic"这一表述。

Query_Text_en: Note : Heptane and Hexane have low miscibility with seawater .
Translation: 注：庚烷与己烷在海水中的溶解度较低。

Query_Text_en: Heavy fluids and granulated or slurried solids are often required in order to ballast structures down against the buoyancy of the seawater .
Translation: 为抵消海水浮力对结构的抬升作用，通常需采用高密度液体或颗粒状/浆状固体作为压载物。

Query_Text_en: Table 22.8 gives the properties of weighted drilling muds , while Table 22.9 gives the properties of bulk solids .
Translation: 表22.8列出了加重钻井液的性能参数，表22.9则列出了散装固体的性能参数。

Query_Text_en: Note : Most of the above require environmental consideration .
Translation: 注：上述多数事项需考量环境因素。

Query_Text_en: To lower and position deep sea structures , wire rope , chain , drill pipe and drill casing have been used .
Translation: 为下放和定位深海结构物，通常采用钢丝绳、锚链、钻杆及钻井套管等设备。

Query_Text_en: The properties of these are listed in Table 22.10 through Table 22.12 .
Translation: 表22.10至表22.12列明了这些特性。

Query_Text_en: Carbon fiber strands , as well as Kevlar rope , are commercially available .
Translation: 碳纤维丝和凯夫拉绳索均已实现商业化供应。

Query_Text_en: Fiber ropes offer the advantage of relatively high strength with near-neutral buoyancy .
Translation: 纤维绳索具有强度较高且接近中性浮力的优势。

Query_Text_en: Properties of several of the more commonly used rope materials are listed in Table 22.13 .
Translation: 表22.13列出了几种常用绳索材料的性能参数。

Query_Text_en: Kevlar [ aramid fiber rope ] offers the strength of steel wire line at only one fifth of the weight in air and only one-tenth of the weight in water .
Translation: 凯夫拉（芳纶纤维绳）的强度与钢丝绳相当，但其重量在空气中仅为钢丝绳的五分之一，在水中仅为十分之一。

Query_Text_en: Carbon fiber is even stronger but is considerably more costly .
Translation: 碳纤维强度更高，但成本也显著增加。

Query_Text_en: Mooring and hoisting lines are available up to 1,200,000 lb [ 550 tn . breaking strength .
Translation: 系泊与起吊缆绳最大承重可达1,200,000磅[550吨·断裂强度]。

Query_Text_en: Hence , they are especially well suited for deep-water application .
Translation: 因此，它们尤其适用于深水作业。

Query_Text_en: Figure 22.1 and Figure 22.2 give the effective load-carrying capacity of wire rope and drill pipe at various water depths .
Translation: 图22.1与图22.2分别展示了不同水深条件下钢丝绳和钻杆的有效承载能力。

Query_Text_en: At depths beyond 300 m , compliant structures are used .
Translation: 300米以深水域需采用顺应式结构。

Query_Text_en: Their period is significantly longer than that of the design wave .
Translation: 其周期明显超过设计波浪周期。

Query_Text_en: These are structures which are intentionally flexible transversely , yet fixed to the seafloor for shear and axial support .
Translation: 这些结构在横向设计上具有柔性，同时固定于海底以提供剪切和轴向支撑。

Query_Text_en: Several concepts have been developed to achieve this response : the guyed tower , the free-standing flexible tower , and the articulated column [ similar to that described in Section 13.4 but much larger and deeper ] .
Translation: 为实现这一目标，业界已研发出多种结构方案：拉索式塔架、自立式柔性塔架以及铰接柱结构（类似第13.4节所述结构，但规模更大、作业水深更深）。

Query_Text_en: The towers themselves are typically trussed columns with a relatively constant cross section , although a large-diameter tube is also conceptually feasible .
Translation: 桥塔通常采用桁架式柱体结构，其横截面相对恒定；尽管从设计原理而言，采用大直径管状结构同样可行。

Query_Text_en: The base is either spudded or piled , in order to support the tower and provide restraint against lateral shear .
Translation: 基础采用桩基或墩基结构，用以支撑塔体并抵御侧向剪力。

Query_Text_en: Similar to the structures described in Section 13.4 , the base may be set separately or attached to the tower during its installation .
Translation: 与第13.4节所述结构类似，底座可单独设置，也可在塔体安装时同步固定。

Query_Text_en: Fabrication of the tower is carried out on a ways , as with any jacket .
Translation: 塔体采用滑道法建造，与导管架施工工艺相同。

Query_Text_en: Since this structure is primarily for deep-water use , it will often be fabricated in two halves , just as was done for the Hondo platform [ see Section 9.9 ] .
Translation: 由于该结构主要用于深水作业，通常将分为两半预制，正如亨多平台所采用的方式（参见第9.9节）。

Query_Text_en: Preferably the two halves will be built as one , then later separated , to ensure perfect match .
Translation: 为确保完美契合，两部分构件宜先整体建造，再行拆分。

Query_Text_en: However , if sufficient yard space is not available , a short section at the juncture , incorporating both mating sections , can be constructed first .
Translation: 但若场地空间不足，可先在接合处建造一个包含两段连接部分的短节段。

Query_Text_en: Then this section is skidded to the far inshore end of the ways , separated , and the lower half fabricated in a normal manner .
Translation: 随后将该段滑移至滑道最靠近岸端的位置，分离后，下半部分按常规方式建造完成。

Query_Text_en: The mating section of the upper half can be skidded sideways onto a parallel launching ways , then down to the outboard end , and the upper half fabricated concurrently .
Translation: 上半部对接段可横向滑移至平行建造滑道，再移至外侧端部，同时进行上半部的预制施工。

Query_Text_en: There are obviously several variations of the above , depending on yard layout .
Translation: 显然，根据堆场布局的不同，上述方案存在多种变体。

Query_Text_en: Each half is now transported to a protected deepwater site , as was done with Hondo , and then launched .
Translation: 两段船体均被运至一处受保护的深水场地（与洪多油田平台处理方式相同），随后实施下水作业。

Query_Text_en: Note that the launching can be either end-O , or sideways , since the cross section is uniform .
Translation: 需注意，由于截面均匀，发射可从端部O处进行，亦可横向实施。

Query_Text_en: Mating afloat can follow the methods previously described for the Hondo platform , using stabbing cones and watertight access tubes , enabling welding in the dry .
Translation: 水上对接可采用此前为本多平台所述方法，通过插入锥体与防水通道管实现干式焊接作业。

Query_Text_en: Temporary buoyancy tanks ensure that the tower floats horizontally on its upper legs .
Translation: 临时浮力舱确保塔架上部支腿保持水平漂浮状态。

Query_Text_en: A spud-can section is constructed at the lower end of the tower .
Translation: 塔体下端设有桩靴结构。

Query_Text_en: After mating and the welding of the mated legs to form an integral structure , the auxiliary buoyancy towers at the lower end of the tower are ballasted to slightly negative buoyancy .
Translation: 在完成对接并将对接支腿焊接成整体结构后，位于塔架下端的辅助浮力塔通过压载调整为微负浮力状态。

Query_Text_en: Now the structure , having a slightly inclined attitude , is towed to its installation site .
Translation: 目前，该结构体以略微倾斜的姿态被拖曳至安装地点。

Query_Text_en: Ballast added to the spud can section and lower jacket legs causes the structure to upend .
Translation: 压载物注入桩靴段和下节导管腿后，促使结构体完成扶正作业。

Query_Text_en: Bending moments in the tower need to be carefully computed for this operation and may require progressive ballasting of midlength compartments in the tower .
Translation: 在此次作业中，必须精确计算塔架的弯矩，并可能需要对塔架中部舱室进行渐进式压载。

Query_Text_en: The upper temporary buoyancy tanks are designed so that the structure will float vertically at the site .
Translation: 上部临时浮力舱的设计确保结构体在施工地点能保持垂直漂浮状态。

Query_Text_en: Further ballasting of the jacket legs and spud can cause the structure to touch bottom and then force the spud-can into the soil .
Translation: 进一步对导管架腿和桩靴进行压载可能导致结构触底，进而迫使桩靴贯入土层。

Query_Text_en: By lowering the pressure inside the spud can , it may be driven by the hydrostatic imbalance even deeper into the soil , similar to a suction anchor .
Translation: 通过降低桩靴内部压力，可在静水压力失衡作用下使其更深地扎入土层，其原理与吸力锚类似。

Query_Text_en: The anchors may then be installed using a drill ship or semisubmersible .
Translation: 随后可使用钻井船或半潜式平台安装锚固装置。

Query_Text_en: In deep water , suction anchors are increasingly used .
Translation: 在深水领域，吸力锚的应用日益广泛。

Query_Text_en: The first segment of the guy line will be attached to each anchor pile as it is set .
Translation: 每根锚桩就位后，将立即安装第一段拉索。

Query_Text_en: Then the drill ship will lay out the segment , lower the clump anchor , attach the second segment and then lay it down .
Translation: 随后，钻探船将铺设首段管道、下放沉块锚，接驳第二段管道后继续铺设。

Query_Text_en: A pennant will be attached , with a marker buoy , so that the guy line can be retrieved when the tower is moved into position .
Translation: 将配备一面三角旗和一个标志浮标，以便在塔架就位时回收牵引索。

Query_Text_en: Once the tower has been set and the spud-can has achieved initial penetration , each guy line is fed in through a swiveling fairlead and run up to the deck and stopped off .
Translation: 一旦塔架就位且桩靴完成初始贯入，各条张紧索将通过旋转导缆孔穿入，延伸至甲板并固定锚定。

Query_Text_en: A linear hoist is attached and initial tension taken up gradually around the series of guys .
Translation: 线性提升装置安装就位后，沿系列拉索逐步施加初始张力。

Query_Text_en: Then the upper temporary buoyancy tanks are ballasted to a slight negative buoyancy and removed [ see Figure 22.3 through Figure 22.5 ] .
Translation: 随后对上部的临时浮力舱进行压载，使其产生轻微负浮力后拆除（见图22.3至图22.5）。

Query_Text_en: Following final penetration , the tension in each leg is readjusted with the cable grip hoists .
Translation: 最终贯入完成后，使用钢索夹具提升装置对各支腿张力进行重新调整。

Query_Text_en: The deck structure and modules are then set by derrick barge .
Translation: 随后由起重船完成甲板结构和模块的安装。

Query_Text_en: In other installations of guyed towers , a piled base structure was used , with the piles driven through sleeves in the guyed tower .
Translation: 在其他拉线塔的安装中，采用了桩基结构，桩体通过拉线塔套管打入地下。

Query_Text_en: This was the solution adopted for platform Lena , constructed in 1000 ft. [ 300 m ] of water , described in the following section .
Translation: 这一方案被应用于丽娜平台的建设中，该平台作业水深达1000英尺（300米），具体内容将在下节详述。

Query_Text_en: Not only was platform Lena a unique structure once in place , but its installation embodied a number of new ideas that proved successful .
Translation: 平台"莉娜"不仅是一经建成便独树一帜的建筑奇观，其安装过程更蕴含多项创新理念，这些理念最终被实践证明卓有成效。

Query_Text_en: The jacket was 330 m [ 1080 ft. ] long by 36 m [ 120 ft. ] square .
Translation: 该导管架长330米（1080英尺），横截面为36米×36米（120英尺×120英尺）。

Query_Text_en: Launch weight , including main piles and torsion piles , was 27,000 tn .
Translation: 发射总重量（含主桩和抗扭桩）达27,000吨。

Query_Text_en: The jacket was loaded out from the fabrication yard in conventional end-O fashion and then lowered onto transverse skids .
Translation: 该导管架采用常规端部吊装方式从预制场装船，随后被下放至横向滑道上。

Query_Text_en: Launching near the site was sideways , using four launch runners with guides plus rocker arms .
Translation: 发射台附近的发射方式采用横向设计，配备四条带导轨的发射滑轨及摇臂装置。

Query_Text_en: Holdbacks were used to restrain the jacket while the barge was ballasted to heel 7° to starboard .
Translation: 在驳船压载向右舷倾斜7度时，采用止动装置固定导管架。

Query_Text_en: Then the 80 mm frangible nuts of the holdbacks were severed by explosive detonation and hydraulic jacks activated to over-come starting friction .
Translation: 随后，牵制装置上80毫米易碎螺母通过爆破切断，液压千斤顶启动以克服启动摩擦力。

Query_Text_en: The jacket launch took only about 10 s , one fourth the time normally required for a stern launch .
Translation: 此次艉部下水仅耗时约10秒，较常规艉部下水的耗时缩短了四分之三。

Query_Text_en: The jacket had a maximum roll of 53° , the barge a maximum roll of 15° .
Translation: 导管架最大横摇幅度为53度，驳船最大横摇幅度为15度。

Query_Text_en: In all , 12 long buoyancy tanks , each 6 m in diameter by 36 m long , were built into the upper portion of the jacket .
Translation: 整个导管架上部共内置12个长型浮力舱，每个直径6米，长36米。

Query_Text_en: High-density iron ore slurry was placed into the base to assist upending .
Translation: 将高密度铁矿石浆注入底座以辅助扶正作业。

Query_Text_en: A derrick barge was used to control the upending , seating , piling , and guy line attachment .
Translation: 采用浮吊船控制（导管架的）扶正、就位、打桩及拉索固定等作业。

Query_Text_en: This derrick barge maintained position by means of four computer-controlled thrusters .
Translation: 这艘起重驳船通过四台计算机控制的推进器保持定位。

Query_Text_en: The lower sections of the main piles of the structure , 1350 mm in diameter , were carried out with the jacket .
Translation: 该结构主桩下部直径为1350毫米，采用导管架法施工。

Query_Text_en: After upending of the jacket and its seating , they were extended and driven to 170 m penetration .
Translation: 在翻转外套管并固定其位置后，将其延伸并推进至170米深度。

Query_Text_en: For the torsion piles , whose upper end terminated in the base , a system of latches and lugs was used to connect pile and hammer together for lowering as a single unit .
Translation: 对于顶端止于基座的抗扭桩，采用了一套闩锁与凸耳系统，将桩体与锤头连接为一体，以便整体下放。

Query_Text_en: One 100 m-diameter multistrand wire rope was used to lower the combined unit , using a 600,000-lb capacity linear winch .
Translation: 使用一台60万磅级线性绞车，以一根直径100米的多股钢丝绳将组合装置下放到位。

Query_Text_en: Air , electric , and hydraulic lines were lowered with separate constant-tension winches and lines .
Translation: 空气、电力及液压管线通过独立的恒张力绞车和缆绳下放。

Query_Text_en: Initially , hammer efficiency was reduced by the cushioning of compressed air below the hammer ram , but a change in the air exhaust system overcame this problem .
Translation: 最初，锤头下方压缩空气的缓冲作用降低了锻锤效率，但通过改进排气系统解决了这一问题。

Query_Text_en: After driving to full penetration , the latches and lugs were hydraulically released , allowing the hammer to be retrieved .
Translation: 锁扣完全嵌入后，通过液压装置解除锁定机构，即可回收打桩锤。

Query_Text_en: Earlier , the 20 guys and their anchors had been installed .
Translation: 此前，20名工作人员及其固定装置已部署到位。

Query_Text_en: Drilled-in pile anchors were placed and grouted , each with the guy line preattached .
Translation: 钻孔桩锚已安装并灌浆完毕，每根桩锚均预先连接好拉索。

Query_Text_en: These guy lines had articulated clump anchors attached .
Translation: 这些拉索配备了铰接式丛锚装置。

Query_Text_en: A barge laid out the guy with its clumps and then secured it to a buoy temporarily held in position by a small , taut gravity anchor .
Translation: 一艘驳船用其吊臂将缆绳展开，随后将其系在浮标上，该浮标由一个小型重力锚暂时拉紧固定。

Query_Text_en: Once the tower was installed , connection was made with four lines from the tower , leading out through under-water fairleads .
Translation: 塔架安装完毕后，通过水下导缆器引出四条缆索与之连接。

Query_Text_en: These were then pretensioned with linear jacks .
Translation: 随后使用线性千斤顶对这些构件进行了预张拉处理。

Query_Text_en: Then the additional 16 guys were completed and tensions equalized .
Translation: 随后，新增的16名人员全部到位，紧张局势得以缓解。

Query_Text_en: The guy lines were 135-mm-diameter wire lines , each 550 m in total length and sheathed in polyethylene .
Translation: 牵引索为直径135毫米的钢丝绳，总长550米，外覆聚乙烯护套。

Query_Text_en: These guys had a breaking strength of 1525 tn . each and were designed for 500-600 tn . maximum load .
Translation: 这些钢缆的断裂强度为每条1525吨，设计最大载荷为500至600吨。

Query_Text_en: The clump anchors were each 200 tn. , consisting of articulated weights attached to the guy line segments .
Translation: 每组重力锚重达200吨，由连接在分段拉索上的铰接配重块构成。

Query_Text_en: The Baldpate deep-water production platform consists of a 400 m rectangular tower mated to a 100 m tall base section .
Translation: 巴尔佩特深水生产平台由一座400米高的矩形塔架与100米高的基座组成。

Query_Text_en: Eight tubes at the lower end allow the tower to articulate at 150 m above the seafloor [ see Figure 22.6 through Figure 22.8 ] .
Translation: 塔架底部设有八根导管，使其可在海床150米上方实现灵活转向（见图22.6至图22.8）。

Query_Text_en: The tower base was installed by lowering from a heavy lift derrick barge [ 8000 tn . capacity ] .
Translation: 塔基采用重型起重浮吊[起重能力8000吨]进行吊装下沉安装。

Query_Text_en: Two docking piles [ dowels ] were set on four leveling piles ; 12-84 in . [ 2.15 m ] piles were driven 140 m into the seafloor and grouted to the base .
Translation: 四根定位桩上设置了两根对接桩；12至84英寸（2.15米）的桩体被打入海床140米深处，并与基底进行灌浆固结。

Query_Text_en: The tower itself was transported as a single structural unit , by supporting it on two barges .
Translation: 该塔楼作为整体结构单元，通过双驳船支撑完成运输。

Query_Text_en: The barge supporting the lower end was tilted by flooding , allowing that end to launch as the barge was towed clear .
Translation: 支撑桥体下端的驳船因进水倾斜，在拖离过程中使该端得以滑移入水。

Query_Text_en: The upper end was then launched off a conventional rocker arm on its barge .
Translation: 随后，火箭上段通过驳船上的常规摇臂发射升空。

Query_Text_en: The platform was launched in 650 m of water , 12 km from the final site .
Translation: 该平台在距最终选址12公里、水深650米处下水。

Query_Text_en: As planned , it came to a vertical orientation by itself .
Translation: 按计划，飞行器自动调整为垂直状态。

Query_Text_en: Small-diameter tubes at each corner were designed to permit selective ballasting after tow to site for adjustment of verticality and to develop the small negative buoyancy needed to enable submergence for mating .
Translation: 每个角落的小直径管道设计用于在拖至现场后实施选择性压载，以便调整垂直度，并产生实现下沉对接所需的微弱负浮力。

Query_Text_en: Valves were provided for flooding at the lower end and other valves at the upper end for venting of trapped air .
Translation: 下端设有注水阀门，上端另设阀门用于排出滞留空气。

Query_Text_en: Unfortunately , on launching , two of the lower valves were open , instead of closed , as intended .
Translation: 遗憾的是，启动时下方两个阀门处于开启状态，而非预期的关闭状态。

Query_Text_en: Water slowly flooded in , compressing the air at the upper end .
Translation: 海水缓缓涌入，将上端的空气逐渐压缩。

Query_Text_en: The tower sank slowly but inexorably under water , until it landed on the seafloor , still in its vertical attitude , with its top 250 m below water .
Translation: 这座塔楼缓慢却不可阻挡地沉入水中，最终以垂直姿态落至海底，其顶端距水面仍有250米。

Query_Text_en: ROV surveys established that the structure was not sinking deeper into the seafloor ooze .
Translation: 遥控潜水器勘测证实，该结构体并未继续沉入海底软泥层。

Query_Text_en: Lines were attached by ROV and divers .
Translation: 遥控潜水器与潜水员协同完成管线连接作业。

Query_Text_en: A heavy-lift derrick barge was brought to the site and lifted the 8700 tn . tower to the surface .
Translation: 一艘重型起重驳船抵达现场，将这座8700吨的塔吊整体抬升至水面。

Query_Text_en: Due to adhesion of the soil , the initial hoisting required 850 tn . of lift , which decreased to the buoyant tower weight of 700 tn . as soon as it was clear of the bottom .
Translation: 由于土壤黏附力的作用，初始吊装需850吨提升力；一旦塔体脱离海底，所需吊装力即降至浮力状态下的塔身自重700吨。

Query_Text_en: The tower was now towed to the site where it was positioned and submerged to mate with the dowels from the base , where the sleeves were grouted .
Translation: 该塔现已被拖至预定位置并下沉，与基座上的定位销对接，随后对套筒进行了灌浆处理。

Query_Text_en: Then the 4000 tn . topsides were lifted onto the tower .
Translation: 随后，4000吨重的上部模块被吊装至塔架之上。

Query_Text_en: This accident with the valves , although dramatic in this extreme case , has occurred before in shallow water structures .
Translation: 此次阀门事故虽属极端案例，但在浅水建筑结构中早有先例。

Query_Text_en: In one North Sea case , a valve for ballasting was unable to close due to a short piece of wire line jamming .
Translation: 北海某案例中，一艘船舶的压载水阀因被一小段钢丝绳卡住而无法关闭。

Query_Text_en: Thus , consideration should be given to having two valves in series .
Translation: 因此，应考虑串联安装两个阀门。

Query_Text_en: A gravity base is used , on which is mounted a cardan [ articulation joint ] , which will accommodate rotation of the tower in both orthogonal directions .
Translation: 采用重力式基础，其上安装万向铰接装置，可适应塔架在正交双向的旋转运动。

Query_Text_en: A special torque restraint prevents twisting .
Translation: 特殊扭矩限制装置可防止扭转。

Query_Text_en: Buoyancy is provided at the upper end to keep the tower upright .
Translation: 浮力装置设于顶端以确保塔体保持垂直。

Query_Text_en: The tower itself may be an open truss , as shown in Figure 22.9 .
Translation: 如图22.9所示，塔架本身可采用开放式桁架结构。

Query_Text_en: The tension-leg platform system consists of a semisubmersible hull , moored by very high strength tethers under tension to a seafloor template or base .
Translation: 张力腿平台系统由一座半潜式浮体构成，通过高强度张力索与海底基座或模板锚固连接。

Query_Text_en: Although the early uses were in moderate-depth waters in the North Sea , the concept was primarily developed for the deep sea .
Translation: 尽管早期应用集中于北海的中等深度水域，但该技术理念主要是为深海环境研发的。

Query_Text_en: Deep-water installations of TLPs have been made in the Gulf of Mexico in waters 1000 m deep and more .
Translation: 墨西哥湾已成功安装了张力腿平台深水设施，作业水深达1000米以上。

Query_Text_en: The Hutton platform was installed in 1984 in the North Sea .
Translation: 赫顿石油平台于1984年在北海建成投产。

Query_Text_en: The hull was a deep draft semisubmersible , consisting of a base raft and six large-diameter columnar shafts .
Translation: 该船体为深吃水半潜式结构，由基础浮箱和六根大直径柱状轴组成。

Query_Text_en: All construction was of steel .
Translation: 所有建筑均采用钢结构。

Query_Text_en: The installation of the Hutton TLP was an example of excellent engineering , planning , and execution .
Translation: 赫顿张力腿平台的安装堪称卓越工程、周密规划与精准施工的典范。

Query_Text_en: While the platform substructure , the tethers , and deck were being fabricated , the well template was placed and the wells were predrilled .
Translation: 在平台下部结构、系泊缆和甲板预制期间，完成了井口基盘的安装及预钻井作业。

Query_Text_en: Then the foundation [ base ] templates were installed .
Translation: 随后，基础模板安装就位。

Query_Text_en: To achieve the required tolerance in position of the foundation templates of 250 mm in plan , 2° in orientation , and 0.5° in level , a 900-tn . steel guiding frame was lowered and positioned on the previously placed well template .
Translation: 为确保基础模板达到平面位置偏差250毫米、方位角偏差2度及水平度偏差0.5度的精度要求，施工方将重达900吨的钢制导向架下放并精准定位在预先安装的井口模板上。

Query_Text_en: The frame was leveled by jacks operating against the mud mats .
Translation: 千斤顶作用于泥垫上，使框架保持水平。

Query_Text_en: Foundation templates were supported temporarily by the frame and a single 30-m-long pin pile driven through each to fix its position .
Translation: 基础模板由框架临时支撑，并通过打入每块模板的30米长单桩进行定位固定。

Query_Text_en: Then the frame was removed .
Translation: 随后框架被拆除。

Query_Text_en: Then through each template , the eight main piles , each 1.8 m in diameter , were driven to 60 m penetration .
Translation: 随后，通过各模板施工，将8根直径1.8米的主桩打入地下60米深处。

Query_Text_en: A Menck MHU 1700 underwater hydraulic hammer was used .
Translation: 施工采用了一台Menck MHU 1700型水下液压锤。

Query_Text_en: Piles were entered into their 7.5-m-long template sleeves and the hammer was set on them , using an acoustic positioning system and ROV video .
Translation: 桩体被插入7.5米长的模板套筒后，通过声学定位系统和水下机器人视频引导，打桩锤随即就位。

Query_Text_en: After driving , the piles were grouted in the sleeves .
Translation: 打桩完成后，对套筒内进行了灌浆处理。

Query_Text_en: Installation of the platform itself was carried out in calm seas .
Translation: 该平台的安装作业在风平浪静的海况下完成。

Query_Text_en: The semisubmersible TLP was towed to the site and fixed in position by lines from two large semisubmersible derrick barges , which in turn were moored with 12-point anchor systems .
Translation: 半潜式张力腿平台由两艘大型半潜式起重驳船拖至作业地点，并通过缆绳定位固定，而这两艘驳船则采用12点锚泊系统进行系泊。

Query_Text_en: The first leg was run down in each corner and the anchor connector at the lower end latched into the foundation template by hydraulically activated locks .
Translation: 首段立管沿每个角落铺设，底部的锚固接头通过液压驱动锁扣与基础模板锁定。

Query_Text_en: The legs were forged steel hollow tubes , 260 m O.D. , of 92.5-mm wall thickness proof-tested to 800 MPa .
Translation: 支腿采用锻钢空心管制造，外径260毫米，壁厚92.5毫米，经800兆帕压力测试验证。

Query_Text_en: Tapered threaded joints were used to connect the 9.5-m-long segments .
Translation: 9.5米长的管段采用锥形螺纹接头进行连接。

Query_Text_en: The installation sequence follows .
Translation: 安装顺序如下。
