Query_Text_en: During the sub-optimization process , many operations during the fabrication and erection will have to be carried out at high elevations , 50 m or 58 m above the base and land .
Translation: 在次优方案实施过程中，大量制造与安装作业需在距基础面50至58米的高空进行。

Query_Text_en: On the Ninian central platform , bearing plates with screw adjusting nuts were set in the previous concrete pour .
Translation: 在尼尼安中心平台上，带有螺旋调节螺母的承重板已在前期混凝土浇筑中安装就位。

Query_Text_en: A survey crew then surveyed each plate accurately , adjusting it to the proper level and scribing the exact location on the bearing plate where the bearing of the shell should sit .
Translation: 随后，测量人员对每块基板进行精确测量，将其调整至适当水平，并在承压板上标出壳体支座应处的准确位置。

Query_Text_en: Before each shell element [ 100 - 300 tn ] was lifted , tag lines were attached .
Translation: 每个重达100至300吨的壳体构件在吊装前均系有牵引索。

Query_Text_en: The workers on top could then catch the tag lines and guide the shell unit to the proper location without waiting for further survey checks .
Translation: 这样，上层工人就能立即抓住牵引绳，将壳体单元引导至正确位置，无需等待进一步的测量检查。

Query_Text_en: Mockups also serve a valuable purpose in training workers , especially if they are shown the results of their work .
Translation: 样机在员工培训中也发挥着重要作用，尤其是当员工能够直观看到自身工作成果时。

Query_Text_en: For example , if placing concrete among congested reinforcement results in honeycomb and rock pockets , the workers can visually see the need for vibration .
Translation: 例如，若在密集钢筋间浇筑混凝土导致蜂窝麻面和孔洞，工人可直观判断需进行振捣作业。

Query_Text_en: If welding studs with excessive heat results in plate warping , they will understand the reason for the requirements for frequent shifting of location and imposed time lags [ see Figure 21.8 ] .
Translation: 若焊接螺柱时过热导致钢板变形，操作人员便会理解为何要求频繁变换焊点位置并施加时间间隔（参见图21.8）。

Query_Text_en: One lesson from Japanese shipbuilding practice that has been demonstrated repeatedly in their construction of offshore equipment and structures [ see Figure 21.9 through Figure 21.12 ] is that teams of workers , comprising several trades and assigned to a specific task group with the objective of completing all work within a specific zone , are much more productive than a highly centralized organization by trades alone , with each trade then responsible for all work within its classification throughout the structure .
Translation: 日本造船业在海洋装备与设施建造实践中反复印证的一个重要经验（见图21.9至图21.12）表明：由多工种工人组成、负责特定区域全部作业的任务小组，其工作效率远高于按工种高度集中划分的传统组织模式——后者要求各工种负责整座设施中本专业范畴的全部作业。

Query_Text_en: FIGURE 21.9 Japanese shipyard constructing steel base for Arctic offshore platform .
Translation: 图21.9 日本造船厂正在建造北极海上平台的钢制基座

Query_Text_en: Good access and adequate work room
Translation: 通行便利且工作空间充足

Query_Text_en: Favorable position for working
Translation: 工作有利地位

Query_Text_en: Ability to pace one 's own work without excessive dependence on the progress of fellow workers
Translation: 能够自主安排工作进度，无需过度依赖同事的工作进展。

Query_Text_en: Immediate availability , close to hand , of tools and materials
Translation: 工具材料须就近存放，确保随时取用。

Query_Text_en: Clearly defined work program and procedures
Translation: 明确的工作计划和程序

Query_Text_en: Identification of the individual worker as part of a team .
Translation: 将个体劳动者视为团队的一部分。

Query_Text_en: The adoptions of the zone concept or organization , as opposed to the trade concept , is a return to decentralization .
Translation: 采用区域概念或组织架构，而非贸易概念，是对权力下放的回归。

Query_Text_en: Since basic skills and techniques continue to be implemented by trade , the new approach resembles the matrix system of organization which has been adopted by some large engineering organizations .
Translation: 由于基础技能和工艺仍按行业实施，新方法类似于某些大型工程机构采用的矩阵式组织体系。

Query_Text_en: The task group teams will , of course , be reassigned and reconstituted as the needs demand .
Translation: 当然，工作组团队将根据实际需求进行重新调配和重组。

Query_Text_en: Even where specialist subcontractors are involved [ e.g. , for post-tensioning ] , the task group organization appears to give greater overall efficiency and reliability .
Translation: 即便在涉及专业分包商（如后张法施工）的情况下，任务小组的组织形式仍能显著提升整体效率与可靠性。

Query_Text_en: Construction procedures offshore are planned with primary consideration being given to the sea states and weather conditions under which they will be performed .
Translation: 海上施工程序的制定，首要考量因素是作业海域的海况与气象条件。

Query_Text_en: Chen and Rawstron , in their paper Systems Approach to Offshore Construction Project Planning and Scheduling , Marine Technology Journal , October 1983 , make use of advanced simulation techniques in the planning of offshore construction operations .
Translation: 陈与罗斯特朗在其1983年10月发表于《海洋技术期刊》的论文《海上建设工程项目规划与调度的系统方法》中，运用了先进的模拟技术来规划海上施工作业。

Query_Text_en: Limiting sea states are determined for various operations such as module lifting , pile driving , pipe laying , and saturation diving , and the effects of vessel motions on operations are evaluated .
Translation: 各类海上作业（包括模块吊装、打桩施工、管线铺设及饱和潜水）均需确定限制性海况条件，并评估船舶运动对作业的影响。

Query_Text_en: By its Resolution A. 176 [ VI ] of October 21 , 1969 , the Assembly of the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization decided to convene in 1973 an International Conference on Marine Pollution .
Translation: 政府间海事协商组织大会1969年10月21日通过第A.176(VI)号决议，决定于1973年召开国际海洋污染会议。

Query_Text_en: This Conference was held in London from October 8 to November 2 , 1973 .
Translation: 本次会议于1973年10月8日至11月2日在伦敦举行。

Query_Text_en: The Government of Hong Kong was also represented by an observer .
Translation: 香港政府亦派观察员列席会议。

Query_Text_en: At the opening of the Conference The Hon. Michael Heseltine , Minister of Aerospace and Shipping of the United Kingdom and Mr. Maurice Strong Executive Director of the United Nations Environment Programme made statements supporting the objective of the Conference .
Translation: 英国航空航天和海运大臣迈克尔·赫塞尔廷阁下与联合国环境规划署执行主任莫里斯·斯特朗先生在会议开幕式上发表讲话，对本次会议的目标表示支持。

Query_Text_en: The Conference elected Mr. S. V. Bhave , Head of the Indian delegation , as President of the Conference .
Translation: 会议选举印度代表团团长S·V·巴维先生担任大会主席。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Colin Goad . Secretary-General of the Organization , acted as Secretary-General of the Conference with Mr. J. Queguiner . Deputy Secretary-General , as Deputy Secretary-General of the Conference .
Translation: 科林·戈德先生以本组织秘书长身份担任会议秘书长，副秘书长J·盖吉纳先生担任会议副秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Captain A. Saveliev , Secretary of the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization , was appointed Executive Secretary of the Conference and Mr. Y. Sasamura . Head of Marine Science and Technology Division , and Mr. T. Mensah , Head of Legal Division , of the Organization were appointed Deputy Executive Secretaries of the Conference .
Translation: 本组织海上安全委员会秘书A·萨维列夫船长被任命为会议执行秘书，本组织海洋科学技术司司长Y·笹村先生和法律司司长T·门萨先生被任命为会议副执行秘书。

Query_Text_en: The Conference established the following Committees and a Steering Committee composed of officers of the Conference :
Translation: 会议设立下列委员会及由会议主席团成员组成的指导委员会：

Query_Text_en: - Proposals and comments , including amendments to the drafts mentioned above , submitted to the Conference by interested Governments and Organizations .
Translation: 各相关政府及组织向大会提交的提案和意见，包括对上述草案的修正案。

Query_Text_en: PROTOCOL RELATING TO INTERVENTION ON THE HIGH SEAS IN CASES OF MARINE POLLUTION BY SUBSTANCES OTHER THAN OIL
Translation: 《非油类物质造成海洋污染时公海干预议定书》

Query_Text_en: The Convention and the Protocol constitute Attachments 1 and 2 to this Final Act respectively .
Translation: 本最终议定书附件1和附件2分别为《公约》和《议定书》。

Query_Text_en: The Conference also adopted Resolutions the texts of which comprise Attachment 3 of this Final Act .
Translation: 会议还通过了若干决议，其文本构成本最终文件附件3。

Query_Text_en: The text of this Final Act including its attachments , is deposited with the Secretary-General of the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization [ IMCO ] .
Translation: 本最终议定书文本及其附件存放于政府间海事协商组织秘书长处。

Query_Text_en: It is established in a single original in the English , French , Russian and Spanish languages , and accompanied by the texts of the International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships , 1973 , with its Protocols , Annexes and Appendices , the Protocol relating to Intervention on the High Seas in Cases of Marine Pollution by Substances other than Oil , and the Resolutions of the Conference .
Translation: 本议定书以英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文单一正本形式制定，并附有1973年《国际防止船舶造成污染公约》及其议定书、附则和附录、《关于干预公海非油类物质污染事故议定书》以及会议各项决议的文本。

Query_Text_en: The texts of the Convention , its Protocols , Annexes and Appendices , as well as of the Protocol , appear in their authentic languages , English , French , Russian and Spanish .
Translation: 《公约》及其议定书、附件和附录的文本，以及该议定书的文本，均以英语、法语、俄语和西班牙语等作准语言呈现。

Query_Text_en: The texts of Resolutions of the Conference appear in English , French , Russian and Spanish .
Translation: 会议决议文本以英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文四种语言呈现。

Query_Text_en: Official translations of the Convention with its Protocols , Annexes and Appendices . and the Protocol , shall be prepared in the Arabic , German , Italian and Japanese languages .
Translation: 《公约》及其议定书、附件和附录以及该议定书的正式译本，应以阿拉伯文、德文、意大利文和日文编制。

Query_Text_en: Originals of these official translations shall be deposited with this Final Act .
Translation: 本最终议定书应保存这些正式译文的原件。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General of the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization shall send a certified copy of this Final Act and , when they have been prepared , certified copies of the official translations of the Convention with its Protocols , Annexes and Appendices , the Protocol and the Resolutions of the Conference to the Governments invited to be represented at the Conference in accordance with the wishes of those Governments .
Translation: 政府间海事协商组织秘书长应将本最后议定书的核证无误副本，以及公约及其议定书、附件和附录、会议议定书和决议的正式译本（一经备妥）的核证无误副本，按受邀与会各国政府之意愿，分送各该国政府。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned have affixed their signatures to this Final Act .
Translation: 兹由下列签署人签署本最后文件，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: DONE AT LONDON this second day of November , one thousand nine hundred and seventy-three .
Translation: 一九七三年十一月二日订于伦敦。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The Parties to the Convention undertake to give effect to the provisions of the present Convention and those Annexes thereto by which they are bound , in order to prevent the pollution of the marine environment by the discharge of harmful substances or effluents containing such substances in contravention of the Convention .
Translation: [ 1 ] 本公约各缔约方承诺实施本公约及其所附对其具有约束力的议定书条款，以防止违反公约规定排放有害物质或含有此类物质的废水，造成海洋环境污染。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Unless expressly provided otherwise , a reference to the present Convention constitutes at the same time a reference to its Protocols and to the Annexes .
Translation: [ 2 ] 除非另有明文规定，本公约之援引应同时包括其议定书及附件。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] `` Regulations '' means the Regulations contained in the Annexes to the present Convention .
Translation: "规章"系指本公约附件所载的各项规章。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] `` Harmful substance '' means any substance which , if introduced into the sea , is liable to create hazards to human health , to harm living resources and marine life , to damage amenities or to interfere with other legitimate uses of the sea , and includes any substance subject to control by the present Convention .
Translation: “有害物质”系指任何进入海洋后可能危害人类健康、损害生物资源和海洋生物、破坏环境舒适性或妨碍其他合法利用海洋活动的物质，包括受本公约管控的所有物质。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] release of harmful substances for purposes of legitimate scientific research into pollution abatement or control .
Translation: 为开展污染减排或控制的合法科学研究而排放有害物质。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] `` Ship '' means a vessel of any type whatsoever operating in the marine environment and includes hydrofoil boats , air-cushion vehicles , submersibles , floating craft and fixed or floating platforms .
Translation: [ 4 ] "船舶"系指在海洋环境中运行的任何类型的船只，包括水翼艇、气垫船、潜水器、浮动装置以及固定或浮动平台。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] `` Administration '' means the Government of the State under whose authority the ship is operating .
Translation: [ 5 ] “主管机关”系指船舶运营所在国政府。

Query_Text_en: With respect to a ship entitled to fly a flag of any State , the Administration is the Government of that State .
Translation: 对于有权悬挂任一国家旗帜的船舶，其主管机关即为该国政府。

Query_Text_en: With respect to fixed or floating platforms engaged in exploration and exploitation of the sea-bed and subsoil thereof adjacent to the coast over which the coastal State exercises sovereign rights for the purposes of exploration and exploitation of their natural resources , the Administration is the Government of the coastal State concerned .
Translation: 对于从事勘探和开发邻接沿海国海岸的海底及其底土自然资源的主权权利范围内的活动的固定或浮动平台，其主管机关为有关沿海国政府。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] `` Incident '' means an event involving the actual or probable discharge into the sea of a harmful substance , or effluents containing such a substance .
Translation: [ 6 ] "事故"系指涉及实际或可能将有害物质或含有此类物质的废水排放入海的事件。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] `` Organization '' means the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization .
Translation: [ 7 ] “本组织”系指政府间海事协商组织。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] ships not entitled to fly the flag of a Party but which operate under the authority of a Party .
Translation: [b] 无权悬挂缔约方旗帜但在缔约方授权下运营的船舶。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Nothing in the present Article shall be construed as derogating from or extending the sovereign rights of the Parties under international law over the sea-bed and subsoil thereof adjacent to their coasts for the purposes of exploration and exploitation of their natural resources .
Translation: 本条规定不得解释为减损或扩大缔约方根据国际法对邻接其海岸的海床及其底土所享有的主权权利，该等权利旨在勘探和开发其自然资源。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The present Convention shall not apply to any warship , naval auxiliary or other ship owned or operated by a State and used , for the time being , only on government non-commercial service .
Translation: 本公约不适用于任何由国家拥有或经营、暂时仅用于政府非商业服务的军舰、海军辅助舰艇或其他船舶。

Query_Text_en: However , each Party shall ensure by the adoption of appropriate measures not impairing the operations or operational capabilities of such ships owned or operated by it , that such ships act in a manner consistent , so far as is reasonable and practicable , with the present Convention .
Translation: 然而，各方须在不影响其拥有或运营的此类船舶运行或作业能力的前提下，采取适当措施确保此类船舶在合理可行范围内，其行为符合本公约规定。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Any violation of the requirements of the present Convention shall be prohibited and sanctions shall be established therefor under the law of the Administration of the ship concerned wherever the violation occurs .
Translation: [ 1 ] 无论违规行为发生于何处，均须禁止任何违反本公约要求的行为，并依据船舶所属管理国的法律确立相应处罚措施。

Query_Text_en: If the Administration is informed of such a violation and is satisfied that sufficient evidence is available to enable proceedings to be brought in respect of the alleged violation , it shall cause such proceedings to be taken as soon as possible , in accordance with its law .
Translation: 如行政主管机关获悉该违规行为，并确信已有充分证据可对涉嫌违规行为提起诉讼，则应依照其法律尽快启动相关诉讼程序。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Any violation of the requirements of the present Convention within the jurisdiction of any Party to the Convention shall be prohibited and sanctions shall be established therefor under the law of that Party .
Translation: [ 2 ] 本公约任何缔约方管辖范围内发生的违反本公约要求之行为均应予以禁止，并由该缔约方根据其法律确立相应制裁措施。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] furnish to the Administration of the ship such information and evidence as may be in its possession that a violation has occurred .
Translation: [ b ] 向船舶主管机关提供其掌握的关于违规行为发生的相关信息和证据。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Where information or evidence with respect to any violation of the present Convention by a ship is furnished to the Administration of that ship , the Administration shall promptly inform the Party which has furnished the information or evidence , and the Organization , of the action taken .
Translation: [ 3 ] 当一缔约方就某船舶违反本公约的行为向该船主管机关提供信息或证据时，该主管机关应立即将所采取的行动通报提供信息或证据的缔约方及本组织。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The penalties specified under the law of a Party pursuant to the present Article shall be adequate in severity to discourage violations of the present Convention and shall be equally severe irrespective of where the violations occur .
Translation: [ 4 ] 缔约方依据本条制定的法律所规定的处罚，其严厉程度应足以遏制违反本公约的行为，且无论违法行为发生于何处，均应同等严厉。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Subject to the Provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of the present Article a certificate issued under the authority of a Party to the Convention in accordance with the provisions of the Regulations shall be accepted by the other Parties and regarded for all purposes covered by the present Convention as having the same validity as a certificate issued by them .
Translation: [ 1 ] 在遵守本条第二款规定的前提下，本公约任一缔约方根据条例规定签发的证书，其他缔约方应予接受，并应为本公约一切目的视为与其本国所签发证书具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] A ship required to hold a certificate in accordance with the provisions of the Regulations is subject , while in the ports or off-shore terminals under the jurisdiction of a Party , to inspection by officers duly authorized by that Party .
Translation: [ 2 ] 凡依据本公约规定须持有证书的船舶，当其处于缔约国管辖的港口或近海装卸站时，应接受该缔约国正式授权官员的检查。

Query_Text_en: Any such inspection shall be limited to verifying that there is on board a valid certificate , unless there are clear grounds for believing that the condition of the ship or its equipment does not correspond substantially with the particulars of that certificate .
Translation: 此类检查应仅限于核实船上是否持有有效证书，除非有明显理由认为船舶或其设备状况与该证书所载内容存在重大不符。

Query_Text_en: In that case , or if the ship does not carry a valid certificate , the Party carrying out the inspection shall take such steps as will ensure that the ship shall not sail until it can proceed to sea without presenting an unreasonable threat of harm to the marine environment .
Translation: 在此情况下，或当船舶未持有有效证书时，实施检查的缔约方应采取措施确保该船不得开航，直至其出海航行不会对海洋环境构成不合理危害威胁为止。

Query_Text_en: That Party may , however , grant such a ship permission to leave the port or off-shore terminal for the purpose of proceeding to the nearest appropriate repair yard available .
Translation: 但该缔约方可允许该船舶为驶往最近的可用适当修船厂而离港或驶离近岸码头。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If a Party denies a foreign ship entry to the ports or off-shore terminals under its jurisdiction or takes any action against such a ship for the reason that the ship does not comply with the provisions of the present Convention , the Party shall immediately inform the consul or diplomatic representative of the Party whose flag the ship is entitled to fly , or if this is not possible , the Administration of the ship concerned .
Translation: [3]如缔约方因船舶不符合本公约规定而拒绝其进入管辖范围内的港口或近海码头，或对该船采取任何行动，应立即通知该船有权悬挂其国旗的缔约方的领事或外交代表；若无法通知，则应告知有关船舶的主管机关。

Query_Text_en: Before denying entry or taking such action the Party may request consultation with the Administration of the ship concerned .
Translation: 在拒绝入境或采取此类行动前，缔约方可要求与相关船舶管理部门进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: Information shall also be given to the Administration when a ship does not carry a valid certificate in accordance with the provisions of the Regulations .
Translation: 船舶未持有本条例规定的有效证书的，亦应当向主管机关报告。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] With respect to the ships of non-Parties to the Convention , Parties shall apply the requirements of the present Convention as may be necessary to ensure that no more favourable treatment is given to such ships .
Translation: 对于非本公约缔约国的船舶，各缔约国须在必要时适用本公约规定，以确保此类船舶不享有更优惠待遇。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Parties to the Convention shall co-operate in the detection of violations and the enforcement of the provisions of the present Convention . using all appropriate and practicable measures of detection and environmental monitoring , adequate procedures for reporting and accumulation of evidence .
Translation: [ 1 ] 公约缔约方应通力合作，采用一切适当可行的侦查和环境监测措施，建立充分的证据报告与收集程序，以查明违反本公约行为并确保公约条款得到执行。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] A ship to which the present Convention applies may , in any port or off-shore terminal of a Party , be subject to inspection by officers appointed or authorized by that Party for the purpose of verifying whether the ship has discharged any harmful substances in violation of the provisions of the Regulations .
Translation: [ 2 ] 本公约适用的船舶，在任一缔约国的港口或近海装卸站，均可接受该国委派或授权的官员检查，以核实该船是否违反本附则规定排放了有害物质。

Query_Text_en: If an inspection indicates a violation of the Convention , a report shall be forwarded to the Administration for any appropriate action .
Translation: 如检查发现违反公约行为，应将报告提交主管机关以采取相应措施。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Any Party shall furnish to the Administration evidence , if any , that the ship has discharged harmful substances or effluents containing such substances in violation of the provisions of the Regulations .
Translation: [3]任何缔约国须向主管机关提供证据（如有），证明该船舶违反本规则规定排放了有害物质或含有此类物质的污水。

Query_Text_en: If it is practicable to do so , the competent authority of the former Party shall notify the Master of the ship of the alleged violation .
Translation: 如条件允许，原缔约方主管机关应将涉嫌违规行为通知该船船长。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Upon receiving such evidence , the Administration so informed shall investigate the matter , and may request the other Party to furnish further or better evidence of the alleged contravention .
Translation: [4] 收到此类证据后，被通知的行政当局应对该事项展开调查，并可要求另一方提供涉嫌违规行为的进一步或更确凿证据。

Query_Text_en: If the Administration is satisfied that sufficient evidence is available to enable proceedings to be brought in respect of the alleged violation , it shall cause such proceedings to be taken in accordance with its law as soon as possible .
Translation: 如行政主管机关认定已有充分证据可对涉嫌违法行为提起诉讼，则应依据其法律尽快启动相关诉讼程序。

Query_Text_en: The Administration shall promptly inform the Party which has reported the alleged violation . as well as the Organization , of the action taken .
Translation: 主管部门应立即将所采取的行动通知举报涉嫌违规的一方以及本组织。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] A Party may also inspect a ship to which the present Convention applies when it enters the ports or off-shore terminals under its jurisdiction , if a request for an investigation is received from any Party together with sufficient evidence that the ship has discharged harmful substances or effluents containing such substances in any place .
Translation: [5]若任一缔约国收到关于某船舶在任何地点排放有害物质或含此类物质废液的充分证据并提出调查请求，当该船进入其管辖范围内的港口或近岸终端时，该缔约国亦可对适用本公约的船舶实施检查。

Query_Text_en: The report of such investigation shall be sent to the Party requesting it and to the Administration so that the appropriate action may be taken under the present Convention .
Translation: 调查报告应提交请求调查之当事方及主管机关，以便根据本公约采取适当行动。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] All possible efforts shall be made to avoid a ship being unduly detained or delayed under Articles 4 , 5 or 6 of the present Convention .
Translation: [ 1 ] 应尽一切可能努力，避免船舶因本公约第4条、第5条或第6条规定而遭受不当滞留或延误。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] When a ship is unduly detained or delayed under Article 4 , 5 or 6 of the present Convention , it shall be entitled to compensation for any loss or damage suffered .
Translation: [ 2 ] 若船舶因本公约第四条、第五条或第六条规定而遭受不当扣留或延误，则有权获得所受损失或损害的赔偿。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] A report of an incident shall be made without delay to the fullest extent possible in accordance with the provisions of Protocol I to the present Convention .
Translation: [ 1 ] 应依照本公约第一附加议定书的规定，尽可能毫不迟延地提交事件报告。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] notify the Organization with complete details of such arrangements for circulation to other Parties and Member States of the Organization .
Translation: [b] 向本组织通报此类安排的完整细节，以便分发给本组织其他缔约方和成员国。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] any other State which may be affected .
Translation: [ b ] 任何其他可能受影响的国家。

Query_Text_en: That Party shall , if it considers it appropriate , report accordingly to the Organization and to any other party concerned .
Translation: 该缔约方若认为适当，应向本组织及其他相关方提交相应报告。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Upon its entry into force , the present Convention supersedes the International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution of the Sea by Oil , 1954 , as amended , as between Parties to that Convention .
Translation: 本公约一经生效，即在缔约国之间取代经修正的《1954年国际防止海上油污公约》。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Nothing in the present Convention shall prejudice the codification and development of the law of the sea by the United Nations Conference on the Law of the Sea convened pursuant to Resolution 2750 C [ XXV ] of the General Assembly of the United Nations nor the present or future claims and legal views of any State concerning the law of the sea and the nature and extent of coastal and flag State jurisdiction .
Translation: 本公约任何规定均不妨碍联合国大会第2750 C（XXV）号决议召开的联合国海洋法会议对海洋法的编纂和发展，也不妨碍任何国家就海洋法以及沿海国和船旗国管辖权的性质和范围现在或今后提出的主张和法律意见。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The term `` jurisdiction '' in the present Convention shall be construed in the light of international law in force at the time of application or interpretation of the present Convention .
Translation: [ 3 ] 本公约中"管辖权"一词应根据适用或解释本公约时现行有效的国际法进行理解。

Query_Text_en: Any dispute between two or more Parties to the Convention concerning the interpretation or application of the present Convention shall , if settlement by negotiation between the Parties involved has not been possible , and if these Parties do not otherwise agree , be submitted upon request of any of them to arbitration as set out in Protocol II to the present Convention .
Translation: 本公约两个或两个以上缔约方之间就公约解释或适用产生的任何争议，若相关缔约方无法通过谈判解决，且未能达成其他一致意见，则应其中任一缔约方请求，依照本公约第二号议定书规定提交仲裁解决。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] an annual statistical report , in a form standardized by the Organization , of penalties actually imposed for infringement of the present Convention .
Translation: [ f ] 按本组织规定的标准格式，提交关于违反本公约行为实际所受处罚的年度统计报告。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Organization shall notify Parties of the receipt of any communications under the present Article and circulate to all Parties any information communicated to it under sub-paragraphs [ 1 ] [ b ] to [ f ] of the present Article .
Translation: 本组织应通知各缔约方收到根据本条提交的任何来文，并向所有缔约方分发根据本条第1款第[1]项[b]至[f]目向其通报的任何信息。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Administration undertakes to conduct an investigation of any casualty occurring to any of its ships subject to the provisions of the Regulations if such casualty has produced a major deleterious effect upon the marine environment .
Translation: [ 1 ] 如发生对海洋环境造成重大有害影响的船舶事故，各缔约国政府须对适用本规则条款的所属船舶开展事故调查。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each Party to the Convention undertakes to supply the Organization with information concerning the findings of such investigation , when it judges that such information may assist in determining what changes in the present Convention might be desirable .
Translation: [ 2 ] 本公约各缔约方承诺，在其认为相关信息可能有助于确定本公约需作何种修订时，向本组织提供此类调查结果的相关信息。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The present Convention shall remain open for signature at the Headquarters of the Organization from January 15 , 1974 until December 31 , 1974 and shall thereafter remain open for accession .
Translation: 本公约自1974年1月15日至1974年12月31日在本组织总部开放供签署，此后继续开放供加入。

Query_Text_en: States may become Parties to the present Convention by :
Translation: 各国可通过下列方式成为本公约缔约国：

Query_Text_en: [ c ] accession .
Translation: 加入

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Ratification , acceptance , approval or accession shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument to that effect with the Secretary-General of the Organization .
Translation: [ 2 ] 批准、接受、核准或加入应以向本组织秘书长交存相应文书的方式完成。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Secretary-General of the Organization shall inform all States which have signed the present Convention or acceded to it of any signature or of the deposit of any new instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession and the date of its deposit .
Translation: 本组织秘书长应将本公约的所有签署国或加入国通报每一新签署行为、每一新批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书的交存及其交存日期。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] A State may at the time of signing , ratifying , accepting , approving or acceding to the present Convention declare that it does not accept any one or all of Annexes III , IV and V [ hereinafter referred to as `` Optional Annexes '' ] of the present Convention .
Translation: 一国可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入本公约时，声明其不接受本公约附件三、四、五（以下称"任择附件"）中的任一附件或全部附件。

Query_Text_en: Subject to the above , Parties to the Convention shall be bound by any Annex in its entirety .
Translation: 在遵守上述规定的前提下，本公约缔约方须受任何附件的全部条款约束。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] A State which has declared that it is not bound by an Optional Annex may at any time accept such Annex by depositing with the Organization an instrument of the kind referred to in Article 13 [ 2 ] .
Translation: [2] 已声明不受任择附则约束的国家，可随时通过向本组织提交第十三条[2]款所述文书的方式接受该附则。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] A State which makes a declaration under paragraph [ 1 ] of the present Article in respect of an Optional Annex and which has not subsequently accepted that Annex in accordance with paragraph [ 2 ] of the present Article shall not be under any obligation nor entitled to claim any privileges under the present Convention in respect of matters related to such Annex and all references to Parties in the present Convention shall not include that State in so far as matters related to such Annex are concerned .
Translation: 根据本条第1款对某任择附则作出声明的缔约国，若未按本条第2款随后接受该附则，则无须承担本公约中与该附则相关事项的任何义务，亦无权主张相关特权；且本公约中所有关于"缔约国"的表述，在该附则相关事项上均不适用于该缔约国。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The Organization shall inform the States which have signed or acceded to the present Convention of any declaration under the present Article as well as the receipt of any instrument deposited in accordance with the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of the present Article .
Translation: 本组织应将根据本条所作之任何声明及收到依本条第二款规定交存之任何文书，通知已签署或加入本公约之各国。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The present Convention shall enter into force twelve months after the date on which not less than 15 States , the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than fifty per cent of the gross tonnage of the world 's merchant shipping , have become parties to it in accordance with Article 13 .
Translation: 本公约应自按第十三条规定成为缔约国的不少于15个国家，且其商船总吨位合计不少于世界商船总吨位的百分之五十之日起十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] An Optional Annex shall enter into force twelve months after the date on which the conditions stipulated in paragraph [ 1 ] of the present Article have been satisfied in relation to that Annex .
Translation: [ 2 ] 任择附件应在本条第[ 1 ]款所规定之条件就该附件得到满足后十二个月生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Organization shall inform the States which have signed the present Convention or acceded to it of the date on which it enters into force and of the date on which an Optional Annex enters into force in accordance with paragraph [ 2 ] of the present Article .
Translation: 本组织应将本公约生效日期及按本条第[2]款任选附则生效日期通知已签署或加入本公约的国家。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] For States which have deposited an instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession in respect of the present Convention or any Optional Annex after the requirements for entry into force there of have been met but prior to the date of entry into force , the ratification , acceptance , approval or accession shall take effect on the date of entry into force of the Convention or such Annex or three months after the date of deposit of the instrument whichever is the later date .
Translation: 对于在本公约或任何任选附则生效条件满足后、但正式生效之日前已提交批准、接受、核准或加入文书的国家，其批准、接受、核准或加入行为应于公约或该附则生效之日，或文书交存之日起满三个月后生效，以较晚之日期为准。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] For States which have deposited an instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession after the date on which the Convention or an Optional Annex entered into force , the Convention or the Optional Annex shall become effective three months after the date of deposit of the instrument .
Translation: 对于在本公约或任选附则生效之日后交存批准、接受、核准或加入文书的国家，本公约或该任选附则应自文书交存之日起三个月后对其生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] After the date on which all the conditions required under Article 16 to bring an amendment to the present Convention or an Optional Annex into force have been fulfiled , any instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession deposited shall apply to the Convention or Annex as amended .
Translation: 根据《公约》第十六条规定，修正本公约或任择附件的全部生效条件满足后，所交存的任何批准、接受、核准或加入文书，均应适用于修正后的公约或附件。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The present Convention may be amended by any of the procedures specified in the following paragraphs .
Translation: [ 1 ] 本公约可通过下列条款规定的任一程序予以修订。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] any amendment proposed by a Party to the Convention shall be submitted to the Organization and circulated by its Secretary-General to all Members of the Organization and all Parties at least six months prior to its consideration ;
Translation: [ a ] 本公约任何缔约方提出的修正案应提交本组织，并由秘书长至少在审议前六个月分发给本组织所有成员国及所有缔约方；

Query_Text_en: [ b ] any amendment proposed and circulated as above shall be submitted to an appropriate body by the Organization for consideration ;
Translation: [ b ] 任何按上述程序提出并分发的修正案，应由本组织提交相关机构审议；

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Parties to the Convention , whether or not Members of the Organization , shall be entitled to participate in the proceedings of the appropriate body ;
Translation: 本公约缔约方，无论是否为本组织成员，均有权参与相关机构的议事程序。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] amendments shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of only the Parties to the Convention present voting ;
Translation: [d]项修正案应由出席会议并参加表决的本公约缔约方以三分之二多数票通过；

Query_Text_en: [ e ] if adopted in accordance with sub-paragraph [ d ] above , amendments shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the Organization to all the Parties to the Convention for acceptance ;
Translation: 若根据上述[d]项通过修正案，应由本组织秘书长通报公约所有缔约方以供接受；

Query_Text_en: [ i ] an amendment to an Article of the Convention shall be deemed to have been accepted on the date on which it is accepted by two-thirds of the Parties , the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than fifty per cent of the gross tonnage of the world 's merchant fleet ;
Translation: 本公约某一条款的修正案应视为在获得三分之二缔约国接受之日即被接受，且接受国商船总吨位合计不少于世界商船总吨位的百分之五十。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] an amendment to an Annex to the Convention shall be deemed to have been accepted in accordance with the procedure specified in sub-paragraph [ f ] [ iii ] unless the appropriate body , at the time of its adoption , determines that the amendment shall be deemed to have been accepted on the date on which it is accepted by two-thirds of the Parties , the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than fifty per cent of the gross tonnage of the world 's merchant fleet .
Translation: [二]公约附件的修正案应视为已按[六][三]项规定的程序获得接受，除非相关机构在通过该修正案时决定：该修正案须在获得三分之二缔约国接受后方视为已被接受，且这些缔约国的商船总吨位合计不低于世界商船总吨位的百分之五十。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , at any time before the entry into force of an amendment to an Annex to the Convention , a Party may notify the Secretary-General of the Organization that its express approval will be necessary before the amendment enters into force for it .
Translation: 然而，在公约附件修正案生效前的任何时间，缔约方可通知本组织秘书长，声明该修正案须经其明确批准方能对其生效。

Query_Text_en: The latter shall bring such notification and the date of its receipt to the notice of Parties ;
Translation: 后者应将此类通知及其收悉日期告知各缔约方；

Query_Text_en: [ v ] an amendment to Protocol II to the Convention shall be subject to the same procedures as for the amendments to an Article of the Convention , as provided for in sub-paragraph [ f ] [ i ] above ;
Translation: 对《公约》第二号议定书的修正应依照上文第[f][i]项规定的《公约》条款修正程序进行。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] in the case of an amendment to an Article of the Convention , to Protocol II . or to Protocol I or to an Annex to the Convention not under the procedure specified in sub-paragraph [ f ] [ iii ] , the amendment accepted in conformity with the foregoing provisions shall enter into force six months after the date of its acceptance with respect to the Parties which have declared that they have accepted it ;
Translation: 如对《公约》某一条款、《第二议定书》、《第一议定书》或未按[ f ]款[ iii ]项程序修订的《公约》附件提出修正案，则根据上述规定获得接受的修正案应自接受之日起六个月后对已声明接受该修正案的缔约方生效；

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] in the case of an amendment to Protocol I , to an Appendix to an Annex or an Annex to the Convention under the procedure specified in sub-paragraph [ f ] [ iii ] , the amendment deemed to have been accepted in accordance with the foregoing conditions shall enter into force six months after its acceptance for all the Parties with the exception of those which , before that date , have made a declaration that they do not accept it or a declaration under sub-paragraph [ f ] [ ii ] , that their express approval is necessary .
Translation: [二]对于按照[六][三]项程序修订的《第一议定书》、公约某附件的附录或某附件，根据上述条件视为已被接受的修正案，应在接受之日后六个月对所有缔约方生效，但在此日期前已声明不接受该修正案，或根据[六][二]项声明须经其明确批准的缔约方除外。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Upon the request of a Party , concurred in by at least one-third of the Parties , the Organization shall convene a Conference of Parties to the Convention to consider amendments to the present Convention .
Translation: 应某一缔约方请求并经至少三分之一缔约方同意，本组织应召开公约缔约方大会，审议对本公约的修正案。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Every amendment adopted by such a Conference by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting of the Parties shall be communicated by the Secretary-General of the Organization to all Contracting Parties for their acceptance .
Translation: [ b ] 凡经此类会议以出席并参加表决的缔约方三分之二多数通过的修正案，应由本组织秘书长通报全体缔约方以供接受。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Unless the Conference decides otherwise , the amendment shall be deemed to have been accepted and to have entered into force in accordance with the procedures specified for that purpose in paragraph [ 2 ] [ f ] and [ g ] above .
Translation: 除缔约方大会另有决定外，该修正案应视为已获接受，并按照上文第[2]款[（f）]项和[（g）]项规定的程序生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ a ] In the case of an Amendment to an Optional Annex , a reference in the present Article to a `` Party to the Convention '' shall be deemed to mean a reference to a Party bound by that Annex .
Translation: [4][a] 对于任择附件的修正案，本条款中所述"公约缔约方"应视为指受该附件约束的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any Party which has declined to accept an amendment to an Annex shall be treated as a non-Party only for the purpose of application of that Amendment .
Translation: [ b ] 任何拒绝接受某附件修正案的缔约方，仅就该修正案之适用而言，应视为非缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The adoption and entry into force of a new Annex shall be subject to the same procedures as for the adoption and entry into force of an amendment to an Article of the Convention .
Translation: 新附件的通过和生效程序应与本公约条款修正案的通过和生效程序相同。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] Unless expressly provided otherwise , any amendment to the present Convention made under this Article , which relates to the structure of a ship , shall apply only to ships for which the building contract is placed , or in the absence of a building contract , the keel of which is laid , on or after the date on which the amendment comes into force .
Translation: 除另有明文规定外，根据本条对本公约作出的任何涉及船舶结构的修正案，仅适用于修正案生效之日或之后签订建造合同的船舶；若无建造合同，则适用于该日期或之后安放龙骨的船舶。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] Any amendment to a Protocol or to an Annex shall relate to the substance of that Protocol or Annex and shall be consistent with the Articles of the present Convention .
Translation: [7] 对议定书或附件的任何修正均应涉及该议定书或附件的实质内容，并须符合本公约条款之规定。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] The Secretary-General of the Organization shall inform all Parties of any amendments which enter into force under the present Article , together with the date on which each such amendment enters into force .
Translation: [ 8 ] 本组织秘书长应将根据本条生效的任何修正案及其生效日期一并通报全体缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ 9 ] Any declaration of acceptance or of objection to an amendment under the present Article shall be notified in writing to the Secretary-General of the Organization .
Translation: [ 9 ] 根据本条所作之修正案接受或反对的任何声明，均应以书面形式通知本组织秘书长。

Query_Text_en: The latter shall bring such notification and the date of its receipt to the notice of the Parities to the Convention .
Translation: 后者应将此项通知及其收到日期告知公约各缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] the encouragement of research .
Translation: 鼓励开展研究工作。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The present Convention or any Optional Annex may be denounced by any Parties to the Convention at any time after the expiry of five years from the date on which the Convention or such Annex enters into force for that Party .
Translation: [ 1 ] 本公约或任何任择附件的缔约国，可在该公约或附件对其生效满五年后的任何时间，退出该公约或附件。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Denunciation shall be effected by notification in writing to the Secretary General of the Organization who shall inform all the other Parties of any such notification received and of the date of its receipt as well as the date on which such denunciation takes effect .
Translation: [ 2 ] 退出应以书面形式通知本组织秘书长，秘书长须将收到的所有此类通知及其收讫日期和退出生效日期告知其他缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] A denunciation shall take effect twelve months after receipt of the notification of denunciation by the Secretary-General of the Organization or after the expiry of any other longer period which may be indicated in the notification .
Translation: 退约通知经本组织秘书长收悉后满十二个月，或通知中所载任何更长时限届满时，退约即行生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The present Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the Organization who shall transmit certified true copies thereof to all States which have signed the present Convention or acceded to it .
Translation: [ 1 ] 本公约应交存本组织秘书长保存，秘书长应将核证无误的副本分送所有签署或加入本公约的国家。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] As soon as the present Convention enters into force , the text shall be transmitted by the Secretary-General of the Organization to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration and publication , in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations .
Translation: [ 2 ] 本公约一经生效，其文本应由本组织秘书长根据《联合国宪章》第一百零二条规定，送交联合国秘书长登记并公布。

Query_Text_en: The present Convention is established in a single copy in the English , French , Russian and Spanish languages , each text being equally authentic .
Translation: 本公约以英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文单一正本形式制定，各文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: Official translations in the Arabic , German , Italian and Japanese languages shall be prepared and deposited with the signed original .
Translation: 阿拉伯文、德文、意大利文及日文之正式译本，应与签署之正本一并备存。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned being duly authorized by their respective Governments for that purpose have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 兹由经各自政府正式授权之下列签署人签署本公约，以昭信守。

Query_Text_en: Explosions on offshore installations have come very much into the focus in the last few years because new insight has revealed that previous knowledge about blast loads is obsolete .
Translation: 近年来，海上设施爆炸事件备受关注，最新研究表明原有爆炸荷载理论已不适用。

Query_Text_en: Even worse , the blast loads that result from the latest tests are so high that they can not be designed against , in many cases .
Translation: 更糟糕的是，最新测试产生的爆炸载荷过高，多数情况下根本无法通过设计手段抵御。

Query_Text_en: Estimation and assessment of blast loads are therefore important subjects for this book .
Translation: 因此，爆炸荷载的估算与评估构成本书的重要研究课题。

Query_Text_en: The physical laws and detailed calculation methods are outside the scope of this book because it would be a book in itself .
Translation: 本书不涉及物理定律及具体计算方法，因其内容足以自成专著。

Query_Text_en: A brief introduction to some of the main concepts is provided .
Translation: 以下简要介绍若干主要概念。

Query_Text_en: Evaluation of secondary blast effects , such as missiles , etc.
Translation: 评估二次爆炸效应，如抛射物等。

Query_Text_en: Explosion modelling has been substantially improved as a result of a program of large scale tests conducted through the BFETS [ Blast and Fire Engineering for Topside Structures ] research program [ SCI , 1998 ] .
Translation: 通过"上部结构爆炸与火灾工程"（BFETS）研究项目开展的大规模试验计划[钢铁建筑研究所，1998年]，爆炸建模技术已取得显著改进。

Query_Text_en: The knowledge gained through this program has led to the realisation that loads are likely to be considerably higher than previously thought .
Translation: 通过本项目获得的认识表明，实际负荷可能远超此前预期。

Query_Text_en: An assessment of the effects of explosion loads on people is parallel with the structural effects analysis , although in some respects considerably simpler .
Translation: 对爆炸荷载对人体影响的评估与结构效应分析同步进行，尽管在某些方面要简单得多。

Query_Text_en: Some indicative loads were mentioned in Section 7.3.3 .
Translation: 部分参考荷载已在第7.3.3节中列出。

Query_Text_en: The frequency of explosion events is usually estimated from an event tree analysis in QRA studies .
Translation: 在定量风险评估研究中，爆炸事件的发生频率通常通过事件树分析法进行估算。

Query_Text_en: Consider Figure 9.1 , which is the same as used in Chapter 5 in order to illustrate the simple event tree following a process leak .
Translation: 请见图9.1，该图与第5章所用相同，旨在说明工艺泄漏后的简化事件树。

Query_Text_en: ESD successful , ignition inside module .
Translation: 静电放电成功，模块内部点火启动。

Query_Text_en: The simple event tree assumes that all ignitions of the gas leak lead to explosions .
Translation: 简单事件树模型假设所有燃气泄漏引发的点火都会导致爆炸。

Query_Text_en: A detailed event tree will differentiate more explicitly between ignition causing an explosion and just causing a fire .
Translation: 详细事件树将更明确区分引发爆炸的着火与仅导致火灾的着火。

Query_Text_en: Calculation of event frequencies in the event tree will establish the explosion frequencies for all explosion cases , irrespective of associated blast load .
Translation: 通过事件树中事件频率的计算，可确定所有爆炸情景的爆炸频率，无论其是否伴随冲击波载荷。

Query_Text_en: Norwegian Sea
Translation: 挪威海

Query_Text_en: Atlantic Sea [ West of Shetland ]
Translation: 大西洋海域（设得兰群岛以西）

Query_Text_en: North Sea
Translation: 北海

Query_Text_en: With respect to explosions , there are registrations in the UK as well as Norwegian sectors .
Translation: 关于爆炸事件，英国和挪威海域均有记录在案。

Query_Text_en: In the Danish sector , one exploration drilling well blowout resulted in an explosion in 1977 , but mobile drilling units are excluded from the study referen-ced .
Translation: 1977年，丹麦海域一口勘探井发生井喷爆炸事故，但相关研究未将移动式钻井装置纳入统计范围。

Query_Text_en: There has also been a significant explosion on a production installation [ in 2001 ] in the period after the study period .
Translation: 研究期结束后[2001年]，一处生产设施曾发生重大爆炸事故。

Query_Text_en: In the Dutch sector , no explosions have been registered in the WOAD . data-base , neither on fixed nor floating installations .
Translation: 荷兰海域的WOAD数据库中，无论固定还是浮动设施均未记录到爆炸事件。

Query_Text_en: However , there are confirmed reports of one accident in the Dutch sector in August 1995 , whereby a small explosion occurred in an open area ignited by the hot oil heating system .
Translation: 然而，有确凿报告显示，1995年8月荷兰作业区曾发生一起事故，当时热油加热系统在露天区域引发小型爆炸。

Query_Text_en: Minor damage occurred , but details are not known , and the event is not registered in either WOAD . or Lloyds ' List database .
Translation: 受损情况轻微，但具体细节尚不明确，且该事件未记录于世界事故数据库（WOAD）或劳合社海事数据库。

Query_Text_en: The fire is certain to have occurred , but the explosion preceding it is not confirmed , due to the lack of sources .
Translation: 火灾确已发生，但此前是否发生爆炸尚无法证实，因信息来源不足。

Query_Text_en: Conservatively , it has been assumed that it was an explosion , but with a low overpressure .
Translation: 保守估计，初步判定为一次低超压爆炸事件。

Query_Text_en: 34 relevant explosion incidents have occurred in the relevant areas during the 25 year period .
Translation: 在25年期间，相关地区共发生34起爆炸事故。

Query_Text_en: The following distribution is found :
Translation: 经查，分配情况如下：

Query_Text_en: Denmark : 0 incident
Translation: 丹麦：零事故

Query_Text_en: It is likely that there is some extent of underreporting from the sectors outside the Norwegian sector , due to the fact that the WOAD . database has closer connections to Norwegian authorities than to British , Dutch and Danish .
Translation: 由于WOAD数据库与挪威当局的联系比与英国、荷兰和丹麦更为紧密，挪威以外地区的漏报情况可能存在一定程度。

Query_Text_en: Duration of pressure peaks .
Translation: 压力峰值持续时间

Query_Text_en: Both these two aspects are important when responses and effects are being evaluated , but the descriptions were too vague [ even after consulting with the companies ] in order to allow any such considerations .
Translation: 在评估应对措施及效果时，这两方面因素都至关重要，但相关表述过于笼统（即便经与企业磋商后），仍无法据此作出任何判断。

Query_Text_en: Table 9.1 presents an overview of the 34 blast occurrences identified during the 25 year period , and an assessment of the applicability under various assumptions .
Translation: 表9.1汇总了25年间发生的34起爆炸事故概况，并就不同假设条件下的适用性进行了评估。

Query_Text_en: There is a clear downwards trend in the number of explosions per year for the ` old ' installations , as time passes .
Translation: 随着时间的推移，"老旧"设施的年均爆炸事故数量呈现明显下降趋势。

Query_Text_en: Such a trend may be observed for significant as well as insignificant explosions [ i.e. above and below 0.2 bar ] .
Translation: 这一趋势在重大爆炸和轻微爆炸中均可观察到（即压力值高于和低于0.2巴的情况）。

Query_Text_en: It is therefore concluded that quite considerable conservatism is implied by using the 25 year period with all installations included .
Translation: 因此可以断定，采用包含所有设施的25年周期数据，意味着存在相当大的保守性。

Query_Text_en: An adjustment of the overall frequencies has therefore been made .
Translation: 因此，已对总体频率进行了调整。

Query_Text_en: Unadjusted values are also presented in the report .
Translation: 报告中也列明了未经调整的数值。

Query_Text_en: Comparison was also made between Norwegian and UK installations , but the numbers were too low in order to draw firm conclusions .
Translation: 此外，还对挪威和英国的设施进行了比较，但由于样本数量不足，无法得出确切结论。

Query_Text_en: Frequencies have been estimated on a ` per platform year basis ' as well as a ` per explosion area year ' basis .
Translation: 频率估算采用"单平台年度"和"单爆破区年度"双重基准。

Query_Text_en: Figure 9.2 is limited to results for explosion areas and shows adjusted exceedance frequencies .
Translation: 图9.2仅展示爆炸区域的评估结果，并呈现经调整的超限频率数据。

Query_Text_en: These frequencies have been based on different interpretations of the data , whereby only events relevant to normal opera-tion are used in one case , whereas all events are used in another interpretation .
Translation: 这些频率的设定基于对数据的不同解读方式：一种仅采用与正常运行相关的事件作为计算依据，另一种则将所有事件纳入统计范畴。

Query_Text_en: Also an upper 50 % prediction limit is presented , based on only the so-called ` relevant events ' .
Translation: 同时，基于所谓的"相关事件"，还提出了一个50%的上限预测区间。

Query_Text_en: The exceedance diagram below uses the lower limits in the overpressure ranges as basis for the plotting .
Translation: 下图超压范围示意图以各超压区间的下限值为基准绘制。

Query_Text_en: It was considered that there is some extent of conservatism in the adjusted frequencies .
Translation: 经评估，调整后的频率存在一定程度的保守倾向。

Query_Text_en: It is therefore recommended in the report [ Vinnem , 1998 ] that the 50 % upper prediction limits are used as the upper limits against which results from QRA may be compared .
Translation: 因此，报告[Vinnem，1998]建议采用50%上限预测值作为量化风险评估（QRA）结果的比对基准上限。

Query_Text_en: The values are based on the events relevant to normal production , and a conservative interpretation of the data regarding damage .
Translation: 这些数值基于与正常生产相关的事件，以及对损害数据的保守解读。

Query_Text_en: Explosion loads can range from less than 100 mbar overpressure to many bars overpressure .
Translation: 爆炸载荷产生的超压范围可从不足100毫巴到数巴不等。

Query_Text_en: Damage to process equipment thereby causing immediate escalation of the accident .
Translation: 工艺设备受损，导致事故迅速升级。

Query_Text_en: It is worthwhile noting that the Piper Alpha accident was of the last type .
Translation: 值得注意的是，派珀阿尔法平台事故正属于最后一种类型。

Query_Text_en: Very few events of the first type have occurred on offshore installations , but there have been several on onshore petrochemical and chemical plants .
Translation: 海上设施极少发生第一类事故，但陆上石化与化工厂已发生多起此类事件。

Query_Text_en: The best known accident of this type is the explosion at the Flixborough plant in the UK in 1974 .
Translation: 此类事故中最广为人知的是1974年英国弗利克斯伯勒工厂爆炸事件。

Query_Text_en: This phenomenon has several names : ` Gas explosion ' , ` gaseous explosion ' , ` unconfined vapor cloud explosion ' , ` vapor cloud explosion ' or ` fuel air explosion ' .
Translation: 该现象存在多种称谓："气体爆炸"、"气相爆炸"、"无约束蒸气云爆炸"、"蒸气云爆炸"或"燃料空气爆炸"。

Query_Text_en: The term ` gas explosion ' is used in the following .
Translation: “燃气爆炸”一词在下文中使用。

Query_Text_en: An explosion is defined as an event leading to a rapid increase of pressure .
Translation: 爆炸是指导致压力急剧升高的事件。

Query_Text_en: This pressure increase may arise from many different causes ; nuclear reactions , loss of containment in high pressure vessels , high explosives , metal water vapor explosions , run-away reactions , combustion of dust , mist or gas [ including vapors ] in air or in other oxidisers .
Translation: 压力升高可能由多种不同因素引发：核反应、高压容器密封失效、烈性炸药爆炸、金属与水蒸气反应引发的爆炸、失控化学反应、粉尘燃烧、空气或其他氧化剂中的雾滴或气体（包括蒸气）燃烧等。

Query_Text_en: The burning of gas , liquids , or solids in which fuel is oxidised involves heat release and often light emission .
Translation: 气体、液体或固体燃料在氧化燃烧过程中会释放热量，并常伴随发光现象。

Query_Text_en: The chemical products from complete combustion of a hydrocarbon fuel are mainly CO2 and H2O vapor .
Translation: 碳氢燃料完全燃烧后产生的化学产物主要为二氧化碳和水蒸气。

Query_Text_en: The combustion process will result in increased temperature , due to the transformation of chemically bound energy into heat .
Translation: 燃烧过程将导致温度升高，这是由于化学结合能转化为热能所致。

Query_Text_en: It should be emphasised that the above equation constitutes a great simplification of the real combustion process .
Translation: 需要强调的是，上述方程式是对实际燃烧过程的极大简化。

Query_Text_en: The combustion of gaseous fuels in air may develop in two different modes .
Translation: 气体燃料在空气中的燃烧可能呈现两种不同模式。

Query_Text_en: The most common is fire ,
Translation: 最常见的是火灾，

Query_Text_en: where fuel and oxygen are mixed during the combustion process .
Translation: 燃料与氧气在燃烧过程中混合。

Query_Text_en: In the other case fuel and air [ or another oxidiser ] are premixed and the fuel concentration must be within the flammability limits for ignition to occur .
Translation: 另一种情况是燃料与空气（或其他氧化剂）预先混合，此时燃料浓度必须处于可燃范围内才能实现点火。

Query_Text_en: In general the premixed situation allows the fuel to burn faster i.e. , more fuel is consumed per unit time .
Translation: 一般而言，预混燃烧模式能加快燃料燃烧速度，即在单位时间内消耗更多燃料。

Query_Text_en: The premixed fuel may also burn as a fire , if ignited prior to building up a cloud of any size .
Translation: 预混燃料若在形成任何规模的云团前被引燃，也可能以明火形式燃烧。

Query_Text_en: A gas explosion is a process where combustion of a premixed gas cloud [ i.e. fuel air ] causes a rapid increase of pressure .
Translation: 燃气爆炸是指预混气体云（即燃料与空气混合物）燃烧导致压力急剧上升的过程。

Query_Text_en: Gas explosions can occur inside process equipment or pipes , in buildings or offshore modules , in open process areas , or in unconfined areas .
Translation: 气体爆炸可能发生在工艺设备或管道内部、建筑物或海上模块内、开放式工艺区域，亦或是无围挡区域。

Query_Text_en: The consequences of a gas explosion will depend on the environment in which the gas cloud is contained or which the gas cloud engulfs .
Translation: 燃气爆炸的后果取决于气体云所处的密闭环境或其扩散覆盖的范围。

Query_Text_en: Therefore it is natural to classify a gas explosion from the environment in which the explosion takes place .
Translation: 因此，根据爆炸发生的环境对瓦斯爆炸进行分类是合理的。

Query_Text_en: Unconfined gas explosions in process plants and other unconfined areas .
Translation: 工艺装置及其他非受限区域的非受限气体爆炸

Query_Text_en: It should be pointed out that these terms are not precise , and in an accidental event it may be hard to classify the explosion .
Translation: 需要指出的是，这些术语并不精确，在突发性事件中可能难以对爆炸类型进行准确归类。

Query_Text_en: As an example , an unconfined explosion in a process plant may also involve partly confined explosions in compartments into which the gas cloud has leaked .
Translation: 例如，加工厂内的非密闭爆炸也可能引发气体云泄漏进入的隔间发生部分密闭爆炸。

Query_Text_en: Confined gas explosions are explosions within tanks , process equipment , pipes , culverts , sewage systems , closed rooms and underground installations .
Translation: 受限空间气体爆炸是指发生在储罐、工艺设备、管道、涵洞、污水系统、密闭房间及地下设施内部的爆炸。

Query_Text_en: Confined explosions are also called internal explosions .
Translation: 密闭爆炸亦称内部爆炸。

Query_Text_en: A typical property of this kind of explosion is that the combustion process does not need to be fast in order to cause serious pressure build-up .
Translation: 此类爆炸的典型特性在于，燃烧过程无需剧烈即可引发严重的压力积聚。

Query_Text_en: Partly confined explosions occur when fuel is accidentally released inside a building which is partly open .
Translation: 部分受限爆炸是指燃料在部分开放的建筑物内意外泄漏时发生的爆炸。

Query_Text_en: Typical cases are compressor rooms and offshore modules .
Translation: 典型案例包括压缩机房和海上模块。

Query_Text_en: The building will confine the explosion and the explosion pressure can only be relieved through the explosion vent areas [ i.e. open areas in the walls or light relief walls that open quickly at low overpressure ] , or through failure of the surrounding enclosure .
Translation: 该建筑将限制爆炸冲击，爆炸压力仅能通过泄爆区域（即墙体开口或能在较低超压时快速开启的轻型泄压墙）释放，或通过外围围护结构的破坏得以缓解。

Query_Text_en: The term ` unconfined gas explosion ' is used to describe explosions in open areas such as process plants .
Translation: "非受限气体爆炸"这一术语用于描述诸如加工厂等开放区域的爆炸事故。

Query_Text_en: Large scale tests have demonstrated that a truly unconfined , unobstructed gas cloud ignited by a weak ignition source will only produce low overpressures while burning [ flash fire ] .
Translation: 大规模试验表明，由微弱点火源引燃的真正无约束、无障碍气体云团燃烧时仅会产生较低超压（闪燃现象）。

Query_Text_en: In a process plant there are local areas which are partly confined and obstructed .
Translation: 在工艺装置中，存在部分封闭且存在障碍物的局部区域。

Query_Text_en: In the case of a deflagration it is these areas that are causing high explosion pressures .
Translation: 爆燃发生时，正是这些区域产生了极高的爆炸压力。

Query_Text_en: A deflagration has a limited burning velocity , in the range 100 - 500 m /s .
Translation: 爆燃的燃烧速度有限，通常在每秒100至500米之间。

Query_Text_en: However , if an unconfined gas cloud detonates , the explosion pressure will be very high , in the order of 20 bar , and in principle independent of confinement and obstructions .
Translation: 然而，若未受约束的气体云团发生爆燃，其爆炸压力将高达约20巴，且原则上不受密闭空间与障碍物的影响。

Query_Text_en: The detonation front travels as a shock front , followed closely by a combustion wave .
Translation: 爆轰波以冲击波阵面的形式传播，紧随其后的是燃烧波。

Query_Text_en: The velocity of the detonation front reaches that of the speed of sound in the hot products , and thus substantially higher than in unburnt mixture .
Translation: 爆轰波阵面的传播速度达到高温产物中的声速水平，因而显著高于未燃烧混合气体中的声速。

Query_Text_en: The detonation front velocity may reach 2000～3000m/s .
Translation: 爆轰波前速度可达2000～3000米/秒。

Query_Text_en: A blast wave can be defined as the air wave set in motion by an explosion .
Translation: 爆炸冲击波可定义为爆炸引发的空气波动。

Query_Text_en: The term ` blast wave ' includes sonic compression waves , shock waves and rarefaction waves .
Translation: "冲击波"一词包括声压缩波、激波和稀疏波。

Query_Text_en: Figure 9.3 illustrates in principle different types of blast waves .
Translation: 图9.3展示了不同类型的冲击波原理示意图。

Query_Text_en: a sonic compression wave and a rarefaction wave .
Translation: 一个压缩声波和一个稀疏波。

Query_Text_en: The type of blast wave depends on how and when the energy is released in the explosion and the distance from the explosion area .
Translation: 爆炸冲击波的类型取决于爆炸中能量的释放方式与时间，以及与爆炸源的距离。

Query_Text_en: For strong explosions Category 1 is typical .
Translation: 对于剧烈爆炸，第一类情形较为典型。

Query_Text_en: Weak explosions initially give Category 3 , but the wave can be ` shocking up ' and end as Category 1 when it propagates away from the explosion .
Translation: 初始微弱的爆炸虽归为第三类，但当冲击波向外扩散时可能"激化升级"，最终形成第一类爆炸。

Query_Text_en: Pressure is a type of stress which is exerted uniformly in all directions and is measured as the force exerted per unit area .
Translation: 压力是一种均匀作用于各个方向的应力，其计量单位为每单位面积所承受的作用力。

Query_Text_en: In fluid dynamics we often use the terms like static pressure , dynamic pressure and stagnation pressure .
Translation: 在流体力学中，我们常用静压、动压和滞止压力等术语。

Query_Text_en: Static pressure is what we normally call the pressure .
Translation: 静压即我们通常所称的压力。

Query_Text_en: Dynamic pressure is the pressure increase that a moving fluid would have if it was brought to rest by isentropic flow against a pressure gradient .
Translation: 动压是指运动流体在逆压力梯度等熵流动至静止状态时所产生的压力增量。

Query_Text_en: Stagnation pressure is the pressure that a moving fluid would have if it was brought to rest by isentropic flow against a pressure gradient .
Translation: 滞止压力是指运动流体在逆压力梯度的等熵流动中被阻滞至静止状态时所具有的压力。

Query_Text_en: The stagnation pressure is the sum of the static and the dynamic pressures .
Translation: 滞止压力等于静压与动压之和。

Query_Text_en: For blast waves and shock waves we use the terms side-on pressure and reflected pressure .
Translation: 对于爆炸波和冲击波，我们采用侧向压力与反射压力这两个术语。

Query_Text_en: The side-on pressure is measured perpendicular to the propagation direction of the wave .
Translation: 侧向压力垂直于波的传播方向进行测量。

Query_Text_en: Side-on pressure is the static pressure behind the shock wave .
Translation: 侧向压力是冲击波后方的静压。

Query_Text_en: The reflected pressure is measured when the wave hits an object like a wall head-on .
Translation: 反射压力是指冲击波正面撞击墙体等物体时测得的压力值。

Query_Text_en: Since reflection is not an isentropic process there is a difference between stagnation pressure and the reflected pressure .
Translation: 由于反射过程并非等熵过程，滞止压力与反射压力之间存在差异。

Query_Text_en: These definitions of side-on and reflected pressures are illustrated in Figure 9.4 .
Translation: 侧向压力与反射压力的定义如图9.4所示。

Query_Text_en: If the gas cloud formed by a release is outside the flammable concentration range [ i.e. the interval between LEL and UEL ] , or there is no ignition source , combustion will not occur .
Translation: 若泄漏形成的气云浓度处于可燃范围之外（即低于爆炸下限或高于爆炸上限），或不存在点火源，则不会发生燃烧。

Query_Text_en: Subsequently the gas cloud will dilute and disappear .
Translation: 随后，气云将逐渐稀释并最终消散。

Query_Text_en: In the case of an immediate ignition a fire will develop .
Translation: 一旦立即点火，火势将迅速蔓延。

Query_Text_en: The most dangerous situation , however , will occur if a large flammable premixed fuel air cloud is formed and ignited .
Translation: 然而，最危险的情况是形成大面积可燃性预混油气云团并被引燃。

Query_Text_en: A serious explosion may then result .
Translation: 届时可能引发剧烈爆炸。

Query_Text_en: The released substance can be a gas , an evaporating liquid , or a gas-liquid [ two phase ] flow .
Translation: 释放物质可能为气体、挥发性液体或气液两相流。

Query_Text_en: The source will be characterised as a jet release [ i.e. gas , two phase ] or evaporating liquid , or a diffuse release , [ i.e. evaporating pool ] .
Translation: 排放源将界定为喷射释放（即气体、两相流）或蒸发液体，或弥散释放（即蒸发池）。

Query_Text_en: The two sources have quite different characteristics .
Translation: 这两种信息来源具有截然不同的特征。

Query_Text_en: The jet release will have a high momentum and establish a strong flow field due to additional air entrainment .
Translation: 喷流释放时将产生高动量，并因额外空气卷吸作用而形成强劲流场。

Query_Text_en: Recirculation zones may be generated where the gas concentration can reach a combustible cloud .
Translation: 气体浓度可能达到可燃水平的区域会形成再循环区。

Query_Text_en: The evaporating pool will act as a diffuse release source , the wind forces and buoyancy will control the dispersion process .
Translation: 蒸发池将作为扩散释放源发挥作用，风力与浮力将主导其扩散过程。

Query_Text_en: The flow velocities will be much lower than for the jet release .
Translation: 流速将远低于喷射释放时的水平。

Query_Text_en: If the evaporating liquid forms a dense gas , a layer of combustible gas may be formed at the ground level , or in a lower compartment .
Translation: 若挥发性液体形成高浓度气体，可能在地面或低层空间形成可燃气体层。

Query_Text_en: Similarly in an open area a dense gas cloud will have the tendency to intrude into confined spaces such as buildings , which may pose serious problems due to high overpressure .
Translation: 同样，在开阔区域，高密度气体云团易侵入建筑物等密闭空间，由于超压过高，可能造成严重后果。

Query_Text_en: To ignite a gas cloud requires an ignition source with sufficient strength .
Translation: 引燃气云需要具备足够强度的点火源。

Query_Text_en: The minimum ignition energy depends on fuel concentration and the type of fuel , see Figure 9.5 .
Translation: 最小点火能量取决于燃料浓度和燃料类型，详见图9.5。

Query_Text_en: The minimum energy occurs for a concentration which is close to the stoichiometric mixture .
Translation: 最低能量出现在接近化学计量混合比的浓度条件下。

Query_Text_en: The curve illustrates the principle , and the scales have therefore been omitted .
Translation: 该曲线图旨在阐明原理，故未标注具体刻度。

Query_Text_en: As the source of the leak is emptied the release rate will gradually be reduced and the gas concentration in the cloud will decrease .
Translation: 随着泄漏源逐渐排空，释放速率将逐步降低，云团中的气体浓度也将随之下降。

Query_Text_en: A weak ignition source will ` sit and wait ' until the gas cloud has the right composition before it is ignited .
Translation: 微弱的点火源会"静候待机"，待气体云达到适宜成分时才会触发燃烧。

Query_Text_en: In several accidental gas explosions the time from the release until the explosion was 10 to 20 minutes .
Translation: 在数起燃气爆炸事故中，从气体泄漏到发生爆炸的间隔时间为10至20分钟。

Query_Text_en: In such cases it is probable [ but speculative ] that the gas concentration is decreasing at the time of ignition .
Translation: 在此类情况下，[虽属推测]点火时气体浓度很可能正在降低。

Query_Text_en: When the ignition source is strong the gas cloud will be ignited when the edge of the cloud reaches the ignition source .
Translation: 当点火源强度足够时，一旦气云边缘接触点火源，气云即被引燃。

Query_Text_en: If the ignition source is weak , however , the source may fail to ignite the cloud in the early phase of the dispersion process or ignite only a small part of the cloud .
Translation: 然而，若点火源强度不足，可能在扩散过程初期无法引燃云团，或仅能引燃云团的一小部分。

Query_Text_en: Subsequently , a homogeneous large gas cloud may be formed .
Translation: 随后，可能形成一个均匀的大型气体云团。

Query_Text_en: This cloud reaches a flammable concentration as the pressure reservoir is emptied and a weak ignition source may ignite the cloud .
Translation: 当压力储罐排空时，该云团达到可燃浓度，微弱点火源即可引燃云团。

Query_Text_en: This discussion shows some of the complexities involved in assessing ignition probability and the formation of explosive gas clouds .
Translation: 本次讨论揭示了评估点火概率与爆炸性气体云团形成过程中所涉及的部分复杂性。

Query_Text_en: It has been claimed that ` the best building has no walls ' .
Translation: 有观点认为，"至臻建筑，不囿于墙"。

Query_Text_en: This is particularly true with respect to gas explosion safety .
Translation: 这一点在燃气爆炸安全方面尤为突出。

Query_Text_en: In an open building the natural ventilation will enhance the gas dispersion and if an explosion occurs , the pressure is dissipated through the open areas .
Translation: 在开放式建筑中，自然通风会加速气体扩散；若发生爆炸，压力将通过开放区域迅速消散。

Query_Text_en: If the release rates are small there is no doubt that mechanical ventilation systems can counteract the formation of explosive gas clouds .
Translation: 若释放速率较低，机械通风系统无疑能够有效抑制爆炸性气体云团的形成。

Query_Text_en: However , for a massive release , the forced ventilation rate will in general be too low .
Translation: 然而，对于大规模泄漏而言，强制通风率通常过低。

Query_Text_en: A ventilation system may also transport gas from one area to another .
Translation: 通风系统还可将气体从一个区域输送至另一区域。

Query_Text_en: This occurred onboard the MODU West Vanguard in 1985 [ see Section 4.4 ] ,
Translation: 1985年，这一事件发生在"西先锋号"移动式海上钻井平台上[详见第4.4节]。

Query_Text_en: when gas from a shallow gas pocket blew out under the platform , was sucked into the ventilation system and distributed around the platform .
Translation: 当浅层气藏的气体在平台下方发生井喷时，被吸入通风系统并扩散至整个平台。

Query_Text_en: The subsequent gas explosions also followed the ventilation ducts .
Translation: 随后发生的燃气爆炸也沿着通风管道蔓延。

Query_Text_en: A deflagration is a gas explosion where the flame front propagates at subsonic speed [ relative to the unburnt gas ] , immediately ahead of the pressure wave .
Translation: 爆燃是一种气体爆炸现象，其火焰前锋以低于未燃气体音速的速度传播，并紧贴于压力波前方。

Query_Text_en: In a gas explosion the propagating velocity can span more than three orders of magnitude .
Translation: 燃气爆炸的传播速度可跨越三个数量级以上。

Query_Text_en: The mechanism of flame propagation will be quite different at different velocities .
Translation: 火焰传播机制在不同速度下存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: When the cloud is ignited by a weak ignition source [ i.e. a spark or a hot sur-face ] the flame starts as a laminar flame .
Translation: 当可燃云团被弱点火源（如电火花或高温表面）引燃时，火焰最初以层流火焰形态形成。

Query_Text_en: For a laminar flame the basic mechanism of propagation is molecular diffusion of heat and mass.
Translation: 层流火焰传播的基本机理是热量与质量的分子扩散。

Query_Text_en: The diffusion of heat and mass into the unburnt gas is relatively slow and the flame will propagate with a velocity of the order of 3～4m/s .
Translation: 热量和质量向未燃气体中的扩散相对较慢，火焰将以3～4米/秒的速度传播。

Query_Text_en: The propagation velocity of the laminar flame depends on the type of fuel and the fuel concentration .
Translation: 层流火焰的传播速度取决于燃料类型与燃料浓度。

Query_Text_en: In most accidental explosions the laminar flame will accelerate and transit into a turbulent deflagration [ i.e. turbulent flame ] , since the flow field ahead of the flame front becomes turbulent .
Translation: 在多数意外爆炸中，层流火焰会加速并转变为湍流爆燃（即湍流火焰），这是因为火焰前锋前方的流场会形成湍流状态。

Query_Text_en: The turbulence is caused by the interaction of the flow field with process equipment , piping , structures etc.
Translation: 这种湍流是由流场与工艺设备、管道、结构物等的相互作用所引发的。

Query_Text_en: The mechanisms generating turbulence ahead of the flame front are discussed below .
Translation: 下文将探讨火焰锋面前湍流产生的机理。

Query_Text_en: One of the mechanisms causing the increased burning rate in turbulent deflagrations is the wrinkling of the flame front by large turbulent eddies .
Translation: 导致湍流爆燃燃烧速率加快的机制之一，是大尺度湍流涡对火焰前锋面产生的褶皱效应。

Query_Text_en: For this combustion regime the increased flame surface area causes the burning rate to increase .
Translation: 在该燃烧状态下，火焰表面积增大导致燃烧速率提升。

Query_Text_en: When a flame propagates through a premixed gas cloud there are two mechanisms causing pressure build-up .
Translation: 火焰在预混气体云中传播时，会通过两种机制导致压力上升。

Query_Text_en: burning in a confined volume .
Translation: 在有限空间内燃烧。

Query_Text_en: In most accidental explosions a combination of these two effects causes the pressure build-up .
Translation: 大多数意外爆炸中，这两种效应的共同作用导致了压力积聚。

Query_Text_en: The pressure behind the flame [ in the burnt gas ] will gradually decay away from the flame .
Translation: 火焰后方[燃烧气体中]的压力将随远离火焰而逐渐衰减。

Query_Text_en: This pressure decay will mainly depend on the boundary conditions at the end of the tube [ i.e. open or closed tube ] and on the flame velocity .
Translation: 压力衰减主要取决于管道末端的边界条件（即开放或封闭管道）以及火焰传播速度。

Query_Text_en: Since the flame front is a subsonic combustion wave , the burning will influence the flow ahead of the flame .
Translation: 由于火焰锋面属于亚音速燃烧波，其燃烧过程会对前方气流产生影响。

Query_Text_en: The pressure ahead of the flame depends on the flame acceleration and speed .
Translation: 火焰前方的压力取决于火焰的加速度与速度。

Query_Text_en: In order to get a shock wave ahead of the flame , a high flame speed is required .
Translation: 要在火焰前方形成冲击波，必须确保火焰具有足够高的传播速度。

Query_Text_en: If the explosion happens inside a closed vessel , fast flame propagation is not required to obtain high pressures .
Translation: 若爆炸发生在密闭容器内，无需快速火焰传播即可产生高压。

Query_Text_en: A stoichiometric fuel air cloud in a closed vessel will give up to 8～9 bar when exploding .
Translation: 密闭容器中的化学计量燃料空气混合物爆炸时可产生8至9巴的压力。

Query_Text_en: By opening up part of the vessel wall , relief will be provided and the pressure will be reduced .
Translation: 通过开放部分血管壁，可缓解症状并降低压力。

Query_Text_en: The reduction will depend mainly on how fast the flame is burning in the vessel and the location and size of the vent area .
Translation: 减压效果主要取决于容器内火焰燃烧速度以及泄压口的位置与面积大小。

Query_Text_en: In a partly confined area with obstacles [ i.e. process equipment , piping etc. ] the flame may accelerate to several hundred metres per second during a gas explosion .
Translation: 在存在障碍物（如工艺设备、管道等）的部分受限空间内，气体爆炸时火焰可能加速至每秒数百米。

Query_Text_en: The mechanisms causing the increased burning rate in turbulent deflagrations are the wrinkling of the flame front by large eddies and the turbulent transport of heat and mass at the reaction front .
Translation: 湍流爆燃中燃烧速率提升的机理在于：大涡流导致火焰前锋面褶皱，并在反应前沿形成热量与质量的湍流输运。

Query_Text_en: This turbulence is mainly caused by the interaction of the flow with destructions such as structures , pipe racks , etc.
Translation: 这种湍流主要是由流体与构筑物、管架等障碍物的相互作用所引发的。

Query_Text_en: Figure 9.6 shows how turbulence is generated in the wake of obstacles in a channel .
Translation: 图9.6展示了渠道中障碍物后方如何产生湍流现象。

Query_Text_en: When the flame consumes the unburnt gas , the products will expand .
Translation: 火焰引燃未燃烧气体时，其产物将发生膨胀。

Query_Text_en: This expansion can be up to 8～9 times the initial volume .
Translation: 这一扩张幅度可达初始规模的8至9倍。

Query_Text_en: The unburnt gas is therefore pushed ahead of the flame and a turbulent flow field may be generated .
Translation: 因此，未燃气体被推向火焰前方，可能形成湍流流场。

Query_Text_en: When the flame propagates into a turbulent flow field , the burning rate will increase dramatically .
Translation: 当火焰传播进入湍流流场时，燃烧速率将急剧上升。

Query_Text_en: This increased burning rate will further increase the flow velocity and turbulence ahead of the flame .
Translation: 燃烧速率的提升将进一步增大火焰前方的流速与湍流强度。

Query_Text_en: The mechanism of flame accelerations due to the pressure of obstacles causing turbulence constitutes a strong positive feedback loop .
Translation: 障碍物压力引发湍流导致火焰加速的机制，构成了一个极强的正向反馈循环。

Query_Text_en: Flame accelerations may , to some extent , be avoided by venting the hot combustion products .
Translation: 通过排放高温燃烧产物，可在一定程度上避免火焰加速现象。

Query_Text_en: The flow and turbulence in the unburnt mixture ahead of the flame will be reduced .
Translation: 火焰前方未燃混合物的流动和湍流将减弱。

Query_Text_en: Venting combustion products is a very effective way of minimizing the acceleration effect of a member of obstacles .
Translation: 排放燃烧产物是有效降低障碍物构件加速效应的关键手段。

Query_Text_en: Venting of unburnt gas ahead of the flame may also contribute to a lower explosion pressure , particularly when the venting directs the flow away from the obstacles .
Translation: 火焰前沿未燃气体的泄放也可能导致爆炸压力降低，尤其是当泄放引导气流绕过障碍物时。

Query_Text_en: If unburnt gas passes a series of obstacles before it is vented , flame acceleration will most likely occur .
Translation: 若未燃气体在排放前经过一系列障碍物，极可能发生火焰加速现象。

Query_Text_en: This is illustrated later in this chapter , see Figure 9.9 .
Translation: 本章后文将对此进行说明，参见图9.9。

Query_Text_en: Pressure relief venting thereby reducing the effect of the feedback mechanism .
Translation: 泄压口由此减轻反馈机制的影响。

Query_Text_en: These mechanisms have competing effects .
Translation: 这些机制会产生相互抵消的效应。

Query_Text_en: The flame acceleration due to turbulence will increase explosion pressure , while venting will reduce the pressure .
Translation: 湍流导致的火焰加速会增大爆炸压力，而泄压措施则可降低压力。

Query_Text_en: It is the balance between these two effects that is governing the pressure build-up .
Translation: 正是这两种效应的平衡关系决定着压力的积聚程度。

Query_Text_en: When analyzing gas explosions we have to take both of them into account .
Translation: 分析燃气爆炸事故时，必须对两者予以统筹考量。

Query_Text_en: Blast waves from explosions in rooms , offshore modules etc. , are difficult to calculate and thus several research programs have been carried out in order to find a realistic calculation model for such explosions .
Translation: 室内、海上平台模块等密闭空间爆炸产生的冲击波难以精确计算，为此多个研究项目已相继开展，旨在建立符合实际的此类爆炸计算模型。

Query_Text_en: The blast wave will be affected by equipment etc. , in the room although the effect is difficult to quantify .
Translation: 爆炸冲击波会受到室内设备等因素的影响，尽管这种影响难以量化。

Query_Text_en: It is , however , possible to place the equipment and other obstacles favourably in order to reduce the maximum overpressure .
Translation: 然而，通过合理布置设备及其他障碍物，可有效降低最大超压值。

Query_Text_en: This must be done in the planning phase .
Translation: 这必须在规划阶段完成。

Query_Text_en: Avoid long and narrow rooms with openings only in the ends [ cannon ] .
Translation: 避免选用仅在两端设有开口的狭长房间【俗称"炮筒式"格局】。

Query_Text_en: If this geometry is necessary , then place venting areas on at least one sidewall for its entire length .
Translation: 若必须采用此几何结构，则至少应在一侧壁沿其全长设置通风区域。

Query_Text_en: These principles are also shown in Figure 9.7 .
Translation: 这些原则亦如图9.7所示。

Query_Text_en: All equipment in the room will produce turbulence which will increase the burning velocity of the gas , thereby increasing the overpressure .
Translation: 房间内所有设备都会产生湍流，这将提高气体的燃烧速度，进而增大超压值。

Query_Text_en: An increase of the cross-section of equipment in the ventilation direction will give an exponential increase of the overpressure .
Translation: 通风方向上设备截面积的增大会导致超压呈指数级上升。

Query_Text_en: These principles are also shown in Figure 9.8 and Figure 9.9 .
Translation: 这些原则亦在图9.8与图9.9中予以展示。

Query_Text_en: Equipment and structural elements will be subjected to drag loading after the overpressure phase , caused by the transient winds behind the blast wave front .
Translation: 在冲击波超压阶段过后，设备和结构构件将承受由爆轰波阵面后方瞬态风引起的拖曳载荷作用。

Query_Text_en: The drag force will be highest near the venting areas , and is often important for structural elements ; as columns and beams .
Translation: 排气口附近的阻力最大，这对立柱、横梁等结构构件往往至关重要。

Query_Text_en: Further away from the opening the drag force will be considerable less .
Translation: 距离开口处越远，拖曳力将显著减小。

Query_Text_en: For design against blast loads , the dimensioning blast load must be determined .
Translation: 在抗爆荷载设计中，必须确定设计基准爆炸荷载。

Query_Text_en: This is usually based on a probability distribution .
Translation: 这通常基于概率分布。

Query_Text_en: The assessment of design loads implies that an exceedance function has to be established for each structural element to be designed .
Translation: 设计荷载评估要求为每个待设计的结构构件建立超越概率函数。

Query_Text_en: The annual frequency of exceeding a specified overpressure load , is a function of the overpressure level .
Translation: 特定超压负荷的年均超标频次，与超压水平呈函数关系。

Query_Text_en: This exceedance function is established on the basis of uncertainties in the explosion load assessment .
Translation: 该超标函数是基于爆炸荷载评估中的不确定性建立的。

Query_Text_en: The gas concentration in the cloud relative to a stoichiometric concentration
Translation: 云团中的气体浓度相对于化学计量浓度

Query_Text_en: A statistical analysis of the occurrence of all aspects of the event sequence leading up to an explosion is required , in order to establish a probabilistic representation of blast loads .
Translation: 需对爆炸前事件序列各环节的发生概率进行统计分析，以建立爆炸荷载的概率表征模型。

Query_Text_en: performance of barrier elements , in order to limit size and duration of cloud .
Translation: 屏障组件的性能表现，旨在控制云团规模与持续时间。

Query_Text_en: Probability distributions need to be defined for all parameters .
Translation: 所有参数均需定义概率分布。

Query_Text_en: This is available from environmental data for the wind conditions .
Translation: 可通过环境数据获取风力状况信息。

Query_Text_en: Hole size distributions are usually also available from the leak statistics , thus distributions for the flow rates may be generated .
Translation: 泄漏统计数据通常也可提供孔径分布信息，从而可推导出相应的流量分布。

Query_Text_en: Distributions for the location and the direction of the leak are usually based on geometrical considerations .
Translation: 泄漏位置和方向的分布通常基于几何因素考量。

Query_Text_en: These variations will generate input scenarios to dispersion CFD simulations .
Translation: 这些变量将生成用于扩散计算流体力学（CFD）模拟的输入场景。

Query_Text_en: Most of these parameters may have continuous variations , which in theory could generate an infinite number of dispersion scenarios .
Translation: 这些参数大多具有连续变化特性，理论上可衍生出无限多种离散情景。

Query_Text_en: Some form of categorisation will have to be performed , in order to limit the number of cases .
Translation: 必须进行某种形式的分类，以控制案件数量。

Query_Text_en: The basis for the categorisation should as far as possible be scenario dependent , reflecting specific limitations and considerations .
Translation: 分类标准应尽可能基于具体情境，体现特定限制条件和考量因素。

Query_Text_en: If a leak from a flange is considered , there may be variations in the direction corresponding to 360° .
Translation: 若考虑法兰泄漏情况，其泄漏方向可能呈现360度全方位分布。

Query_Text_en: A coarse categorisation would split the directions in two ; below horizontal and above horizontal .
Translation: 粗略分类可分为两种方向：水平线以下和水平线以上。

Query_Text_en: If the flange is close to the ceiling , and there is a vertical truss above and somewhat to the side of the leak source , then such restrictions may limit the free flow of a gas jet and the subsequent dispersion of a gas cloud .
Translation: 若法兰靠近天花板，且泄漏源上方及侧向存在垂直桁架，此类结构限制可能阻碍气体射流的自由流动，继而影响气云扩散。

Query_Text_en: The angle , at which separation between the two categories should be made , is where the gas jet will be split to either side of the truss .
Translation: 确定两类气体分离角度的标准，应以气流在桁架两侧均等分流为基准。

Query_Text_en: The resulting number of dispersion calculations may still be high , even if all parameters are classified into categories .
Translation: 即便将所有参数归类处理，最终所需的扩散计算量仍可能居高不下。

Query_Text_en: The dispersion simulations will therefore have to be made with a coarse grid , in order to limit the computational time .
Translation: 因此，为控制计算时长，需采用粗网格进行扩散模拟。

Query_Text_en: When the dispersion simulations have been completed , it will be required to reduce the number of cases for blast load simulations through elimination of cases which are unignitable and categorisation of cloud conditions when they are similar .
Translation: 完成扩散模拟后，需通过剔除不可燃情形及对相似云团条件进行分类，减少爆炸荷载模拟的案例数量。

Query_Text_en: One difficult aspect is to identify those dispersion scenarios that will be able to reach ignitable atmospheres , but where the extent of the cloud in space or time is insufficient to give a deflagration with significant blast effects .
Translation: 一个难点在于识别那些可能形成可燃气体环境的扩散情景，但这些情景中气体云在空间或时间上的扩散范围不足，无法产生具有显著爆炸效应的爆燃。

Query_Text_en: This has been shown to be important in large scale gas leak dispersion tests carried out at Spade Adam in 1998 [ ERA , 1998 ] .
Translation: 1998年在斯佩德亚当进行的大规模气体泄漏扩散试验[ERA,1998]已证明该因素具有关键作用。

Query_Text_en: When all non-relevant dispersion scenarios have been eliminated , explosion simulations should be carried out for the remaining cases , possibly combining some of the cases into broader categories .
Translation: 在排除所有不相关的扩散情形后，应对剩余情形开展爆炸模拟分析，必要时可将部分情形合并为更宽泛的类别。

Query_Text_en: When blast loads for all of the cases have been simulated , the resulting blast load distributions may be generated from a combination of simulated blast load and scenario probabilities .
