Query_Text_en: Not less than three members shall be elected from each geographical region .
Translation: 每个地理区域至少应选出三名成员。

Query_Text_en: They shall be eligible for re-election .
Translation: 他们可以连选连任。

Query_Text_en: The State Party which submitted the nomination of a member of the Commission shall defray the expenses of that member while in performance of Commission duties .
Translation: 提名委员会成员的缔约国应承担该成员履行委员会职责期间的相关费用。

Query_Text_en: The coastal State concerned shall defray the expenses incurred in respect of the advice referred to in article 3 , paragraph 1 [ b ] , of this Annex .
Translation: 有关沿海国应承担本附件第3条第1款(b)项所述咨询意见所涉费用。

Query_Text_en: The secretariat of the Commission shall be provided by the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 委员会秘书处由联合国秘书长负责提供。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] to provide scientific and technical advice , if requested by the coastal State concerned during the preparation of the data referred to in subparagraph [ a ] .
Translation: [ b ] 应有关沿海国请求，在编制[ a ]项所述资料期间提供科学技术咨询。

Query_Text_en: The Commission may cooperate , to the extent considered necessary and useful , with the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO , the International Hydrographic Organization and other competent international organizations with a view to exchanging scientific and technical information which might be of assistance in discharging the Commission 's responsibilities .
Translation: 委员会可在认为必要且有益的范围内，与联合国教科文组织政府间海洋学委员会、国际水文组织及其他相关国际组织合作，旨在交流有助于履行委员会职责的科学与技术信息。

Query_Text_en: Where a coastal State intends to establish , in accordance with article 76 , the outer limits of its continental shelf beyond 200 nautical miles , it shall submit particulars of such limits to the Commission along with supporting scientific and technical data as soon as possible but in any case within 10 years of the entry into force of this Convention for that State .
Translation: 沿海国根据第七十六条意图划定200海里以外大陆架外部界限时，应尽快向大陆架界限委员会提交该界限的详情及相关科学和技术数据，无论如何应在本公约对该国生效后十年内提交。

Query_Text_en: The coastal State shall at the same time give the names of any Commission members who have provided it with scientific and technical advice .
Translation: 沿海国应同时提供曾向其提供科学和技术咨询意见的任何委员会成员的姓名。

Query_Text_en: Unless the Commission decides otherwise , the Commission shall function by way of sub-commissions composed of seven members , appointed in a balanced manner taking into account the specific elements of each submission by a coastal State .
Translation: 除非委员会另有决定，委员会应通过分委会开展工作。分委会由七名成员组成，其任命须均衡考虑沿海国每一划界案的具体要素。

Query_Text_en: Nationals of the coastal State making the submission who are members of the Commission and any Commission member who has assisted a coastal State by providing scientific and technical advice with respect to the delineation shall not be a member of the sub-commission dealing with that submission but has the right to participate as a member in the proceedings of the Commission concerning the said submission .
Translation: 提交划界案的沿海国国民中，如有人为委员会成员，或曾以提供科学或技术咨询意见方式协助沿海国准备划界案的其他委员会成员，均不得担任处理该划界案的划界案小组委员会成员，但有权以委员身份参与委员会关于该划界案的审议程序。

Query_Text_en: The coastal State which has made a submission to the Commission may send its representatives to participate in the relevant proceedings without the right to vote .
Translation: 已向委员会提交划界案的沿海国可派代表参与相关审议程序，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: The sub-commission shall submit its recommendations to the Commission .
Translation: 小组委员会应向委员会提交建议。

Query_Text_en: Approval by the Commission of the recommendations of the sub-commission shall be by a majority of two thirds of Commission members present and voting .
Translation: 委员会以出席并参加表决的委员三分之二多数通过小组委员会的建议。

Query_Text_en: The recommendations of the Commission shall be submitted in writing to the coastal State which made the submission and to the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 委员会的建议应以书面形式提交提出划界案的沿海国和联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Coastal States shall establish the outer limits of the continental shelf in conformity with the provisions of article 76 , paragraph 8 , and in accordance with the appropriate national procedures .
Translation: 沿海国应依照第七十六条第8款的规定并参照本国相关法定程序划定大陆架外部界限。

Query_Text_en: In the case of disagreement by the coastal State with the recommendations of the Commission , the coastal State shall , within a reasonable time , make a revised or new submission to the Commission .
Translation: 如沿海国对委员会建议存有异议，应在合理期限内向委员会提交修订或新的划界案。

Query_Text_en: The actions of the Commission shall not prejudice matters relating to delimitation of boundaries between States with opposite or adjacent coasts .
Translation: 委员会的行动不应影响相向或相邻沿海国之间的划界事宜。

Query_Text_en: Title to minerals shall pass upon recovery in accordance with this Convention .
Translation: 根据本公约规定，矿物一经开采，其所有权即行转移。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] The Authority shall encourage prospecting in the Area .
Translation: 管理局应鼓励在"区域"内进行勘探活动。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Prospecting shall be conducted only after the Authority has received a satisfactory written undertaking that the proposed prospector will comply with this Convention and the relevant rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority concerning cooperation in the training programs referred to in articles 143 and 144 and the protection of the marine environment , and will accept verification by the Authority of compliance therewith .
Translation: [ b ] 探矿只有在管理局收到令人满意的书面保证后才能进行，该保证应表明拟议探矿者将遵守本《公约》以及管理局关于第一四三条和第一四四条所述培训方案合作和海洋环境保护的相关规则、规章和程序，并接受管理局对其遵守情况的核查。

Query_Text_en: The proposed prospector shall , at the same time , notify the Authority of the approximate area or areas in which prospecting is to be conducted .
Translation: 探矿权申请人应同时向主管部门通报拟开展勘探活动的大致区域范围。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Prospecting may be conducted simultaneously by more than one prospector in the same area or areas .
Translation: 同一区域或不同区域内可允许多名探矿者同时开展勘探作业。

Query_Text_en: Prospecting shall not confer on the prospector any rights with respect to resources .
Translation: 探矿活动不赋予探矿者对资源的任何权利。

Query_Text_en: A prospector may , however , recover a reasonable quantity of minerals to be used for testing .
Translation: 但探矿者可采得适量矿物用于试验。

Query_Text_en: The Enterprise , States Parties , and the other entities referred to in Article 153 , paragraph 2 [ b ] , may apply to the Authority for approval of plans of work for activities in the Area .
Translation: 企业部、缔约国及第一五三条第二款(b)项所述其他实体，可向管理局申请核准其关于"区域"内活动的工作计划。

Query_Text_en: The Enterprise may apply with respect to any part of the Area , but applications by others with respect to reserved areas are subject to the additional requirements of article 9 of this Annex .
Translation: 企业部可对"区域"的任何部分提出申请，但其他实体对保留区域的申请须遵守本附件第九条的附加要求。

Query_Text_en: Exploration and exploitation shall be carried out only in areas specified in plans of work referred to in article 153 , paragraph 3 , and approved by the Authority in accordance with this Convention and the relevant rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority .
Translation: 勘探和开发应仅在依据第一百五十三条第3款提出并经管理局按照本公约以及管理局有关规则、规章和程序核准的工作计划所指明的区域内进行。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] confer on the operator , in accordance with the rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority , the exclusive right to explore for and exploit the specified categories of resources in the area covered by the plan of work .
Translation: 根据管理局的规则、规章和程序，授予经营者在该工作计划所涉区域内勘探和开采特定类别资源的专属权利。

Query_Text_en: If , however , the applicant presents for approval a plan of work covering only the stage of exploration or the stage of exploitation , the approved plan of work shall confer such exclusive right with respect to that stage only .
Translation: 然而，如申请者提交核准的工作计划仅涉及勘探阶段或开发阶段，则核准的工作计划应仅就该阶段赋予专属权利。

Query_Text_en: Upon its approval by the Authority , every plan of work , except those presented by the Enterprise , shall be in the form of a contract concluded between the Authority and the applicant or applicants .
Translation: 管理局核准后，除企业部提出的工作计划外，每一工作计划均应采用管理局与申请者或申请者们订立的合同形式。

Query_Text_en: Applicants , other than the Enterprise , shall be qualified if they have the nationality or control and sponsorship required by article 153 , paragraph 2 [ b ] , and if they follow the procedures and meet the qualification standards set forth in the rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority .
Translation: 除企业部外的申请者，须具备第一五三条第二款(b)项规定的国籍或控制和担保条件，且遵循管理局规则、规章和程序所定程序并符合其规定的资格标准，方为合格。

Query_Text_en: Except as provided in paragraph 6 , such qualification standards shall relate to the financial and technical capabilities of the applicant and his performance under any previous contracts with the Authority .
Translation: 除第6款规定的情形外，此类资质标准应涉及申请人的财务和技术能力，以及其此前与管理局签订的任何合同的履行情况。

Query_Text_en: Each applicant shall be sponsored by the State Party of which it is a national unless the applicant has more than one nationality , as in the case of a partnership or consortium of entities from several States , in which event all States Parties involved shall sponsor the application , or unless the applicant is effectively controlled by another State Party or its nationals , in which event both States Parties shall sponsor the application .
Translation: 每一申请者应由其国籍所属的缔约国担保，但若申请者具有一个以上国籍，例如由多个国家的实体组成的合伙企业或联营企业，则所有涉及的缔约国均应共同担保该申请；若申请者实质上受另一缔约国或其国民控制，则应由该缔约国与申请者国籍所属缔约国共同担保。

Query_Text_en: The criteria and procedures for implementation of the sponsorship requirements shall be set forth in the rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority .
Translation: 担保要求的实施标准和程序应由管理局在其规则、规章和程序中予以规定。

Query_Text_en: The sponsoring State or States shall , pursuant to article 139 , have the responsibility to ensure , within their legal systems , that a contractor so sponsored shall carry out activities in the Area in conformity with the terms of its contract and its obligations under this Convention .
Translation: 根据第一三九条，一个或几个担保国应负责在其法律制度范围内，确保所担保的承包者应依据合同条款及其在本公约下的义务进行"区域"内活动。

Query_Text_en: A sponsoring State shall not , however , be liable for damage caused by any failure of a contractor sponsored by it to comply with its obligations if that State Party has adopted laws and regulations and taken administrative measures which are , within the framework of its legal system , reasonably appropriate for securing compliance by persons under its jurisdiction .
Translation: 然而，若担保国已制定相关法律法规并采取行政措施，且该等措施在其法律框架内对确保其管辖范围内人员履行义务属合理适当，则该国不对其担保承包方未履行义务所造成的损害承担责任。

Query_Text_en: The procedures for assessing the qualifications of States Parties which are applicants shall take into account their character as States .
Translation: 评估缔约国申请方资格的程序应考量其国家属性。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] to comply with the provisions on the transfer of technology set forth in article 5 of this Annex .
Translation: [四]遵守本附件第五条关于技术转让的规定。

Query_Text_en: When submitting a plan of work , every applicant shall make available to the Authority a general description of the equipment and methods to be used in carrying out activities in the Area , and other relevant non-proprietary information about the characteristics of such technology and information as to where such technology is available .
Translation: 在提交工作计划时，每一申请者应向管理局提供关于拟在"区域"内进行活动时所用装备和方法的一般性说明，以及关于这种技术特性的其他非专有性相关资料和关于何处可得到这种技术的信息。

Query_Text_en: Every operator shall inform the Authority of revisions in the description and information made available pursuant to paragraph 1 whenever a substantial technological change or innovation is introduced .
Translation: 各运营商在引入重大技术变更或创新时，须根据第1款规定及时向监管机构报备相关说明及信息的修订内容。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] to make available to the Enterprise on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions , whenever the Authority so requests , the technology which he uses in carrying out activities in the Area under the contract , which the contractor is legally entitled to transfer .
Translation: 管理局提出要求时，承包者应以公平合理的商业条款和条件，向企业部提供其在"区域"内进行合同规定活动时所使用的、且依法有权转让的技术。

Query_Text_en: This shall be done by means of licences or other appropriate arrangements which the contractor shall negotiate with the Enterprise and which shall be set forth in a specific agreement supplementary to the contract .
Translation: 承包商应就此与企业协商，通过颁发许可证或其他适当安排予以落实，并将相关条款载入本合同补充协议。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] to obtain a written assurance from the owner of any technology used in carrying out activities in the Area under the contract , which is not generally available on the open market and which is not covered by subparagraph [ a ] , that the owner will , whenever the Authority so requests , make that technology available to the Enterprise under licence or other appropriate arrangements and on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions , to the same extent as made available to the contractor .
Translation: [b] 从合同区域内活动所涉技术的所有者处获取书面保证——该技术既非公开市场普遍可得，亦不属[a]项范畴——确保所有者应管理局要求，将以公平合理的商业条款，通过许可或其他适当安排，向企业提供该技术，且提供程度与向承包者提供的相同。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] to acquire from the owner by means of an enforceable contract , upon the request of the Enterprise and if it is possible to do so without substantial cost to the contractor , the legal right to transfer to the Enterprise any technology used by the contractor , in carrying out activities in the Area under the contract , which the contractor is otherwise not legally entitled to transfer and which is not generally available on the open market .
Translation: [ c ] 根据企业部的要求，在不对承包者造成重大成本负担且可行的情况下，通过可强制执行合同从所有者处取得法律权利，将承包者在"区域"内依据合同开展活动时所使用的、承包者原本无权转让且未在公开市场普遍流通的任何技术转让给企业部。

Query_Text_en: In cases where there is a substantial corporate relationship between the contractor and the owner of the technology , the closeness of this relationship and the degree of control or influence shall be relevant to the determination whether all feasible measures have been taken to acquire such a right .
Translation: 若承包商与相关技术所有者存在实质性企业关联关系，则双方关系的密切程度及控制或影响力的大小，应作为判断该承包商是否已采取一切可行措施获取技术权利的依据。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] to take the same measures as are prescribed in subparagraphs [ a ] , [ b ] , [ c ] and [ d ] for the benefit of a developing State or group of developing States which has applied for a contract under article 9 of this Annex , provided that these measures shall be limited to the exploitation of the part of the area proposed by the contractor which has been reserved pursuant to article 8 of this Annex and provided that activities under the contract sought by the developing State or group of developing States would not involve transfer of technology to a third State or the nationals of a third State .
Translation: [ e ] 采取与[ a ]、[ b ]、[ c ]和[ d ]项相同措施，以惠及根据本附件第九条申请合同的发展中国家或发展中国家集团；但此类措施应仅限于承包者所提议区域中根据本附件第八条予以保留部分的开发活动，且该发展中国家或发展中国家集团所申请合同下的活动不得涉及向第三国或其国民转让技术。

Query_Text_en: The obligation under this provision shall only apply with respect to any given contractor where technology has not been requested by the Enterprise or transferred by that contractor to the Enterprise .
Translation: 本条款规定的义务仅适用于企业未提出技术转让要求或承包者未向企业转让技术的特定情形。

Query_Text_en: Disputes concerning undertakings required by paragraph 3 , like other provisions of the contracts , shall be subject to compulsory settlement in accordance with Part XI and , in cases of violation of these undertakings , suspension or termination of the contract or monetary penalties may be ordered in accordance with article 18 of this Annex .
Translation: 关于第三款所规定义务的争议，应如合同其他条款一样，按照第十一部分强制解决。若违反此类义务，可依照本附件第十八条规定，下令暂停或终止合同，或处以罚金。

Query_Text_en: Disputes as to whether offers made by the contractor are within the range of fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions may be submitted by either party to binding commercial arbitration in accordance with the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules or such other arbitration rules as may be prescribed in the rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority .
Translation: 对于承包商所提报价是否符合公平合理商业条款范围的争议，任一方均可根据《联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则》或管理局规则、条例和程序规定的其他仲裁规则，提交具有约束力的商业仲裁。

Query_Text_en: If the finding is that the offer made by the contractor is not within the range of fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions , the contractor shall be given 45 days to revise his offer to bring it within that range before the Authority takes any action in accordance with Article 18 of this Annex .
Translation: 如认定承包商所提报价不符合公平合理商业条款范围，当局应给予承包商45天期限修订报价使其符合该范围，之后方可依据本附件第18条规定采取行动。

Query_Text_en: If the Enterprise is unable to obtain on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions appropriate technology to enable it to commence in a timely manner the recovery and processing of minerals from the Area , either the Council or the Assembly may convene a group of States Parties composed of those which are engaged in activities in the Area , those which have sponsored entities which are engaged in activities in the Area and other States Parties having access to such technology .
Translation: 如企业无法在公平合理的商业条款和条件下及时获取开展"区域"矿物开采和加工所需的适当技术，理事会或大会可召集一个缔约国集团，该集团由以下成员组成：在"区域"内从事活动的国家、担保在"区域"内开展活动的实体的国家，以及掌握此类技术的其他缔约国。

Query_Text_en: This group shall consult together and shall take effective measures to ensure that such technology is made available to the Enterprise on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions .
Translation: 该小组应共同协商并采取有效措施，确保企业能以公平合理的商业条款获取此类技术。

Query_Text_en: Each such State Party shall take all feasible measures to this end within its own legal system .
Translation: 各缔约国均应在本国法律体系内采取一切可行措施以实现这一目标。

Query_Text_en: In the case of joint ventures with the Enterprise , transfer of technology will be in accordance with the terms of the joint venture agreement .
Translation: 在与企业合资的情况下，技术转让将依照合资协议的条款执行。

Query_Text_en: The undertakings required by paragraph 3 shall be included in each contract for the carrying out of activities in the Area until 10 years after the commencement of commercial production by the Enterprise , and may be invoked during that period .
Translation: 根据第3款所要求的承诺，应纳入在"区域"内进行活动的每一份合同，直至企业部开始商业生产后10年为止。在此期间，可对这些承诺提出执行要求。

Query_Text_en: For the purposes of this article , `` technology '' means the specialized equipment and technical know-how , including manuals , designs , operating instructions , training and technical advice and assistance , necessary to assemble , maintain and operate a viable system and the legal right to use these items for that purpose on a non-exclusive basis .
Translation: 本文所称"技术"系指组装、维护和运行一套可用系统所需的专用设备与技术诀窍（含手册、设计方案、操作规程、培训及技术咨询与协助），以及以非排他性方式使用上述要素的合法权利。

Query_Text_en: Six months after the entry into force of this Convention , and thereafter each fourth month , the Authority shall take up for consideration proposed plans of work .
Translation: 本公约生效六个月后，管理局应开始审议工作计划提案，此后每四个月审议一次。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the applicant has complied with the procedures established for applications in accordance with article 4 of this Annex and has given the Authority the undertakings and assurances required by that article .
Translation: 申请人已遵守本附件第四条规定的申请程序，并向管理局作出该条所要求的承诺和保证。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the applicant possesses the requisite qualifications provided for in article 4 of this Annex .
Translation: [ b ] 申请人具备本附件第四条所规定的必备资格。

Query_Text_en: All proposed plans of work shall be taken up in the order in which they are received .
Translation: 所有提交的工作计划均应按收到顺序依次审议。

Query_Text_en: The proposed plans of work shall comply with and be governed by the relevant provisions of this Convention and the rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority , including those on operational requirements , financial contributions and the undertakings concerning the transfer of technology .
Translation: 所提交的工作计划应符合并受制于《公约》相关规定及管理局的规则、规章和程序，包括关于作业要求、财政贡献以及技术转让承诺的各项规定。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] plans of work for the exploration and exploitation of polymetallic nodules in non-reserved areas which , taken together , constitute 2 per cent of the total seabed area which is not reserved or disapproved for exploitation pursuant to article 162 , paragraph [ 2 ] [ x ] .
Translation: [二] 关于非保留区多金属结核勘探和开发的工作计划，这些区域合计占依据第一六二条第[二]款[十]项未被保留或未获开发批准的海底总面积的2%。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of the standard set forth in paragraph 3 [ c ] , a plan of work submitted by a partnership or consortium shall be counted on a pro rata basis among the sponsoring States Parties involved in accordance with Article 4 , paragraph 3 , of this Annex .
Translation: 为适用第3款[c]项所定标准，对于企业部、国有企业、自然人或法人组成的合伙或联营体提交的工作计划，应依照本附件第4条第3款按参与担保国比例计算。

Query_Text_en: The Authority may approve plans of work covered by paragraph 3 [ c ] if it determines that such approval would not permit a State Party or entities sponsored by it to monopolize the conduct of activities in the Area or to preclude other States Parties from activities in the Area .
Translation: 管理局若认定核准第3款(c)项所述工作计划不会使某一缔约国或其担保实体垄断"区域"内活动,亦不会排除其他缔约国从事"区域"活动,则可予以批准。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding paragraph 3 [ a ] , after the end of the interim period specified in article 151 , paragraph 3 , the Authority may adopt by means of rules , regulations and procedures other procedures and criteria consistent with this Convention for deciding which applicants shall have plans of work approved in cases of selection among applicants for a proposed area .
Translation: 虽有第3款[a]项之规定，在第一百五十一条第3款所定过渡期间结束后，管理局仍可依据本公约制定规则、规章和程序，在就某一提议区域的多份申请者间作出选择时，采用其他与公约相符的程序和标准，以决定哪些申请者的工作计划应获核准。

Query_Text_en: These procedures and criteria shall ensure approval of plans of work on an equitable and non-discriminatory basis .
Translation: 这些程序和标准应确保以公平、无歧视的方式核准工作计划。

Query_Text_en: The Authority shall issue the authorizations applied for if all such applications can be approved without exceeding the production limitation or contravening the obligations of the Authority under a commodity agreement or arrangement to which it has become a party , as provided in Article 151 .
Translation: 如所有申请均能在不超出生产限额且不违反管理局根据第一五一条规定所参加之商品协定或安排下义务的情况下获得批准，管理局应颁发所申请之核准书。

Query_Text_en: When a selection must be made among applicants for production authorizations because of the production limitation set forth in article 151 , paragraphs 2 to 7 , or because of the obligations of the Authority under a commodity agreement or arrangement to which it has become a party , as provided for in article 151 , paragraph 1 , the Authority shall make the selection on the basis of objective and non-discriminatory standards set forth in its rules , regulations and procedures .
Translation: 当因第一百五十一条第二至第七款规定的生产限额，或因管理局根据第一百五十一条第一款规定成为缔约方的商品协定或安排所承担的义务，而必须在生产核准申请者中作出选择时，管理局应依据其规则、规章和程序所载的客观且无歧视的标准进行遴选。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] have already invested the most resources and effort in prospecting or exploration .
Translation: [丙方]已在勘探或勘查环节投入最多资源和精力。

Query_Text_en: Applicants which are not selected in any period shall have priority in subsequent periods until they receive a production authorization .
Translation: 凡在某一阶段未获选中的申请者，将在后续阶段享有优先权，直至获得生产授权为止。

Query_Text_en: Selection shall be made taking into account the need to enhance opportunities for all States Parties , irrespective of their social and economic systems or geographical locations so as to avoid discrimination against any State or system , to participate in activities in the Area and to prevent monopolization of those activities .
Translation: 遴选时应考虑到需要增强所有缔约国的参与机会，不论其社会经济制度或地理位置如何，以避免对任何国家或制度构成歧视，确保各国均能参与"区域"内活动，并防止此类活动被垄断。

Query_Text_en: Whenever fewer reserved areas than non-reserved areas are under exploitation , applications for production authorizations with respect to reserved areas shall have priority .
Translation: 当保留区域开采面积少于非保留区域时，有关保留区域的生产授权申请应享有优先权。

Query_Text_en: The decisions referred to in this article shall be taken as soon as possible after the close of each period .
Translation: 本条所述决定应于各期结束后尽快作出。

Query_Text_en: Each application , other than those submitted by the Enterprise or by any other entities for reserved areas , shall cover a total area , which need not be a single continuous area , sufficiently large and of sufficient estimated commercial value to allow two mining operations .
Translation: 除企业或其他实体为保留区提交的申请外，每份申请书所涉区域总面积（无需为单一连续区域）应足够广阔且具备足够预估商业价值，以确保可进行两处采矿作业。

Query_Text_en: The applicant shall indicate the coordinates dividing the area into two parts of equal estimated commercial value and submit all the data obtained by him with respect to both parts .
Translation: 申请人应标明将该区域划分为预估商业价值均等的两部分之坐标，并提交其就两部分区域所获取的全部数据资料。

Query_Text_en: Without prejudice to the powers of the Authority pursuant to article 17 of this Annex , the data to be submitted concerning polymetallic nodules shall relate to mapping , sampling , the abundance of nodules , and their metal content .
Translation: 在不影响管理局根据本附件第十七条所具权力的情况下，所提交关于多金属结核的数据应涉及测绘、采样、结核丰度及其金属含量。

Query_Text_en: Within 45 days of receiving such data , the Authority shall designate which part is to be reserved solely for the conduct of activities by the Authority through the Enterprise or in association with developing States .
Translation: 管理局应在收到此类数据后45天内，指定其中哪些部分应保留专供管理局通过企业部或与发展中国家联合开展活动使用。

Query_Text_en: This designation may be deferred for a further period of 45 days if the Authority requests an independent expert to assess whether all data required by this article has been submitted .
Translation: 如监管机构要求独立专家评估本条规定的全部数据是否已提交，则可将该指定期限再延长45天。

Query_Text_en: The area designated shall become a reserved area as soon as the plan of work for the non-reserved area is approved and the contract is signed .
Translation: 所指定区域将在非保留区工作计划获批且合同签署后即刻成为保留区。

Query_Text_en: The Enterprise shall be given an opportunity to decide whether it intends to carry out activities in each reserved area .
Translation: 企业应有机会决定是否在各保留区域开展活动。

Query_Text_en: This decision may be taken at any time , unless a notification pursuant to paragraph 4 is received by the Authority , in which event the Enterprise shall take its decision within a reasonable time .
Translation: 除非管理局收到根据第4款发出的通知，否则此项决定可随时作出；若收到此类通知，企业部应在合理期限内作出决定。

Query_Text_en: The Enterprise may decide to exploit such areas in joint ventures with the interested State or entity .
Translation: 企业可决定与相关国家或实体组建合资企业，共同开发此类区域。

Query_Text_en: The Enterprise may conclude contracts for the execution of part of its activities in accordance with Annex IV , article 12 . It may also enter into joint ventures for the conduct of such activities with any entities which are eligible to carry out activities in the Area pursuant to article 153 , paragraph 2 [ b ] .
Translation: 企业可依照附件四第十二条的规定，就实施其部分活动订立合同。企业也可根据第一五三条第二款(ｂ)项，同任何按照该款规定有资格进行"区域"内活动的实体为进行此种活动成立合资企业。

Query_Text_en: When considering such joint ventures , the Enterprise shall offer to States Parties which are developing States and their nationals the opportunity of effective participation .
Translation: 在考虑此类合资企业时，企业应向作为发展中国家的缔约国及其国民提供有效参与的机会。

Query_Text_en: The Authority may prescribe , in its rules , regulations and procedures , substantive and procedural requirements and conditions with respect to such contracts and joint ventures .
Translation: 管理局可在其规则、规章和程序中，对此类合同和合资企业规定实质性及程序性要求和条件。

Query_Text_en: Any State Party which is a developing State or any natural or juridical person sponsored by it and effectively controlled by it or by other developing State which is a qualified applicant , or any group of the foregoing , may notify the Authority that it wishes to submit a plan of work pursuant to Article 6 of this Annex with respect to a reserved area .
Translation: 任何缔约国如为发展中国家，或由其担保并受其或其国民有效控制的任何自然人或法人，或符合资格申请者的其他发展中国家，或上述各方的任何组合，均可通知管理局，表示希望根据本附件第六条就保留区域提交工作计划。

Query_Text_en: The plan of work shall be considered if the Enterprise decides , pursuant to paragraph 1 , that it does not intend to carry out activities in that area .
Translation: 如企业根据第1款决定无意在该区域开展活动，则应对该工作计划予以审议。

Query_Text_en: An operator who has an approved plan of work for exploration only , as provided in article 3 , paragraph 4 [ c ] , of this Annex shall have a preference and a priority among applicants for a plan of work covering exploitation of the same area and resources .
Translation: 根据本附件第3条第4款(c)项规定，已获核准仅从事勘探工作计划的承包者，在申请同一区域和资源的开发工作计划时，应享有优先权。

Query_Text_en: However , such preference or priority may be withdrawn if the operator 's performance has not been satisfactory .
Translation: 但若运营商表现未达预期，此类优惠或优先权可予撤销。

Query_Text_en: Contracts may provide for joint arrangements between the contractor and the Authority through the Enterprise , in the form of joint ventures or production sharing , as well as any other form of joint arrangement , which shall have the same protection against revision , suspension or termination as contracts with the Authority .
Translation: 合同可规定承包者与管理局通过企业部进行合作安排，包括采用合资企业或产品分成等任何形式的联合安排，此类安排应与同管理局签订的合同一样，享有同等保护，免受修订、中止或终止的影响。

Query_Text_en: Contractors entering into such joint arrangements with the Enterprise may receive financial incentives as provided for in article 13 of this Annex .
Translation: 与企业部订立此类联合安排的承包者，可按照本附件第十三条的规定享有财政鼓励。

Query_Text_en: Partners in joint ventures with the Enterprise shall be liable for the payments required by article 13 of this Annex to the extent of their share in the joint ventures , subject to financial incentives as provided for in that article .
Translation: 与本企业组建合资企业的合作方，应根据其在该合资企业中所占份额承担本附件第十三条规定的付款责任，同时可享受该条款规定的财政激励措施。

Query_Text_en: Activities in the Area carried out by the Enterprise pursuant to Article 153 , paragraph 2 [ a ] , shall be governed by Part XI , the rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority and its relevant decisions .
Translation: 企业依据第一五三条第二款（a）项在"区域"内进行的活动，应受第十一部分、管理局的规则、规章和程序及其相关决定的管辖。

Query_Text_en: Any plan of work submitted by the Enterprise shall be accompanied by evidence supporting its financial and technical capabilities .
Translation: 企业提交的任何工作计划均应附有证明其财务和技术能力的佐证材料。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] to ensure that , as a result of the financial incentives provided to contractors under paragraph 14 , under the terms of contracts reviewed in accordance with article 19 of this Annex or under the provisions of article 11 of this Annex with respect to joint ventures , contractors are not subsidized so as to be given an artificial competitive advantage with respect to land-based miners .
Translation: 为确保承包商根据本附件第14款获得的财政激励、依照本附件第19条审查的合同条款或本附件第11条关于合资企业的规定，不会使承包商获得补贴从而对陆上采矿者形成人为竞争优势。

Query_Text_en: A fee shall be levied for the administrative cost of processing an application for approval of a plan of work in the form of a contract and shall be fixed at an amount of $ US 500,000 per application .
Translation: 每份工作计划核准申请（合同形式）需缴纳行政处理费，费用标准定为50万美元/份。

Query_Text_en: The amount of the fee shall be reviewed from time to time by the Council in order to ensure that it covers the administrative cost incurred .
Translation: 理事会应定期审核费用金额，以确保其足以支付所产生的行政成本。

Query_Text_en: If such administrative cost incurred by the Authority in processing an application is less than the fixed amount , the Authority shall refund the difference to the applicant .
Translation: 如管理局在处理申请过程中产生的行政费用低于固定金额，应将差额退还给申请人。

Query_Text_en: A contractor shall pay an annual fixed fee of $ US 1 million from the date of entry into force of the contract .
Translation: 承包商应自合同生效之日起每年支付100万美元的固定费用。

Query_Text_en: If the approved date of commencement of commercial production is postponed because of a delay in issuing the production authorization , in accordance with article 151 , the annual fixed fee shall be waived for the period of postponement .
Translation: 如因延迟颁发生产授权导致商业生产核准开始日期推迟，则根据第151条规定，推迟期间的年固定费用应予免除。

Query_Text_en: From the date of commencement of commercial production , the contractor shall pay either the production charge or the annual fixed fee , whichever is greater .
Translation: 自商业生产启动之日起，承包商应缴纳生产费或年度固定费（以较高者为准）。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] paying a combination of a production charge and a share of net proceeds .
Translation: [ b ]支付生产费用加净收益分成。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The said market value shall be the product of the quantity of the processed metals produced from the polymetallic nodules extracted from the area covered by the contract and the average price for those metals during the relevant accounting year , as defined in paragraphs 7 and 8 .
Translation: 所述市场价值应为合同区域内开采的多金属结核所产加工金属数量与相关会计年度内该金属平均价格之乘积，具体定义见第七款和第八款。

Query_Text_en: If , in the second period of commercial production , as defined in subparagraph [ d ] , the return on investment in any accounting year as defined in subparagraph [ m ] falls below 15 per cent as a result of the payment of the production charge at 4 per cent , the production charge shall be 2 per cent instead of 4 per cent in that accounting year .
Translation: 如按第[d]项所界定的商业生产第二期期间，由于缴纳4%的生产费，导致第[m]项界定的任何会计年度投资回报率低于15%，则该会计年度的生产费应降为2%，而非4%。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The said market value shall be the product of the quantity of the processed metals produced from the polymetallic nodules recovered from the area covered by the contract and the average price for those metals during the relevant accounting year as defined in paragraphs 7 and 8 .
Translation: [ b ] 所述市场价值应为合同区域内回收的多金属结核加工所得金属产量与相关会计年度内该金属平均价格（按第7款和第8款定义）之乘积。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] [ i ] The Authority 's share of net proceeds shall be taken out of that portion of the contractor 's net proceeds which is attributable to the mining of the resources of the area covered by the contract , referred to hereinafter as attributable net proceeds .
Translation: 管理局应得的净收益份额应从承包者因开采合同所涉区域资源而产生的净收益部分中提取，该部分净收益以下称为可归属净收益。

Query_Text_en: In the first accounting year during which development costs are incurred , unrecovered development costs shall equal the development costs less cash surplus in that year .
Translation: 在发生开发成本的第一个会计年度，未回收开发成本应等于该年度开发成本减去现金盈余。

Query_Text_en: In each subsequent accounting year , unrecovered development costs shall equal the unrecovered development costs at the end of the preceding accounting year , plus interest thereon at the rate of 10 per cent per annum , plus development costs incurred in the current accounting year and less contractor 's cash surplus in the current accounting year .
Translation: 在后续每个会计年度，未回收开发成本应等于前一会计年度末的未回收开发成本，加上按年利率10%计算的利息，加上本会计年度发生的开发成本，再减去本会计年度承包商的现金盈余。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] The second period of commercial production shall commence in the accounting year following the termination of the first period of commercial production and shall continue until the end of the contract .
Translation: [ ii ] 第二个商业生产期应自第一个商业生产期结束后的会计年度开始，持续至合同期满为止。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] `` Attributable net proceeds '' means the product of the contractor 's net proceeds and the ratio of the development costs in the mining sector to the contractor 's development costs .
Translation: "可归属净收益"指承包者净收益乘以采矿部门开发成本与承包者开发成本之比所得的乘积。

Query_Text_en: If the contractor engages in mining , transporting polymetallic nodules and production primarily of three processed metals , namely , cobalt , copper and nickel , the amount of attributable net proceeds shall not be less than 25 per cent of the contractor 's net proceeds .
Translation: 如承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核及主要生产钴、铜和镍三种加工金属，其应得净收益份额不得低于承包者净收益的25%。

Query_Text_en: Subject to subparagraph [ n ] , in all other cases , including those where the contractor engages in mining , transporting polymetallic nodules , and production primarily of four processed metals , namely , cobalt , copper , manganese and nickel , the Authority may , in its rules , regulations and procedures , prescribe appropriate floors which shall bear the same relationship to each case as the 25 per cent floor does to the three-metal case .
Translation: 除第[n]分段规定的情形外，在其他所有情况下，包括承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核及主要生产钴、铜、锰、镍四种加工金属的活动时，管理局可在其规则、规章和程序中规定适当的底限，该底限与各类情形的比例关系应等同于25%底限与三金属情形的比例关系。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] `` Contractor 's net proceeds '' means the contractor 's gross proceeds less his operating costs and less the recovery of his development costs as set out in subparagraph [ j ] .
Translation: [ f ] "承包商净收益"指承包商的毛收益减去其运营成本，并扣除第[ j ]项所列开发成本回收部分后的金额。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] [ i ] If the contractor engages in mining , transporting polymetallic nodules and production of processed metals , `` contractor 's gross proceeds '' means the gross revenues from the sale of the processed metals and any other monies deemed reasonably attributable to operations under the contract in accordance with the financial rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority .
Translation: 如承包者从事多金属结核开采、运输及加工金属生产，"承包者总收益"系指出售加工金属所得总收入以及根据管理局财务规则、规章和程序可合理归因于合同业务的其他任何收入。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] In all cases other than those specified in subparagraphs [ g ] [ i ] and [ n ] [ iii ] , `` contractor 's gross proceeds '' means the gross revenues from the sale of the semi-processed metals from the polymetallic nodules recovered from the area covered by the contract , and any other monies deemed reasonably attributable to operations under the contract in accordance with the financial rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority .
Translation: [二]除[g][一]项和[n][三]项所规定的情形外，"承包者毛收入"系指从合同所涉区域回收的多金属结核经半加工后销售所得总收入，以及管理局财务规则、规章和程序认定的可合理归因于合同业务的其他款项。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] expenditures similar to those set forth in [ i ] above incurred subsequent to the commencement of commercial production and necessary to carry out the plan of work , except those chargeable to operating costs .
Translation: [二] 与上述[一]项所列支出性质相同、且在商业生产开始后产生的支出，此类支出为执行工作计划所必需，但不包括应计入运营成本的费用。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] The proceeds from the disposal of capital assets and the market value of those capital assets which are no longer required for operations under the contract and which are not sold shall be deducted from the contractor 's development costs during the relevant accounting year .
Translation: 处置资本性资产所得款项及合同运营不再需要且未出售的资本性资产市值，应从承包商相关会计年度的开发成本中扣除。

Query_Text_en: When these deductions exceed the contractor 's development costs the excess shall be added to the contractor 's gross proceeds .
Translation: 若上述抵扣金额超出承包商开发成本，超出部分应计入承包商总收入。

Query_Text_en: [ j ] The contractor 's development costs incurred prior to the commencement of commercial production referred to in subparagraphs [ h ] [ i ] and [ n ] [ iv ] shall be recovered in 10 equal annual instalments from the date of commencement of commercial production .
Translation: 承包商在[ h ]、[ i ]及[ n ][ iv ]项所述商业生产开始前发生的开发成本，应自商业生产开始之日起分10个相等年度分期收回。

Query_Text_en: The contractor 's development costs incurred subsequent to the commencement of commercial production referred to in subparagraphs [ h ] [ ii ] and [ n ] [ iv ] shall be recovered in 10 or fewer equal annual instalments so as to ensure their complete recovery by the end of the contract .
Translation: 承包商在[h][ii]项和[n][iv]项所述商业生产开始后发生的开发费用，应在十个或更少的相等年度分期中回收，以确保在合同期满前全部收回。

Query_Text_en: [ k ] `` Contractor 's operating costs '' means all expenditures incurred after the commencement of commercial production in the operation of the productive capacity of the area covered by the contract and the activities related thereto for operations under the contract , in conformity with generally recognized accounting principles , including , inter alia , the annual fixed fee or the production charge , whichever is greater , expenditures for wages , salaries , employee benefits , materials , services , transporting , processing and marketing costs , interest , utilities , preservation of the marine environment , overhead and administrative costs specifically related to operations under the contract , and any net operating losses carried forward or backward as specified herein .
Translation: [ k ] "承包者经营成本"系指根据公认会计原则，在商业生产开始后，为履行合同所发生的与合同区域生产能力运营及相关活动有关的一切支出，包括但不限于年度固定费用或生产费（以较高者为准）、工资薪金及员工福利支出、材料费、服务费、运输加工及营销成本、利息、公用事业费、海洋环境保护费、专门与合同作业相关的管理及行政费用，以及本合同规定的可结转或追溯的任何净经营亏损。

Query_Text_en: Net operating losses may be carried forward for two consecutive years except in the last two years of the contract in which case they may be carried backward to the two preceding years .
Translation: 除合同最后两年外，净经营亏损可连续结转两年；若亏损发生在合同最后两年期间，则允许向前追溯抵减前两个年度的应税所得。

Query_Text_en: [ l ] If the contractor engages in mining , transporting of polymetallic nodules , and production of processed and semi-processed metals , `` development costs of the mining sector '' means the portion of the contractor 's development costs which is directly related to the mining of the resources of the area covered by the contract , in conformity with generally recognized accounting principles , and the financial rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority , including , inter alia , application fee , annual fixed fee and , where applicable , costs of prospecting and exploration of the area covered by the contract , and a portion of research and development costs .
Translation: 若承包者从事多金属结核的开采、运输及加工与半加工金属生产，"采矿部门开发成本"指承包者根据公认会计准则及管理局财务规则、规章和程序，直接用于合同所涉区域资源开采的开发成本部分，具体包括但不限于申请费、年度固定费，以及在适用情况下合同区域勘探费用，以及部分研发成本。

Query_Text_en: [ m ] `` Return on investment '' in any accounting year means the ratio of attributable net proceeds in that year to the development costs of the mining sector .
Translation: 在任何会计年度，“投资回报率”均指该年度矿业部门可归属净收益与开发成本之比。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of computing this ratio the development costs of the mining sector shall include expenditures on new or replacement equipment in the mining sector less the original cost of the equipment replaced .
Translation: 为计算该比率，矿业部门开发成本应包括该部门新增或置换设备的支出，扣除被置换设备的原始成本。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] `` attributable net proceeds '' means the whole of the contractor 's net proceeds ;
Translation: [一]“可归属净收益”指承包商的全部净收益；

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] `` contractor 's net proceeds '' shall be as defined in subparagraph [ f ] ;
Translation: [ ii ] "承包商净收益"定义见第[ f ]款；

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] `` contractor 's gross proceeds '' means the gross revenues from the sale of the polymetallic nodules , and any other monies deemed reasonably attributable to operations under the contract in accordance with the financial rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority ;
Translation: [三] “承包者总收益”是指出售多金属结核所得的总收入，以及根据管理局财务规则、规章和程序可合理归因于合同业务的其他款项；

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] `` contractor 's development costs '' means all expenditures incurred prior to the commencement of commercial production as set forth in subparagraph [ h ] [ i ] , and all expenditures incurred subsequent to the commencement of commercial production as set forth in subparagraph [ h ] [ ii ] , which are directly related to the mining of the resources of the area covered by the contract , in conformity with generally recognized accounting principles ;
Translation: [四]“承包者开发成本”系指根据公认会计原则，与合同所涉区域资源开采直接相关的所有支出，包括按[（h）（i）]项所列商业生产开始前发生的支出，以及按[（h）（ii）]项所列商业生产开始后发生的支出。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] `` contractor 's operating costs '' means the contractor 's operating costs as in subparagraph [ k ] which are directly related to the mining of the resources of the area covered by the contract in conformity with generally recognized accounting principles ;
Translation: [五]“承包者业务费用”系指[十一]项下按照公认会计原则与合同所涉区域资源开采直接相关的承包者业务费用；

Query_Text_en: [ vi ] `` return on investment '' in any accounting year means the ratio of the contractor 's net proceeds in that year to the contractor 's development costs .
Translation: [六]“投资回报”在任一会计年度指承包方该年度净收益与开发成本之比。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of computing this ratio , the contractor 's development costs shall include expenditures on new or replacement equipment less the original cost of the equipment replaced .
Translation: 在计算该比率时，承包商的开发成本应包括新增或置换设备的支出，扣除被置换设备的原始成本。

Query_Text_en: [ o ] The costs referred to in subparagraphs [ h ] , [ k ] , [ l ] and [ n ] in respect of interest paid by the contractor shall be allowed to the extent that , in all the circumstances , the Authority approves , pursuant to article 4 , paragraph 1 , of this Annex , the debt-equity ratio and the rates of interest as reasonable , having regard to existing commercial practice .
Translation: 承包商根据第[h]、[k]、[l]和[n]项支付的利息相关费用，在管理局根据本附件第四条第一款认为其债务股本比率及利率符合现行商业惯例且属合理的前提下，可予列支。

Query_Text_en: [ p ] The costs referred to in this paragraph shall not be interpreted as including payments of corporate income taxes or similar charges levied by States in respect of the operations of the contractor .
Translation: 本段所述费用不应解释为包括缔约国对承包者业务征收的企业所得税或类似税费。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] `` Processed metals '' , referred to in paragraphs 5 and 6 , means the metals in the most basic form in which they are customarily traded on international terminal markets .
Translation: [甲]第五款和第六款所述"加工金属"指在国际终端市场上惯常交易的最基本形态金属。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , the Authority shall specify , in its financial rules , regulations and procedures , the relevant international terminal market .
Translation: 为此目的，管理局应在其财务规则、条例和程序中明确规定相关国际终端市场。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] If the Authority can not otherwise determine the quantity of the processed metals produced from the polymetallic nodules recovered from the area covered by the contract referred to in paragraphs 5 [ b ] and 6 [ b ] , the quantity shall be determined on the basis of the metal content of the nodules , processing recovery efficiency and other relevant factors , in accordance with the rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority and in conformity with generally recognized accounting principles .
Translation: [ b ] 如管理局无法以其他方式确定从合同所指区域（见第5款[ b ]项及第6款[ b ]项）回收的多金属结核所产加工金属的数量，则应根据管理局的规则、规章和程序，并遵循公认会计原则，按结核金属含量、加工回收率及其他相关因素核定该数量。

Query_Text_en: If an international terminal market provides a representative pricing mechanism for processed metals , polymetallic nodules and semi-processed metals from the nodules , the average price on that market shall be used .
Translation: 如国际终端市场为加工金属、多金属结核及结核半加工金属提供代表性定价机制，则应采用该市场的平均价格。

Query_Text_en: In all other cases , the Authority shall , after consulting the contractor , determine a fair price for the said products in accordance with paragraph 9 .
Translation: 在其他所有情况下，管理局应在与承包者协商后，依照第9款规定确定上述产品的公平价格。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] All costs , expenditures , proceeds and revenues and all determinations of price and value referred to in this article shall be the result of free market or arm 's length transactions .
Translation: [ a ] 本条所述所有成本、支出、收益及收入，以及价格与价值的确定，均须源自自由市场或公平独立交易。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] In order to ensure compliance with and enforcement of the provisions of this paragraph , the Authority shall be guided by the principles adopted for , and the interpretation given to , arm 's length transactions by the Commission on Transnational Corporations of the United Nations , the Group of Experts on Tax Treaties between Developing and Developed Countries and other international organizations , and shall , in its rules , regulations and procedures , specify uniform and internationally acceptable accounting rules and procedures , and the means of selection by the contractor of certified independent accountants acceptable to the Authority for the purpose of carrying out auditing in compliance with those rules , regulations and procedures .
Translation: 为确保本款规定得到遵守和执行，管理局应遵循联合国跨国公司委员会、发达国家与发展中国家税务条约专家组及其他国际组织所采纳的关于公平交易的原则和解释，并应在规则、规章和程序中规定统一且国际公认的会计规则和程序，以及承包者为遵照这些规则、规章和程序进行审计而选聘管理局认可的合格独立会计师的方式。

Query_Text_en: The contractor shall make available to the accountants , in accordance with the financial rules , regulations and procedures of the Authority , such financial data as are required to determine compliance with this article .
Translation: 承包商应根据管理局的财务规则、条例和程序，向会计师提供确定本条合规性所需的财务数据。

Query_Text_en: ONE DAY about fifteen years ago I walked into the library of my friend Professor Gustav Haloun for one of the sessions in which I was reading with him that ancient , largely Taoist book , the Kuan Tzu , He suggested that we might rapidly pass over certain material connected with the chapter before us as it seemed to embody nonsensical fables about animals , but I was for a closer examination of it .
Translation: 约十五年前的一天，我去好友古斯塔夫·哈隆教授的图书馆参加《管子》研读会。这部道家典籍的某一章前附有若干看似荒诞的动物寓言材料，教授建议我们快速浏览即可，但我坚持要深入研读。

Query_Text_en: It turned out to contain a statement that certain marine animals were subject to a lunar cycle , increasing and decreasing in size as the moon waxed and waned .
Translation: 经查证，该记载称某些海洋生物受月球周期影响，其体型会随月相盈亏而增减。

Query_Text_en: Great was my astonishment as I remembered that Aristotle said exactly the same thing .
Translation: 令我大为震惊的是，我记得亚里士多德也曾说过完全相同的话。

Query_Text_en: Aristotles statements refer to the sea , and have been confirmed in our own time .
Translation: 亚里士多德的论述针对海洋，且在我们这个时代得到了验证。

Query_Text_en: The latter possibility is difficult to believe .
Translation: 后一种可能性令人难以置信。

Query_Text_en: Again , a few weeks before writing these paragraphs , I attended a meeting at the Royal Society of Medicine at which another old friend , Dr Charles Singer , spoke of Galen in relation to ancient anatomy .
Translation: 就在撰写这几段文字的数周前，我参加了皇家医学会的一场会议。会上我的另一位老友查尔斯·辛格博士，就盖伦与古代解剖学的关系发表了见解。

Query_Text_en: He emphasised that Galen himself never dissected the human body , nor did any of his teachers do so , yet it is certain that the Alexandrians had carried out dissections , beginning with Herophilus and Erasistratus in the first half of the3rd century .
Translation: 他强调，盖伦本人从未解剖过人体，其师承诸贤亦无此举。然可确证的是，自公元前3世纪上半叶希罗菲卢斯与埃拉西斯特拉图斯始，亚历山大港学派已开展人体解剖实践。

Query_Text_en: The early Christian fathers mostly speak of dissection as of something shocking which they themselves had not been personally in contact with . a I reflected on the strangeness of the fact that a similar rise and fall of ancient anatomy can be observed in China , beginning rather earlier with Pien Chhio , well attested in the time of Wang Mang ( +9 ) and continuing a little later into the San Kuo period ( c. +240 ) , after which , as in Europe , it vanishes until the late middle ages .
Translation: 早期基督教教父们谈及解剖学时，大多视之为令人震惊之事，且坦言自身未曾亲历。我思索这一现象的奇特之处：中国古代解剖学同样经历了类似的兴衰轨迹，其发端可追溯至更早的扁鹊时代，王莽时期（公元9年）已有确凿记载，并延续至三国时代（约公元240年）。此后与欧洲如出一辙，解剖学逐渐湮没无闻，直至中世纪晚期才重现于世。

Query_Text_en: Then the Sung anatomists precede Mondino de Luzzi by about a century , but fail to go further .
Translation: 宋代解剖学家比蒙迪诺·德·卢齐早约一个世纪，但未能取得更大进展。

Query_Text_en: The object of these examplesand many other equally strange parallelisms could be citedis to show the necessity of saying something , before discussing the history of thought and the individual sciences in China , about what one might call the credibility of the travel of ideas at different historical times between East Asia and West Europe .
Translation: 上述例证（还可举出许多同样奇特的相似现象）旨在表明：在探讨中国思想史及各门学科发展之前，必须首先阐明一个关键问题——即东亚与西欧在不同历史时期思想传播的可信度问题。这种必要性源于我们需要理解，相隔万里的两种文明何以会反复出现理念的共振。

Query_Text_en: As a necessary preliminary , therefore , a brief discussion of the whole question of the conditions of possible mutual influences , as by trade and translators , seems to be in place .
Translation: 因此，作为必要的铺垫，首先简要探讨贸易与翻译等可能产生相互影响的条件这一整体问题，似乎恰逢其时。

Query_Text_en: In spite of the vast literature on the contacts between China and Europe , some guides to which will shortly be given , we still do not have enough facts on which to base a generalisation , and of course the further one goes back in history the worse the situation becomes .
Translation: 尽管关于中欧交往的文献浩如烟海（相关导论即将呈现），我们仍缺乏足够史实支撑整体性论断。历史年代越是久远，这种史料匮乏的状况便愈发严重。

Query_Text_en: Inevitably much of what has been written has been little more than speculation .
Translation: 已发表的内容大多难免流于臆测。

Query_Text_en: In the section on Language we referred to the 18th Systems , based on early realisation of the ideographic nature of the Chinese language , that the Chinese were a colony of the ancient Egyptians .
Translation: 在"语言"章节中，我们提及了18世纪基于对汉字表意特性早期认知形成的学说，该学说认为中华民族是古埃及人的殖民分支。

Query_Text_en: In the following century this idea was canvassed with some persistence , but the now long discredited theories of a Terrien de Lacouperie or a Ball no longer need to be combated by upholders of the essentially autochthonous character of Chinese civilisation .
Translation: 在随后的一个世纪里，这一观点曾屡被提及，但诸如拉克伯里或鲍尔等早已被学界否定的理论，已无需中国文明本土论的支持者再费周章加以驳斥。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless the general attitude that a large proportion of characteristic developments in Chinese thought and practice were derived from western sources has died very hard .
Translation: 然而，那种认为中国思想与实践中的诸多典型发展均源自西方的普遍观念，却始终难以消弭。

Query_Text_en: Let us take some examples .
Translation: 让我们来看几个例子。

Query_Text_en: Henri Maspero at first thought that the ancient geography of the Chinese , expressed in the Shan Hai Cking , had been stimulated by a wave of foreign ( Indian and Iranian ) influence in the 5th century ; and that the greater part of Chinese astronomy was of Western inspiration .
Translation: 马伯乐最初认为，《山海经》所载的中国古代地理知识，是受公元前5世纪外来（印度与伊朗）文化浪潮的激发；而中国天文学的主体部分亦源自西方启发。

Query_Text_en: The twenty hsiu ( divisions of the equator ) , the Jupiter cycle , the gnomon and the clepsydra , had , he thought , been introduced in the time of Darius , while a second wave , in the time of Alexander , had imported geometry , the duodenary cycle , the system of star cataloguing , etc. .
Translation: 他认为，二十宿（赤道分度）、岁星周期、圭表与漏壶等天文历法知识，是在大流士时代传入中土；而几何学、十二循环历法、星表体系等第二波知识，则是在亚历山大时代东传。

Query_Text_en: All this is now quite untenable , as we shall see , and in his later brilliant monographs on Chinese astronomy he abandoned such views , passing over in silence the questions of contacts and stimuli .
Translation: 如今这些观点显然已站不住脚，正如我们即将阐明的那样。在他后期关于中国天文学的杰出专论中，他摒弃了此类见解，对文明交流与相互影响的问题保持了缄默。

Query_Text_en: The problem of the relations of the Chinese hsiu and the Indian nakshatra is indeed still with us , and it has not been possible to grant historical priority for either of them .
Translation: 中印两国关于二十八宿与纳沙特拉的渊源问题至今悬而未决，尚无法判定何者更具历史优先性。

Query_Text_en: Their origin is probably Babylonian .
Translation: 其起源很可能在巴比伦。

Query_Text_en: Other authors blandly assumed that nearly everything of value in Chinese science came from the West , e.g. Vacca , who did not hesitate to derive the Han hodometers from Heron of Alexandria ( fl . +60 ) , though the first references to them in Chinese literature are associated with the names of Prince Tan of Yen ( 240 to 226 ) and Han Yen-Shou ( between 140 and 70 ) .
Translation: 另有学者则轻率断言，中国科学中几乎所有有价值的内容均源自西方。例如瓦卡便不假思索地将汉代记里鼓车的发明归功于公元60年前后的亚历山大里亚的赫伦，殊不知中国文献中关于记里鼓车的最早记载，实与燕太子丹（公元前240-前226年）及韩延寿（公元前140-前70年间）二人密切相关。

Query_Text_en: These early Han references do not describe the hodometer as something quite new , and even if some doubt remains as to exactly what kind of vehicle was meant , precisely described hodometers appear later in the Han too soon to be accounted for by any transmission from Alexandria , Vacca also believed that the Chou Pei geometry was Western in origin , that the early Chinese calculations of the value of were inspired from the West , that Chu Shih-Chiehs table of binomial coefficients in +1300 was derived from Umar al-Khaiyam and so on .
Translation: 汉代早期文献中提及的记里鼓车并未被描述为全新发明，即便对所指车辆类型尚存疑义，但汉代后期已出现精确记载的记里鼓车，其时间之早绝非源自亚历山大里亚的传播所能解释。瓦卡还认为《周髀算经》的几何学源自西方，中国古代圆周率计算受西方启发，朱世杰公元1300年所创二项式系数表亦承袭自奥马尔·海亚姆之说。

Query_Text_en: He ended with the really extraordinary statement that the first Chinese astronomer of any importance was the Buddhist I-Hsing of the Thanga whole millennium after the men who correspond to Hipparchus and indeed preceded him .
Translation: 他最后竟说出这样一句极不寻常的话：中国第一位重要的天文学家是唐代的僧人一行，而实际上在相当于喜帕恰斯（古希腊天文学家）甚至更早的时代，中国就已有了天文学家，这比一行要早整整一千年。

Query_Text_en: Another interesting example , the work of the Austrian engineer Horwitz , will arise in detail in the Section on Engineering .
Translation: 奥地利工程师霍维茨的研究成果将在"工程学"章节中详述，这是另一个值得关注的案例。

Query_Text_en: With other historians of technology , he noticed that some of the illustrations of machines in the Great Encyclopaedia of +1726 ( Thu Shu Chi Chheng ) were evidently copies , rather badly redrawn , of pictures which he could identify in 16th European books .
Translation: 与其他技术史学者一样，他注意到1726年《古今图书集成》中部分机械插图明显摹自16世纪欧洲典籍中的图样，且临摹质量拙劣，这些图稿来源均可考辨。

Query_Text_en: Since then , the line of descent of these pictures through the first works on engineering produced by the Jesuits in the early years of the +17 th century has been traced , but the flaws in the argument were ( a ) the assumption that the mistakes were due to later Chinese copyists , and ( b ) that because the European source of an illustration had been traced , the machine must have been new to the Chinese when the Jesuits introduced it .
Translation: 此后，这些图样的传承脉络已追溯至17世纪初耶稣会士制作的首批工程学著作。然而，该论断存在两处缺陷：其一，错误地假定图像讹误源于后世中国抄录者；其二，只要某插图的欧洲源头可考，便认定该机械必为耶稣会士传入时中国人前所未见之物。

Query_Text_en: In the realm of philosophical theory and practice , determined efforts have been made to show that early Taoism owed much both to the Indian Upanishad literature for its theory , a and to Indian yogism for some of its practices ; further , that Chinese Chhan Buddhism was an importation from India .
Translation: 在哲学理论与实践领域，学界已通过深入研究证实：早期道家思想在理论上深受印度《奥义书》典籍影响，其修行实践亦多借鉴印度瑜伽术；更有研究表明，中国禅宗实为印度佛教东传之产物。

Query_Text_en: These views , however , as Creel says , have never been really convincing .
Translation: 然而，正如顾立雅所言，这些观点从未真正令人信服。

Query_Text_en: The Upanishads are metaphysical commentaries on the Vedas , and date from the 8th to the 4th centuries , so that they are little earlier than the first period of elaboration of Taoist doctrine .
Translation: 《奥义书》是对《吠陀》的形而上学阐释，其成书年代可追溯至公元前8世纪至前4世纪，因而略早于道家学说体系化的最初阶段。

Query_Text_en: Their strongly marked metaphysical idealism , with its conception of the unity of the brahman and the atman , the absolute and the self , is not at all characteristic of the Taoists ; though the latter , as we shall see , greatly emphasised the unity of nature , and the incorporation of the individual within it .
Translation: 印度哲学鲜明的形而上学唯心主义特征——主张梵我合一、绝对与自我统一的理念——与道家思想截然不同。尽管如后文所述，道家同样极力强调自然的统一性及个体与自然的融合，但其理论体系从未体现这种特质。

Query_Text_en: For the influence of Yoga practices , g especially the breathing exercises , which are certainly very ancient in India , upon early Taoism , a better case can be made out ( Filliozat ) .
Translation: 关于瑜伽修行（尤其是印度极为古老的呼吸法）对早期道教的影响，菲利奥扎特已提出了更具说服力的论证。

Query_Text_en: Some Taoist schools , at any rate , practiced self by concentration on the inhaling and exhaling processes ( Waley ) , but it was not universal as Chuang Tzu has a passage condemning it .
Translation: 某些道家学派确实通过专注呼吸吐纳来修炼自我（韦利译注），但此法并非普遍通行，庄子就曾撰文予以批驳。

Query_Text_en: In any case the aims of this samadhi or dhyana among the Taoists were entirely different from those of the Indian rishis .
Translation: 无论如何，道教徒修习三昧或禅定的目的与印度圣贤们截然不同。

Query_Text_en: Both wished to master organic life and to attain supernatural powers , but while the Indians sought for an ascetic virtue which would enable them to dominate the gods themselves ( cf. Wilkins ) , the Taoists sought a material immortality in a universe in which there were no gods to overcome , and asceticism was only one of the methods which they were prepared to use to attain their end .
Translation: 二者皆欲掌控生命本源并获取超凡能力，然印度修行者追求苦行禁欲以凌驾众神之上（参见威尔金斯学说），而道家则于无神可胜之寰宇中探求肉身不朽，苦修仅为其达成目标所择手段之一。

Query_Text_en: Besides contemplation of the universe during quietist self , they were also interested in the techniques of sexual intercourse by which they thought that life might be prolonged , and above all in the preparation of drugs which would render the taker immortal .
Translation: 除静修观想宇宙外，他们亦钻研房中术以期延年益寿，尤重炼制服之可长生不死的丹药。

Query_Text_en: Admittedly , both these other elements have parallels in ancient Indian and Iranian thought .
Translation: 诚然，这两种元素在古代印度和伊朗思想中均有对应。

Query_Text_en: Sex has been outstandingly significant in all Hindu myth and religion , particularly in the theme of the Saktis and as Dubs points out , the ancient intoxicating sacred drink ( Indian soma , Iranian hraoma ) was regarded as in some sense an elixir of immortality .
Translation: 性在印度教神话与宗教中具有极其重要的地位，尤其在萨克提崇拜主题中体现得淋漓尽致。正如杜布斯所指出的，古代令人迷醉的圣饮（印度苏摩酒、伊朗豪麻酒）在某种意义上被视为不朽的长生甘露。

Query_Text_en: But in general it must be said that the parallels which can be adduced remain always vague and uncertain , while the whole atmosphere and intellectual climate of Chinese thought is radically different from either the Indian or the Persian .
Translation: 但总体而言，必须承认所能援引的相似之处始终模糊不定，而中国思想的整体氛围与智识环境，与印度或波斯思想皆存在根本差异。

Query_Text_en: Lastly , the dependence of Chhan Buddhist quietism on Indian vedantism and the story that it was brought by the monk Bodhidharma , has been shown by Pelliot to be a late legend , designed only to give authority to the movement .
Translation: 最后，伯希和已证实：禅宗佛教的寂静主义对印度吠檀多哲学的依赖，以及达摩祖师东渡传法的故事，实为后世附会之说，其目的仅在于为该宗派增添权威性。

Query_Text_en: Another very common suggestion has been that the Yin-Yang dualism of Chinese thought was an importation of Iranian origin .
Translation: 另一种广为流传的观点认为，中国思想中的阴阳二元论源自伊朗。

Query_Text_en: Originally meaning the shady side and the sunny side of hills or houses , the words suddenly appear as philosophical terms about the 4th century , Yin standing for dark , weak , female , night , moon and so on ; and Yang standing for bright , strong , male , day , sun , etc. from these categories an elaborate theory of Nature grew up .
Translation: "阴"与"阳"原指山体或房屋的背光面与向阳面，约公元四世纪时突然演变为哲学概念——"阴"代表黑暗、柔弱、女性、夜晚、月亮等属性；"阳"则象征光明、刚强、男性、白昼、太阳等特质。基于这些对立范畴，逐渐发展出一套精密的自然哲学体系。

Query_Text_en: A superficial similarity with Zoroastrianism is obvious , but I entirely agree with Waleya in his rejection of any direct influence .
Translation: 表面上看与琐罗亚斯德教确有相似之处，但我完全赞同瓦莱亚的观点，即否认二者存在任何直接影响。

Query_Text_en: In Zoroastrianism , he says , darkness is essentially evil ;
Translation: 他指出，在琐罗亚斯德教中，黑暗本质上是邪恶的；

Query_Text_en: But the fundamental conception of Yin and Yang was quite different ;
Translation: 但阴阳的基本概念却截然不同；

Query_Text_en: they were two independent and complementary facets of existence , and the aim of the Yin-Yang philosophers was not the triumph of light , but the attainment in human life of perfect balance between the two principles .
Translation: 阴阳二者是独立互补的存在面向。阴阳哲学家的目标并非光明战胜黑暗，而在于实现人类生活中两种原理的完美平衡。

Query_Text_en: Waley is assuredly right in seeking the origins of the theory in indigenous divination practices .
Translation: 韦利将这一理论的起源追溯至本土占卜实践，无疑是正确的。

Query_Text_en: He has still less difficulty in disposing of the suggestion that the theory of the five elements ( wu hsing ) could have arisen from the Greek element theory , since in fact the basic Chinese conception was of operations in process , and static elementariness was implicit or derivative only .
Translation: 他更不费力地驳斥了五行学说可能源自希腊元素论的观点，因为中国的基本观念实际上是关于运行过程的动态体系，静态的元素性只是隐含或派生属性。

Query_Text_en: Finally , he discusses the relation between the paradoxes of Hui Shih and the Eleatic paradoxes , without attaining any definite conclusionthe correspondence is , indeed , another example of that extraordinary simultaneity between phenomena which we sometimes find at the two ends of the Old World .
Translation: 最后，他探讨了惠施悖论与埃利亚学派悖论之间的关联，但未得出明确结论。这种对应关系，实则再次印证了我们偶尔在旧大陆两端所发现的现象间那种惊人的同步性。

Query_Text_en: For the date of Hui Shih is mid 4th century , and Eleatic Zenos floruit is placed about 460 .
Translation: 惠施活跃于公元前四世纪中叶，而埃利亚的芝诺鼎盛时期约在公元前460年。

Query_Text_en: The parallelism here is at least as remarkable as the case of the lunar periodicity of marine invertebrate reproduction , with which this section began , or the earliest appearance of the water , which we shall study later together with other mechanical examples .
Translation: 此处所呈现的规律性，其显著程度丝毫不亚于本节开篇探讨的海洋无脊椎动物繁殖的月周期现象，亦或我们后续将结合其他力学案例共同研究的水体最早出现时机。

Query_Text_en: Although we tend to think that everything must have had only one origin , we can not rule out the possibility of completely independent and parallel lines of thought , especially where scientific theories , discoveries and observations are concerned .
Translation: 尽管我们往往认为万物必有单一源头，但在科学理论、发现与观测领域，尤其不能排除思想体系完全独立并行发展的可能性。

Query_Text_en: One might take the theories of atomism as an example .
Translation: 不妨以原子论学说为例。

Query_Text_en: Its story in our own classical civilisation , beginning with such men as Leucippus and Democritus of Abdera , of the 5th century , and culminating in , Epicurus and Lucretius of the late 3rd and early 1st , is well known to us .
Translation: 这一思想体系在我们古典文明中的发展脉络广为人知：它肇始于公元前5世纪留基伯与阿布德拉的德谟克利特等先哲，历经演变，至公元前3世纪末至公元前1世纪初的伊壁鸠鲁与卢克莱修时期达到顶峰。

Query_Text_en: Indian atomism seems to be later in date , the Jaina system of Umasvati showing its greatest strength about +50 , and the Vaiseshika darsana ( theory ) of Kanada flourishing in the second half of the +2 nd century .
Translation: 印度原子论的出现时间似乎较晚：邬摩斯伐底提出的耆那教体系在公元50年左右达到鼎盛，而迦那陀创立的胜论派学说则在公元2世纪下半叶蓬勃发展。

Query_Text_en: But there are reasons , as Rey urges , for believing that the roots of the theory of paratnanu ( atoms ) go much further back in the history of Indian thought .
Translation: 但正如雷伊所言，有理由相信"极微"（原子）理论在印度思想史上的渊源要深远得多。

Query_Text_en: Thirdly , in Chinese physics atomism never arose , as we shall see , a but the geometry of the Mo Ching ( the Mohist Canon , which must have been put together somewhere in the neighborhood of 370 ) seems to define a point as a line which has been cut so short that it can not be cut any further .
Translation: 第三，中国物理学中从未出现过原子论（我们将在后文详述），但《墨经》（约成书于公元前370年前后的《墨子》核心篇章）的几何学似乎将"点"定义为：将线段截短至不可再分割的极限状态。

Query_Text_en: Thus there seems really no reason why the concept of insecability should not have arisen in each of these three great civilisations independently .
Translation: 由此可见，不可分割性这一概念完全有可能在这三大文明中各自独立形成。

Query_Text_en: In all and each of them men were cutting and sawing lengths of wood and other material , and it would not be a very difficult thing for some reflective person to wonder what would happen if one went on cutting in half until the remaining object was so small that it could no longer be cut in half Philosophical speculation could then work out all that the permutations and movements of such small objects could explain .
Translation: 在所有这些人当中，人们都在切割和锯断木材及其他材料的长度。对于一个善于思考的人来说，不难想象如果持续将物体对半切割，直至剩余部分小到无法再分割时会发生什么。哲学思辨便可由此推演出这些微小物体的排列组合与运动所能解释的一切。

Query_Text_en: Another case which seems to me comparable is the Aristotelian doctrine of the ladder of souls in which plants were regarded as possessing a vegetative soul , animals a vegetative and a sensitive soul , and man a vegetative , a sensitive and a rational soul .
Translation: 在我看来，另一个可资类比的理论是亚里士多德的灵魂阶梯学说。该学说认为植物具有植物性灵魂，动物兼具植物性与感受性灵魂，而人类则拥有植物性、感受性及理性三重灵魂。

Query_Text_en: I shall later show ( Sect . ge ) that a very similar doctrine was taught by Hslin Tzu ( Hsun Chhing ) .
Translation: 后文（见第三章）将指出，荀子（荀卿）所倡导的学说与此极为相似。

Query_Text_en: Aristotle lived from 384 to 322 , Hsiirx Chhing from 298 to 238 .
Translation: 亚里士多德生活于公元前384至322年，荀卿生活于公元前298至238年。

Query_Text_en: If transmission of the conception occurred , therefore , it must have been very rapid , though the conditions of travel at this period would make such movement most unlikely .
Translation: 因此，即便这一理念确曾传播，其过程也必然极为迅速，尽管当时的交通条件使得这种传播极不可能发生。

Query_Text_en: We may prefer to believe that the idea originated independently , since it constitutes after all an obvious reflection on the scala naturae , a more or less intuitive recognition of the fact that some living organisms are much less complex than others , a foreshadowing , in fact , of the evolution which ensues as soon as the ladder is realized to exist within time .
Translation: 我们或许更愿意相信这一理念是独立萌发的，毕竟它本质上是对自然阶梯的直观映射——一种对生物体复杂度存在显著差异的直觉认知，实际上这已预示了进化论思想：一旦认识到这种阶梯结构具有时间维度，进化理论便应运而生。

Query_Text_en: These facts add interest to a couple of parallelisms which L. Giles has noted between Greek writers and the Lieh Tzu book , , parts of which are very probably older than 400 , though the actual existence of a philosopher of the name of Lieh Yti-Khou is highly doubtful .
Translation: 这些事实为翟理斯所发现的希腊作家与《列子》一书之间的几处相似之处增添了趣味。尽管列御寇其人的真实存在性极值得怀疑，但《列子》部分篇章的成书年代很可能早于公元前400年。

Query_Text_en: This occurs in Lieh Tzu , told of Confucius and Jung Chhi-Chhi , the old man of Thai Shan , but a very similar story is also attributed by Plutarch in his Life of Marius to Plato ( therefore between +46 and +122 ) ;
Translation: 此事见于《列子》所载孔子与泰山老人荣启期之对话，然普鲁塔克在其《马略传》中亦记载了极为相似的故事，并归之于柏拉图（其时约在公元46至122年间）。

Query_Text_en: and by Diogenes Laertius to Thales or Socrates ( therefore about +220 ) .
Translation: 第欧根尼·拉尔修将其归于泰勒斯或苏格拉底（约公元220年前后）。

Query_Text_en: One wonders whether this type of story would not naturally arise from the conception of a ladder of souls , in which case the obvious similarity would not be evidence of transmission , Giless other story , which concerns mourning for a child , and which occurs in Lieh Tzu about Tungmen Wu of Wei , as well as in Plutarch 's Moralia is less elaborate and may not be more than a coincidence .
Translation: 人们不禁怀疑，这类故事是否本就源自"灵魂阶梯"的哲学构想。若真如此，那么表面上的相似性便不能作为文化传播的证据。吉尔斯记载的另一则关于丧子之痛的故事，既见于《列子》中魏国东门吴的典故，也出现在普鲁塔克的《道德论集》中。该故事叙述较为简略，或许仅是巧合。

Query_Text_en: Arendt long ago pointed out similar parallels of a not very convincing nature , the most interesting being a criticism of men who are willing to accept political office without special training , though not undertaking the exercise of trades and professions when untrainedthis occurs in Mo Tzu and in Xenophons Memorabilia , where it is told of Socrates and Euthydemus .
Translation: 阿伦特早先就指出过一些并不十分令人信服的相似之处，其中最耐人寻味的莫过于对这样一类人的批评：他们虽不愿在未经训练的情况下贸然从事某项手艺或职业，却乐于在未经专门培训时就接受政治职务。这种观点既见于墨子的论述，也出现在色诺芬的《回忆苏格拉底》中——该书记载了苏格拉底与欧绪德谟斯的对话。

Query_Text_en: Mo Ti and Xenophon were contemporaries .
Translation: 墨子与色诺芬为同时代人。

Query_Text_en: These are by no means the only instances of curious similarities .
Translation: 这些绝非奇巧相似的孤例。

Query_Text_en: Thus Phelps has discussed parallels between the Confucian and Platonic treatment of the place of music in education .
Translation: 因此，菲尔普斯探讨了儒家与柏拉图学派在教育中音乐地位问题上的相通之处。

Query_Text_en: The fact that this occurs implicitly in the Hsiao Ching ( Filial Piety Classic ) is not very significant , since this book is generally regarded as having been forged in the name of the disciples of Confucius as late as the 1st ( or even the +1 st ) century ;
Translation: 《孝经》中虽隐含此说，但不足为据，因学界普遍认为该书系公元1世纪（甚或更晚）托名孔子门徒所伪撰。

Query_Text_en: but the argument itself is as old as the 6th , as may be seen from the Lun Yii and Meng Tzu , Since Confucius died half a century before Plato was born , and since the teaching activity of Mencius was at its height only some twenty years after his death , there is certainly interest in the parallel which Martin draws between the Chinese formulations of the argument , and the discussion of the same question in the Platonic dialogue Euthyphro .
Translation: 然而这一论争本身可追溯至公元前六世纪，这在《论语》与《孟子》中均有体现。孔子去世比柏拉图诞生早半个世纪，而孟子讲学鼎盛时期仅在其逝世后约二十年。因此，马丁将中国典籍中的相关论述与柏拉图对话录《游叙弗伦》中对同一问题的探讨进行平行比较，确实具有重要学术价值。

Query_Text_en: The treatment is of course very different , but Martin adds an observation that the meaning of the name used as title is very similar to the Chinese expression chih jen ( straight man ) , which occurs in the same connection .
Translation: 当然，处理方式截然不同。但马丁补充指出，用作书名的这个名字的含义与中文表达"直人"（正直之人）极为相似，二者出现的语境也相同。

Query_Text_en: We may return for a moment to the general question raised in these paragraphs .
Translation: 我们不妨再回到这几段提出的总体问题上来。

Query_Text_en: Although this is not yet the place for final conclusions , there can be no doubt that China was , among the ancient civilisations of the Old World , the one which was most isolated from the others . The originality of its characteristic cultural patterns was therefore greater .
Translation: 尽管此处尚非定论之所在，但毋庸置疑，在旧大陆诸多古代文明中，中国是与其他文明最为隔绝的一个。正因如此，其独特文化模式的原创性也更为显著。

Query_Text_en: furthermore , through all the successive centuries for three millennia , China was giving forth , and receiving , with ever intensity , cultural and technical elements .
Translation: 此外，在绵延三千年的历史长河中，中国始终以日益增强的力度进行着文化与技术要素的输出与吸纳。

Query_Text_en: Those who , with Price and P.F. Cressey , go about to prove that Chinese civilisation has always been in the circuit of the diffusion process , are struggling with an open doorfor of this fact there can be no denial .
Translation: 与普赖斯和克雷西一道试图证明中华文明始终处于文化传播循环体系中的学者们，其实是在论证一个不证自明的命题——这一事实根本无可辩驳。

Query_Text_en: It is , of course , equally necessary to make allowance for parallel development of ideas and techniques , independence of invention , and the like .
Translation: 当然，同样必须考虑到思想与技术的平行发展、发明的独立性等因素。

Query_Text_en: In all these matters the repetition of generalisations is useless ;
Translation: 泛泛而论在这些事务上毫无裨益；

Query_Text_en: what we need to know are more facts such as those to the elucidation of which the present work is devoted .
Translation: 我们所需了解的是更多事实，正如本书致力于阐明的那类事实。

Query_Text_en: It is probable that our final conclusion will be that there was far more intercourse and reaction between the Chinese and their western and southern neighbors than has often been supposed , but nevertheless that the essential style of Chinese thought and culture patterns maintained a remarkable and perennial autonomy .
Translation: 我们最终的结论很可能是：中国与其西方及南方邻邦之间的交流互动远比通常设想的更为频繁，但中国思想与文化形态的核心风格始终保持显著而持久的自主性。

Query_Text_en: This is the real meaning of the isolation of China ;
Translation: 这正是中国被孤立的真实含义；

Query_Text_en: contacts there were , but never abundant enough to affect the characteristic style of the civilisation , and hence of its science .
Translation: 彼时虽有交流，却远不足以撼动该文明的特有风貌，其科学体系亦如是。

Query_Text_en: What knowledge the ancient peoples of the Mediterranean basin had of China was assembled long ago in the form of citations by Reinaud and Coedfes .
Translation: 地中海沿岸古代民族对中国的认知，早已由雷诺和考狄斯以引文汇编的形式辑录成册。

Query_Text_en: Naturally it concerned mostly silk and the trade in silk , and the geographical knowledge which arose directly out of this .
Translation: 这自然主要涉及丝绸及丝绸贸易，以及由此直接衍生的地理知识。

Query_Text_en: But it is worth while to notice that some rumors of Confucianism seem to have reached Europe as early as the +2 nd century .
Translation: 值得注意的是，早在公元2世纪，儒家学说的某些传闻似乎就已传至欧洲。

Query_Text_en: Bardesanes , a Syrian writer who flourished at the end of that century and the beginning of the +3 rd ( a contemporary therefore of such men as Cheng Hsuan and Tshai Yung , scholars of the Late Han and early San Kuo period ) , is quoted by Eusebius as having said : In every country men have instituted different laws , some being committed to writing and some not ;
Translation: 叙利亚作家巴尔德萨内斯活跃于公元2世纪末至3世纪初（与东汉末三国初的郑玄、蔡邕等学者同时代），尤西比乌斯曾引述其言："各国皆立相异之法，或载诸竹帛，或口耳相传"。

Query_Text_en: I shall tell what I know of them , and what I can remember , beginning where the world begins ( i.e. in the Far East ) .
Translation: 我将从世界之始（即远东）说起，讲述我所知晓并记忆犹新的历史。

Query_Text_en: Among the Seres ( the Chinese ) the laws prohibit murder , prostitution , robbery , and the adoration of images The passage of glittering Mars across the meridian has no power there to bind the will of any man to put another to the sword .
Translation: 赛里斯人（中国人）的律法严禁凶杀、淫乱、劫掠与偶像崇拜。纵使璀璨火星划过子午线，亦无法诱使任何人起意戕害同胞。

Query_Text_en: Nor can Venus when in conjunction with Mars force any of them to have commerce with each others wives .
Translation: 即便金星与火星相合，亦无法迫使其与彼此之妻行苟且之事。

Query_Text_en: Yet Mars is seen there in the heavens every night , and there is no hour either of the day or the night at which a child is not born among the Seres .
Translation: 然而火星每夜都高悬天际，赛里斯人无时无刻不在诞育新生。

Query_Text_en: This interesting passage was the basis for many repetitions and enlargements .
Translation: 这段引人入胜的论述成为后世诸多演绎与拓展的蓝本。

Query_Text_en: Respect for the law is more potent among the Chinese than the constellation under which the individual is born .
Translation: 中国人对法律的敬畏，远胜于对生辰八字的信奉。

Query_Text_en: The Book of the Laws of the Countries , written apparently by a pupil of Bardesanes , adds that , although the Chinese are not subject to starry influences , there are yet rich and poor among them , sick and healthy , governors and subjects , because these things are given into the power of the rulers .
Translation: 《诸国律法书》据传为巴尔德萨内斯门徒所著，书中进一步指出：尽管中国人不受星象影响，但其间仍有贫富之分、病健之别、官民之序，盖因诸般事态皆归统治者权柄所辖。

Query_Text_en: There must surely have been some real transmission here , for a century and a half later , Caesarius , the brother of Gregory of Nyssa , correctly stated that in China custom was followed rather than codified law . In every country , among other peoples as with us , laws of princes exist , whether written or not ;
Translation: 显然，这里存在某种真实的传承关系。一个半世纪后，尼萨的格里高利之弟凯撒留便准确指出：在中国，习俗的效力高于成文法。无论在哪个国度，其他民族与我们一样，都存在着君主制定的律法——无论其是否形诸文字。

Query_Text_en: in some places they are written , while elsewhere there are customs ( which have the force of law ) .
Translation: 某些地方以成文法形式确立，另一些地方则以具有法律效力的惯例形式存在。

Query_Text_en: For those who do not have ( codes of ) laws , ancestral customs predominate .
Translation: 凡无成文法可循之处，祖制习俗即为圭臬。

Query_Text_en: Among such peoples , the first to be mentioned are the Seres ( the Chinese ) who inhabit the ( eastern ) extremity of the earththey have for laws the customs of their fathers which prohibit prostitution , robbery , adultery , the adoration of images and the invocation of go ...
Translation: 在这些民族中，首推居于世界（东方）极远之地的赛里斯人（即中国人）。他们以祖制为法度，严禁娼妓、劫掠、通奸之事，禁绝偶像崇拜与祈求鬼神......

Query_Text_en: Among the Seres the laws of their ancestors are more powerful than the fates determined by the stars .
Translation: 华夏之邦，祖制重于天命。

Query_Text_en: This was afterwards copied several times , as by George Hamartolos , the Byzantine monkish chronicler , about +840 ; and two other Byzantine writers , Cedrenos and Phrantzes in the +11 th century .
Translation: 此后，这一记载被多次转引：约公元840年拜占庭僧侣编年史家乔治·哈马托罗斯曾援引；11世纪时又有两位拜占庭作家——塞德雷诺斯与弗兰策斯沿用了此说。

Query_Text_en: Still more remarkable is the rumor of Confucian atheism , which was apparently appealed to by Celsus , the great pagan writer attacked by Origen .
Translation: 更令人瞩目的是关于儒家无神论的传闻，这一观点显然被塞尔苏斯所援引——这位遭奥利金抨击的异教大文豪曾对此大加推崇。

Query_Text_en: The atheism of the Seres is mentioned several times in Origen , s refutation .
Translation: 奥利金在《驳塞尔苏斯》中多次提及赛里斯人的无神论思想。

Query_Text_en: It is of the greatest interest that a hint of Confucian rationalism and scepticism thus reached a world ridden by individual astrology and Gnostic superstition , though the picture of Seric virtue was distinctly idealised .
Translation: 尤为引人瞩目的是，当西方世界深陷占星术与诺斯替迷信之时，儒家理性主义与怀疑论的微光竟能远播至此——尽管其中对赛里斯人美德的描绘显然经过了理想化处理。

Query_Text_en: The transmission of all these ideas may be understood without difficulty , for they occur a couple of centuries after the opening of the Old Silk Road , and we shall shortly examine the records of contemporary Chinese historians which describe the visits of Roman-Syrian merchants to East Asian ports throughout this period .
Translation: 这些思想的传播过程不难理解，因为它们都出现在古丝绸之路开通后的两三个世纪内。我们稍后将研读中国历代史家的记载——这些史料详细记录了同一时期罗马-叙利亚商贾频繁造访东亚港口的史实。

Query_Text_en: Before going on , however , to speak of the trade of historical times , and some of the travellers who are known to have gone along them , something may be said concerning exchanges that were more impalpable , either because they took place almost before history begins , or because of their literary or artistic character .
Translation: 然而，在继续探讨历史时期的贸易往来及已知的旅行者行迹之前，有必要先论及那些更为隐微的交流形式——或因发生于史前时期而难以考证，或因具有文学艺术特质而超越物质范畴。

Query_Text_en: In the first place , as already suggested , there was a certain continuity between China and Europe in the bronze age , not simply because of the presumed transmission of the technique , but because of an actual correspondence of forms of objects .
Translation: 首先，如前所述，中国与欧洲在青铜时代存在某种延续性，这不仅源于冶铸技术的传播推定，更因器物形制上存在实质性的对应关系。

Query_Text_en: In a series of important papers Janse has demonstrated the essential unity of Europe and China in this respect from before the Shang dynasty ( 1500 ) well into the Chou .
Translation: 詹森在一系列重要论文中证明，早在商朝（公元前1500年）之前直至周朝，欧洲与中国在这方面本质上是一体的。

Query_Text_en: The correspondences described are impressive One paper deals particularly with bronze and iron swords ;
Translation: 所述对应关系令人瞩目，其中一篇论文专门探讨了青铜剑与铁剑。

Query_Text_en: and ( d ) scabbard strap attachments or cleats .
Translation: 以及（d）鞘带固定装置或系缆墩。

Query_Text_en: Certain other types , however , are peculiar either to China or to Europe .
Translation: 然另有若干类型，或为中国所独有，或为欧洲所特有。

Query_Text_en: The annulus pommel continued in use in China in the Han time , as witness the reliefs in the Wu Liang tomb , one of which is reproduced here from the Chin Shih So .
Translation: 汉代中国仍沿用环首刀，武梁祠浮雕可为佐证，此处据《金石索》复刻其一。

Query_Text_en: Another paper was devoted to the curious pieces or ornaments , characteristic both of Chinese bronze age and of the Hallstatt civilisation in Europe .
Translation: 另一篇论文专门探讨了中国青铜时代与欧洲哈尔施塔特文明共有的奇特装饰品。

Query_Text_en: and ( g ) chalices of precious metals with a sphere or ring on the stem .
Translation: 及（g）带球形或环形底座的贵金属圣杯。

Query_Text_en: Lindblom has added vessels with star lids , the wide distribution of which includes Africa .
Translation: 林德布洛姆新增了带星形盖的器皿，此类器皿在非洲等地广泛流通。
