Query_Text_en: Article 30 When the financing lease contract , comes to an end , the lessee , unless exercising a right to purchase the civil aircraft to hold the civil aircraft on lease f a further period in accordance with the contract , shall return the civil aircraft to the less in the condition specified in Article 29 of this Law .
Translation: 第三十条  融资租赁合同终止时，承租人应当将民用航空器退还出租人；但是，承租人依照合同行使购买民用航空器的权利或者按照融资租赁合同约定继续租赁该民用航空器的除外。返还的民用航空器应当符合本法第二十九条规定的状况。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 The supplier in the financing lease of a civil aircraft shall not be liable to both the less and the lessee at the same time in respect of the same damage .
Translation: 第三十一条 民用航空器融资租赁中的供货方，不就同一损害同时对承租人和出租人承担责任。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 During the period of financing lease , the lessee may transfer the right of the possession of the civil aircraft as well as other rights under the lease contract only with the consent of the less and without jeopardizing the interests of third parties .
Translation: 第三十二条 在融资租赁期间，经出租人同意，在不损害第三人利益的情况下，承租人可以转让民用航空器占有权及其他合同权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 33 In the case of a financing lease , other leases covering a period of six months longer , the lessee shall register his right of possession of the civil aircraft with the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council ; no such lease may act against a third party unless registered .
Translation: 第三十三条 以融资租赁方式占有民用航空器的权利，或者六个月以上的其他租赁期限占有民用航空器的权利，承租人应当向国务院民用航空主管部门办理权利登记；未经登记的，不得对抗第三人。

Query_Text_en: Article 34 Application shall be filed with the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council f type certificate the designing of civil aircraft and its engines , propellers and on-board equipment .
Translation: 第三十四条  设计民用航空器及其发动机、螺旋桨和民用航空器上设备，应当向国务院民用航空主管部门申请型号合格证。

Query_Text_en: A type certificate shall be issued accordingly if found qualified .
Translation: 经审查合格后，即颁发型号合格证书。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 Application shall be filed with the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council f production certificate and maintenance certificate the production and maintenance of civil aircraft and its engines , propellers and on-board equipment .
Translation: 第三十五条 民用航空器及其发动机、螺旋桨和机上设备的制造、维修活动，应当向国务院民用航空主管部门申请生产许可证和维修许可证。

Query_Text_en: A certificate certificates shall be issued accordingly if found qualified .
Translation: 经审核合格后，应按规定颁发相应证书。

Query_Text_en: Article 36 Where a civil aircraft and its engines , propellers and on-board equipment produced by a feign manufacturer are imported into China f the first time , such feign manufacturer shall file an application with the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council f type validation certificate .
Translation: 第三十六条　外国制造人生产的任何型号的民用航空器及其发动机、螺旋桨和民用航空器上设备，首次进口中国的，该外国制造人应当向国务院民用航空主管部门申请领取型号认可证书。

Query_Text_en: A type validation certificate shall be issued if found qualified .
Translation: 经检验合格后，将颁发型式认证证书。

Query_Text_en: Where a civil aircraft and its engines , propellers and on-board equipment , f which a type certificate has been issued in a feign country , are produced f the first time in China , the holder of the type certificate shall file an application with the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council f type validation certificate .
Translation: 凡已取得外国型号合格证的民用航空器及其发动机、螺旋桨和机载设备，首次在中国境内生产时，型号合格证持有人应当向国务院民用航空主管部门申请型号认可证书。

Query_Text_en: Article 37 A civil aircraft possessing the nationality of the People s Republic of China may fly only if it holds an airworthiness certificate issued by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 第三十七条 具有中华人民共和国国籍的民用航空器，应当持有国务院民用航空主管部门颁发的适航证书，方可飞行。

Query_Text_en: Application shall be filed with the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council by the manufacturer of export airworthiness certificate with respect to the export of civil aircraft and its engines , propellers and on-board equipment .
Translation: 民用航空器及其发动机、螺旋桨和机载设备的制造商，应当向国务院民用航空主管部门申请出口适航证书。

Query_Text_en: An export airwthinees certificate shall be issued if found qualified .
Translation: 经检验合格后，方可签发出口适航证书。

Query_Text_en: A feign civil aircraft on lease may fly only after the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council has examined and rendered valid its airworthiness certificate issued by the State in which the nationality of such aircraft was originally registered , has issued a new airworthinees certificate therefore .
Translation: 租赁的外国民用航空器，应当经国务院民用航空主管部门对其原国籍登记国发给的适航证书审查认可或者另发适航证书，方可飞行。

Query_Text_en: The regulations f the airworthiness of civil aircraft shall be formulated by the State Council .
Translation: 民用航空器适航管理条例由国务院制定。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 The owner and lessee of a civil aircraft shall use the aircraft in accordance with the scope of use prescribed in airworthiness certificate , conscientiously carry out the maintenance of the aircraft and ensure its airworthiness .
Translation: 第三十八条 民用航空器的所有人或者承租人应当按照适航证书规定的使用范围使用航空器，做好航空器的维修保养工作，保证航空器处于适航状态。

Query_Text_en: 2 Ground personnel , including civil aircraft maintenance personnel , air traffic controllers , flight dispatchers and aeronautical radio station operators .
Translation: 2 地面人员，包括民用航空器维修人员、空中交通管制员、飞行签派员以及航空电台操作员。

Query_Text_en: Article 40 An airman may perform the duty specified in his licence only if be bas received professional training , and has been qualified through examination and issued a licence by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 第四十条 航空人员只有接受专业训练，经国务院民用航空主管部门考核合格，取得执照，方可担任其执照载明的工作。

Query_Text_en: Flight personnel and air traffic controllers shall , before obtaining licences , also be subject to the check of the physical examination unit approved by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council , and obtain the physical examination certificate issued by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 飞行人员和空中交通管制员在取得执照前，还应当接受国务院民用航空主管部门认可的体格检查单位的检查，并取得国务院民用航空主管部门颁发的体格检查合格证书。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 Flight personnel shall in performing flight missions , carry on their persons licences and physical examination certificates and be subject to the check of the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 第四十一条 飞行人员执行飞行任务时，应当随身携带执照和体格检查合格证书，并接受国务院民用航空主管部门的查验。

Query_Text_en: Article 42 Airmen shall be subject to the periodical non-periodical inspection and examination of the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council . Only those qualified in inspection and examination may continue to perform the duties specified in their licences .
Translation: 第四十二条　航空人员应当接受国务院民用航空主管部门的定期或者不定期检查和考核；经检查、考核合格的，方可继续担任其执照载明的工作。

Query_Text_en: Flight personnel shall also take part in periodical training of emergency procedures .
Translation: 机组人员还应定期参加应急程序培训。

Query_Text_en: Flight personnel who have exceeded the time limit of interruption in flight prescribed by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council shall be subject to inspection and examination ; with the exception of cabin attendants , flight personnel shall also go through instruction flight .
Translation: 国务院民用航空主管部门规定的中断飞行时限超过的飞行人员，应当接受检查考核；除乘务员外，飞行人员还应当完成带飞训练。

Query_Text_en: Only those qualified through inspection , examination and instruction flight may continue to perform the duties specified in their licenses .
Translation: 经检验、考核和飞行教学合格者，方可继续履行其执照规定的职责。

Query_Text_en: Article 43 The crew of a civil aircraft is composed of a pilot-in-command and other flight personnel .
Translation: 第四十三条 民用航空器机组由机长和其他空勤人员组成。

Query_Text_en: The pilot-in-command shall be a pilot possessing the technique and experience of independently piloting that type of civil aircraft .
Translation: 机长应当由具有独立驾驶该型号民用航空器技术和经验的正驾驶员担任。

Query_Text_en: The composition of a crew and the number of its members shall conform to the regulations of the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 机组人员的组成和人数应当符合国务院民用航空主管部门的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 44 The pilot-in-command is responsible f the operation of the civil aircraft , and shall strictly perform his duties to protect the safety of the civil aircraft and persons and property carried therein .
Translation: 第四十四条 机长负责民用航空器的操作，应当严格履行职责，保护民用航空器及其所载人员和财产的安全。

Query_Text_en: The pilot-in-command issues orders within the scope of his functions and powers , and the orders shall be implemented by the persons carried by the civil aircraft .
Translation: 机长在其职权范围内发布的命令，民用航空器上所载人员都应当执行。

Query_Text_en: Article 45 The pilot-in-command shall carry out necessary inspection of the civil aircraft before flight ; no civil aircraft shall takeoff unless inspected .
Translation: 第四十五条 机长在飞行前应当对民用航空器实施必要检查；未经检查的，不得起飞。

Query_Text_en: Where and when a pilot-in-command discovers that the civil aircraft , airport and weather conditions do not conform to the requirements prescribed and can not ensure flight safety , he has the right to refuse takeoff .
Translation: 机长发现民用航空器、机场、气象条件等不符合规定且不能保证飞行安全时，有权拒绝起飞。

Query_Text_en: Article 46 The pilot-in-command bas the right to take necessary and appropriate measures in flight , under the prerequisite of ensuring flight safety , against any acts which may destroy the civil aircraft , interfere with the der on board and jeopardize the safety of persons property therein , and any other acts jeopardizing flight safety .
Translation: 第四十六条 机长在飞行中，为保障航空器及所载人员安全，有权对任何破坏航空器、扰乱航空器内秩序、危害航空器所载人员或财产安全以及其他危及飞行安全的行为，采取必要且适当的措施。

Query_Text_en: In case of extraordinary circumstances in flight , the pilot-in-command shall have authority as to the disposition of the civil aircraft so as to ensure the safety of the aircraft and the persons therein .
Translation: 飞行中遇有特殊情况时，机长有权对民用航空器作出处置，以保证航空器及所载人员的安全。

Query_Text_en: Article 47 The pilot-in-command has the right to ask f a change of crew member s in der to ensure flight safety if he discovered that the crew member s are not suitable f performing the flight mission .
Translation: 第四十七条 机长发现机组人员不适宜执行飞行任务的，为保证飞行安全，有权提出调整。

Query_Text_en: Article 48 In case a civil aircraft is in distress , the pilot-in-command has the right to take all necessary measures , and direct the crew members and other persons on board the aircraft to take rescue measures .
Translation: 第四十八条 民用航空器遇险时，机长有权采取一切必要措施，并指挥机组人员和航空器上其他人员采取抢救措施。

Query_Text_en: In case of emergency which necessitates evacuation from the civil aircraft in distress , the pilot-in-command must take measures first to organize passengers to leave the civil aircraft safely ; no crew member shall leave the civil aircraft unless authorized by the pilot-in-command ; the pilot-in-command shall be the last to leave the aircraft .
Translation: 遇险需要撤离民用航空器的，机长必须采取必要措施，首先组织旅客安全离开民用航空器；未经机长许可，机组人员不得擅自离开民用航空器；机长应当最后离开民用航空器。

Query_Text_en: Article 49 In case an accident occurred to a civil aircraft , the pilot-in-command shall report in time the state of the accident accurately to the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council directly through air traffic control unit .
Translation: 第四十九条 民用航空器发生事故，机长应当直接或者通过空中交通管制单位，及时将事故情况准确报告国务院民用航空主管部门。

Query_Text_en: Article 50 When a pilot-in-command received SOS signals from a ship another aircraft , discovered , a ship an aircraft and the persons therein in distress , he shall report the state of distress in time to the nearest air traffic control unit and give possible , rational assistance .
Translation: 第五十条 机长收到船舶或者其他航空器的遇险信号，或者发现遇险的船舶、航空器及其人员，应当将遇险情况及时报告就近的空中交通管制单位并给予可能的合理的援助。

Query_Text_en: Article 51 In case a pilot-in-command is unable to perform his duties in flight due to one reason another , the pilot holding a post next only to him shall act on his behalf , the owner lessee of the civil aircraft shall assign a new pilot-in-command to take over before the aircraft takes off at the next place of stop .
Translation: 第五十一条 飞行中，机长因故不能履行职务的，由仅次于机长职务的驾驶员代理机长；在下一个经停地起飞前，民用航空器所有人或者承租人应当指派新机长接任。

Query_Text_en: Article 52 In the case of a civil aircraft with only one pilot and without the need to have other flight personnel , the provisions of this Section concerning the pilot-in-command shall be applicable to such pilot .
Translation: 第五十二条 对于仅配备一名飞行员且无需其他飞行人员的民用航空器，本节关于机长的规定适用于该飞行员。

Query_Text_en: Article 53 `` Civil airport '' as referred to in this Law means a defined area , including any subsidiary buildings , installations and equipment , intended to be used the takeoff , landing , taxiing , parking and other activities of civil aircraft .
Translation: 第五十三条 本法所称民用机场，是指专供民用航空器起飞、降落、滑行、停放以及进行其他活动使用的划定区域，包括附属的建筑物、装置和设施。

Query_Text_en: The civil airport referred to in this Law does not include temporary airfield .
Translation: 本法所称民用机场不包括临时机场。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of the management of airports used by both military and civil air operations shall be separately formulated by the State Council and the Central Military Commission .
Translation: 军民合用机场的管理规定由国务院和中央军事委员会另行制定。

Query_Text_en: Article 54 The construction and utilization of civil airports shall be subject to overall arrangement and rational distribution , and the efficiency of airport utilization shall be raised .
Translation: 第五十四条 民用机场的建设和使用应当统筹安排、合理布局，提高机场的使用效率。

Query_Text_en: The plan of distributions and construction of civil airports in the whole country shall be formulated by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council and other departments concerned under the State Council , and shall be implemented after being approved in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the State .
Translation: 全国民用机场的布局和建设规划，由国务院民用航空主管部门会同国务院有关部门制定，并按照国家规定的程序批准后实施。

Query_Text_en: The People s Governments of provinces , autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government shall formulate the civil airport construction plans of their own administrative areas on the basis of the national plan of civil airport distribution and construction , and incorporate such plans in the national economic and social development programs at their respective levels after being approved in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the State .
Translation: 省、自治区、直辖市人民政府应当根据全国民用机场布局和建设规划，制定本行政区域的民用机场建设规划，并按照国家规定的程序报经批准后，将其纳入本级国民经济和社会发展规划。

Query_Text_en: Article 55 The civil airport constriction plan shall be coordinated with city construction planning .
Translation: 第五十五条 民用机场建设规划应当与城市建设规划相协调。

Query_Text_en: Article 56 The constriction , modification and extension of civil airport shall conform to the plan of civil airport distribution and construction formulated according to law and to the standards of civil airport , and shall be subject to the approval of the competent authority concerned and implemented in accordance with State regulations .
Translation: 第五十六条 民用机场的建设和使用应当统筹安排、合理布局，提高机场的使用效率。全国民用机场的布局和建设规划，由国务院民用航空主管部门会同国务院其他有关部门制定，并按照国家规定的程序，经批准后实施。

Query_Text_en: A construction project of civil airport not conforming to the plan of civil airport distribution and construction formulated according to law shall not be approved .
Translation: 凡不符合依法制定的民用机场布局和建设规划的民用机场建设项目，一律不予批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 57 With respect to the construction and extension of civil airport , an announcement shall be issued by the local People s Government at county higher level of the place where the civil airport is located .
Translation: 第五十七条 民用机场新建、扩建的公告应当由机场所在地县级以上地方人民政府发布。

Query_Text_en: The announcement prescribed in the preceding paragraph shall be published in main local newspapers , and posted in areas around the airport to be constructed extended .
Translation: 前款规定的公告，应在当地主要报纸上刊登，并在拟扩建机场周边区域张贴。

Query_Text_en: 7 The construction of buildings and facilities that will affect the electromagnetic environment of the airport .
Translation: 7 建设影响机场电磁环境的建筑物和设施。

Query_Text_en: Herding of livestock within the limits of civil airport defined according to law is prohibited .
Translation: 依法划定的民用机场范围内禁止放牧牲畜。

Query_Text_en: Article 59 Before the issue of announcement concerning the constriction and extension of a civil airport , the buildings , structures , trees , lights and other obstacles existing within the limits of the civil airport defined according to law and within the airport obstacle clearance protection zone defined in accordance with State regulations that might affect light safety shall be removed within prescribed time limit ; the damage caused thereby shall be compensated , other remedial measures shall be taken according to law .
Translation: 第五十九条 在依法划定的民用机场范围内和按照国家规定划定的机场净空保护区域内，对可能影响飞行安全的高大建筑物、构筑物、树木、灯光和其他障碍物体，应当在规定的期限内清除；由此造成的损失，应当依法给予补偿或者采取其他补救措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 60 After the issue of announcement concerning the constriction and extension of a civil airport , the buildings , structures , trees , lights and other obstacles that affect flight safety built , planted put up by any unit of individual within the limits of the civil airport defined according to law and within the airport obstacle clearance protection zone defined in accordance with State regulations in violation of this Law and the provisions of relevant administrative rules and regulations shall be removed by the der of the local People s Government at county higher level of the place where the airport is located ; the damage caused thereby shall be borne by the person who built , planted of put up such obstacles .
Translation: 第六十条 民用机场新建、扩建的公告发布后，任何单位和个人违反本法和有关行政法规的规定，在依法划定的民用机场范围内和按照国家规定划定的机场净空保护区域内修建、种植或者设置影响飞行安全的建筑物、构筑物、树木、灯光和其他障碍物体的，由机场所在地县级以上地方人民政府责令清除；由此造成的损失，由修建、种植或者设置该障碍物体的人承担。

Query_Text_en: Article 61 In accordance with the relevant regulations , of the State , movement obstacle lights and marks shall be installed on high buildings facilities outside the civil airport and its obstacle clearance protection zone defined according to State regulations that will possibly affect flight safety , and shall be kept in normal condition .
Translation: 第六十一条 按照国家有关规定，在民用机场及其按照国家规定划定的净空保护区域以外的高大建筑物或者设施上，可能影响飞行安全的，应当设置飞行障碍灯和标志，并使其保持正常状态。

Query_Text_en: Article 62 A civil airport may be opened to traffic only if it holds an airport operating licence .
Translation: 第六十二条 民用机场须持有机场使用许可证，方可开放使用。

Query_Text_en: 5 It has available other conditions specified by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 5 具备国务院民用航空主管部门规定的其他条件。

Query_Text_en: An international airport shall also have the conditions for operating international air transport and be provided with customs and other port inspection organs .
Translation: 国际机场还应具备国际航空运输运营条件，并设有海关及其他口岸检查机构。

Query_Text_en: Article 63 A civil airport operating licence shall be applied f by airport administrative goran to the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council , and shall be issued after being examined and approved by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 第六十三条 民用机场经营许可证由机场管理机构向国务院民用航空主管部门申请领取；经国务院民用航空主管部门审查批准后颁发。

Query_Text_en: Article 64 The establishment of an international airport shall be reported by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council of the examination and approval of the State Council .
Translation: 第六十四条 国际机场的设立，由国务院民用航空主管部门报请国务院审查批准。

Query_Text_en: The opening to traffic of an international airport shall be announced to the public by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council ; the data of an international airport shall be exclusively provided by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 国际机场的开放使用由国务院民用航空主管部门公告；国际机场资料由国务院民用航空主管部门统一提供。

Query_Text_en: Article 65 A civil airport shall take measures to ensure the safety of personnel and property in the airport in accordance with the provisions of the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 第六十五条 民用机场应当依照国务院民用航空主管部门的规定，采取措施，保证机场内人员和财产的安全。

Query_Text_en: Article 66 A civil airport used by civil aircraft f the purpose of transporting passengers and cargo shall be equipped with necessary facilities to provide good service to passengers , shippers and consignees in accordance with the standards provided by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 第六十六条 供运输旅客或者货物的民用航空器使用的民用机场，应当按照国务院民用航空主管部门规定的标准，设置必要设施，为旅客和货物托运人、收货人提供良好服务。

Query_Text_en: Article 67 A civil airport administrative organ shall protect well the environment of the civil airport in accordance with the provisions of the laws and administrative rules and regulations concerning environment protection .
Translation: 第六十七条 民用机场管理机构应当依照环境保护法律、行政法规的规定，做好机场环境保护工作。

Query_Text_en: Article 68 A user s charge and a service charge shall be paid f the use of civil airport and its navaid by a civil aircraft ; the rates of user s charge and service charge shall be formulated by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council and the finance department and the competent authority of prices under the State Council .
Translation: 第六十八条 民用航空器使用民用机场及其助航设施的，应当缴纳使用费、服务费；使用费和服务费的收费标准，由国务院民用航空主管部门会同国务院财政部门、物价主管部门制定。

Query_Text_en: Article 69 Where a civil airport is abandoned used f other purposes , the civil airport administrative organ shall go through the formalities of reporting and approval in accordance with State regulations .
Translation: 第六十九条 民用机场废弃或者改作他用，机场管理机构应当依照国家规定办理报批手续。

Query_Text_en: Article 70 The State exercises unified management over the airspace .
Translation: 第七十条 国家对空域实行统一管理。

Query_Text_en: Article 71 In delineating the airspace , consideration shall be given to the requirements of both civil aviation and the security of national defense and to public interest f the rational , full and effective utilization of the airspace .
Translation: 第七十一条  空域划设应当兼顾民用航空和国防安全的需要以及公众利益，使空域得到合理、充分、有效的利用。

Query_Text_en: Article 72 The detailed method of airspace management shall be formulated by the State Council , and the Central Military Commission .
Translation: 第七十二条 空域管理的具体办法，由国务院、中央军事委员会制定。

Query_Text_en: Article 73 Responsibility of the control of aircraft operating within a defined , controlled airspace shall be vested in a single air traffic control unit .
Translation: 第七十三条 在划定的管制空域内运行的航空器管制责任，应当由单一的空中交通管制单位承担。

Query_Text_en: Article 74 The approval of an air traffic control unit shall be obtained f a civil aircraft to conduct flight activities in a controlled airspace .
Translation: 第七十四条 民用航空器在管制空域内进行飞行活动，应当取得空中交通管制单位的许可。

Query_Text_en: Article 75 A civil aircraft in flight shall follow the air route and fly at the altitude specified by the air traffic control unit ; permission shall be obtained from the air traffic control unit if a deviation from the air route a change in flight altitude specified is necessary f one reason another .
Translation: 第七十五条 民用航空器应当按照空中交通管制单位指定的航路和飞行高度飞行；因故确需偏离指定的航路或者改变飞行高度飞行的，应当取得空中交通管制单位的许可。

Query_Text_en: Article 76 Aircraft flying in the territory of the People s Republic of China must observe unified rules of the air .
Translation: 第七十六条 在中华人民共和国境内飞行的航空器，必须遵守统一的飞行规则。

Query_Text_en: A civil aircraft performing visual flight shall observe visual flight rules and keep a safe separation from other aircraft and ground obstacles .
Translation: 实施目视飞行的民用航空器应当遵守目视飞行规则，并与其他航空器、地面障碍物保持安全间隔。

Query_Text_en: A civil aircraft performing instrument flight shall observe instrument flight rules .
Translation: 实施仪表飞行的民用航空器应当遵守仪表飞行规则。

Query_Text_en: The rules of the air shall be formulated by the State Council and the Central Military Commission .
Translation: 航空管制规则由国务院和中央军事委员会共同制定。

Query_Text_en: Article 77 No crew member of a civil aircraft shall perform a flight mission if his flight time on duty exceeds the time limits prescribed by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 第七十七条 民用航空器机组人员的飞行时间不得超过国务院民用航空主管部门规定的时限。

Query_Text_en: No crew member of a civil aircraft shall perform a flight mission if his work capacity is impaired by the effect of alcoholic beverage , narcotic other drugs .
Translation: 民用航空器机组人员受酒精饮料、麻醉剂或其他药物影响导致工作能力受损的，不得执行飞行任务。

Query_Text_en: Article 78 No civil aircraft shall fly into a prohibited area unless it is specially approved in accordance with State regulations ; no civil aircraft shall fly into a restricted area unless it observes the prescribed conditions of restriction .
Translation: 第七十八条 民用航空器除按照国家规定经特别批准外，不得飞入禁区；除遵守规定的限制条件外，不得飞入限制区。

Query_Text_en: The prohibited area and restricted area specified in the preceding paragraph are defined in accordance with State regulations .
Translation: 前款规定的禁区和限制区，系按照国家相关规定划定。

Query_Text_en: 3 The flight has been approved in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the State .
Translation: 该航班已按国家规定程序获批。

Query_Text_en: 2 It is indispensable f performing a rescue mission other flights missions conforming to the public interest of the society .
Translation: 执行符合社会公共利益的救援任务及其他飞行任务不可或缺。

Query_Text_en: Article 81 No civil aircraft shall fly out of the territory of the People s Republic of China unless approved .
Translation: 第八十一条 任何民用航空器未经批准不得飞出中华人民共和国领空。

Query_Text_en: Where a civil aircraft is leaving the airspace of the People s Republic of China without authorization , the department concerned has the right to take necessary measures to stop it in accordance with concrete conditions .
Translation: 民用航空器未经批准擅自飞出中华人民共和国领空的，有关部门有权根据具体情况采取必要措施予以制止。

Query_Text_en: Article 82 An air traffic control unit shall provide air traffic service to civil aircraft in flight , including air traffic control service , flight information service and alerting service .
Translation: 第八十二条 空中交通管制单位应当为飞行中的民用航空器提供空中交通服务，包括空中交通管制服务、飞行情报服务和告警服务。

Query_Text_en: The purpose of providing air traffic control service is to prevent collisions between civil aircraft and aircraft , and between civil aircraft and obstacles , and maintain and expedite flow of air traffic .
Translation: 提供空中交通管制服务的目的是防止民用航空器与航空器之间、民用航空器与障碍物之间的碰撞，并保持和加速空中交通流动。

Query_Text_en: The purpose of providing flight information service is to provide advice and information useful f the safe and efficient conduct of flights .
Translation: 提供飞行情报服务的目的是为飞行安全高效运行提供有益的建议和信息。

Query_Text_en: The purpose of providing alerting service is to notify appropriate organizations regarding aircraft in need of search and rescue aid , and assist such organizations as required .
Translation: 提供告警服务的目的是向相关机构通报需要搜救援助的航空器信息，并在必要时协助这些机构开展行动。

Query_Text_en: Article 83 In the event that an air traffic control unit discovers a civil aircraft deviated from its specified air route lost its course , it shall rapidly take all necessary measures to enable the aircraft to regain course .
Translation: 第八十三条 空中交通管制单位发现民用航空器偏离指定航路、迷失航向时，应当迅速采取一切必要措施，使其回归航路。

Query_Text_en: Article 84 Necessary navigation , communication , metrological and ground monitoring equipment shall be installed on the air route .
Translation: 第八十四条 航路上应当设置必要的导航、通信、气象和地面监视设备。

Query_Text_en: Article 85 The natural obstacles that affect flight safety on air route shall be marked on aeronautical test ; flight obstacle rights and marks shall be installed on man-made obstacles that affect flight safety on air route and shall be kept in normal condition .
Translation: 第八十五条 航路上影响飞行安全的自然障碍物体，应当在航图上标明；航路上影响飞行安全的人工障碍物体，应当设置飞行障碍灯和标志，并使其保持正常状态。

Query_Text_en: Article 86 The construction of a shooting range other facilities that will possibly affect flight safety is prohibited within the area extending 30 kilometers from the edges of an air route , unless it is a shooting range f flat trajectory light weapon .
Translation: 第八十六条 在航路边缘30公里以内的地带，禁止修建可能影响飞行安全的靶场和其他设施；但平射轻武器靶场除外。

Query_Text_en: The construction of a fixed temporary shooting ground beyond the area prescribed in the preceding paragraph shall be subject to approval according to relevant State regulations ; the shooting direction of an air shooting range shall not intersect an air route .
Translation: 在前款规定区域外修建固定或者临时射击场，应当按照国家有关规定报批；空中射击靶场的射击方向不得与航空航线交叉。

Query_Text_en: Article 87 Any activity that will possibly affect flight safety may be carried out only after being approved according to law with necessary measures being taken to ensure flight safety .
Translation: 第八十七条 可能影响飞行安全的活动，应当依法获得批准，并采取确保飞行安全的必要措施，方可进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 88 The competent civil aviation authority under the State Council shall exercise control over civil aviation radio stations and the special frequencies assigned to be used by civil aviation system according to law .
Translation: 第八十八条 国务院民用航空主管部门应当依法对民用航空无线电台和分配给民用航空系统使用的专用频率实施管理。

Query_Text_en: No radio station other instrument and device used by a unit an individual shall hinder the normal use of civil aviation special radio frequencies .
Translation: 任何单位或个人使用的无线电设备及其他仪器、装置，均不得妨碍民用航空专用无线电频率的正常使用。

Query_Text_en: Where harmful interference has been caused to civil aviation special radio frequencies , the unit individual concerned shall rapidly remove such interference ; the use of such radio station other instrument and device shall be stopped before the removal of the interference .
Translation: 对民用航空专用无线电频率造成有害干扰时，有关单位和个人必须迅速排除干扰；在排除干扰前，应当停止使用该无线电台（站）或者其他仪器、设备。

Query_Text_en: Article 89 The post and telecommunication enterprise shall give priority in service to civil aviation telecommunication transmission .
Translation: 第八十九条 邮电通信企业应当优先传递民用航空通信业务。

Query_Text_en: The State metrological organ shall provide necessary metrological data to civil aviation metrological organ .
Translation: 国家计量机构应当向民航计量机构提供必要的计量数据。

Query_Text_en: 8 Other documents that should be carried according to the flight mission .
Translation: 根据飞行任务要求应当携带的其他文件。

Query_Text_en: Where a civil aircraft fails to carry the documents as listed in the preceding paragraph according to regulations , the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council the regional civil aviation administrative organ authorized by it may prohibit such civil aircraft to take off .
Translation: 民用航空器未按规定携带前款所列文件的，国务院民用航空主管部门或者其授权的地区民用航空管理机构可以禁止该民用航空器起飞。

Query_Text_en: Article 91 `` Public air transport enterprise '' means an enterprise engaged in the transport of passengers , baggage , mail cargo with civil aircraft f the purpose of making profit .
Translation: 第九十一条 公共航空运输企业，是指以营利为目的，使用民用航空器运送旅客、行李、邮件或者货物的企业法人。

Query_Text_en: Article 92 In establishing a public air transport enterprise , application shall be filed with the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council f operating licence , and registration with the department of industrial and commercial administration shall be performed according to law ; where a public air transport enterprise fails to obtain operating licence , no registration should be performed f such enterprise by the department of industrial and commercial administration .
Translation: 第九十二条 设立公共航空运输企业，应当向国务院民用航空主管部门申请领取经营许可证，并依法办理工商登记；未取得经营许可证的，工商行政管理部门不得办理工商登记。

Query_Text_en: 4 Other conditions prescribed in laws and administrative rules and regulations .
Translation: 法律、行政法规规定的其他条件。

Query_Text_en: Article 94 The provisions of the Cpation Law shall be applicable to the form of organization and institutional framework of public air transport enterprises .
Translation: 第九十四条 公共航空运输企业的组织形式、组织机构适用《公司法》的规定。

Query_Text_en: Where the form of organization and institutional framework of the public air transport enterprises established before the implementation of this Law do not completely conform to the provisions of the Cpation Law , original provisions can continue to be followed , and the date of the application of the provisions in the preceding paragraph shall be specified by the State Council .
Translation: 本法施行前设立的公共航空运输企业，其组织形式、组织机构不完全符合《公司法》规定的，可以继续沿用原有的规定，适用前款规定的时间由国务院规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 95 A public air transport enterprise shall take the assurance of flight safety , the regularity of flight and the provision of good service as guiding principles , and take effective measures to improve transport service quality .
Translation: 第九十五条 公共航空运输企业应当以保证飞行安全、航班正常和提供良好服务为准则，采取有效措施，提高运输服务质量。

Query_Text_en: A public air transport enterprise shall educate and require its staff and workers to strictly perform their duties , and conscientiously accomplish the services of transporting passengers and cargo with refined manners and thoughtfulness .
Translation: 公共航空运输企业应当教育和要求从业人员严格履行职责，以文明礼貌、细致周到的服务态度，认真做好旅客和货物运输的各项服务工作。

Query_Text_en: In the event of delay in passenger transport flight , relevant information shall be announced in time in the airport .
Translation: 旅客运输航班延误时，机场应及时发布相关信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 96 A public air transport enterprise shall apply to the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council f approval with respect to the air route to be operated f scheduled air services , and the suspension termination of the operation of air route .
Translation: 第九十六条　公共航空运输企业申请经营定期航班运输的航线，暂停、终止经营航线，应当报经国务院民用航空主管部门批准。

Query_Text_en: A public air transport enterprise operating scheduled air services shall have its timetable published .
Translation: 经营定期航班运输的公共航空运输企业应当公布其班期时刻。

Query_Text_en: Article 97 The geable business items of a public air transport enterprise shall be determined by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 第九十七条 公共航空运输企业的营业项目，由国务院民用航空主管部门规定。

Query_Text_en: The tariff of domestic air transport shall be formulated by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council and the competent authority of prices under the State Council , and shall be implemented after being approved by the State Council .
Translation: 国内航空运输运价由国务院民用航空主管部门会同国务院物价主管部门制定，报国务院批准后执行。

Query_Text_en: The tariff of international air transport shall be implemented in accordancewith the provisions of the agreements signed between the Government of the People s Republic of China and feign governments ; in the absence of any agreement , the tariff shall be formulated with reference to the market prices of international air transport , and shall be implemented after being approved by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 国际航空运输运价应当按照中华人民共和国政府与外国政府签订的协定执行；没有协定的，参照国际航空运输市场价格确定，报国务院民用航空主管部门批准后执行。

Query_Text_en: Article 98 The operation of non-scheduled air transport by a public air transport enterprise shall be subject to the approval of the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council , provided that it shall not affect the normal operation of scheduled air transport .
Translation: 第九十八条 公共航空运输企业从事不定期运输，应当经国务院民用航空主管部门批准，并不得影响定期运输的正常经营。

Query_Text_en: Article 99 A public air transport enterprise shall formulate a security plan in accordance with the public air transport security regulations formulated by the State Council , and report to the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council of the recd .
Translation: 第九十九条 公共航空运输企业应当依照国务院制定的公共航空运输安全保卫规定，制定安全保卫方案，并报国务院民用航空主管部门备案。

Query_Text_en: Article 100 No public air transport enterprise shall carry articles the transport of which is prohibited by the provisions of laws and administrative rules and regulations .
Translation: 第一百条 公共航空运输企业不得运输法律、行政法规和国务院规定禁止运输的物品。

Query_Text_en: No public air transport enterprise shall carry munitions of war and implements of war unless approved by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 未经国务院民用航空主管部门批准，任何公共航空运输企业不得运输作战武器和作战装备。

Query_Text_en: Passengers bringing on their persons articles the transport of which is prohibited by the provisions of laws and administrative rules and regulations are prohibited from flying in a civil aircraft .
Translation: 禁止旅客随身携带法律、行政法规和规章规定禁运的物品乘坐民用航空器。

Query_Text_en: Article 101 A public air transport enterprise shall observe the relevant regulations of the State in the transport of dangerous articles .
Translation: 第一百零一条 公共航空运输企业运输危险品，应当遵守国家有关规定。

Query_Text_en: The consigning of dangerous articles f shipment under the name of non-dangerous articles is prohibited .
Translation: 禁止以非危险品名义托运危险品。

Query_Text_en: Passengers bringing dangerous articles on their persons are prohibited from flying in a civil aircraft .
Translation: 禁止旅客随身携带危险物品乘坐民用航空器。

Query_Text_en: Passengers bringing firearms cutting tools are prohibited from flying in a civil aircraft unless they are performing official duties and approved in accordance with State regulations .
Translation: 除执行国家规定并获批准的公务外，禁止携带枪支刀具的旅客乘坐民用航空器。

Query_Text_en: The consigning of dangerous articles as baggage for shipment against the provisions stipulated by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council is prohibited .
Translation: 禁止违反国务院民用航空主管部门规定，以行李形式托运危险物品。

Query_Text_en: The names of dangerous articles shall be prescribed and published by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 危险品名称由国务院民用航空主管部门规定并公布。

Query_Text_en: Article 102 No public air transport enterprise shall carry passengers who refused to accept security inspection , n shall it carry baggage which have not gone through security inspection against State regulation .
Translation: 第一百零二条 公共航空运输企业不得运输拒绝接受安全检查的旅客，也不得违反国家规定运输未经安全检查的行李。

Query_Text_en: A public air transport enterprise must carry out security inspection take other measures to ensure the security of the cargo it undertakes to transport in accordance with the provisions stipulated by the competent civil aviation authority under the State Council .
Translation: 公共航空运输企业应当按照国务院民用航空主管部门的规定，对承运的货物进行安全检查或者采取其他保证安全的措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 103 The civil aircraft of a public air transport enterprise engaged in international air transport and the persons , baggage and cargo carried therein shall accept the inspection of such competent authorities as frontier inspection , customs and quarantine ; provided that unnecessary delay shall be prevented at the time of inspection .
Translation: 第一百零三条　公共航空运输企业从事国际航空运输的民用航空器及其所载人员、行李、货物，应当接受边防、海关、检疫等主管部门的检查；但是，检查时应当避免不必要的延误。

Query_Text_en: Article 104 A public air transport enterprise shall give priority to the transport of mail in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative rules and regulations .
Translation: 第一百零四条 公共航空运输企业应当依照有关法律、行政法规的规定优先运输邮件。

Query_Text_en: Article 105 A public air transport enterprise shall be covered by insurance against liability f third parties on the surface .
Translation: 第一百零五条 公共航空运输企业应当投保地面第三人责任险。

Query_Text_en: Article 106 This Chapter shall apply to the transport of persons , baggage , cargo performed by the civil aircraft of public air transport enterprise , including the gratuitous transportperformed by the civil aircraft of public air transport enterprise .
Translation: 第一百零六条 本章适用于公共航空运输企业使用民用航空器经营的旅客、行李或者货物的运输，包括公共航空运输企业使用民用航空器办理的免费运输。

Query_Text_en: This Chapter shall not apply to the transport of mail performed by civil aircraft .
Translation: 本章不适用于民用航空器执行的邮件运输。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of this Chapter shall apply to the part of transport by air in the case of multi-modal transport .
Translation: 本章规定适用于多式联运中涉及航空运输的部分。

Query_Text_en: Article 107 `` Domestic air transport '' referred to in this Chapter means any transport in which , according to the contract of transport by air between the parties , the place of departure , the place of destination and the agreed stopping place are all situated within the territory of the People s Republic of China .
Translation: 第一百零七条  本章所称国内航空运输，是指根据当事人订立的航空运输合同，运输的出发地点、约定的经停地点和目的地点均在中华人民共和国境内的运输。

Query_Text_en: `` International air transport '' referred to in this Chapter means any transport in which , according to the contract of transport by air between the parties , the place of departure , the place of destination the agreed stopping place , whether not there be a break in the transport a transshipment , is not situated within the territory of the People s Republic of China .
Translation: 本章所称"国际航空运输"，是指根据当事人订立的航空运输合同，无论运输有无间断或者转运，其出发地点、约定经停地点和目的地点均不在中华人民共和国境内的运输。

Query_Text_en: Article 108 Transport to be performed by several successive air carriers is deemed , f the purpose of this Law , to be one undivided transport , if it has been regarded by the parties of the contract of transport by air as a single operation , whether it had been agreed upon under the form of a single contract of a series of contracts .
Translation: 根据本法规定，若航空运输合同各方将连续多个承运人实施的运输视为单一运输行为，则无论该运输是通过单一合同还是一系列合同达成协议，均认定为不可分割的整体运输。

Query_Text_en: Article 109 The transport of passengers the carrier shall deliver a passenger ticket .
Translation: 第一百零九条　承运人运送旅客，应当出具客票。

Query_Text_en: A passenger to travel in civil aircraft shall produce a valid passenger ticket f check .
Translation: 旅客乘坐民用航空器，应当交验有效客票。

Query_Text_en: 3 If the ultimate destination , the place of departure the agreed stopping place of the passenger s journey is not situated within the territory of the People s Republic of China , a notice indicating the international air transport convention applicable to such transport , in case such convention requires the inclusion of the notice in the passenger ticket .
Translation: 若旅客行程的最终目的地、出发地或约定经停地不在中华人民共和国境内，且适用的国际航空运输公约要求在客票中载明相关通知时，须在客票上注明该国际航空运输公约的适用条款。

Query_Text_en: Article 111 The passenger ticket shall constitute prima facie evidence of the conclusion and conditions of the contract of transport of passenger by air .
Translation: 第一百一十一条 客票是航空旅客运输合同订立和运输合同条件的初步证据。

Query_Text_en: The failure of the passenger to produce the passenger ticket , the irregularity loss of the passenger ticket does not affect the existence validity of the contract of transport .
Translation: 旅客未能出示客票或客票遗失、不合规定，均不影响运输合同的存在与效力。

Query_Text_en: In domestic air transport , if , with the consent of the carrier , the passenger embarks on a civil aircraft without a passenger ticket having been delivered , the carrier shall not be entitled to avail himself of the provisions of Article 128 of this Law concerning the limit of liability .
Translation: 在国内航空运输中，承运人同意旅客不经其出票而乘坐民用航空器的，承运人无权援用本法第一百二十八条有关赔偿责任限制的规定。

Query_Text_en: In international air transport , if , with the consent of the carrier , the passenger embarks on a civil aircraft without a passenger ticket having been delivered , if the ticket does not include the notice required by sub-paragraph 3 of Article 110 of this Law , the carrier shall not be entitled to avail himself of the provisions of Article 129 of this Law concerning the limit of liability .
Translation: 在国际航空运输中，若经承运人同意，旅客未持客票即登乘民用航空器，或客票未载明本法第一百一十条第三项规定的通知事项，承运人无权援用本法第一百二十九条有关责任限制的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 112 In respect of the transport of checked baggage by a carrier , a baggage check may be combined with incarnated in a passenger ticket .
Translation: 第一百一十二条　承运人载运托运行李时，行李票可以包含在客票之内或者与客票相结合。

Query_Text_en: 2 If a declaration of interest in delivery at destination of the checked baggage is required , indicate the sum of d interest .
Translation: 如需申报托运行李目的地交付权益，请注明权益金额。

Query_Text_en: The baggage check shall constitute prima facie evidence of the checking of the baggage and , of the condition of the contract of transport .
Translation: 行李票是行李托运和运输合同条件的初步证据。

Query_Text_en: The failure of the passenger to produce the baggage check , the irregularity loss of the baggage check does not affect the existence validity of the contract of transport .
Translation: 旅客未能出示行李票或行李票遗失、缺损，均不影响运输合同的存在与效力。

Query_Text_en: In domestic air transport , if the carrier carries the checked baggage without a baggage check having been delivered , he shall not be entitled to avail himself of the provisions of Article 128 of this Law concerning the limit of liability .
Translation: 在国内航空运输中，承运人载运托运行李而未出具行李票的，无权援用本法第一百二十八条有关赔偿责任限制的规定。

Query_Text_en: In international air transport , if the carrier carries the checked baggage without a baggage check having been delivered , if the baggage check does not include the notice required by sub-paragraph 3 of Article 110 of this Law , the carrier shall not be entitled to avail himself of the provisions of Article 129 of this Law concerning the limit of liability .
Translation: 在国际航空运输中，若承运人未交付行李票而载运托运行李，或行李票未载明本法第一百一十条第三项规定的通知事项，则承运人无权援引本法第一百二十九条关于责任限额的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 113 The carrier has the right to require the shipper to make out an air waybill ; a shipper has the right to require the carrier to accept the air waybill .
Translation: 第一百一十三条　承运人有权要求托运人填写航空货运单，托运人有权要求承运人接受该航空货运单。

Query_Text_en: The failure of the shipper to produce the air waybill , the irregularity loss of the air waybill shall not affect the existence validity of the contract of transport .
Translation: 托运人未能出示航空货运单、航空货运单不符合规定或者航空货运单遗失，不影响运输合同的存在或者效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 114 The air waybill shall be made out by the shipper in three original parts and be handed over to the carrier with the cargo .
Translation: 第一百一十四条 航空货运单由托运人填写，一式三份，连同货物交给承运人。

Query_Text_en: The first part of the air waybill shall be marked `` for the carrier '' and shall be signed and sealed by the shipper ; the second part shall be marked `` for the consignee '' and shall be signed and sealed by both the shipper and the carrier ; the third part shall be signed and sealed by the carrier and handed by him to the shipper after the cargo has been accepted .
Translation: 航空货运单第一联注明"交承运人"，由托运人签字或盖章；第二联注明"交收货人"，由托运人和承运人共同签字或盖章；第三联由承运人在接收货物后签字或盖章，并交付托运人。

Query_Text_en: If , at the request of the shipper , the carrier makes out the air waybill , he shall be deemed , subject to proof to the contrary , to have done so on behalf of the shipper .
Translation: 应托运人要求，承运人填开航空货运单的，在没有相反证明的情况下，应当视为代托运人办理。

Query_Text_en: 3 If the ultimate destination , the place of departure the agreed stopping place of the cargo transport is not situated within the territory of the People s Republic of China , a notice indicating the international air transport convention applicable to such transport , in case such convention requires the inclusion of the notice in the air waybill .
Translation: 3 若货物运输的最终目的地、始发地或约定经停地不在中华人民共和国境内，且相关国际航空运输公约要求将适用该运输的公约通知载入航空货运单时，则须在货运单上注明所适用的国际航空运输公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 116 In domestic air transport , if , with the consent of the carrier , cargo is carried without an air waybill having been made out , the carrier shall not be entitled to avail himself of the provisions of Article 128 of this Law concerning the limit of liability .
Translation: 第一百一十六条　在国内航空运输中，承运人同意未经出具航空货运单而载运货物的，承运人无权援用本法第一百二十八条有关赔偿责任限制的规定。

Query_Text_en: In international air transport , if , with the consent of the carrier , cargo is carried without an air waybill having been made out , if the air waybill does not include the notice required by sub-paragraph 3 of Article 115 of this Law , the carrier shall not be entitled to avail himself of the provisions of Article 129 of this Law concerning the limit of liability .
Translation: 在国际航空运输中，经承运人同意，货物未凭航空货运单而运输，或者航空货运单未载明本法第一百一十五条第三项所要求的通知的，承运人无权援用本法第一百二十九条有关责任限制的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 117 The shipper shall be responsible f the correctness of the particulars and statements relating to the cargo which he is in the air waybill .
Translation: 第一百一十七条 托运人应当对航空货运单上关于货物的说明和声明的正确性负责。

Query_Text_en: The shipper shall indemnify the carrier against all damage suffered by him , by any other person to whom the carrier is liable , by reason of the irregularity , incorrectness incompleteness of the particulars and statements in the air waybill .
Translation: 托运人须就航空运单中各项说明及陈述不合规、不正确或不完整所导致的损失，向承运人作出赔偿。该赔偿范围包括承运人自身遭受的损害，以及承运人须对第三方承担责任的任何损害。

Query_Text_en: Article 118 The air waybill shall be prima facie evidence of the conclusion of the contract of transport of cargo by air , of the conditions of transport and of the receipt of the cargo by the carrier .
Translation: 第一百一十八条 航空货运单是航空货物运输合同订立和运输条件以及承运人接收货物的初步证据。

Query_Text_en: The statements in the air waybill relating to the weight , dimensions , and packing of the cargo , as well as those relating to the number of packages , shall be prima facie evidence of the facts stated .
Translation: 空运单上关于货物重量、尺寸、包装以及件数的记载，均构成所述事实的初步证据。

Query_Text_en: Those relating to the quantity , volume , and conditions of the cargo shall not constitute evidence against the carrier except so far as they both have been and are stated in the air waybill to have been checked by him in the presence of the shipper , relate to the apparent coalition of the cargo .
Translation: 关于货物数量、体积及状况的记载，除非该等事项已在航空运单上载明并经承运人会同托运人当场查验，且仅涉及货物外观状况，否则不得作为对抗承运人的证据。

Query_Text_en: Article 119 Subject to his liability to carry out all his obligations under the contract of transport of cargo by air , the shipper shall have the right to dispose of the cargo by withdrawing them at the airport of departure destination , by stopping them in the course of the journey on any landing , by calling f them to be delivered at the place of destination , in the course of the journey to a person other than the consignee named in the air waybill , by requiring them to be returned to the airport of departure ; provided that the shipper must not exercise this right of disposition in such a way as to prejudice the carrier other shippers and he must repay any expenses occasioned by the exercise of this right .
Translation: 第一百一十九条 在不影响托运人履行航空货运合同规定之全部义务的前提下，托运人有权对货物进行处置，包括在始发地或目的地机场提回货物、在航程中经停时中止运输、要求将货物交付给非航空货运单指定收货人的其他目的地接货人，或指令将货物运回始发地机场。但托运人行使此项处置权时，不得损害承运人及其他托运人之权益，并应偿付因行使该权利所产生的一切费用。

Query_Text_en: Attempts to replace large airways have met with serious problems .
Translation: 尝试替换大尺寸气道导管面临着严峻的技术难题。

Query_Text_en: Prerequisites for a tissue-engineered replacement are a suitable matrix , cells , ideal mechanical properties , and the absence of antigenicity .
Translation: 组织工程替代物的必备条件包括：合适的基质、细胞、理想的机械性能以及无抗原性。

Query_Text_en: We aimed to bioengineer tubular tracheal matrices , using a tissue-engineering protocol , and to assess the application of this technology in a patient with end-stage airway disease .
Translation: 我们旨在通过组织工程方案，对管状气管基质进行生物工程改造，并评估该技术在终末期气道疾病患者中的应用效果。

Query_Text_en: This graft was then used to replace the recipient 's left main bronchus .
Translation: 随后，该移植物被用于替换受体的左主支气管。

Query_Text_en: The patient had no anti-donor antibodies and was not on immunosuppressive drugs .
Translation: 该患者未检出抗供体抗体，且未接受免疫抑制剂治疗。

Query_Text_en: Interpretation The results show that we can produce a cellular , tissue-engineered airway with mechanical properties that allow normal functioning , and which is free from the risks of rejection .
Translation: 研究表明，我们能够制造出具有正常生理机能所需力学性能的细胞组织工程气管，且该器官不存在排异反应风险。

Query_Text_en: The findings suggest that autologous cells combined with appropriate biomaterials might provide successful treatment for patients with serious clinical disorders .
Translation: 研究表明，将自体细胞与适宜的生物材料相结合，或可为罹患严重临床病症的患者提供有效治疗方案。

Query_Text_en: Funding Ministerio de Sanidady Consumo , Instituto de Salud Carlos III , Fondo de Investigaci n Sanitaria , Spain ; Charles Courtenay-Cowlin Fund , University of Bristol ; UK Arthritis Research Campaign ; and the James Tudor Foundation .
Translation: 资助方包括：西班牙卫生与消费部卡洛斯三世卫生研究院、卫生研究基金会；英国布里斯托大学查尔斯·考特尼-考林基金；英国关节炎研究运动组织；以及詹姆斯·都铎基金会。

Query_Text_en: Large airway defects present a major problem for clinicians because of the absence of effective methods of treatment .
Translation: 由于缺乏有效的治疗方法，大气道缺损给临床医生带来了重大难题。

Query_Text_en: Tracheal resection with primary repair is the only curative treatment in patients with several benign or malignant processes .
Translation: 气管切除一期吻合术是治疗多种良恶性病变的唯一根治性手段。

Query_Text_en: However , the resectable length is restricted to 30 % of the total length in children or 6 cm in adults ,
Translation: 然而，儿童的可切除长度限制为总长度的30%，成人则为6厘米。

Query_Text_en: and replacement of longer sections will only be feasible if a safe , functional tracheal replacement can be developed .
Translation: 唯有研发出安全且功能完备的气管替代物，才可能实现较长节段气管的置换修复。

Query_Text_en: Attempts to provide autologous or synthetic grafts for human application have been disappointing .
Translation: 为人体应用提供自体或合成移植物的尝试结果令人失望。

Query_Text_en: Tissue bioengineering already has provided functional human organ replacements elsewhere .
Translation: 组织生物工程已在其他领域成功实现功能性人体器官替代。

Query_Text_en: Previous preclinical airway experiments have been too lengthy and complex for routine clinical application , or relied on non-biological matrices .
Translation: 既往的呼吸道临床前实验或因耗时过长、流程复杂而难以常规应用于临床，或依赖于非生物基质材料。

Query_Text_en: We have used mouse and pig models to develop a streamlined process in which autologous epithelial and mesenchymal stem-cell-derived chondrocytes are seeded onto a decellularised donor tracheal scaff old and matured in a novel bioreactor system .
Translation: 我们利用小鼠和猪模型开发了一套高效流程：将自体上皮细胞与间充质干细胞分化的软骨细胞接种于脱细胞处理的供体气管支架上，并在新型生物反应器系统中完成成熟培养。

Query_Text_en: Encouraged by the in-vitro generation of short but vital tracheal matrices and by the absence of an immunological response to allografted and xenografted tracheal constructs in animals , we aimed to bioengineer tubular tracheal matrices longer than 6 cm , and to assess the application of this technology in a patient with end-stage airway disease .
Translation: 受体外成功培育出短小但具有关键功能的气管基质，以及动物实验中对同种异体和异种气管移植物未出现免疫排斥反应的鼓舞，我们致力于开发生物工程化气管基质管，其长度超过6厘米，并评估该技术应用于终末期气道疾病患者的临床效果。

Query_Text_en: A CT scan showed a circumferential , near-occlusive 3 cm airway stenosis starting 2 cm subglottically , and a hypoplastic left main bronchus with expiratory collapse .
Translation: CT扫描显示：声门下2厘米处开始出现环周性、近乎闭塞的3厘米气道狭窄，同时左主支气管发育不良伴呼气性塌陷。

Query_Text_en: The mycobacterial infection was successfully treated over the next 6 months but severe dyspnoea persisted .
Translation: 该分枝杆菌感染在随后6个月内得到成功治疗，但严重呼吸困难症状持续存在。

Query_Text_en: Subsequently , the tracheal stenosis was successfully treated with a subglottic resection with primary end-to-end anastomosis , followed by placement of a Dumon stent in the patient 's left main bronchus .
Translation: 随后，通过声门下切除并行端端吻合术成功治疗了气管狭窄，并在患者左主支气管内放置了杜蒙支架。

Query_Text_en: The stent was poorly tolerated and , despite multiple endoscopic toilet , replacement or repositioning procedures , recurrent episode of pneumonitis in her left lower lobe , untreatable cough , and mucous retention occurred ; therefore , we removed the stent .
Translation: 患者对该支架耐受性差，虽经多次内镜下清理、更换及复位操作，仍反复出现左下叶肺炎、顽固性咳嗽及黏液潴留，故予以移除。

Query_Text_en: We did virtual endoscopy using volume-rendering CT [ figure 1A and 1B ] to confirm a normal cervical airway but there was a substantial reduction in the calibre of the left main bronchus [ residual diameter of 4 mm ] , a fixed stenosis [ maximal 1.2 cm from carina ] , cranial dislocation with compression by the aorta , and complete expiratory collapse .
Translation: 我们采用容积重建CT（图1A、1B）进行虚拟内镜检查，结果显示患者颈部气道正常，但左主支气管管径显著缩窄（残余直径4毫米），存在固定性狭窄（距隆突最大1.2厘米），同时伴有主动脉压迫导致的头端移位及呼气相完全塌陷。

Query_Text_en: At this point , the only conventional option remaining was left carinal total pneumonectomy , since the cranial dislocation of the affected bronchus prevented further main-sleeve resection .
Translation: 此时，唯一可行的常规手术方案是左全肺切除术，因为受累支气管向头侧移位，已无法实施进一步的支气管袖状切除术。

Query_Text_en: However , such a strategy can result in high mortality rates , and perioperative and long-term morbidity .
Translation: 然而，这种策略可能导致高死亡率，以及围手术期和长期并发症。

Query_Text_en: In case further salvage was needed thereafter , we counselled that it would not preclude subsequent carinal pneumonectomy .
Translation: 若此后仍需进一步挽救性治疗，我们建议这并不妨碍后续实施隆突切除术。

Query_Text_en: Patients provided written informed consent .
Translation: 患者均已签署书面知情同意书。

Query_Text_en: A 7 cm tracheal segment was retrieved from a 51-year-old white female transplant donor who had died of cerebral hemorrhage [ blood type O , and negative viral , treponemal , and - human chorionic gonadotropin serology ] .
Translation: 从一名因脑出血死亡的51岁白人女性移植供体（O型血，病毒、梅毒螺旋体及人绒毛膜促性腺激素血清学检测均为阴性）中获取了一段7厘米长的气管节段。

Query_Text_en: All loose connective tissue was removed , and the trachea rinsed in phosphate buffered saline [ PBS ] containing 1 % penicillin , 1 % streptomycin , and 1 % amphotericin B [ all Sigma , Barcelona , Spain ] .
Translation: 清除所有疏松结缔组织后，将气管置于含1%青霉素、1%链霉素及1%两性霉素B（均为西班牙巴塞罗那Sigma公司产品）的磷酸盐缓冲液中冲洗。

Query_Text_en: We verified the presence of cellular elements and MHC-positive cells histologically after each cycle .
Translation: 经组织学检测，每个周期后均确认存在细胞成分及MHC阳性细胞。

Query_Text_en: After we allowed for the periodic removal of sections for histology , a final graft length of 6.5 cm was obtained , which was reduced to 5 cm intraoperatively to fit the defect .
Translation: 在预留周期性组织切片检测所需样本后，最终获取的移植物长度为6.5厘米，术中根据缺损部位实际尺寸调整为5厘米。

Query_Text_en: For negative controls , we omitted the primary antibody .
Translation: 作为阴性对照，我们未使用一抗。

Query_Text_en: We subjected cellular brushings from the external surface of the seeded matrix preimplantation and from the graft lumen 4 days postoperatively to triple-colour immunofluorescence , with a mouse anti-human monoclonal antibody to collagen II [ Abcam ] to confirm the presence of chondrocytes , an anti-human monoclonal antibody to cytokeratins 5 and 8 [ BD Biosciences ] to identify epithelial cells , and stained for nuclear DNA with DAPI .
Translation: 我们在植入前对基质种子层外表面细胞刷取物、术后4天对移植物管腔细胞刷取物进行三色免疫荧光检测：使用小鼠抗人II型胶原单克隆抗体[Abcam]确认软骨细胞存在，采用抗人细胞角蛋白5和8单克隆抗体[BD Biosciences]识别上皮细胞，并以DAPI进行细胞核DNA染色。

Query_Text_en: Since bronchial epithelial cells grew far more readily than did nasal cells , we used only the bronchial cells subsequently for graft development .
Translation: 由于支气管上皮细胞比鼻腔细胞更易培养，后续移植体开发仅采用支气管细胞。

Query_Text_en: Biopsy samples were transported in ice-cold PBS containing penicillin [ 100 U\/mL ] and streptomycin [ 100 g\/mL ] [ both Sigma-Aldrich , Dorset , UK ] .
Translation: 活检样本被置于含有青霉素[100 U/mL]和链霉素[100 μg/mL]的冰镇PBS溶液[两者均购自英国多塞特Sigma-Aldrich公司]中进行运输。

Query_Text_en: We placed the samples in 70 % ethanol for 30 s and then in a solution containing 5 mL 1 % trypsin [ Sigma-Aldrich ] , 15 mL PBS , and 800 L penicillin and streptomycin in a centrifuge tube overnight at 4 C.
Translation: 将样本置于70%乙醇中浸泡30秒，随后转入离心管，加入含5毫升1%胰蛋白酶（Sigma-Aldrich）、15毫升PBS及800微升青霉素-链霉素的混合溶液，于4℃条件下静置过夜。

Query_Text_en: At 24 h , we warmed the tissue to 37 C for 45 min and then disrupted it by repeated vigorous pipetting with a plugged glass pasteur pipette .
Translation: 24小时后，我们将组织升温至37℃并保持45分钟，随后使用带塞玻璃巴斯德吸管通过反复强力吹打使其解离。

Query_Text_en: We neutralised the trypsin solution with complete medium [ Dulbecco 's modified Eagle medium [ DMEM ] , Invitrogen , Paisley , UK ] , containing 10 % fetal calf serum [ PAA , Yeovil , UK ] , penicillin [ 100 U\/mL ] , and streptomycin [ 100 g\/mL ] .
Translation: 我们用完全培养基中和了胰蛋白酶溶液，该培养基为杜尔贝科改良伊格尔培养基（DMEM，购自英国佩斯利Invitrogen公司），其中含有10%胎牛血清（购自英国Yoevil的PAA公司）、青霉素（100 U/mL）以及链霉素（100 μg/mL）。

Query_Text_en: We changed the culture medium every 5 days .
Translation: 我们每5天更换一次培养基。

Query_Text_en: We subjected cytospins of cultured autologous recipient epithelial cells at first passage to dual-colour immunofluorescence histology for cytokeratins 5 and 8 as above , counterstained with DAPI to confirm epithelial phenotype before attachment to the matrix in the bioreactor .
Translation: 我们对培养的自体受体上皮细胞第一代样本进行细胞离心涂片，采用上述针对细胞角蛋白5和8的双色免疫荧光组织学检测，并以DAPI复染确认其在生物反应器内基质附着前仍保持上皮表型特征。

Query_Text_en: We prepared chondrocytes as previously described .
Translation: 我们按照前述方法制备软骨细胞。

Query_Text_en: We added each 10 mL volume of bone-marrow aspirate , taken on the day of culture , to 40 mL of complete medium [ DMEM , containing 1000 mg L-glucose , Sigma-Aldrich ] , 10 % fetal bovine serum [ Autogen Bioclear , Wilts , UK ] , 100 U\/mL penicillin , 100 g\/mL streptomycin , and 2 mmol\/L GlutaMax-I [ Invitrogen ] in a centrifuge tube .
Translation: 在离心管中，我们向40毫升完全培养基[DMEM，含1000毫克/升L-葡萄糖（Sigma-Aldrich提供）]中添加了10毫升骨髓抽吸物（取材于培养当天），该培养基成分为：10%胎牛血清[Autogen Bioclear，英国威尔特郡]、100单位/毫升青霉素、100微克/毫升链霉素以及2毫摩尔/升GlutaMax-I[Invitrogen]。

Query_Text_en: After centrifugation of the cells for 5 min at 600 g , we removed the fat layer and supernatant , and resuspended the cell pellet containing mesenchymal stem cells in 20 mL of complete medium .
Translation: 以600g离心细胞5分钟后，去除脂肪层与上清液，将含有间充质干细胞的细胞沉淀重悬于20毫升完全培养基中。

Query_Text_en: We incubated the cells undisturbed at 37 C in a humidified 5 % CO2 atmosphere for 72 h for promotion of adherence , and replaced the medium with fresh complete medium containing basic fibroblast growth factor every 3 days .
Translation: 将细胞置于37℃、5%二氧化碳的湿润培养环境中静置培养72小时以促进贴壁，此后每3天更换一次含碱性成纤维细胞生长因子的新鲜完全培养基。

Query_Text_en: When cells reached 90 % confluence , we removed the medium and washed the cells once with Hanks ' balanced salt solution and then passaged them with 0.25 % trypsin-EDTA [ edetic acid , Invitrogen ] .
Translation: 当细胞融合度达到90%时，移除培养基，用汉克斯平衡盐溶液洗涤细胞一次，随后使用0.25%胰蛋白酶-EDTA溶液（乙二胺四乙酸，Invitrogen公司）进行传代培养。

Query_Text_en: At each passage , we seeded the cells at a density of 1 106 per mL .
Translation: 在每次传代时，我们将细胞以每毫升1×10⁶的密度接种。

Query_Text_en: To induce chondrocyte differentiation , we changed the culture medium to complete medium containing 10 ng\/mL of recombinant human transforming growth factor - 3 [ RandD Systems , Abingdon , UK ] , 10 nmol\/L recombinant parathyroid hormone-related peptide [ PeproTech ] , 100 nmol\/L dexamethasone , and 10 g\/mL insulin [ both Sigma-Aldrich , Dorset , UK ] , and incubated the cells for 72 h.
Translation: 为诱导软骨细胞分化，我们将培养基更换为含10纳克/毫升重组人转化生长因子-3[英国阿宾顿RandD Systems]、10纳摩尔/升重组甲状旁腺激素相关肽[PeproTech]、100纳摩尔/升地塞米松及10微克/毫升胰岛素[两者均来自英国多塞特Sigma-Aldrich]的完全培养基，随后将细胞培养72小时。

Query_Text_en: No fibroblasts could be detected in the chondrocyte culture before seeding .
Translation: 接种前，软骨细胞培养物中未检测到成纤维细胞。

Query_Text_en: For the present application , we designed a novel bioreactor to simultaneously address the requirements of seeding and culturing of different cell types on either side of a tubular matrix ; nutrient supply and waste removal ; biomechanical cues in the form of hydrodynamic shear stress ; and autoclavability , ease of sterile handling , reliability , and precision compatible with good laboratory practice .
Translation: 针对当前应用需求，我们设计了一种新型生物反应器，可同步满足以下要求：在管状基质两侧分别接种和培养不同细胞类型；实现营养供给与废物清除；提供流体剪切应力形式的生物力学刺激；同时具备可高压灭菌、无菌操作便捷、运行可靠、精度符合实验室规范等特性。

Query_Text_en: The device rotated the airway construct around its longitudinal axis in culture medium tailored to the requirements of both cell-types , moving cells alternately between liquid [ medium ] and gaseous [ air ] phases [ 1.0-1 .5 revolutions per min ; figure 2 ] .
Translation: 该装置在专为两种细胞类型需求配制的培养基中，沿气道构建物的纵轴进行旋转（转速为每分钟1.0-1.5转；见图2），使细胞在液相[培养基]与气相[空气]环境之间交替移动。

Query_Text_en: A polysulphone chamber housed the medium and construct , which was rotated by a subsystem-controlled DC motor isolated from the culture chamber .
Translation: 培养液和构建物置于聚砜培养室内，该培养室由与培养环境隔离的子系统控制直流电机驱动旋转。

Query_Text_en: Secondary elements induced continuous mixing of the culture medium to increase oxygenation , and the exchange of nutrients and catabolites to and from the adhering cells .
Translation: 次级效应促使培养基持续混合，以增强氧合作用，并促进营养物质与代谢产物在贴壁细胞间的交换。

Query_Text_en: We seeded the recipient 's cultured cells onto the matrix within the bioreactor .
Translation: 我们将受体的培养细胞接种至生物反应器内的基质上。

Query_Text_en: Every 30 min , we rotated the matrix 90 degrees until all surfaces had been completely exposed to cells .
Translation: 我们每30分钟将基质旋转90度，直至所有表面均充分接触细胞。

Query_Text_en: We changed the external medium [ chondrocytes ] every 48 h and internal medium [ epithelial cells ] every 24 h , and tested the extracted medium for microbial colonisation .
Translation: 我们每48小时更换一次外部培养基[软骨细胞]，每24小时更换一次内部培养基[上皮细胞]，并对提取的培养基进行微生物定植检测。

Query_Text_en: The total period of bioreactor culture was 96 h.
Translation: 生物反应器培养总时长为96小时。

Query_Text_en: We monitored the recipient for 2 days in the intensive care unit , when she was well enough to return to a general ward and was discharged on the tenth postoperative day .
Translation: 患者在重症监护病房接受了两天密切监测，待病情稳定后转入普通病房，并于术后第十天康复出院。

Query_Text_en: Ethical permission was obtained from the Spanish Transplantation Authority and the Ethics Committee of the Hospital Clinic , Barcelona .
Translation: 本研究已获得西班牙移植管理局及巴塞罗那医院诊所伦理委员会的伦理许可。

Query_Text_en: We took brushings at 4 days and prepared cytospins as above .
Translation: 我们在第4天采集了刷检样本，并按照上述方法制备了细胞离心涂片。

Query_Text_en: We screened recipient anti-donor HLA antibody production and specificity using the National Institutes of Health version of the complement-dependent cytotoxic test , against a panel of 64 cell lines and by solid-phase antigen test FlowPRA class I and class II screening beads [ One Lambda , Canoga Park , CA , USA ] .
Translation: 我们采用美国国立卫生研究院改良版补体依赖性细胞毒试验，通过64种细胞系组合及固相抗原检测FlowPRA I/II类筛查微珠（美国加州卡诺加帕克One Lambda公司），对受者抗供者HLA抗体产生情况及特异性进行了筛查。

Query_Text_en: Tests were done preoperatively , and at 14 days , 1 month , and 2 months postoperatively .
Translation: 术前及术后14天、1个月和2个月分别进行检测。

Query_Text_en: The sponsor of the study had no role in study design , data collection , data analysis , data interpretation , or writing of the report .
Translation: 本研究资助方未参与研究设计、数据收集、数据分析、数据解读及报告撰写工作。

Query_Text_en: The corresponding author had full access to all the data in the study and had final responsibility for the decision to submit for publication .
Translation: 通讯作者可获取研究中的所有数据，并对决定投稿发表负有最终责任。

Query_Text_en: 25 cycles [ figure 3 , parts C to F ] were needed to completely remove HLA-A , HLA-B , and HLA-C antigen expression , although low amounts of focal MHC class II expression were still seen in a few areas .
Translation: 需要25个循环[图3，C至F部分]才能完全消除HLA-A、HLA-B和HLA-C抗原的表达，但在少数区域仍可见微量局灶性MHC II类分子表达。

Query_Text_en: The recipient had no complications from the operation and was discharged from hospital on the tenth post operative day .
Translation: 受赠者术后未出现并发症，于术后第十天出院。

Query_Text_en: She has remained well since , and is able to walk up two flights of stairs , walk 500 m without stopping , and care for her children .
Translation: 此后她身体状况一直良好，能步行上两层楼梯、不间断行走500米，并能照料子女。

Query_Text_en: Lung-function tests done at 2 months were all within the normal range for age and sex [ table ] .
Translation: 2个月时进行的肺功能检测结果均处于同年龄段及性别的正常范围内[表]。

Query_Text_en: Serological examination showed the complete absence of anti-donor HLA antibodies at 14 days , 1 month , and 2 months .
Translation: 血清学检测显示，术后14天、1个月及2个月均未检出抗供体HLA抗体。

Query_Text_en: At 4 days , the graft was almost indistinguishable from adjacent normal bronchial mucosa .
Translation: 移植后第四天，移植物与邻近正常支气管黏膜几乎难以区分。

Query_Text_en: Laser-doppler readings confirmed a rich adjacent microvascular bed .
Translation: 激光多普勒读数证实邻近区域存在丰富的微血管床。

Query_Text_en: At 14 days , there was an adherent layer of mucus on the graft surface in which no inflammatory cells were detected cytologically .
Translation: 术后第14天，移植物表面形成一层粘附性黏液层，细胞学检测未发现炎症细胞。

Query_Text_en: At 14 days , 1 month , 2 months , and 3 months , the graft seemed healthy with a strong laser-doppler recording [ at 2 months : 6.0 mL per min for graft , 5.8 mL per min for right bronchus ] .
Translation: 术后14天、1个月、2个月及3个月时，移植物状态良好，激光多普勒检测显示血流充沛（2个月数据：移植物每分钟6.0毫升，右支气管每分钟5.8毫升）。

Query_Text_en: At 1 month , the appearance of the graft was indistinguishable from native trachea , and local mucosal bleeding was elicited when the biopsy sample was taken , indicating successful revascularisation .
Translation: 术后1个月时，移植部位外观与原生气管无异，活检取样时局部黏膜出现出血现象，表明血管重建成功。

Query_Text_en: Three-dimensional CT-reconstructions preoperatively and at 1 month postoperatively showed a transformation in the appearance of the airway from near-total collapse to wide patency [ figure 1C and 1D ] .
Translation: 术前及术后1个月的三维CT重建显示，患者气道形态由近乎完全塌陷转变为完全通畅（图1C、1D）。

Query_Text_en: Viable chondrocytes were also seen in these brushings .
Translation: 这些刮取物中也可见到活性软骨细胞。

Query_Text_en: Similar cytospins were prepared from the external surface of the graft before implantation , and both cell types were found to be present [ figure 4 ] .
Translation: 移植物植入前，其外表面也制备了类似的细胞离心涂片，结果显示两种细胞类型均存在（图4）。

Query_Text_en: With this protocol we removed HLA antigens from a donor matrix , which was then readily colonised by the recipient 's epithelial cells and chondrogenic mesenchymal stem cells .
Translation: 通过该方案，我们成功去除了供体基质中的人类白细胞抗原（HLA），使受体上皮细胞和软骨间充质干细胞得以顺利定植。

Query_Text_en: This matrix was used to prepare and transplant an airway graft for a patient with left main bronchus malacia , resulting in a patent airway and an improved quality of life .
Translation: 该基质被用于制备并移植至一名左主支气管软化症患者的气道移植物，术后患者气道畅通，生活质量显著改善。

Query_Text_en: By contrast with solid organ transplants , which take place in sterile mesenchymal environments , the airway represents an interface between internal and external environment .
Translation: 与在无菌间质环境中进行的实体器官移植不同，气道是连接人体内外环境的交界界面。

Query_Text_en: Unsurprisingly , the airway mucosa has immunologically active cells playing a key part in airway transplantation , and these contribute to acute allograft rejection , which requires high-dose immunosuppression .
Translation: 不出所料，气道黏膜中的免疫活性细胞在气道移植中起着关键作用，这些细胞会导致急性同种异体移植排斥反应，因而需要大剂量免疫抑制治疗。

Query_Text_en: Unlike other transplants , airway replacement is rarely a life-saving procedure , so a completely non-immunogenic tracheal allograft with preserved functional and mechanical characteristics is the minimum target for organ replacement .
Translation: 与其他移植手术不同，气道置换术通常不属于挽救生命的治疗手段，因此构建具有完整功能特性和机械特性的完全非免疫原性气管同种移植物，是器官置换研究的最低目标。

Query_Text_en: The extracellular matrix plays an active part in regulating diverse aspects of cell biology that are essential to the normal function of tissues .
Translation: 细胞外基质在调控细胞生物学的多个方面发挥着积极作用，这些方面对组织的正常功能至关重要。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , recent bioengineering studies have focused on the application of extracellular matrix-derived prosthetic materials as bioactive supports .
Translation: 因此，近期生物工程研究聚焦于应用细胞外基质衍生修复材料作为生物活性支架。

Query_Text_en: Scaff olds derived from decellularised tissues have been shown to support in-vitro adhesion , growth , and function of several cell types , and have been used successfully in animals and man , and act as a template for ingrowth and remodelling .
Translation: 经脱细胞处理的组织支架已被证实能支持多种细胞类型的体外黏附、增殖及功能表达，成功应用于动物和人体实验，并可作为组织长入与重塑的模板。

Query_Text_en: A major potential problem with bioengineered organs is the provision of a functional blood supply .
Translation: 生物工程器官面临的一个主要潜在问题在于功能性血液供应的保障。

Query_Text_en: In this study , laser-doppler measurements showed a healthy , adjacent microvascular bed from postoperative day 4 and active mucosal bleeding at 30 days .
Translation: 本研究中，激光多普勒测量显示术后第4天邻近微血管床状态良好，至30天时仍存在活跃的黏膜出血现象。

Query_Text_en: Although not studied , we have shown that angiogenic cytokines [ basic fibroblast growth factor , transforming growth factor 8 ] might be present within decellularised matrices , and postulated that similar expression will contribute to timely revascularisation .
Translation: 尽管尚未深入研究，但我们已证实脱细胞基质中可能存在血管生成细胞因子[碱性成纤维细胞生长因子、转化生长因子8]，并推测此类因子的类似表达将促进血管的及时再生。

Query_Text_en: 25 cycles of detergent enzymatic method completely removed cell membranes , all MHC class I and virtually all MHC class II expressions , but retained some other cellular elements in cartilaginous areas .
Translation: 经过25次去垢酶解法处理，细胞膜结构被完全清除，主要组织相容性复合体I类分子全部去除，II类分子表达也基本消除，但软骨区域仍保留部分其他细胞成分。

Query_Text_en: Conversely , the possibility is that cellular residues could express minor antigens capable of inducing a chronic rejection response .
Translation: 反之，细胞残留物可能表达次要抗原，从而诱发慢性排斥反应。

Query_Text_en: However , minor antigens play a restricted part in clinical transplantation and here there was no sign of inflammation or anti-donor antibodies at 2 months .
Translation: 然而，次要抗原在临床移植中作用有限，且该病例术后两个月未出现炎症反应或抗供体抗体迹象。

Query_Text_en: However , with a reduced detergent enzymatic method time , nasal cells might be preferred for future airway tissue-engineering applications .
Translation: 然而，随着酶解法处理时间的缩短，鼻腔细胞有望成为未来气道组织工程应用的首选材料。

Query_Text_en: Although the graft was completely covered with viable mucosa at 1 month , we can not say whether these cells originated from those seeded or whether they grew in from an adjacent healthy airway .
Translation: 尽管移植片在一个月内已被完全存活的黏膜覆盖，但我们无法确定这些细胞是源于植入的种子细胞，还是由邻近健康气道生长而来。

Query_Text_en: Although animal studies have provided circumstantial evidence that the implanted cells are likely to contribute in an important way , further research into the fate of these cells is essential before embarking on full clinical trials with the present protocol .
Translation: 尽管动物研究提供的间接证据表明，植入细胞可能发挥重要作用，但在采用现行方案开展全面临床试验之前，必须进一步研究这些细胞的最终去向。

Query_Text_en: In vitro , epithelial cells and chondrocytes became deeply embedded within the matrix by 24 h. This finding suggests that the matrix is highly permissive and an ideal immediate environment for these cells .
Translation: 体外实验显示，24小时内上皮细胞与软骨细胞已深度嵌入基质。这一结果表明该基质具有高度通透性，能为上述细胞提供理想的即时生长环境。

Query_Text_en: In fact , after 24 h in the bioreactor , no cells [ alive or dead ] could be detected in the culture medium , suggesting a near 100 % adherence .
Translation: 事实上，生物反应器运行24小时后，培养基中未检测到任何活细胞或死细胞，表明细胞贴壁率接近100%。

Query_Text_en: The presence of clearly viable epithelial cells and chondrocytes on the graft surface at 4 days confirms this view , and shows that the cells continue to function in vivo .
Translation: 移植后第4天，移植物表面存在明显存活的表皮细胞和软骨细胞，这一现象证实了上述观点，并表明这些细胞在体内仍保持正常功能。

Query_Text_en: Both types of cells could be seen in cytological samples from both surfaces of the conduit , despite clear structural separation of the two bioreactor compartments .
Translation: 尽管两个生物反应器舱室结构分明，但在导管两侧的细胞学样本中均可观察到这两种细胞类型。

Query_Text_en: If confirmed , this interpretation is important , with implications for future tissue-engineering designs .
Translation: 若该解读得到证实，将具有重要意义，并对未来组织工程设计方案产生深远影响。

Query_Text_en: Zani has shown in animals that an ordered architectural association between different cell types is not necessary for functional healing .
Translation: 扎尼通过动物实验证明，不同细胞类型之间有序的结构关联并非功能性愈合的必要条件。

Query_Text_en: Our findings extend this observation to man .
Translation: 我们的研究将这一发现延伸至人类。

Query_Text_en: We wished to minimize trauma to both the patient and the graft , and so have restricted cellular analysis to the cytology before and 4 days postimplantation , at which times bronchoscopy was clinically indicated in any case .
Translation: 我们希望将对患者和移植组织的损伤降至最低，因此将细胞学分析限制在植入前和植入后4天这两个时间点——毕竟这两个时段无论从临床角度还是支气管镜检查指征来看都是必要的。

Query_Text_en: Since our heterotopic-pig experiments showed some success with decellularised grafts in the absence of recolonisation with autologous cells , we can not quantify the contribution of these cells , nor exclude the possibility that the addition of cells is , in fact , unnecessary .
Translation: 由于我们在异位猪实验中观察到，即便未使用自体细胞进行再植，脱细胞移植物仍取得了一定成效，因此我们既无法量化这些细胞的具体作用，也无法排除添加细胞可能实属多余的情况。

Query_Text_en: However , the rapid integration seen in our study is consistent with animal models in which cells seem to play a crucial part .
Translation: 然而，本研究中观察到的快速整合现象与动物模型研究结果一致，这些模型显示细胞在此过程中发挥着关键作用。

Query_Text_en: Major challenges in functional airway bioengineering are uniform and highly efficient cell seeding on both the outer and inner surface of the three-dimensional tubular matrix , co-culturing different cell types , and optimum mass transport between the culture medium and the growing tissues .
Translation: 功能性气道生物工程面临的主要挑战包括：在三维管状基质内外表面实现均匀高效的双面细胞接种、不同细胞类型的共培养，以及培养基与生长组织间的最优化物质传输。

Query_Text_en: To address these issues , we developed a novel bioreactor suitable for in-vitro engineering of long airway grafts .
Translation: 为解决上述问题，我们研发出一款适用于长段气道移植物体外构建的新型生物反应器。

Query_Text_en: Viability of cells in both compartments was maintained to the point of operation .
Translation: 两个隔室中的细胞活性均维持至手术时点。

Query_Text_en: The dynamic culture environment in our bioreactor , controllable and reproducible , is essential for the nutrient supply and waste removal needed to sustain large three-dimensional constructs .
Translation: 我们生物反应器中动态可控、稳定重现的培养环境，对于维持大型三维构建体所需的营养供给与代谢废物清除至关重要。

Query_Text_en: The rotation provides the hydrodynamic shear stress necessary to promote metabolic activity and proper differentiation of the seeded cells .
Translation: 旋转产生的流体剪切应力可促进接种细胞的代谢活动与正常分化。

Query_Text_en: Despite the larger number of detergent-enzymatic method cycles used in the clinical setting than that used in preclinical work , and the known structural differences between pig and human trachea , the similarity to native trachea in terms of tissue handling and elasticity , both preoperatively and postoperatively , was remarkable and commensurate with the biomechanical results of preclinical studies .
Translation: 尽管临床应用中采用的去垢酶解法循环次数多于临床前研究，且猪与人类气管存在已知的结构差异，但该材料在术前术后组织操作性和弹性方面与天然气管高度相似，这一特性与临床前研究的生物力学结果相符。

Query_Text_en: The elasticity of the trachealis segment in particular allows adjustment of lumen size to the recipient 's bronchus .
Translation: 气管肌段的弹性尤其有助于调节管腔尺寸，使之与受体支气管相匹配。

Query_Text_en: Before a full clinical trial is done , a follow-up for longer than 6 months would be helpful .
Translation: 在开展全面临床试验之前，进行超过6个月的随访将大有裨益。

Query_Text_en: In particular , we wish to assess the long-term retention of biomechanical properties , and whether new chondrogenesis [ or osteogenesis ] from the seeded chondrocytes occurs .
Translation: 我们尤其希望评估其生物力学特性的长期留存情况，以及接种的软骨细胞是否会产生新的软骨[或骨]生成。

Query_Text_en: However , the early functioning of graft and patient are excellent and we feel that substantial complications or long-term restenosis is unlikely , particularly in the presence of a new blood supply as above .
Translation: 然而，移植血管与患者早期功能状态良好，我们认为出现严重并发症或远期再狭窄的可能性较低，尤其是在上述新生血供形成的情况下。

Query_Text_en: In clinical transplantation , the development of anti-donor antibodies , in which these complications have not occurred by 2 months , is very rare so we do not now expect to see any signs of rejection .
Translation: 在临床移植中，若两个月内未出现上述并发症，则产生抗供体抗体的情况极为罕见，因此目前我们预计不会观察到任何排斥反应迹象。

Query_Text_en: In this paper , we have described an innovative method for tissue-engineered large airway replacement in a person , resulting in a substantially improved quality of life .
Translation: 本文阐述了一种用于人体组织工程化大气道置换的创新方法，该方法显著提升了患者的生活质量。

Query_Text_en: The results show that a cellular , tissue-engineered airway can be produced with mechanical properties that allow normal functioning , and which is free from the risks of rejection .
Translation: 研究结果表明，通过组织工程技术构建的细胞化人工气道具备正常生理功能所需的力学特性，且能完全规避排异反应风险。

Query_Text_en: This patient provides new evidence that autologous cells combined with appropriate biomaterials might provide , in future , successful functional solutions for serious clinical disorders .
Translation: 该病例提供了新证据，表明自体细胞与适宜生物材料结合，未来或可为严重临床病症提供有效的功能性治疗方案。

Query_Text_en: The first international asthma guidelines meeting was held in Toronto almost 20 years ago and the consensus conclusions from this meeting were published the following year .
Translation: 首届国际哮喘指南会议于近20年前在多伦多召开，其共识结论于次年正式发布。

Query_Text_en: Since then , many national and inter - national groups have developed asthma guidelines as evidence-based documents .
Translation: 此后，多个国家和国际组织相继制定了循证性哮喘诊疗指南。

Query_Text_en: This common failure to identify the target audience and intended outcomes might explain why the guidelines so often fail to meet the hopes of their authors .
Translation: 这种普遍存在的目标受众与预期效果界定不清的问题，或许正是指导方针屡屡令制定者失望的症结所在。

Query_Text_en: An early innovation of the Canadian Asthma Guidelines group was to introduce the concept of asthma control as a pragmatic outcome measure after office-based treatment and as a decision-making tool , which suggests a strategic approach to asthma management that has since been widely incorporated , clarified , and refined by subsequent guideline documents .
Translation: 加拿大哮喘指南工作组的一项早期创新，是引入哮喘控制概念作为门诊治疗后的实效性疗效指标和决策工具。这一理念提出了一种哮喘管理的策略性方法，后续指南文件对其进行了广泛采纳、明确阐释和细化完善。

Query_Text_en: Despite widespread adoption by academic specialists , translating this consensus knowledge into improved practice patterns and outcomes has been unsuccessful .
Translation: 尽管学术专家普遍采纳了这一共识，但将其转化为改进的实践模式和成效的努力尚未取得成功。

Query_Text_en: The latest and largest study to document our failure to improve asthma control out comes in primary practice has been the Personal Practice Assessment Program , in more than 350 Canadian primary-care settings where physicians surveyed the asthma control status of more than 10 000 patients .
