Translation: 该研究已获得赫尔辛基及新地区医院外科伦理委员会的批准。

Query_Text_en: Permission was provided by the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health , Finland , to use paraffin-embedded tissue .
Translation: 芬兰社会事务与卫生部批准使用石蜡包埋组织样本。

Query_Text_en: Clinical data were extracted from the hospital records using data collection forms .
Translation: 通过数据采集表从医院记录中提取临床数据。

Query_Text_en: An effort was made to record clinical information about 50 characteristics .
Translation: 研究人员对50项临床特征进行了系统记录。

Query_Text_en: Relapse and survival data also were extracted from the files of the Finnish Cancer Registry and the hospital registries when available .
Translation: 复发与生存数据亦取自芬兰癌症登记处及医院登记系统（如有记录）。

Query_Text_en: For study inclusion , the following information was required for each patient : the date of diagnosis , age at diagnosis , information about other malignancies , post surgical primary tumor size , axillary nodal status , follow-up data , and the vital status data at the end of follow-up .
Translation: 纳入研究时，需收集每位患者的以下信息：确诊日期、确诊年龄、其他恶性肿瘤病史、术后原发肿瘤大小、腋窝淋巴结状态、随访数据以及随访截止时的生存状态数据。

Query_Text_en: This information was available in 2656 [ 91 % ] of the 2930 eligible patients .
Translation: 在2930名符合资格的患者中，有2656人（占比91%）提供了该信息。

Query_Text_en: The proportion of patients varied from 79 % in southwestern Finland to 97 % in eastern Finland .
Translation: 芬兰各地患者比例存在差异，西南地区为79%，东部地区则高达97%。

Query_Text_en: We also included 186 patients who fulfilled the inclusion criteria but who were not identified in the original computer search because the place of residence was outside the specified regions .
Translation: 我们还纳入了186名符合入选标准但未被原始计算机检索识别的患者，因其居住地不在指定区域内。

Query_Text_en: Thus , the total number of patients entered into the database was 2842 [ data available at http://www.finprog.org ] .
Translation: 因此，录入数据库的患者总数达2842例[数据详见http://www.finprog.org]。

Query_Text_en: We excluded patients for the following reasons [ a single patient may have been excluded for more than one reason ] : having lobular [ n = 17 ] or ductal [ n = 186 ] carcinoma in situ ; having distant metastases at diagnosis [ n = 136 ] ; having synchronous or meta-chronous bilateral breast cancer [ n = 261 ] or other malignancy [ except for basal cell carcinoma or cervical carcinoma in situ , n = 235 ] ; and not having underwent breast surgery [ n = 42 ] .
Translation: 我们基于以下原因排除患者[单个患者可能因多重原因被排除]：存在小叶原位癌[n=17]或导管原位癌[n=186]；确诊时已发生远处转移[n=136]；存在同步或异时性双侧乳腺癌[n=261]或其他恶性肿瘤[基底细胞癌或宫颈原位癌除外，n=235]；以及未接受乳腺手术[n=42]。

Query_Text_en: We excluded women [ n = 49 ] in which the method of cancer detection was not known from the remaining 2032 patients , which left a total of 1983 women with unilateral invasive breast carcinoma .
Translation: 我们从剩余的2032名患者中排除了49例癌症检测方法不明的女性病例，最终纳入1983名单侧浸润性乳腺癌女性患者。

Query_Text_en: The method of cancerous tumor detection was based on the hospital case record data .
Translation: 该癌症肿瘤检测方法基于医院病历数据。

Query_Text_en: According to this source , 443 [ 22 % ] of the 1983 women were diagnosed based on tumors detected by mammography screening ; 3 [ 0.7 % ] among patients aged 39 years or younger ; 48 [ 10.8 % ] among patients aged 40 to 49 years ; 277 [ 62.5 % ] among patients aged 50 to 59 years ; 102 [ 23.0 % ] among patients aged 60 to 69 years ; and 13 [ 2.9 % ] among patients aged 70 years or older .
Translation: 据该资料显示，1983名女性患者中，443例（22%）通过乳腺X光筛查检出肿瘤后确诊。其中39岁及以下患者3例（0.7%），40至49岁患者48例（10.8%），50至59岁患者277例（62.5%），60至69岁患者102例（23.0%），70岁及以上患者13例（2.9%）。

Query_Text_en: Of the 1540 women who were diagnosed based on tumors detected outside of screening , 125 [ 8.1 % ] were among patients aged 39 years or younger ; 381 [ 24.7 % ] were among patients aged 40 to 49 years ; 247 [ 16.0 % ] among patients aged 50 to 59 years ; 291 [ 18.9 % ] among patients aged 60 to 69 years ; and 496 [ 32.2 % ] among patients aged 70 years or older .
Translation: 在1540名通过筛查外发现的肿瘤确诊的女性患者中，39岁及以下患者125例（占比8.1%），40至49岁患者381例（24.7%），50至59岁患者247例（16.0%），60至69岁患者291例（18.9%），70岁及以上患者496例（32.2%）。

Query_Text_en: To verify the correctness of the method of detection , the hospital case record data were compared with the Finnish National Registry for Cancerous Tumors Detected by Mammography Screening , which is located at the Finnish Cancer Registry .
Translation: 为验证该检测方法的准确性，医院病例记录数据与芬兰癌症登记处下设的全国乳腺筛查肿瘤登记系统进行了比对。

Query_Text_en: This registry was not complete , but 70 % of the women who were diagnosed as having cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening in the hospital case records were also identified in the Finnish registry as having cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening .
Translation: 该登记系统虽不完善，但医院病例记录中经乳腺X光筛查确诊患癌的女性，有70%在芬兰登记系统中同样被记录为乳腺X光筛查发现的癌症患者。

Query_Text_en: The nationwide mammography screening program has been active in Finland since 1987 .
Translation: 芬兰自1987年起在全国范围内推行乳腺X光筛查项目。

Query_Text_en: Because of legislation , 460 municipalities in Finland had to screen women aged 50 to 59 years during 1991 and 1992 .
Translation: 由于立法规定，芬兰460个市镇在1991至1992年间必须对50至59岁女性群体实施筛查。

Query_Text_en: However , a few of the municipalities decided also to screen other age cohorts [ 40-49 years , 60-69 years , or 70 years ] .
Translation: 然而，部分城市还决定对其他年龄段人群[40-49岁、60-69岁或70岁]开展筛查。

Query_Text_en: No other mass mammography screening took place concomitantly with these public screenings .
Translation: 这些公共筛查活动期间未同步开展其他大规模乳腺X光检查。

Query_Text_en: Screening was based either on mammography alone or mammography combined with palpation and\/or ultrasound examination .
Translation: 筛查基于仅乳房X光检查或乳房X光检查结合触诊和/或超声检查。

Query_Text_en: The most common screening interval was 2 years .
Translation: 最常见的筛查间隔期为2年。

Query_Text_en: and data on the round of detection was not available in 143 women .
Translation: 143名妇女的检测轮次数据缺失。

Query_Text_en: Cancerous tumors also were detected in women [ 1 ] between mammography screenings ; [ 2 ] prior to an invitation for mammography screening was received ; [ 3 ] who were invited but did not participate in screening ; and [ 4 ] who lived in a municipality that decided not to organize mammography screening .
Translation: 在以下女性群体中也检测出了恶性肿瘤：[1]两次乳腺X光筛查间隔期间确诊的病例；[2]收到乳腺X光筛查邀请函前已患病的病例；[3]收到邀请但未参与筛查的病例；[4]所在市政当局未组织开展乳腺X光筛查项目的病例。

Query_Text_en: Fifty-nine percent of the cancerous tumors detected by screening and 71 % of the tumors detected outside of screening were treated with mastectomy and axillary dissection ; 39 % and 25 % with breast-conserving surgery and axillary dissection ; 0 % and 2 % with mastectomy without axillary dissection ; and 2 % and 2 % with lumpectomy without axillary dissection , respectively .
Translation: 通过筛查发现的癌症肿瘤中，59%接受了乳房切除术联合腋窝淋巴结清扫治疗，非筛查发现的肿瘤中这一比例为71%；39%和25%分别采用保乳手术联合腋窝淋巴结清扫；0%与2%选择单纯乳房切除术（不进行腋窝清扫）；另有2%与2%实施肿瘤切除术（不进行腋窝清扫）。

Query_Text_en: A total of 266 women received postoperative radiotherapy for cancerous tumors detected by screening [ 60 % ] and 889 women received postoperative radiotherapy for cancerous tumors detected outside of screening [ 58 % ] .
Translation: 通过筛查发现的癌变肿瘤患者中，266名女性（占比60%）接受了术后放疗；而在非筛查途径发现的癌变肿瘤患者中，889名女性（占比58%）接受了术后放疗。

Query_Text_en: In both cohorts , postoperative breast irradiation was performed in 93 % of the women following breast-conserving surgery .
Translation: 两组中均有93%的女性在保乳手术后接受了术后乳腺放疗。

Query_Text_en: Thirty-nine percent of the women with cancerous tumors detected by screening and 56 % of women whose cancerous tumors were detected outside of screening received chest wall and axillary radiotherapy following mastectomy .
Translation: 通过筛查检出癌性肿瘤的女性中，39%接受了乳房切除术后胸壁及腋窝放疗；而在筛查外检出癌性肿瘤的女性群体中，这一比例达到56%。

Query_Text_en: A total of 96 [ 22 % ] women with cancerous tumors detected by screening received systemic adjuvant therapy and 628 [ 41 % ] women with cancerous tumors detected outside of screening received systemic adjuvant therapy .
Translation: 通过筛查发现癌性肿瘤的女性中，共有96人（22%）接受了系统性辅助治疗；而在筛查之外发现癌性肿瘤的女性中，有628人（41%）接受了系统性辅助治疗。

Query_Text_en: In the age group of 50 to 69 years , adjuvant systemic therapy was given to 79 [ 21 % ] of the 374 women with cancerous tumors detected by screening and to 208 [ 39 % ] of the 531 women with cancerous tumors detected outside of screening .
Translation: 在50至69岁年龄组中，374名通过筛查检出癌性肿瘤的女性中有79人（21%）接受了辅助全身治疗，而531名通过非筛查方式检出癌性肿瘤的女性中有208人（39%）接受了该治疗。

Query_Text_en: Tamoxifen was given to 432 women , of whom 392 [ 91 % ] were older than 50 years and the combination of cyclophosphamide , methotrexate , and 5-fluorouracilwas given to 275women , of whom 237 [ 86 % ] were aged 50 years or younger .
Translation: 432名女性接受了他莫昔芬治疗，其中392人（91%）年龄超过50岁；另有275名女性接受了环磷酰胺、甲氨蝶呤和5-氟尿嘧啶联合治疗，其中237人（86%）为50岁或以下。

Query_Text_en: Eight women [ 0.4 % ] received both tamoxifen and the combination of cyclophosphamide , methotrexate , and 5-fluorouracil .
Translation: 有8名女性（占比0.4%）同时接受了他莫昔芬治疗及环磷酰胺、甲氨蝶呤与5-氟尿嘧啶联合化疗方案。

Query_Text_en: The type of adjuvant therapy received was not known in 9 women .
Translation: 9名女性接受的辅助治疗类型未予记录。

Query_Text_en: Of these , 10 had tumors detected by screening and 97 had tumors detected outside of screening .
Translation: 其中，10例肿瘤通过筛查发现，97例肿瘤在筛查之外发现。

Query_Text_en: Eighty-six [ 95 % ] of the women with node-positive tumors detected by screening and 512 [ 91 % ] of those with node-positive tumors detected outside of screening received adjuvant systemic therapy .
Translation: 通过筛查发现的淋巴结阳性肿瘤女性患者中，86例（95%）接受了辅助全身治疗；而在筛查之外发现的淋巴结阳性肿瘤女性患者中，有512例（91%）接受了辅助全身治疗。

Query_Text_en: The median follow-up survival time was 9.5 years [ range , 0.2-10 .8 years ; range 8.2-10 .8 years if 2 women who moved out of the country shortly after receiving a diagnosis are excluded ] .
Translation: 中位随访生存时间为9.5年[范围0.2-10.8年；若排除确诊后不久移居国外的2名女性患者，则范围为8.2-10.8年]。

Query_Text_en: Histological typing and evaluation of the grade components [ mitotic count , nuclear pleomorphism , and tubule formation ] was usually performed according to the World Health Organization classification system , although the criteria used in tumor classification can not be stated with certainty in retrospect .
Translation: 通常根据世界卫生组织分类系统进行组织学分型及分级评估（包括有丝分裂计数、核多形性和小管形成程度），但回顾性研究无法明确当时采用的肿瘤分类标准。

Query_Text_en: The main difference between these criteria and those published by Elston and Ellis is that the latter use semi-quantitative assessment of tubule formation and define more accurately how to perform mitotic counting .
Translation: 这些标准与埃尔斯顿和埃利斯所发布标准的主要区别在于：后者采用半定量方法评估小管形成，并更精确地界定了如何进行有丝分裂计数。

Query_Text_en: The tumors were classified into 3 histological types : ductal carcinoma [ not otherwise specified , includes apocrine , mixedmucinous , and atypical medullary types ] , lobular carcinoma [ infiltrating lobular carcinoma with variants ] , and the special histological types [ tubular , medullary , cribriform , papillary , and puremucinous carcinomas ] .
Translation: 肿瘤组织学类型分为三类：导管癌[非特殊型，包括大汗腺型、混合粘液型及非典型髓样型]、小叶癌[浸润性小叶癌及其亚型]以及特殊组织学类型[管状癌、髓样癌、筛状癌、乳头状癌及单纯粘液癌]。

Query_Text_en: More than 50 pathologists performed histological typing and grading at the time of the diagnoses .
Translation: 超过50名病理学家在诊断时进行了组织学分型和分级。

Query_Text_en: The longest primary tumor diameters were extracted from pathology reports [ 69 % ] or from surgery or mammography reports .
Translation: 最长原发肿瘤直径数据提取自病理报告[69%]、手术报告或乳腺X光检查报告。

Query_Text_en: In case of multiple invasive lesions [ n = 192 , 10 % ] , the diameter of the largest lesion was recorded .
Translation: 若存在多发性浸润性病灶（n=192，占比10%），则以最大病灶直径作为记录标准。

Query_Text_en: The status of estrogen and progesterone receptors was determined either by immunohistchemistry [ 60 % and 62 % , respectively ] or the dextrancoated charcoalmethod , and was classified as positive or negative .
Translation: 雌激素和孕激素受体状态通过免疫组化法（阳性率分别为60%与62%）或葡聚糖活性炭法测定，结果判定为阳性或阴性。

Query_Text_en: Formalin-fixed , paraffin-embedded tumor samples were used for tissue microarrays .
Translation: 采用福尔马林固定、石蜡包埋的肿瘤样本制作组织微阵列。

Query_Text_en: Representative tumor regions were first defined from sections stained with hematoxylin-eosin and marked .
Translation: 首先在苏木精-伊红染色切片上确定并标记具有代表性的肿瘤区域。

Query_Text_en: Tumor tissue array blocks were made by punching a 0.6-mmtissue cylinder through a histologically representative area of each donor tumor block , which was then inserted into an empty recipient tissue array paraffin block using a specific instrument .
Translation: 采用专用仪器从每例供体肿瘤组织蜡块中选取具有代表性的组织区域，钻取直径0.6毫米的组织柱，随后将其植入空白受体组织阵列石蜡块中，制成肿瘤组织芯片蜡块。

Query_Text_en: Each contained 50 to 144 tumor samples .
Translation: 每个样本包含50至144个肿瘤组织。

Query_Text_en: Sections of 5 m were cut and processed for immunohistochemistry and chromogen in situ hybridization .
Translation: 将样本切割为5米长片段，经免疫组织化学与显色原位杂交技术处理后进行分析。

Query_Text_en: Evaluation of the tissue array slides was aided by the use of a computer-controlled and motorized specimen stage [ EcoDrive , Marzhauser Inc , Wetzlar , Germany ] installed on a BX50 microscope [ Olympus , Tokyo , Japan ] .
Translation: 组织芯片切片的评估借助了安装在奥林巴斯BX50显微镜（日本东京）上的计算机控制电动载物台【EcoDrive，德国韦茨拉尔Marzhauser公司】完成。

Query_Text_en: For ERBB2 staining , the sections were deparaffinized , followed by antigen retrieval [ autoclave treatment at 121 C for 2 minutes in a 10-mM sodium citrate buffer with a pH of 6.0 ] .
Translation: ERBB2染色处理流程如下：切片经脱蜡处理后进行抗原修复（采用pH6.0的10mM柠檬酸钠缓冲液，121℃高压灭菌处理2分钟）。

Query_Text_en: The primary antibody [ CB11 , Novocastra Laboratories , Newcastle , England ] was diluted 1:200 in an antimouse-peroxidase polymer blocking solution [ Powervision , Immunovision Inc , Daly City , Calif ] and incubated overnight at 4 C.
Translation: 一抗[CB11，英国纽卡斯尔Novocastra实验室]以1:200比例稀释于抗鼠过氧化物酶聚合物封闭液[美国加州戴利市Immunovision公司Powervision]，并于4℃环境下孵育过夜。

Query_Text_en: The antimouse-peroxidase polymer [ Immunovision Inc ; 30minutes at room temperature ] and diaminobenzidine chromogen were used for visualization .
Translation: 使用抗鼠过氧化物酶聚合物[Immunovision公司产品，室温反应30分钟]及二氨基联苯胺显色剂进行显色反应。

Query_Text_en: The sections were counter-stained with hematoxylin and embedded .
Translation: 切片经苏木精复染后封片。

Query_Text_en: A positive and a negative control sample [ tumors with and without ERBB2 amplification in fluorescent in situ hybridization ] were included in every staining batch .
Translation: 每批次染色均设置阳性与阴性对照样本（即荧光原位杂交检测中ERBB2基因扩增与未扩增的肿瘤组织）。

Query_Text_en: Evaluation of immunohistochemistry was performed using an objective magnification of 20 .
Translation: 免疫组化评估采用20倍物镜放大倍数进行。

Query_Text_en: Only strong intensity immunostaining [ ie , 3 + ] present on the cell membrane of the majority of cancer cells was scored as positive for ERBB2 .
Translation: 仅当大多数癌细胞细胞膜上出现强强度免疫染色（即3+）时，才判定为ERBB2阳性。

Query_Text_en: The TP53 protein was immunostained with the DO7 antibody [ Novocastra Laboratories ] at a dilution of 1:500 and the MK167 protein [ Ki-67 ] using theMM-1 antibody [ Novocastra Laboratories ; dilution 1:1000 ] .
Translation: TP53蛋白采用DO7抗体[诺华实验室]按1:500稀释度进行免疫组化染色，MK167蛋白[Ki-67]则使用MM-1抗体[诺华实验室；稀释度1:1000]进行检测。

Query_Text_en: Staining forMK167 and TP53 proteins were considered positive when more than 20 % of cancer cell nuclei showed staining .
Translation: 当超过20%的癌细胞核显示染色时，MK167和TP53蛋白的染色被认为是阳性。

Query_Text_en: In brief , the microarray slides were deparaffinized and incubated in 0.1-MTris hydrochloride [ pH , 7.3 ] at 92 C for 10 minutes , followed by cooling for 20 minutes at room temperature .
Translation: 简言之，将微阵列玻片进行脱蜡处理后，置于0.1摩尔/升的Tris盐酸缓冲液（pH值7.3）中，在92℃条件下孵育10分钟，随后室温冷却20分钟。

Query_Text_en: Enzymatic digestion was performed by applying 100 L of digestion enzyme onto the slides [ Digest-All III solution , Zymed Inc , San Francisco , Calif ] .
Translation: 采用100微升消化酶溶液（Digest-All III，美国Zymed公司，加州旧金山）对载玻片样本进行酶解处理。

Query_Text_en: Following dehydration , a ready-to-use digoxigenin-labeled ERBB2 DNA probe [ Zymed Inc ] was applied on the slides .
Translation: 脱水处理后，将现成的地高辛标记ERBB2 DNA探针（Zymed公司产）滴加至载玻片。

Query_Text_en: The sections were denatured on a thermal plate and hybridization was performed overnight at 37 C.
Translation: 切片经热板变性处理后，置于37℃环境进行过夜杂交反应。

Query_Text_en: The ready-to-use digoxigenin-labeled ERBB2 probe was detected by means of sequential incubations with mouse anti-digoxigenin [ diluted 1:300 ; Roche Biochemicals , Mannheim , Germany ] , antimouse-peroxidase polymer [ Immunovision Inc ] , and diaminobenzidine chromogen .
Translation: 现成的洋地黄毒苷标记ERBB2探针通过以下步骤检测：依次与小鼠抗洋地黄毒苷抗体[1:300稀释；德国曼海姆罗氏生化]、抗小鼠过氧化物酶聚合物[Immunovision公司]及二氨基联苯胺显色剂进行孵育。

Query_Text_en: The tissue sections were lightly counterstained with hematoxylin and embedded .
Translation: 组织切片经苏木素轻度复染后包埋。

Query_Text_en: A positive and a negative control sample [ tumors with and without ERBB2 amplification in fluorescent in situ hybridization ] were included in every hybridization batch .
Translation: 每个杂交批次均包含阳性与阴性对照样本（即荧光原位杂交中ERBB2基因扩增与未扩增的肿瘤组织）。

Query_Text_en: The sections were evaluated using a 40magnification dry objective .
Translation: 各切片均采用40倍干物镜进行评估。

Query_Text_en: Amplification was defined as 6 or more signals per nucleus in more than 50 % of cancer cells or when large gene copy clusters were seen .
Translation: 扩增定义为超过50%的癌细胞中每个细胞核出现6个或更多信号，或观察到大量基因拷贝簇。

Query_Text_en: Frequency tables were analyzed using the X2 test .
Translation: 频数表采用卡方检验进行分析。

Query_Text_en: Life-tables were calculated according to the Kaplan-Meier method .
Translation: 寿命表采用卡普兰-迈耶法进行计算。

Query_Text_en: Distant disease-free survival was computed from the date of the diagnosis to occurrence of metastases outside the regional area or to death from breast cancer .
Translation: 无远处转移生存期从确诊之日起计算，至出现区域外转移或因乳腺癌死亡为止。

Query_Text_en: The log-rank test was used to compare time-to-event distributions , which were expected to be random over time .
Translation: 采用时序检验法比较事件发生时间的分布情况，预期该分布随时间推移呈随机性。

Query_Text_en: Multivariate survival analyses were performed using method of tumor detection [ mammography screening , 0 ; outside of screening , 1 ] ; grade [ well differentiated , 0 ; moderately or poorly differentiated , 1 ] ; the status of estrogen and progesterone receptors [ positive or borderline , 0 ; negative , 1 ] ; ERBB2 protein immunostaining [ negative , 0 ; positive , 1 ] ; ERBB2 amplification status [ no amplification , 0 ; amplification , 1 ] ; histological type [ lobular or special , 0 ; ductal , 1 ] ; and age at detection grouped to account for the nonlinear risk associated with age .
Translation: 采用多变量生存分析法，考察以下变量：肿瘤检出方式（乳腺筛查检出=0，非筛查检出=1）、组织学分级（高分化=0，中低分化=1）、雌激素与孕激素受体状态（阳性/临界=0，阴性=1）、ERBB2蛋白免疫组化（阴性=0，阳性=1）、ERBB2基因扩增状态（无扩增=0，有扩增=1）、组织学类型（小叶型/特殊型=0，导管型=1），并将确诊年龄分组以消除其非线性风险影响。

Query_Text_en: The tumor size in centimeters and the number of metastatic axillary lymph nodes were entered as continuous variables into the multivariatemodel .
Translation: 肿瘤大小（厘米）及腋窝转移淋巴结数量作为连续变量纳入多因素模型。

Query_Text_en: The final multivariate model was constructed using backward Cox stepwise proportional hazards regression , and a P value of .05 was adopted as the limit for inclusion of a covariate .
Translation: 最终多变量模型采用反向Cox逐步比例风险回归法构建，并将协变量纳入标准设定为P值≤0.05。

Query_Text_en: All P values are 2-sided .
Translation: 所有P值均为双侧检验。

Query_Text_en: We used Statview statistical software [ version 5.0 , SAS Institute Inc , Cary , NC ] .
Translation: 本研究采用Statview 5.0版统计软件（美国北卡罗来纳州卡里市SAS研究所出品）进行数据分析。

Query_Text_en: Cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening were most common in the age groups of 50 to 59 years and 60 to 69 years .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查检出的恶性肿瘤最常见于50至59岁及60至69岁年龄段人群。

Query_Text_en: In the age cohort of 50 to 69 years , 379 [ 41 % ] of the women were diagnosed as having breast cancer by mammography screening ; 50 to 59 years , 53 % ; and 60 to 69 years , 26 % .
Translation: 在50至69岁年龄组中，379名女性（占比41%）通过乳腺X光筛查被确诊为乳腺癌；其中50至59岁组确诊率为53%，60至69岁组确诊率为26%。

Query_Text_en: tumors of these sizes were less commonly associated with axillary lymph nodes metastases [ 21 % vs 35 % ; P [ .001 , TABLE 1 ] .
Translation: 此类大小的肿瘤较少出现腋窝淋巴结转移（21% vs 35%，P<0.001，见表1）。

Query_Text_en: Tumors detected by mammography screening were often one of the special histological types [ 13 % vs 9 % ; P = .04 ] and expressed the MK167 antigen less often [ 17 % vs 25 % ; P = .04 ] .
Translation: 乳腺X线筛查检出的肿瘤多为特殊组织学类型（13%对9%，P=0.04），且MK167抗原表达率较低（17%对25%，P=0.04）。

Query_Text_en: Thirty-one percent of the tumors detected by mammography screening were histologically well differentiated [ grade 1 ] compared with 16 % of tumors found outside of screening [ P [ .001 ] .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查检出的肿瘤中，31%在组织学上表现为高分化（1级），而筛查外发现的肿瘤这一比例仅为16%（P<0.001）。

Query_Text_en: In general , these differences were similar when the comparisons were limited to the age cohort of 50 to 69 years that contained the majority [ 86 % ] of the women with tumors detected by mammography screening [ Table 1 ] .
Translation: 总体而言，当比较范围限定在50至69岁这一年龄组时（该组占乳腺筛查检出肿瘤女性总数的86%），上述差异特征仍保持相似[见表1]。

Query_Text_en: Women with cancerous tumors found during the first screening round had similar outcomes as women with tumors found during the second or a later round [ P = .96 ] .
Translation: 在首轮筛查中发现癌性肿瘤的女性患者，其预后情况与在第二轮或后续筛查中发现肿瘤的患者无显著差异（P=0.96）。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , outcomes of all women with cancerous tumors detected by screening were compared with women whose tumors were found outside of screening in further analyses .
Translation: 因此，在后续分析中，将所有通过筛查检出癌性肿瘤的女性患者与未参与筛查而发现肿瘤的女性患者进行了疗效对比。

Query_Text_en: Women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening had better distant disease-free survival than women whose tumors were found outside of screening in all tumor size categories examined [ 10mm , 11-20mm , 21-30 mm , ] 30 mm , FIGURE ] .
Translation: 通过乳腺X光筛查检测出癌性肿瘤的女性，在所有检查的肿瘤大小分类[10毫米以下、11-20毫米、21-30毫米、大于30毫米，见图表]中，其无远处转移生存率均优于未参与筛查而发现肿瘤的女性。

Query_Text_en: In general , women with tumors detected by screening that were 11 to 30 mm in diameter were associated with similar outcomes as women with tumors found outside of screening that were 10 mm in diameter or smaller [ TABLE 2 ] .
Translation: 总体而言，通过筛查发现的肿瘤直径为11至30毫米的女性患者，其预后与未参与筛查但肿瘤直径不超过10毫米的女性患者相当（见表2）。

Query_Text_en: Similar differences in outcome were present when the largest single subgroups were compared [ age cohort of 50-69 years and women with node-negative tumors ] .
Translation: 在比较最大单一亚组（50-69岁年龄组和淋巴结阴性肿瘤女性患者）时，也出现了类似的疗效差异。

Query_Text_en: No significant difference in outcome was found between women with tumors detected by screening and women with tumors detected outside of screening in the size category of 30mm or larger , but only a few patients with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening were available for analysis in this subgroup [ n = 25 ] .
Translation: 在肿瘤大小为30毫米或更大的分组中，筛查检出肿瘤的女性与非筛查检出肿瘤的女性在治疗结果上未发现显著差异，但该亚组中仅有少数患者（25例）是通过乳腺X光筛查发现的癌性肿瘤可供分析。

Query_Text_en: Only 19 [ 21 % ] of the 90women with node-positive tumors detected by screening had distant recurrence .
Translation: 在筛查发现的90例淋巴结阳性肿瘤女性患者中，仅有19例（21%）出现远端复发。

Query_Text_en: Because the proportion of cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening was higher in the age cohort of 50 to 59 years [ 53 % ] than in the other age groups [ 40-49 years , 11 % of tumors ; 60-69 years , 26 % ; and 70-79 years , 3 % ] , age at detection needs to be taken into account as a confounding factor .
Translation: 由于乳腺X光筛查检出的恶性肿瘤比例在50至59岁年龄组[53%]显著高于其他年龄段[40-49岁组肿瘤占比11%；60-69岁组26%；70-79岁组3%]，因此必须将检出年龄作为混杂因素纳入考量。

Query_Text_en: Survival outcomes for women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening were better than women with tumors detected outside of screening , irrespective of age at the time of the diagnosis .
Translation: 无论确诊时的年龄如何，通过乳腺X光筛查检测出癌性肿瘤的女性，其生存率均优于未参与筛查而发现肿瘤的女性。

Query_Text_en: Variation in distant disease-free survival between the age cohorts was small compared with the large outcome differences between the women with tumors detected by screening compared with women with tumors detected outside of screening [ TABLE 3 ] .
Translation: 与筛查检出肿瘤患者和非筛查检出肿瘤患者间的显著疗效差异相比[表3]，不同年龄组间的远期无病生存率差异较小。

Query_Text_en: Of note , women aged 50 to 59 years whose tumors were found outside screening had roughly similar 10-year distant disease-free survival [ 73 % ] as women with similarly detected tumors in the other age cohorts [ 72 % for ages 40-49 years ; 69 % , ages 60-69 years ; and 67 % , ages 70 years ] , despite a much larger proportion of women in the age cohort of 50 to 59 years who had tumors detected by mammography screening .
Translation: 值得注意的是，50至59岁女性中，虽该年龄段通过乳腺筛查发现肿瘤的比例远高于其他年龄组，但其肿瘤在筛查外被发现者的10年无远处转移生存率[73%]与其他年龄组类似方式检出肿瘤的患者基本相当[40-49岁为72%；60-69岁为69%；70岁以上为67%]。

Query_Text_en: Because the age distribution of women with tumors detected by screening was different from that of the women with tumors detected outside of screening , and because tumors detected during screening were better differentiated , expressed the progesterone receptor more frequently , and had a lower cell proliferation rate as measured with staining for the MK167 protein , a multivariate analysis was performed to find out whether tumor detection in screening is an independent prognostic factor in the series .
Translation: 由于筛查检出的肿瘤患者年龄分布与非筛查检出者存在差异，且筛查检出肿瘤的分化程度更高、孕激素受体阳性率更频繁、MK167蛋白染色测定的细胞增殖率更低，本研究通过多变量分析以验证肿瘤筛查检出是否为该队列中独立的预后因素。

Query_Text_en: In comparison , an increase of 1 cm in the tumor diameter was associated with an HR increase of 1.20 [ 95 % , CI , 1.10-1 .31 ] for distant metastases .
Translation: 相比之下，肿瘤直径每增加1厘米，远处转移风险比（HR）将上升1.20（95%置信区间1.10-1.31）。

Query_Text_en: When breast cancer-specific survival [ HR , 2.11 ; 95 % CI , 1.16-3 .85 ] or overall survival [ HR , 1.63 ; 95 % CI , 1.02-2 .60 ] was chosen as the end point instead of distant disease-free survival , cancerous tumor detection outside of screening remained an independent adverse prognostic variable .
Translation: 当研究终点采用乳腺癌特异性生存期（风险比2.11，95%置信区间1.16-3.85）或总生存期（风险比1.63，95%置信区间1.02-2.60）替代无远处转移生存期时，筛查范围外检出的癌性肿瘤仍为独立的不良预后变量。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , tumor detection mode was an adverse prognostic variable when the women , who had cancerous tumors detected by screening based on hospital case record data but whose tumors were not registered in the Finnish National Registry for Cancerous Tumors Detected by Mammography Screening , were deleted from the analysis [ 30 % of cases detected by screening ] .
Translation: 同样地，当我们将那些通过医院病例记录数据筛查发现癌性肿瘤但未在芬兰乳腺X光筛查癌性肿瘤国家登记处注册的女性（占筛查检出病例的30%）从分析中剔除时，肿瘤检出模式成为一个不良预后变量。

Query_Text_en: Cancer detection by mammography screening was retained in the model with little change in the HR [ 2.09 ; 95 % CI , 1.13-3 .85 ] .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查检出的癌症在模型中得以保留，其风险比[2.09；95%置信区间1.13-3.85]变化甚微。

Query_Text_en: Within the subgroup of patients with node-negative tumors , who were aged 50 to 69 years at diagnosis and who did not receive adjuvant therapy [ n = 430 ] , detection by mammography screening was also associated with amore favorable prognosis -- independent of tumor size and the histological grade of cancer .
Translation: 在未接受辅助治疗且确诊年龄为50至69岁的淋巴结阴性肿瘤患者亚组（共430例）中，乳腺X光筛查检出同样与更佳预后相关——这一关联性独立于肿瘤大小和组织学分级而存在。

Query_Text_en: The generally favorable outcomes of women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening compared with women whose tumors were found outside of screening might be explained by the smaller median tumor size detected by screening , or by their more favorable biological features .
Translation: 与通过非筛查方式发现肿瘤的女性相比，经乳腺X光筛查检出癌变肿瘤的女性患者总体预后更佳，这一现象可能归因于筛查检测到的肿瘤中位尺寸较小，抑或源于其更具优势的生物学特征。

Query_Text_en: In line with some other series , tumors detected by mammography screening were smaller than the tumors detected outside of screening in the present cohort .
Translation: 与其他系列研究一致，本队列中通过乳腺X光筛查检出的肿瘤体积小于非筛查途径发现的肿瘤。

Query_Text_en: 6,9,10 Cancerous tumors detected by screening had also given rise to axillary lymph node metastases less often , were better differentiated , were more often of one of the special histological types , had a lower cell proliferation rate as assessed by immunostaining for the MK167 antigen , and tended to be more often ERBB2-amplification negative and progesterone-receptor positive .
Translation: 通过筛查检出的恶性肿瘤出现腋窝淋巴结转移的几率较低，分化程度较高，特殊组织学类型的占比更大，经MK167抗原免疫组化检测显示的细胞增殖率更低，且往往更少出现ERBB2基因扩增，更多呈现孕激素受体阳性特征。

Query_Text_en: However , these features did not fully explain the generally better outcomes of women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening because the mode of detection was an independent prognostic variable in multivariate analyses .
Translation: 然而，这些特征并不能完全解释通过乳腺X光筛查检出癌性肿瘤的女性患者总体预后较好的现象，因为在多变量分析中，检测方式本身就是一个独立的预后变量。

Query_Text_en: Tumors detected by screening were much more common in the present series in the age cohorts of 50 to 59 years and 60 to 69 years because the municipalities seldom organized screening for women younger than 50 years or women older than 70 years .
Translation: 在本研究系列中，通过筛查发现的肿瘤在50至59岁及60至69岁年龄组中更为常见，因为市政部门很少为50岁以下或70岁以上的女性组织筛查。

Query_Text_en: The different age distribution of the women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening is also unlikely to explain the favorable outcome because women with tumors detected by screening had superior survival compared with other women in all age cohorts examined .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查检出的癌症患者年龄分布差异同样难以解释其良好预后，因为在所有受检年龄组中，通过筛查发现肿瘤的女性生存率均优于其他女性群体。

Query_Text_en: Tumor detection by mammography screening was an independent prognostic variable in amultivariate analysis that also included age .
Translation: 在包含年龄因素的多变量分析中，乳腺X光筛查发现的肿瘤是一个独立的预后变量。

Query_Text_en: The generally favorable outcome is not explained by the treatments given because women with tumors detected by screening had received less systemic cancer therapies than women whose cancerous tumors were found outside of screening .
Translation: 筛查检出肿瘤的女性患者接受的系统性抗癌治疗少于非筛查检出者，这一事实表明，现有治疗手段并非总体良好疗效的原因。

Query_Text_en: Women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening had better distant disease-free survival compared with women with a similar primary tumor size detected outside of screening .
Translation: 通过乳腺X光筛查发现癌性肿瘤的女性，其无远端转移生存率优于未参与筛查但检出相似原发肿瘤大小的患者。

Query_Text_en: The relatively large size of the present series allowed evaluation of relatively narrow tumor diameter strata .
Translation: 本系列研究样本量较大，可对较窄的肿瘤直径分层进行评估。

Query_Text_en: This may be of importance because tumors detected by screening are generally considerably smaller in size than other cancerous tumors , which might bias comparisons within wider tumor size strata .
Translation: 这可能具有重要意义，因为通过筛查发现的肿瘤通常比其他癌性肿瘤小得多，这可能会在更广泛的肿瘤大小分层中导致比较偏差。

Query_Text_en: We are not aware of any prior studies in which outcome of tumors of similar size detected by screening and outside of screening have been compared , but the present results are in accordance with 2 smaller studies that compared tumors detected by screening and other tumors within the tumor node metastasis group categories .
Translation: 我们尚未发现任何先前研究对筛查检出与非筛查检出的相似大小肿瘤的预后进行过比较，但本研究结果与两项规模较小的研究结论一致——这两项研究对比了筛查检出肿瘤与肿瘤淋巴结转移组分类中其他肿瘤的情况。

Query_Text_en: Both studies concluded that women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening may be associated with superior outcomes compared with other women when an adjustment is made for the tumor size .
Translation: 两项研究均得出结论：在针对肿瘤大小进行调整后，通过乳腺X光筛查发现癌性肿瘤的女性，其治疗效果可能优于其他女性群体。

Query_Text_en: We found the influence of the method of detection on outcome to be substantial .
Translation: 我们发现检测方法对结果的影响相当显著。

Query_Text_en: For example , women with tumor diameters of 11 to 30 mm that were detected by mammography screening had approximately similar survival as women whose cancerous tumors were found outside of screening and were 10 mm or smaller in diameter .
Translation: 例如，通过乳腺X光筛查发现的肿瘤直径为11至30毫米的女性患者，其生存率与未参与筛查但肿瘤直径在10毫米及以下的确诊患者大致相当。

Query_Text_en: Comparison of tumors of roughly similar size is likely to reduce the influence of the lead-time bias on outcome comparisons .
Translation: 对体积大致相当的肿瘤进行比较，可减少领先时间偏倚对疗效对比的影响。

Query_Text_en: Selection bias also is unlikely to play a major role in this nationwide series .
Translation: 选择偏误在这项全国性研究中也不太可能产生重大影响。

Query_Text_en: Cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening may have biological properties different from other tumors , and , thus , the length bias [ more indolent tumors are detected by screening ] might be an important factor in explaining their generally favorable prognoses .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查检出的癌性肿瘤可能具有与其他肿瘤不同的生物学特性，因此，长度偏差（筛查更易检出惰性肿瘤）或许是解释其预后普遍较好的重要因素。

Query_Text_en: However , apart from the histological grade , none of the tumor biological factors examined was strongly associated with the mode of cancer detection ,
Translation: 然而，除组织学分级外，所研究的肿瘤生物学因素均与癌症检出方式无显著关联。

Query_Text_en: and the method of detection was an independent prognostic variable in a multivariate survival analysis in which histological grade and a few cancer biological factors were included as covariates .
Translation: 在多变量生存分析中，当纳入组织学分级及若干癌症生物学因素作为协变量时，检测方法被证实为独立预后变量。

Query_Text_en: Compared with tumors found outside of screening , tumors detected by screening are associated less often with symptoms or signs such as breast pain , pressure in the breast , or nipple discharge .
Translation: 与筛查外发现的肿瘤相比，通过筛查检出的肿瘤较少伴随乳房疼痛、乳房压迫感或乳头溢液等症状或体征。

Query_Text_en: Such symptoms , in turn , might be associated with some cancer invasiveness-related factors , such as neural or perineural microinvasion [ causing pain ] , edema [ feeling of pressure ] , vascular invasion , or duct obstruction or invasion [ nipple discharge , pain , pressure ] .
Translation: 反过来，这些症状可能与某些癌症侵袭性相关因素有关，例如神经或神经周围微浸润（引发疼痛）、水肿（产生压迫感）、血管侵犯，或导管阻塞及浸润（导致乳头溢液、疼痛或压迫感）。

Query_Text_en: These parameters were not investigated in our study and might in part explain the poorer outcome of women with tumors detected outside of screening .
Translation: 本研究未对这些参数进行探究，这可能部分解释了筛查外检出肿瘤的女性患者预后较差的原因。

Query_Text_en: Other factors related to tumor angiogenesis and metastasis formation might also be of importance and require further study .
Translation: 与肿瘤血管生成和转移形成相关的其他因素可能同样重要，有待进一步研究。

Query_Text_en: Some tumors detected by mammography screening might grow slowly ; and indolent tumors might not ever surface during the life-span of the woman .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查发现的某些肿瘤可能生长缓慢；而惰性肿瘤在女性有生之年甚至可能永远不会显现。

Query_Text_en: In a few autopsy studies , occult breast tumors have been detected in a substantial proportion of women representing the general population .
Translation: 数项尸检研究表明，在代表普通人群的女性中，相当比例存在隐匿性乳腺肿瘤。

Query_Text_en: In these studies , occult in situ carcinoma was found in 4.3 % to 18 % of women , and invasive breast cancer in 1.8 % of women in one series consisting of forensic autopsies .
Translation: 多项研究表明，在法医尸检案例中，女性隐匿性原位癌检出率为4.3%至18%，其中浸润性乳腺癌占比达1.8%。

Query_Text_en: The biological behavior of untreated breast cancer has been investigated in a historical series consisting of patients who have refused surgery for early breast cancer .
Translation: 一项针对拒绝手术治疗的早期乳腺癌患者的历史病例系列研究，揭示了未经治疗的乳腺癌自然生物学行为特征。

Query_Text_en: Many women survived longer than expected with untreated breast cancer [ mean survival , 30-40 .5 months from the onset of symptoms to death ] , and several women with stage I , II , or III breast cancer who refused treatment survived for 5 years .
Translation: 许多未接受治疗的乳腺癌患者生存期超出预期（从症状出现到死亡的平均生存期为30至40.5个月），其中数名拒绝治疗的Ⅰ、Ⅱ或Ⅲ期乳腺癌患者存活时间达五年。

Query_Text_en: However , it is clear that the majority of self-detected tumors are aggressive and usually manifest with distant metastases during the first 10 years of follow-up and only rarely after the 15th year of follow-up .
Translation: 然而，可以明确的是，绝大多数自我检出的肿瘤具有侵袭性，通常在随访前10年内即出现远端转移，极少在随访15年后才显现。

Query_Text_en: The mode of tumor detection was based on the data available in the hospital case records .
Translation: 肿瘤检测方式依据医院病历档案中的现有数据确定。

Query_Text_en: We also examined the mode of tumor detection from the Finnish national mammography registry .
Translation: 我们还从芬兰国家乳腺X光检查登记系统中分析了肿瘤检测模式。

Query_Text_en: Seventy percent of the women with tumors detected by screening [ based on hospital case record data ] were identified also in the screening registry files .
Translation: 根据医院病例记录数据显示，通过筛查发现的肿瘤患者中，有70%的女性病例也在筛查登记档案中得到确认。

Query_Text_en: Many of the remaining 30 % of women who were not identified in the registry were also likely to have cancerous tumors detected by screening .
Translation: 其余30%未登记在册的女性中，也有相当比例可能通过筛查检出癌性肿瘤。

Query_Text_en: However , this assertion could not be confirmed because the registry was incomplete .
Translation: 然而，由于登记资料不完整，这一说法无法得到证实。

Query_Text_en: Removal of women from the cohort who had cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening , based on hospital records only , had little influence on the HR of distant recurrence associated with screening in a multivariate model .
Translation: 仅依据医院记录剔除通过乳腺X光筛查检出癌性肿瘤的女性患者后，在多变量模型中，筛查相关的远端复发风险比所受影响甚微。

Query_Text_en: Cancerous tumors detected during the first or a later screening round were combined in further analyses because the round of cancer detection had no significant effect on outcome [ P = .96 ] , and data on the screening round was missing in a proportion of the women .
Translation: 由于癌症检出轮次对治疗结果无显著影响（P=0.96），且部分女性筛查轮次数据缺失，在后续分析中将初筛与后续筛查中检出的恶性肿瘤合并统计。

Query_Text_en: The detection outside of screening group consisted of self-detected cancerous tumors , tumors detected in women who did not participate in screening , and tumors detected between mammography screening rounds .
Translation: 筛查组外的检出病例包括自我发现的恶性肿瘤、未参与筛查女性中检出的肿瘤，以及两次乳腺X光筛查间隔期内发现的肿瘤。

Query_Text_en: Interestingly , survival of such women with cancer was roughly similar in the age cohort of 50 to 59 years as in the other cohorts , although the relative proportion of self-detected cancerous tumors was lower in the age group of 50 to 59 years than in the other age cohorts due to the more extensive screening performed in the 50 - to 59-year age group .
Translation: 值得注意的是，尽管50至59岁年龄组中自我检出癌症肿瘤的比例因该年龄段更广泛的筛查而低于其他年龄组，但该年龄段女性癌症患者的生存率与其他年龄组大致相当。

Query_Text_en: This finding is in line with a few other studies that have found cancerous tumors detected between mammography screening rounds are associated with approximately similar outcomes as other women with tumors detected outside of screening .
Translation: 这一发现与少数其他研究结果一致，即乳腺X光筛查间隔期检出的癌性肿瘤与其他女性在非筛查期间发现的肿瘤预后大致相似。

Query_Text_en: Tumor detection between mammography screening rounds appears to be more common among premenopausal women and women who use hormone replacement therapy , probably due to their denser breast parenchyma , but the technical quality of the mammograms and the skill of the radiologist also are likely to be of importance .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查间隔期发现肿瘤的情况，在绝经前女性和使用激素替代疗法的女性中更为常见，这可能与其乳腺实质密度较高有关。但乳腺X光片的技术质量及放射科医师的专业水平同样具有重要影响。

Query_Text_en: Tumors detected between mammography screening rounds are false-negatives 10 % to 30 % of the time , but retrospective classification of tumors that were detected between mammography screening rounds into true interval tumors and missed tumors is demanding , and is seldom performed in the routine clinical praxis .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查间隔期间检出的肿瘤中，10%至30%实为筛查假阴性病例。但对此类间期检出肿瘤进行回顾性分类（区分为真性间期肿瘤与漏诊肿瘤）存在较高难度，常规临床实践中鲜少开展此类分类工作。

Query_Text_en: For these reasons and the considerable logistic problems involved in a nationwide series , we made no attempt to subclassify tumors detected outside of mammography screening .
Translation: 基于上述原因及全国性系列研究所涉及的巨大后勤难题，我们未对乳腺X光筛查之外检出的肿瘤进行亚型分类。

Query_Text_en: Any cohort of women with tumors detected by mammography screening may contain a few women with symptomatic cancer because some women might wait for the screening visit instead of making an appointment with a physician .
Translation: 通过乳腺X光筛查发现的肿瘤患者群体中，可能包含部分已出现症状的癌症患者，因为有些女性会选择等待筛查而非主动预约就诊。

Query_Text_en: Thus , the survival difference in favor of the screened cohort might be greater than the one we observed due to inclusion of some women with symptomatic cancer in the screened cohort .
Translation: 因此，由于筛查队列中纳入了部分有症状的癌症患者，筛查组在生存率上的优势可能比我们观察到的更为显著。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , women who refused screening and who may have had an inferior outcome compared with women who participated in screening were included in the subgroup of women whose cancerous tumors were detected outside screening .
Translation: 另一方面，拒绝筛查且预后可能较参与筛查女性更差的患者，被归入通过筛查以外途径检出癌变的亚组。

Query_Text_en: However , the proportion of women who refuse mammography screening is small in Finland .
Translation: 然而，芬兰拒绝接受乳腺X光筛查的女性比例较低。

Query_Text_en: In the age groups of 40 to 49 years , 60 to 69 years , and 70 years or older , the rate of participation in screening was largely dictated by the decision made by the municipality of residence to offer mammography screening .
Translation: 在40至49岁、60至69岁以及70岁及以上的年龄组中，乳腺癌筛查参与率主要取决于居民所在城市是否提供乳腺X光检查服务的决定。

Query_Text_en: We conclude that women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening have better survival outcomes than other women with tumors of roughly similar primary diameter .
Translation: 我们得出结论，通过乳腺X光筛查发现的癌症肿瘤患者，其生存预后优于其他原发性肿瘤直径相近的女性患者。

Query_Text_en: Cancerous tumor detection in mammography screening was a favorable prognostic variable independent of the number of axillary lymph nodes , the primary tumor size , age at cancer detection , and the histological grade .
Translation: 乳腺X光筛查中发现的癌性肿瘤是一个独立的良好预后指标，其预测价值不受腋窝淋巴结数量、原发肿瘤大小、癌症确诊年龄以及组织学分级的影响。

Query_Text_en: None of the histopathological or cancer biological factors explained the effect of cancerous tumor detection in screening on the risk for distant recurrence .
Translation: 筛查中发现的癌性肿瘤对远端复发风险的影响，无法通过组织病理学或癌症生物学因素得到解释。

Query_Text_en: Further research on factors related to cancer invasiveness and metastasis formation needs to be performed .
Translation: 需进一步开展与癌症侵袭性和转移形成相关因素的研究。

Query_Text_en: For women with cancerous tumors detected by mammography screening , the risk of distant metastases may be overestimated unless the method of detection is taken into account in risk estimations .
Translation: 对于通过乳腺X光筛查发现癌性肿瘤的女性而言，若风险评估未将检测方法纳入考量，其远端转移风险可能被高估。

Query_Text_en: Context Knowledge of risk factors for colorectal neoplasia could inform risk reduction strategies for asymptomatic individuals .
Translation: 掌握结直肠肿瘤的风险因素知识，可为无症状人群制定风险防控策略提供依据。

Query_Text_en: Few studies have evaluated risk factors for advanced colorectal neoplasia in asymptomatic individuals , compared risk factors between persons with and without polyps , or included most purported risk factors in amultivariate analysis .
Translation: 现有研究鲜少评估无症状人群进展期结直肠肿瘤的风险因素，或对有息肉和无息肉人群的风险因素进行比较，亦或在多变量分析中纳入多数公认的风险因素。

Query_Text_en: Objective To determine risk factors associated with advanced colorectal neoplasia in a cohort of asymptomatic persons with complete colonoscopy .
Translation: 目的 旨在通过全结肠镜检查，探究无症状人群中进展性结直肠肿瘤的相关风险因素。

Query_Text_en: Design , Setting , and Participants Prospective , cross-sectional study of 3121 asymptomatic patients aged 50 to 75 years from 13 Veterans Affairs medical centers conducted between February 1994 and January 1997 .
Translation: 研究设计、场所与对象：1994年2月至1997年1月期间，对来自13家退伍军人事务部医疗中心的3121名50至75岁无症状患者开展了一项前瞻性横断面研究。

Query_Text_en: All participants had complete colonoscopy to determine the prevalence of advanced neoplasia , defined as an adenoma that was 10 mm or more in diameter , a villous adenoma , an adenoma with high-grade dysplasia , or invasive cancer .
Translation: 所有受试者均接受完整结肠镜检查，以确定进展期肿瘤的患病率。进展期肿瘤定义为直径≥10毫米的腺瘤、绒毛状腺瘤、伴有高级别上皮内瘤变的腺瘤或浸润性癌。

Query_Text_en: Variables examined included history of first-degree relative with colorectal cancer , prior cholecystectomy , serum cholesterol level , physical activity , smoking , alcohol use , and dietary factors .
Translation: 研究变量包括：一级亲属结直肠癌病史、既往胆囊切除术史、血清胆固醇水平、体力活动情况、吸烟饮酒习惯及膳食因素等。

Query_Text_en: Main Outcome Measures An age-adjusted analysis was performed for each variable to calculate the odds ratios [ ORs ] and 95 % confidence intervals [ CIs ] associated with having advanced neoplasia compared with having no polyps .
Translation: 主要结局指标 对各变量进行年龄校正分析，计算与无息肉者相比存在进展期肿瘤的比值比（OR）及其95%置信区间（CI）。

Query_Text_en: We developed a multivariate logistic regression model to identify the most informative risk factors .
Translation: 我们构建了多元逻辑回归模型，以识别最具预测价值的风险因素。

Query_Text_en: A secondary analysis examined risk factors for having hyperplastic polyps compared with having no polyps and compared with having advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 二次分析针对存在增生性息肉与无息肉、以及存在增生性息肉与存在晚期肿瘤的情况，分别进行了风险因素比较研究。

Query_Text_en: Results Three hundred twenty-nine participants had advanced neoplasia and 1441 had no polyps .
Translation: 结果显示，329名受试者检出进展期肿瘤，1441名受试者未发现息肉。

Query_Text_en: In multivariate analyses , we found positive associations for history of a first-degree relative with colorectal cancer [ OR , 1.66 ; 95 % CI , 1.16-2 .35 ] , current smoking [ OR , 1.85 ; 95 % CI , 1.33-2 .58 ] , and current moderate to heavy alcohol use [ OR , 1.02 ; 95 % CI , 1.01-1 .03 ] .
Translation: 多变量分析显示，一级亲属结直肠癌病史（OR=1.66，95%CI：1.16-2.35）、当前吸烟（OR=1.85，95%CI：1.33-2.58）及当前中重度饮酒（OR=1.02，95%CI：1.01-1.03）均呈显著正相关。

Query_Text_en: Inverse associations were found for cereal fiber intake [ OR , 0.95 ; 95 % CI , 0.91-0 .99 ] , vitamin D intake [ OR , 0.94 ; 95 % CI , 0.90-0 .99 ] , and use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs [ NSAIDs ] [ OR , 0.66 ; 95 % CI , 0.48-0 .91 ] .
Translation: 研究发现谷物纤维摄入量（OR=0.95，95%CI：0.91-0.99）、维生素D摄入量（OR=0.94，95%CI：0.90-0.99）与非甾体抗炎药使用（OR=0.66，95%CI：0.48-0.91）均呈负相关关系。

Query_Text_en: In the univariate analysis , the inverse association was found with cereal fiber intake greater than 4.2 g\/d , vitamin D intake greater than 645 IU\/d , and daily use of NSAIDs .
Translation: 在单变量分析中，发现与谷物纤维摄入量大于4.2克/天、维生素D摄入量大于645国际单位/天以及每日使用非甾体抗炎药呈负相关。

Query_Text_en: Marginal factors included physical activity , daily multivitamin use , and intake of calcium and fat derived from red meat .
Translation: 次要因素包括体力活动、每日服用复合维生素，以及从红肉中摄入的钙和脂肪。

Query_Text_en: No association was found for body mass index , prior cholecystectomy , or serum cholesterol level .
Translation: 未发现体重指数、既往胆囊切除术或血清胆固醇水平存在关联。

Query_Text_en: Three hundred ninety-one patients had hyperplastic polyps as the worst lesion found at colonoscopy .
Translation: 结肠镜检查发现391名患者的最严重病变为增生性息肉。

Query_Text_en: Risk variables were similar to those for patients with no polyps , except that past and current smoking were associated with an increased risk of hyperplastic polyps .
Translation: 除既往及当前吸烟者发生增生性息肉的风险较高外，其他风险变量与无异型增生息肉患者相似。

Query_Text_en: Conclusions Our data endorse several important risk factors for advanced colonic neoplasia and provide a rationale for prudent risk reduction strategies .
Translation: 结论 我们的数据证实了晚期结肠肿瘤的若干重要风险因素，并为制定审慎的风险降低策略提供了依据。

Query_Text_en: Further study is needed to determine if lifestyle changes can moderate the risk of colorectal cancer .
Translation: 需进一步研究以确定生活方式调整能否降低结直肠癌患病风险。

Query_Text_en: Colorectal cancer is the second leading cause of cancer death in North America .
Translation: 结直肠癌是北美地区癌症致死的第二大诱因。

Query_Text_en: Evidence exists that screening asymptomatic populations beginning at age 50 years can reduce mortality due to colorectal cancer 1-8 and that removal of precursor adenomas may reduce the incidence of colorectal cancer .
Translation: 有证据表明，从50岁开始对无症状人群进行筛查可降低结直肠癌导致的死亡率1-8，同时切除癌前腺瘤可能降低结直肠癌发病率。

Query_Text_en: Identification of important risk factors for advanced colonic neoplasia could inform both risk stratification and development of risk reduction strategies .
Translation: 识别晚期结肠肿瘤的重要风险因素，可为风险分级和制定风险降低策略提供依据。

Query_Text_en: Many potential risk factors for colorectal neoplasia have been investigated previously .
Translation: 此前已有研究探讨过多种可能导致结直肠肿瘤的潜在风险因素。

Query_Text_en: Few studies have evaluated risk factors for advanced colorectal neoplasia in asymptomatic individuals , compared risk factors between persons with and without polyps , or included most purported risk factors in a multivariate analysis .
Translation: 现有研究鲜少评估无症状人群进展期结直肠肿瘤的风险因素，或对有息肉与无息肉人群的风险因素进行比较，亦或在多变量分析中纳入多数公认的风险因素。

Query_Text_en: We conducted a cross-sectional study to determine risk factors for advanced colonic neoplasia in asymptomatic persons undergoing a complete screening colonoscopic examination .
Translation: 我们对接受完整结肠镜筛查的无症状人群开展横断面研究，旨在确定晚期结肠肿瘤病变的风险因素。

Query_Text_en: The unique features of this study are [ 1 ] the inclusion of persons known to be free of colonic polyps based on colonoscopy as a comparison group vs patients with advanced neoplasia and [ 2 ] a sample size sufficient to analyze the most important risk variables in a multivariate analysis .
Translation: 本研究的独特之处在于：[1]将经结肠镜检查确认无结肠息肉的健康人群作为对照组，与晚期肿瘤患者进行对比；[2]样本量充足，足以通过多变量分析评估最重要的风险变量。

Query_Text_en: Suspected risk factors were selected based on associations found in prior studies and biological plausibility .
Translation: 可疑风险因素的筛选依据既有研究中发现的关联性及其生物学合理性。

Query_Text_en: We studied family history of colorectal cancer , diet , smoking , alcohol use , nonsteroidal antiinflammatory drug [ NSAID ] use , body mass index , prior cholecystectomy , serum cholesterol level , and physical activity as potential risk factors .
Translation: 我们研究了结直肠癌家族史、饮食习惯、吸烟、饮酒、非甾体抗炎药使用、体重指数、既往胆囊切除术、血清胆固醇水平及体力活动等潜在风险因素。

Query_Text_en: We performed a secondary analysis of patients whose worst colonic lesions were 1 or more hyperplastic polyps .
Translation: 我们对结肠最严重病变为1个或多个增生性息肉的患者进行了二次分析。

Query_Text_en: Hyperplastic polyps are benign and common .
Translation: 增生性息肉属于良性且较为常见。

Query_Text_en: Current guidelines suggest that patients with hyperplastic polyps be treated similarly to patients with no polyps .
Translation: 现行指南建议，增生性息肉患者的处理方式应与无息肉患者相同。

Query_Text_en: No prior studies have evaluated risk factors in patients with hyperplastic polyps to determine if they resemble those in patients with no polyps .
Translation: 此前尚无研究对增生性息肉患者的风险因素进行评估，以确定其是否与无息肉患者的风险因素相似。

Query_Text_en: Our study provided an opportunity to determine risk variables for patients with hyperplastic polyps compared with those in patients with no polyps and with those in patients with advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 本研究为确定增生性息肉患者相较于无息肉患者及进展性肿瘤患者的风险变量提供了契机。

Query_Text_en: Patients aged 50 to 75 years who did not have lower gastrointestinal tract symptoms were recruited from 13 Veterans Affairs medical centers between February 1994 and January 1997 .
Translation: 1994年2月至1997年1月期间，研究人员从13家退伍军人事务部医疗中心招募了50至75岁、无下消化道症状的患者。

Query_Text_en: The study protocol was approved by a central human rights committee and by institutional review boards at each participating center , and all participants provided written informed consent .
Translation: 本研究方案已获得中央人权委员会及各参与中心的机构审查委员会批准，所有受试者均签署了书面知情同意书。

Query_Text_en: Patients completed a clinic survey to determine eligibility .
Translation: 患者需完成临床调查以确认是否符合入选标准。

Query_Text_en: Patients were excluded if they reported symptoms of lower gastrointestinal tract disease , including rectal bleeding [ on 1 occasion in the previous 6 months ] , a marked change in bowel habits , or lower abdominal pain that would normally require medical evaluation .
Translation: 若患者报告有以下下消化道疾病症状则予以排除：包括直肠出血（过去6个月内至少发生1次）、排便习惯显著改变或通常需就医诊治的下腹部疼痛。

Query_Text_en: Other exclusion criteria were current participation in other studies , history of disease of the colon [ such as colitis , polyps , or cancer ] , prior colonic surgery , a colonic examination [ ie , sigmoidoscopy , colonoscopy , or barium enema ] within the previous 10 years , a medical condition that could increase the risk associated with colonoscopy or that would preclude a benefit from colonoscopic screening [ cancer or any terminal illness ] , a prosthetic heart valve , anticoagulant therapy , nonmedical problems [ psychiatric disorders , lack of transportation , homelessness or lack of support at home , or excessive use of alcohol ] , or a need for special precautions in performing colonoscopy [ such as antibiotic prophylaxis ] .
Translation: 其他排除标准包括：当前参与其他研究、有结肠疾病史（如结肠炎、息肉或癌症）、既往接受过结肠手术、过去10年内进行过结肠检查（如乙状结肠镜检查、结肠镜检查或钡灌肠检查）、存在可能增加结肠镜检查风险或使结肠镜筛查无法获益的医疗状况（癌症或任何终末期疾病）、安装人工心脏瓣膜、接受抗凝治疗、存在非医学问题（精神疾病、缺乏交通工具、无家可归或家庭支持不足、酗酒）、或需在结肠镜检查时采取特殊预防措施（如抗生素预防）。

Query_Text_en: Women with childbearing potential were excluded .
Translation: 有生育能力的女性被排除在外。

Query_Text_en: 2346 patients declined to complete the clinic survey .
Translation: 2346名患者拒绝完成临床调查。

Query_Text_en: The most common reasons for exclusion were colonic examination in the previous 10 years [ n = 6486 ] , history of colon disease [ n = 2221 ] , serious medical disorder [ n = 1052 ] , and anticoagulation therapy [ n = 712 ] .
Translation: 最常见的排除原因包括：过去10年内接受过结肠检查（6486例）、有结肠疾病史（2221例）、患有严重基础疾病（1052例）以及正在接受抗凝治疗（712例）。

Query_Text_en: Among patients who met the eligibility criteria , 1463 [ 31.4 % ] declined to participate and 3196 eligible patients were enrolled .
Translation: 在符合入选标准的患者中，有1463人（占比31.4%）拒绝参与研究，最终纳入3196名合格患者。

Query_Text_en: Patients who had complete colonoscopy examinations were included in this analysis [ n = 3121 ] .
Translation: 本分析纳入了接受完整结肠镜检查的患者[共3121例]。

Query_Text_en: We determined our sample size requirements to have sufficient power [ ] 90 % ] to detect a clinically important doubling of risk for key categorical risk factors .
Translation: 我们确定了样本量需求，以确保至少具备90%的统计效力来检测关键分类风险因素临床风险倍增的情况。

Query_Text_en: We analyzed the 329 patients with advanced neoplasia and 1441 without polyps [ N = 1770 ] [ TABLE 1 ] .
Translation: 我们对329名晚期肿瘤患者和1441名无息肉患者（总计1770例）进行了分析[表1]。

Query_Text_en: Procedures for performing colonoscopy and histologic evaluation have been described previously .
Translation: 结肠镜检查与组织学评估的操作流程已有文献详述。

Query_Text_en: Advanced colonic neoplasia was defined as an adenoma of 10 mm or more , a villous adenoma [ at least 25 % villous ] , adenoma with high-grade dysplasia , or invasive cancer .
Translation: 进展期结肠肿瘤的定义包括：直径≥10毫米的腺瘤、绒毛状腺瘤（绒毛成分≥25%）、伴有高级别上皮内瘤变的腺瘤或浸润性癌。

Query_Text_en: Patients with a pathologic inter pretation of intramucosal carcinoma or carcinoma in situ were classified in the high-grade dysplasia group .
Translation: 病理诊断为黏膜内癌或原位癌的患者被归类为高度不典型增生组。

Query_Text_en: Cancer was defined as invasion of malignant cells be yond the muscularis mucosa .
Translation: 癌症被定义为恶性细胞突破黏膜肌层的浸润。

Query_Text_en: Patients were classified based on the most histologically advanced lesion .
Translation: 根据组织学上最严重的病变对患者进行分类。

Query_Text_en: A second cohort of patients in whom hyperplastic polyps were the worst colonic lesions was studied to determine if their risk factors differed from those of patients with no polyps or from those of patients with advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 为探究增生性息肉患者（其结肠最严重病变为增生性息肉）的风险因素是否与无息肉患者或晚期肿瘤患者存在差异，我们对第二组患者队列展开了研究。

Query_Text_en: Patients were excluded if they left 70 or more items blank or reported implausibly high or low scores for total energy intake .
Translation: 若患者有70项及以上条目未填写，或报告的总能量摄入值明显过高或过低，则予以排除。

Query_Text_en: Based on this questionnaire , the following measurements were made in each patient : total energy intake ; total fat ; fat derived from beef , pork , or lamb ; total dietary fiber ; fiber from cereal , fruits , and vegetables ; total calcium ; total folate ; vitamin D ; and daily multivitamin use .
Translation: 根据该问卷调查，我们对每位患者进行了以下指标测量：总能量摄入量；脂肪总量；源自牛肉、猪肉或羊肉的脂肪量；膳食纤维总量；谷物、水果及蔬菜所含纤维量；钙元素总量；叶酸总量；维生素D含量；以及每日复合维生素使用情况。

Query_Text_en: The physical activity index was adopted from the Framingham Study .
Translation: 体力活动指数采用自弗雷明汉研究。

Query_Text_en: Patients were provided definitions of very light , light , moderate , and heavy activity for home , occupation , and recreation and recorded their time spent in each category to generate a 24-hour score .
Translation: 研究人员向患者提供了居家、职业及休闲活动中极轻度、轻度、中度和重度体力活动的定义标准，患者需记录每类活动的持续时间，据此生成24小时活动强度评分。

Query_Text_en: The second measure used a calculation of metabolic equivalents , a well-validated assessment of energy expenditure during specific forms of moderate to heavy exercise , expressed as metabolic equivalents per week .
Translation: 第二种方法采用代谢当量计算，这是一种经过充分验证的评估方式，用于衡量特定形式中高强度运动的能量消耗，其计量单位为每周代谢当量。

Query_Text_en: The 2 scoring systems reflect different profiles of physical activity .
Translation: 这两套评分体系反映了不同的身体活动特征。

Query_Text_en: On the physical activity index , an individual who engages in many hours per day of mild activity may have a similar score to a person who performs a short period of exertional activity .
Translation: 在体力活动指数评估中，每日进行多小时轻度活动者可能与短期高强度运动者获得相近评分。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , the metabolic equivalent score discriminates individuals who engage in moderate to heavy physical activity ; an individual with several hours of mild activity will have a lower score than a person with short periods of heavy exertion .
Translation: 相比之下，代谢当量评分能有效区分从事中高强度体力活动的人群：进行数小时轻度活动者的得分，将低于短时间高强度运动者。

Query_Text_en: Patients were queried regarding current use , number of cigarettes per day , and number of years of smoking .
Translation: 调查询问了患者当前吸烟情况、每日吸烟支数及吸烟年限。

Query_Text_en: For prior smokers , the year of cessation , number of years of smoking , and number of cigarettes per day were determined .
Translation: 对于既往吸烟者，需记录其戒烟年份、吸烟年限及每日吸烟支数。

Query_Text_en: Current and past use of alcohol was measured by ascertaining the number of drinks per week , defined as wine [ 4 oz per glass ] , beer [ 12 oz per can or bottle ] , or liquor [ 1 oz per shot ] , each equivalent to approximately 11 g of alcohol per drink .
Translation: 当前及既往饮酒情况通过每周饮酒量进行测算，计量标准为：葡萄酒（每杯4盎司）、啤酒（每罐/瓶12盎司）或烈酒（每杯1盎司），每份酒类约含11克酒精。

Query_Text_en: Use of aspirin or other NSAIDs was ascertained by a query that included every known NSAID .
Translation: 阿司匹林或其他非甾体抗炎药的使用情况通过包含所有已知非甾体抗炎药的问卷进行确认。

Query_Text_en: This list was revised and updated during the study as new products became available .
Translation: 随着新产品问世，本研究对清单进行了修订和更新。

Query_Text_en: Patients indicated specific product used , daily dosage , and duration [ in years ] of consumption .
Translation: 患者需注明所使用具体产品、每日剂量及服用持续时间（以年计）。

Query_Text_en: The data were analyzed based on current use [ never vs occasional or daily ] and on duration of any use .
Translation: 数据分析基于当前使用情况[从未使用、偶尔使用或每日使用]以及任何使用时长。

Query_Text_en: History of prior cholecystecto my and date of surgery were ascertained .
Translation: 既往胆囊切除术史及手术日期均已核实确认。

Query_Text_en: Serum cholesterol was measured from a fasting blood sample .
Translation: 血清胆固醇水平通过空腹血样检测得出。

Query_Text_en: Study database management and all statistical analyses were performed with SAS software , version 6.12 [ SAS Institute Inc , Cary , NC ] .
Translation: 研究数据管理与所有统计分析均采用SAS 6.12版软件[美国北卡罗来纳州卡里市SAS研究所]完成。

Query_Text_en: Descriptive statistical analyses included calculation of rates and proportions for categorical data and means and SEs for continuous data .
Translation: 描述性统计分析包括计算分类数据的比率和比例，以及连续数据的均值和标准误。

Query_Text_en: In addition , standard logistic regression methods were used for calculating relative risks as odds ratios [ ORs ] with 95 % confidence intervals [ CIs ] .
Translation: 此外，本研究采用标准逻辑回归方法计算相对风险，以比值比（OR）表示，并附95%置信区间（CI）。

Query_Text_en: In the analysis of dietary and other continuous variables , participants were categorized according to quintiles ranging from lowest to highest values , with the lowest quintile serving as the reference group .
Translation: 在膳食及其他连续变量分析中，受试者按数值从低到高划分为五等分组，并以最低五分位数组作为参照组。

Query_Text_en: Dietary variables were adjusted first for age and then for age plus total energy intake and medical history factors [ family history , body mass index , smoking , alcohol use , physical activity index , and NSAID use ] .
Translation: 首先对饮食变量进行年龄调整，随后进一步调整为年龄叠加总能量摄入及病史因素（家族病史、体重指数、吸烟、饮酒、体力活动指数及非甾体抗炎药使用情况）。

Query_Text_en: Nondietary risk factors were adjusted for age .
Translation: 非饮食风险因素已根据年龄进行调整。

Query_Text_en: A primary objective was to assess in a multivariate model the relative importance of the risk factors .
Translation: 主要目标是通过多元模型评估各风险因素的相对重要性。

Query_Text_en: These factors fell into general classes within which there were multiple measures [ eg , physical activity ; dietary fiber as total and cereal , fruit , and vegetable ] .
Translation: 这些因素可归入若干大类，每类包含多项衡量指标（如：身体活动水平；膳食纤维摄入量，包括总量及谷物、水果、蔬菜分项数据）。

Query_Text_en: The development of the multivariate model required variable selection to avoid problems of redundancy and over specification .
Translation: 构建多元模型时需进行变量筛选，以避免冗余和过度参数化问题。

Query_Text_en: In cases of ambiguity , a statistical approach involving stepwise regression procedures was used within classes of factors to select the most statistically relevant variables .
Translation: 在存在歧义的情况下，采用逐步回归统计方法对各类因素进行分析，以筛选出统计相关性最强的变量。

Query_Text_en: The multivariate model included the following list of variables , rescaled with reasonable increments : family history [ 1 first-degree relatives with colorectal cancer vs none ] ; body mass index [ continuous in 5-unit increments ] ; physical activity index [ continuous in 5-unit increments ] ; smoking [ current vs never or past ] ; alcohol use [ continuous by number of servings per week ] ; NSAID use [ any vs never ] ; beef , pork , or lamb as main dish [ continuous as a percentage of total energy intake ] representing the fat class of dietary factors ; cereal fiber [ continuous in 1-g increments ] as the fiber variable ; and vitamin D [ continuous in 100-IUincrements ] .
Translation: 该多变量模型纳入以下经合理增量调整的变量：家族史[1名一级亲属患结直肠癌对比无]；体重指数[连续变量，每5个单位增量]；体力活动指数[连续变量，每5个单位增量]；吸烟状况[当前吸烟者对比从未或既往吸烟者]；饮酒量[连续变量，按每周饮用份数计]；非甾体抗炎药使用情况[曾使用对比从未使用]；以牛肉、猪肉或羊肉为主菜[连续变量，按占总能量摄入百分比计]作为膳食因素中的脂肪类别变量；谷物纤维[连续变量，每1克增量]作为纤维变量；以及维生素D[连续变量，每100国际单位增量]。

Query_Text_en: For all analyses , P [ .05 was considered statistically significant .
Translation: 所有分析中，P值小于0.05视为具有统计学意义。

Query_Text_en: A total of 3121 persons had complete colonoscopy to the cecum and have been previously described .
Translation: 共有3121人接受了完整的结肠镜检查并到达盲肠，此前已有相关描述。

Query_Text_en: Men accounted for 96.8 % of this cohort , so these results can not be generalized to women .
Translation: 该群体中男性占比高达96.8%，因此研究结论不适用于女性群体。

Query_Text_en: Patients were classified by the worst histologic lesion found in the colon .
Translation: 根据结肠中发现的最严重组织学病变对患者进行分类。

Query_Text_en: A total of 1441 patients had no polyps , 118 [ 3.8 % ] had nonadenomatous lesions , 391 [ 12.5 % ] had hyperplastic polyps , and 842 [ 27.0 % ] had 1 or more tubular adenomas less than 1 cm in diameter .
Translation: 共有1441名患者未检出息肉，118例（3.8%）存在非腺瘤性病变，391例（12.5%）发现增生性息肉，842例（27.0%）检出直径小于1厘米的管状腺瘤（单发或多发）。

Query_Text_en: Three hundred twenty-nine patients [ 10.5 % ] had at least 1 advanced neoplastic lesion in the colon and are the subject of this analysis .
Translation: 329名患者（10.5%）结肠内存在至少1处进展期肿瘤性病变，本项分析即针对该群体展开。

Query_Text_en: These patients were compared with 1441 patients who had no polyps or growths in the colon .
Translation: 这些患者与1441名结肠内未发现息肉或增生组织的患者进行了对比。

Query_Text_en: Complete medical history information was obtained for all patients .
Translation: 所有患者的完整病史资料均已获取。

Query_Text_en: Complete dietary information was obtained for 312 patients with advanced neoplasia [ 94.8 % ] and for 1359 patients with no neoplasia [ 94.3 % ] .
Translation: 在312名晚期肿瘤患者（占比94.8%）和1359名非肿瘤患者（占比94.3%）中，我们获取了完整的膳食信息。

Query_Text_en: Patients with advanced neoplasia were older than patients with no neoplasia [ 65.1 years vs 62.7 years ; P [ .001 ] .
Translation: 晚期肿瘤患者年龄显著高于未患肿瘤者（65.1岁 vs 62.7岁；P<0.001）。

Query_Text_en: All ORs are adjusted for age .
Translation: 所有比值比均经年龄校正。

Query_Text_en: The results of the age-adjusted analysis of medical history risk factors are summarized in Table 1 .
Translation: 经年龄校正后的病史风险因素分析结果汇总于表1。

Query_Text_en: Patients with at least 1 first-degree relative with colorectal cancer had an increased risk of advanced neoplasia [ OR , 1.68 ; 95 % CI , 1.21-2 .31 ] , which was higher if patients had 2 first-degree relatives with colorectal cancer .
Translation: 至少有一位一级亲属患结直肠癌的患者，其进展性肿瘤风险显著升高[比值比(OR)为1.68，95%置信区间(CI)1.21-2.31]；若患者有两位一级亲属患病，则该风险进一步上升。

Query_Text_en: There were no significant differences in risk of advanced neoplasia when whites were compared with blacks and Hispanics .
Translation: 白人与黑人和西班牙裔人群相比，晚期肿瘤发生风险无显著差异。

Query_Text_en: There was no association between body mass index and risk of advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 体重指数与晚期肿瘤风险无显著关联。

Query_Text_en: A physical activity index level of greater than 36was associated with reduced relative risk of advanced neoplasia [ OR , 0.67 ; 95 % CI , 0.49-0 .93 ] .
Translation: 当体力活动指数超过36时，晚期肿瘤形成的相对风险显著降低[比值比0.67；95%置信区间0.49-0.93]。

Query_Text_en: Metabolic equivalents per week did not demonstrate an association with risk .
Translation: 每周代谢当量水平与风险未呈现显著关联。

Query_Text_en: No differences were found in serum cholesterol levels or rates of cholecystectomy among patients with vs without advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 血清胆固醇水平或胆囊切除率在伴与不伴晚期肿瘤的患者间未发现差异。

Query_Text_en: Current smoking [ Table 1 ] was strongly associated with increased risk [ OR , 2.12 ; 95 % CI , 1.49-3 .01 ] .
Translation: 当前吸烟[表1]与风险上升呈显著相关性[比值比2.12；95%置信区间1.49-3.01]。

Query_Text_en: Risk was increased for current users who had more than 25 pack-years of smoking and for past smokers of more than 49 pack-years before cessation of smoking .
Translation: 当前吸烟者中累计吸烟量超过25包年者，以及既往吸烟者中戒烟前累计吸烟量超过49包年者，其患病风险显著上升。

Query_Text_en: Current alcohol consumption was associated with increased risk if participants were consuming an average of 1 or more alcoholic drinks per day [ OR , 2.12 ; 95 % CI , 1.44-3 .14 ] .
Translation: 若受试者日均饮酒量达到或超过1标准杯，则当前饮酒量与患病风险上升显著相关[比值比2.12；95%置信区间1.44-3.14]。

Query_Text_en: Occasional or daily use of NSAIDs was associated with a decreased risk of advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 偶尔或日常使用非甾体抗炎药可降低晚期肿瘤发生风险。

Query_Text_en: When the duration of use was analyzed as a continuous variable , the age-adjusted OR for advanced neoplasia was strongly associated with increased duration of use [ OR , 0.83 for 10 years of use ; 95 % CI , 0.73-0 .95 ] .
Translation: 当使用时长作为连续变量分析时，年龄校正后的晚期肿瘤风险比值比与用药时长呈显著正相关[每用药10年的OR值为0.83；95%置信区间0.73-0.95]。

Query_Text_en: Dietary variables were adjusted for age , total energy consumption , and medical history risk factors [ TABLE 2 ] .
Translation: 饮食变量已根据年龄、总能量摄入量及病史风险因素进行校正（见表2）。

Query_Text_en: Total animal fat consumption had a weak , nonsignificant association with advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 动物脂肪总摄入量与晚期肿瘤仅存在微弱且无统计学意义的关联。

Query_Text_en: A stronger association was observed for the highest quintile of fat intake derived from red meat .
Translation: 红肉来源脂肪摄入量最高五分位数组的相关性更为显著。

Query_Text_en: Participants who consumed beef , pork , or lamb as a main dish 5 or more times per week had an increased relative risk of advanced neoplasia compared with those who did not consume these products [ OR , 2.73 ; 95 % CI , 1.05-3 .63 ] .
Translation: 每周将牛羊肉或猪肉作为主菜食用5次以上的参与者，其进展性肿瘤的相对发病风险较不食用者显著升高[比值比2.73；95%置信区间1.05-3.63]。

Query_Text_en: Among the components of fiber in-take , only cereal fiber was associated with a reduced relative risk of advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 在膳食纤维的各类成分中，仅谷物纤维与降低晚期肿瘤相对风险存在关联。

Query_Text_en: Statistically significant reductions in relative risk of advanced neoplasia were found with increased intake of total calcium , total folate , and vitamin Din the highest quintile compared with the lowest quintile .
Translation: 与最低五分位数组相比，最高五分位数组的总钙、总叶酸和维生素D摄入量可使晚期肿瘤相对风险出现统计学显著降低。

Query_Text_en: Daily consumption of multivitamins was associated with a significant reduction in risk [ OR , 0.75 ; 95 % CI , 0.56-0 .99 ] .
Translation: 每日服用复合维生素可使患病风险显著降低[比值比0.75；95%置信区间0.56-0.99]。

Query_Text_en: There were no risk variables that distinguished the 2 groups except for past and current smoking .
Translation: 除既往及当前吸烟史外，两组间未发现其他具有区分度的风险变量。

Query_Text_en: Past [ OR , 1.65 ; 95 % CI , 1.23-2 .23 ] and current [ OR , 2.71 ; 95 % CI , 1.93-3 .81 ] smokers had a significantly increased risk of hyperplastic polyps compared with polyp-free controls .
Translation: 与无息肉对照组相比，既往吸烟者[OR=1.65；95%CI 1.23-2.23]和当前吸烟者[OR=2.71；95%CI 1.93-3.81]发生增生性息肉的风险显著增加。

Query_Text_en: Daily use of NS AIDs was associated with a decreased OR for hyperplastic polyps [ OR , 0.75 ; 95 % CI , 0.56-0 .99 ] .
Translation: 每日服用非甾体抗炎药可降低增生性息肉发病风险[比值比0.75，95%置信区间0.56-0.99]。

Query_Text_en: When we compared risk variables in patients with hyperplastic polyps with patients with advanced neoplasia , results were generally similar to those in patients with no polyps .
Translation: 将增生性息肉患者与晚期肿瘤患者的风险变量进行对比时，结果总体上与无息肉患者的情况相似。

Query_Text_en: Increased age was associated with increased risk of advanced neoplasia , and higher intake of vitamin D and multivitamins was associated with a lower risk .
Translation: 年龄增长与晚期肿瘤风险升高相关，而维生素D和复合维生素摄入量较高则与风险降低相关。

Query_Text_en: Other associations were not statistically significant .
Translation: 其余关联性在统计学上均不显著。

Query_Text_en: A multivariate model including each medical history factor and 1 factor from each of the dietary groups was developed [ TABLE 4 ] .
Translation: 我们构建了一个多变量模型，该模型纳入了各项病史因素以及各饮食组别中的一个代表性因素[见表4]。

Query_Text_en: Dietary variables were selected statistically by within-category stepwise regression .
Translation: 膳食变量通过类别内逐步回归法进行统计筛选。

Query_Text_en: This analysis identified cereal fiber , vitamin D , and beef \/ pork\/lamb as main dish [ as percentage of total energy intake ] to be the best candidates for the model .
Translation: 该分析确定谷物纤维、维生素D以及以牛肉/猪肉/羊肉为主菜的[占总能量摄入百分比]是最适合纳入模型的候选因素。

Query_Text_en: In the multivariate analysis , factors associated with a significantly increased risk of advanced neoplasia were family history , current smoking , and moderate to heavy current alcohol use .
Translation: 多变量分析显示，家族病史、当前吸烟及中重度饮酒与进展期肿瘤风险显著升高相关。

Query_Text_en: Risk factors associated with a significantly decreased risk of advanced neoplasia were use of NSAIDs , cereal fiber intake , and vitamin D.
Translation: 与非晚期肿瘤风险显著降低相关的因素包括非甾体抗炎药使用、谷物纤维摄入量以及维生素D水平。

Query_Text_en: Vitamin D dominated total calcium and folate intake in the multivariate analysis .
Translation: 多元分析显示，维生素D摄入量对钙和叶酸总摄入量具有决定性影响。

Query_Text_en: Higher levels of physical activity were associated with a marginal non-statistically significant reduction in risk .
Translation: 较高水平的体力活动与风险略有降低相关，但这一关联未达到统计学显著性。

Query_Text_en: The current study is the first cross-sectional study to assess a wide range of risk factors for advanced colonic neoplasia in asymptomatic individuals who have had a complete colon examination .
Translation: 本研究首次采用横断面研究方法，针对接受过完整结肠镜检查的无症状人群，系统评估了多种导致晚期结肠肿瘤病变的风险因素。

Query_Text_en: The choice of advanced colonic neoplasia as the study end point was designed to identify risk factors in the patients most likely to develop malignancy , with the goal of developing preventive strategies .
Translation: 本研究选择晚期结肠肿瘤作为观察终点，旨在识别最可能恶化的患者风险因素，以制定预防策略。

Query_Text_en: This end point has some limitations since many patients with advanced neoplasia will not develop colon cancer in their lifetime .
Translation: 这一终点指标存在局限性，因为许多晚期肿瘤患者终其一生并不会发展为结肠癌。

Query_Text_en: Several risk factors were not informative .
Translation: 若干风险因素未提供有效信息。

Query_Text_en: Prior studies have found weak associations between colorectal neoplasia risk and bodymass index , serum cholesterol level , and prior cholecystectomy .
Translation: 既往研究发现，结直肠肿瘤风险与体重指数、血清胆固醇水平及既往胆囊切除术之间的关联性较弱。

Query_Text_en: These variables were not significantly associated with advanced colonic neoplasia in our study , but modest associations can not be excluded .
Translation: 本研究中这些变量与进展期结肠肿瘤无显著相关性，但尚不能完全排除其存在微弱关联的可能性。

Query_Text_en: There was discrepancy between the results of 2 indexes used to assess physical activity .
Translation: 两项用于评估身体活动的指标结果存在差异。

Query_Text_en: Patients who scored in the higher range of the physical activity index , with either longer periods of mild exercise or some heavy activity , had a lower age-adjusted risk of advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 在体育活动指数中得分较高的患者——无论是进行较长时间的轻度锻炼还是参与一定强度的剧烈运动——其经年龄调整后的晚期肿瘤发病风险均呈现下降趋势。

Query_Text_en: There was no difference in risk across quintiles of the metabolic equivalent score .
Translation: 代谢当量评分的五分位数间风险无差异。

Query_Text_en: These findings suggest that individuals may be just as likely to benefit from long periods of mild physical activity as from shorter periods of heavy activity .
Translation: 研究结果表明，长时间轻度体力活动与短时间高强度运动对个体的健康效益可能相当。

Query_Text_en: In the multivariate analysis , physical activity had a marginal , non-statistically significant benefit .
Translation: 多变量分析显示，体育锻炼的益处有限，且未达到统计学显著性。

Query_Text_en: The relationship of dietary fat and fiber and colorectal neoplasia is uncertain .
Translation: 膳食脂肪和纤维摄入量与结直肠肿瘤的关联性尚不明确。

Query_Text_en: Our analysis found no significant increase in risk of advanced neoplasia associated with total fat and a marginal , nonsignificant increase associated with fat derived from red meat sources .
Translation: 我们的分析发现，总脂肪摄入量与晚期肿瘤风险无显著关联，而红肉来源脂肪仅与风险存在微弱且无统计学意义的上升趋势。

Query_Text_en: Although we did not find a strong relationship between fat and advanced adenomas , we can not exclude the possibility that dietary fat may promote malignant change in precursor adenomas , thus leading to higher rates of cancer .
Translation: 尽管我们未发现脂肪与晚期腺瘤之间存在显著关联，但不能排除膳食脂肪可能促使前期腺瘤恶变，从而导致癌症发病率升高的可能性。

Query_Text_en: The current data show that among the fiber variables , the highest quintiles of cereal fiber intake were associated with lower risk of advanced neoplasia in the univariate model , and the relationship remained after adjustments in the multivariate model .
Translation: 现有数据显示，在膳食纤维变量中，谷类纤维摄入量最高五分位数组与晚期肿瘤风险降低存在单变量模型关联，且该关联性在多变量模型调整后依然显著。

Query_Text_en: Prior interventional studies with fiber have failed to demonstrate a protective effect over a 3 - to 4-year study period .
Translation: 先前关于膳食纤维的干预性研究未能证明其在3至4年研究周期内具有保护作用。

Query_Text_en: However , these studies used any adenoma [ large or small ] as an end point and evaluated a short period of intervention .
Translation: 然而，这些研究以任意腺瘤（无论大小）作为终点指标，且干预周期较短。

Query_Text_en: Our results do not necessarily conflict with these studies .
Translation: 我们的研究结果未必与这些研究相矛盾。

Query_Text_en: Our data suggest that higher intake of cereal fiber over a long period may protect against development of advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 我们的数据显示，长期摄入较高谷物纤维可能有助于预防晚期肿瘤的发生。

Query_Text_en: Vitamin D emerged as an important protective factor .
Translation: 维生素D是一项重要的保护性因素。

Query_Text_en: Several prior studies have suggested that vitamin D and , in particular , its active form [ 1,25-hydroxyvitamin D ] exerts an antiproliferative effect on colonic mucosa in vitro , and several clinical studies have suggested a beneficial effect .
Translation: 此前多项研究表明，维生素D（尤其是其活性形式[1,25-羟基维生素D]）在体外对结肠黏膜具有抗增殖作用，若干临床研究也证实其存在积极疗效。

Query_Text_en: Some prior studies have found amarginal benefit from calcium supplementation in the prevention of adenomas .
Translation: 此前一些研究发现，补钙对预防腺瘤仅有边际效益。

Query_Text_en: In our multivariate analysis , dietary vitamin D dominated calcium as a beneficial risk factor .
Translation: 在多变量分析中，膳食维生素D作为有益风险因素的作用显著优于钙元素。

Query_Text_en: We did not measure sunlight exposure in our patients , which can influence 25-hydroxyvitamin D levels .
Translation: 本研究未对患者日照时长进行测定，而日照因素可能影响25-羟基维生素D水平。

Query_Text_en: These data suggest that vitamin D may be an important protective factor , and further study is warranted to determine the relative contributions of diet vs sunlight .
Translation: 这些数据表明，维生素D可能是一种重要的保护性因素，有必要开展进一步研究以确定膳食摄入与阳光照射各自的作用程度。

Query_Text_en: The impact of total folate and daily multivitamin intake are difficult to separate in the analysis ; both factors were associated with a protective effect in the univariate analysis .
Translation: 在分析中，总叶酸摄入量与每日复合维生素的影响难以区分；单变量分析显示，这两个因素均具有保护作用。

Query_Text_en: We found that a history of 1 or more first-degree relatives with colorectal cancer is strongly associated with advanced neoplasia , confirming results from many other studies .
Translation: 我们发现，一级亲属中有一位或以上结直肠癌病史与晚期肿瘤形成存在显著关联，这一结论与多项其他研究结果相互印证。

Query_Text_en: When we compared the risk of advanced neoplasia in participants with family members diagnosed as having cancer either before or after age 60 years , we did not find a significant difference .
Translation: 在比较家族成员60岁前后确诊癌症的受试者罹患晚期肿瘤风险时，我们未发现显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , our data reinforce recommendations to treat all patients who have a first-degree relative with colorectal cancer as a high-risk group and offer screening with colonoscopy .
Translation: 因此，我们的数据进一步支持将直系亲属患结直肠癌的所有患者视为高风险人群的建议，并应为其提供结肠镜检查筛查服务。

Query_Text_en: Current cigarette smoking and consumption of more than 7 drinks of alcohol per week were strongly associated with increased risk , consistent with prior studies .
Translation: 当前吸烟及每周饮酒超过7杯与患病风险显著上升密切相关，这一发现与既往研究结论一致。

Query_Text_en: Although the physiologic mechanisms are unclear , these data provide further reason for health care practitioners to advise smoking cessation and moderation of alcohol consumption .
Translation: 尽管其生理机制尚不明确，但该数据为医疗从业者提供了新的依据，建议患者戒烟并适度饮酒。

Query_Text_en: Participants taking NSAIDs on a regular basis had a lower risk of advanced neoplasia compared with those who did not use these drugs , consistent with many prior studies .
Translation: 与未服用此类药物者相比，定期服用非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）的受试者罹患晚期肿瘤的风险更低，这与既往多项研究结论一致。

Query_Text_en: There was a strong relationship between duration of drug exposure and reduction in risk .
Translation: 药物暴露时长与风险降低呈显著相关性。

Query_Text_en: This study precedes the availability of the cyclooxygenase-2 inhibitor drugs , which have been shown to reduce the development of adenomas in patients with familial polyposis .
Translation: 本研究开展时尚无环氧化酶-2抑制剂类药物可供使用，而后续研究表明该药物可抑制家族性息肉病患者的腺瘤发展。

Query_Text_en: More than 80 % of our participants already were taking aspirin as prophylaxis for cardiovascular disease or other NSAIDs for arthritis and pain .
Translation: 超过80%的参与者已在服用阿司匹林预防心血管疾病，或使用其他非甾体抗炎药治疗关节炎和疼痛。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , there are potential harms .
Translation: 此外，还存在潜在危害。

Query_Text_en: The risk of peptic ulcer disease and gastrointestinal bleeding and other health effects must be balanced against the potential benefits .
Translation: 必须权衡消化性溃疡、胃肠道出血及其他健康风险与潜在益处之间的利弊关系。

Query_Text_en: The decision to begin therapy with aspirin or other NSAIDs solely for reduction of risk of colonic neoplasia requires further study .
Translation: 仅以降低结肠肿瘤风险为目的而开始使用阿司匹林或其他非甾体抗炎药的治疗方案，仍需进一步研究论证。

Query_Text_en: In a secondary analysis , we determined risk factors in patients whose most serious colonic lesions were 1 or more hyperplastic polyps .
Translation: 在二次分析中，我们针对结肠最严重病变为1个或多个增生性息肉的患者群体，确定了相关风险因素。

Query_Text_en: Most guidelines regard hyperplastic polyps as benign , and several large screening studies have found that distal hyperplastic polyps are not risk factors for proximal neoplasia .
Translation: 多数诊疗指南认为增生性息肉属于良性病变，多项大型筛查研究亦证实远端增生性息肉不会增加近端肿瘤发生风险。

Query_Text_en: We hypothesized that if hyperplastic polyps are incidental , nonneoplastic growths , patients with hyperplastic polyps should closely resemble patients with no polyps .
Translation: 我们假设，若增生性息肉属于偶发的非肿瘤性赘生物，那么增生性息肉患者应与无息肉患者的临床特征高度相似。

Query_Text_en: No prior study has determined if there are any distinguishing risk variables for hyperplastic polyps .
Translation: 此前尚无研究确定是否存在增生性息肉的特异性风险变量。

Query_Text_en: Our results suggest that patients with only hyperplastic polyps are similar to polyp-free controls .
Translation: 研究结果表明，仅患增生性息肉的患者与无息肉对照组情况相似。

Query_Text_en: Only past or current smoking emerged as a significant risk factor .
Translation: 仅过去或现在吸烟成为显著风险因素。

Query_Text_en: This is of interest because smoking is the only risk factor associated with both hyperplastic polyps and advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 这具有重要研究价值，因为吸烟是唯一同时与增生性息肉和进展性肿瘤相关的风险因素。

Query_Text_en: Smoking may promote DNA hypermethylation , and development of advanced adenomas may depend on methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase genotype .
Translation: 吸烟可能促使DNA发生高甲基化，而进展性腺瘤的发展可能与亚甲基四氢叶酸还原酶基因型相关。

Query_Text_en: When we compared the advanced neoplasia cohort to patients with hyperplastic polyps , we found that higher intake of vitamin D intake and multivitamins was associated with a lower risk of advanced neoplasia .
Translation: 将晚期肿瘤患者与增生性息肉患者进行对比后发现，维生素D和复合维生素摄入量较高者发生晚期肿瘤的风险较低。

Query_Text_en: Other differences were not statistically significant .
Translation: 其余差异在统计学上并不显著。

Query_Text_en: Since this was a secondary analysis , our study was not powered to detect such differences .
Translation: 由于本次研究属于二次分析，我们的样本量不足以检测此类差异。

Query_Text_en: In addition , patients with advanced neoplasia as their worst lesions may also have hyperplastic polyps , creating some overlap between groups .
