Query_Text_en: The idea of robots -- -- if not the things themselves -- -- has inspired human affection ever since the Tin Man lamented his lack of a heart in `` The Wizard of Oz . ''
Translation: 自《绿野仙踪》中的铁皮人哀叹自己缺少一颗心以来，机器人概念——即便不是实体本身——就始终激发着人类的情感共鸣。

Query_Text_en: But in spite of the appeal of fictional metal men , robot reality has been pretty mundane .
Translation: 然而，尽管金属机器人的虚构形象颇具吸引力，现实中的机器人技术发展却相当平淡。

Query_Text_en: But things are changing ï¼ In 1990 , U. S. robot manufacturers had their best year since 1984 , shipping more than $ 517.4 million worth of robotic devices .
Translation: 然而形势正在发生变化：1990年成为自1984年以来美国机器人制造商最辉煌的一年，其出货的机器人设备总值超过5.174亿美元。

Query_Text_en: And while most of the machines are built for the auto industry , a new generation of nimble , ultrasophisticated medical robots is emerging that could eventually Wend its way into the human heart -- quite literally .
Translation: 尽管多数机器人专为汽车制造业打造，新一代灵巧精密的医疗机器人正崭露头角——它们终将真正进入人类心脏实施手术。

Query_Text_en: There is palpable excitement in the medical community over fast-developing `` medibots '' that may soon aid in everything from complicated neurological surgery to human hip replacement .
Translation: 医学界对快速发展的"医疗机器人"充满期待，这些机器人可能很快将应用于从复杂神经外科手术到人工髋关节置换等各类医疗场景。

Query_Text_en: Dr. James Zinreich , a neuroradiologist at Johns Hopkins University in Baltimore , Maryland , is a pioneer in the use of robots in the operating room One of the first to use computerized three-dimensional medical imaging , Zinreich has been working with ISG Technology in Toronto to develop a sensor called a viewing wand that lets surgeons see inside a human skull during brain surgery .
Translation: 马里兰州巴尔的摩市约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的神经放射学家詹姆斯·津里奇博士是手术室机器人应用领域的先驱。作为首批采用计算机三维医学成像技术的专家之一，津里奇一直与多伦多ISG科技公司合作开发名为"观察棒"的传感器，该设备能让外科医生在脑部手术时实时观察患者颅内部位。

Query_Text_en: The system , which uses computer imaging and consists of a computerized workstation and a six-joined mechanical arm attached to the operating table , presages a potential breakthrough in both neurosurgery and sinus surgery .
Translation: 该系统采用计算机成像技术，由计算机化工作站和连接手术台的六关节机械臂组成，预示着神经外科与鼻窦手术领域或将取得重大突破。

Query_Text_en: During surgery , the doctor moves the wand , which is attached to the mechanical arm , into the opened skull .
Translation: 手术过程中，医生将连接在机械臂上的探针移入已打开的颅腔内。

Query_Text_en: In so doing , a three-dimensional computer model of the patient 's skull appears to peel away layer by layer , as the tip of the probe moves past bone and soft tissue .
Translation: 此时，随着探针尖端穿过骨骼与软组织，患者颅骨的三维计算机模型会逐层剥离显现。

Query_Text_en: In addition , stop-action three-dimensional images can be made with views magnified or altered to show any perspective .
Translation: 此外，定格三维图像可通过放大或调整视角来呈现任意观察角度。

Query_Text_en: The system is in its investigative stages at Johns Hopkins .
Translation: 约翰·霍普金斯大学目前正处于该系统的研究阶段。

Query_Text_en: Zinreich has used it on fewer than a dozen patients thus far , but he believes the system holds great promise .
Translation: 迄今为止，津瑞奇医生仅对不足十二例患者应用了该技术，但他坚信这套系统具有广阔的应用前景。

Query_Text_en: `` The most important thing it does is allow you to stop and check yourself for positional accuracy when you get into a particular area , '' he says .
Translation: 他表示："其最重要的功能是，当您进入特定区域时，能让您停下来检查自身定位是否准确。"

Query_Text_en: `` In brain surgery , for example , if you have a tumor embedded in the brain tissue it is not the easiest thing to localize exactly where the tumor is and from what perspective to approach it .
Translation: 以脑外科手术为例，若肿瘤深嵌于脑组织中，精确定位病灶位置并确定最佳手术入路角度并非易事。

Query_Text_en: According to Bruce Leggett , the project manager at ISG who developed the viewing wand , one of the benefits of the sensor is that it enables surgeons to make smaller incisions into the skull .
Translation: ISG公司项目经理布鲁斯·莱格特开发了这种观察棒，他表示该传感器的优势之一在于能让外科医生在颅骨上实施更小切口。

Query_Text_en: While a typical craniotomy is about 10 centimeters , doctors can cut that down by more than two-thirds , to roughly three centimeters .
Translation: 传统开颅手术切口通常为10厘米，而医生可将其缩短三分之二以上，降至约3厘米。

Query_Text_en: Smaller boles mean less risk of complications as well as reducing the duration of surgery by as much as half .
Translation: 创口更小意味着并发症风险更低，同时可将手术时长缩短多达一半。

Query_Text_en: In addition to its applications in neurosurgery , the viewing wand is being abated fir use in extremely delicate sinus surgery , which has a high risk of complication because of the complex anatomy of the sinuses and their proximity to the brain .
Translation: 除应用于神经外科手术外，该导航系统还被用于高风险的精细鼻窦手术——由于鼻窦解剖结构复杂且毗邻大脑，此类手术极易引发并发症。

Query_Text_en: During such procedures the sinuses are usually examined through a thin viewing device called an endoscope , which is inserted through a nostril .
Translation: 在此类手术过程中，通常通过一种名为内窥镜的细长观察设备检查鼻窦，该设备经由鼻腔置入。

Query_Text_en: Zinreich and ISG are working toward adapting the wand so it can be positioned at the tip of the endoscope .
Translation: Zinreich与ISG正致力于改进该探测棒，使其能够固定于内窥镜顶端。

Query_Text_en: To keep the wand positioned properly , the Zinrech-ISG team is developing a `` head holder '' and `` head follower '' that will readjust if an unanesthetized patient should inadvertently move his head during the operation .
Translation: 为确保探针定位准确，Zinrech-ISG团队正在研发"头部固定器"与"头部追踪器"装置，可在未麻醉患者术中意外移动头部时自动校准位置。

Query_Text_en: In Toronto , James Drake , a pediatric neurosurgeon , has been using a similar system to aid in the removal of brain tumors in children , a procedure considered extremely risky .
Translation: 多伦多儿科神经外科医生詹姆斯·德雷克采用同类系统辅助儿童脑瘤切除手术，该手术被公认为具有极高风险性。

Query_Text_en: Drake , using robotics-assisted surgery , has been able to remove tumors from , three children whose prior surgery was unsuccessful .
Translation: 德雷克采用机器人辅助手术，成功为三名此前手术未获成效的儿童切除了肿瘤。

Query_Text_en: He says he occasionally treats children with tumors that `` do n't respond well to radiation and chemotherapy , and in the past they were regarded as not being surgically acceptable .
Translation: 他表示，自己偶尔会接诊一些对放疗和化疗反应不佳的肿瘤患儿，这类病例在过去被认为不适合手术治疗。

Query_Text_en: Now with the robot arm and imaging system you can actually see what you are doing all of the time .
Translation: 如今借助机械臂和成像系统，操作者能够全程实时掌握作业动态。

Query_Text_en: Drake 's system is similar to that used by Zinreich , in that it allows the surgeon a virtually unobstructed view of the interior of the that patient 's skull using a computer imaging system , while the surgeon performs the operation .
Translation: 德雷克的系统与津里希所采用的类似，其通过计算机成像技术使外科医生在手术过程中能近乎无阻碍地观察患者颅腔内部。

Query_Text_en: But while neither Drake nor Zinreich has used robots to actually perform surgery , another team of doctors , computer specialists and a veterinarian in Southern California have gone one step beyond and built a robot that has already performed hip replacement surgery on dogs .
Translation: 然而，尽管德雷克和津里奇尚未将机器人实际应用于外科手术，但南加州另一支由医生、计算机专家和兽医组成的团队已更进一步——他们研发的机器人已成功为犬类实施了髋关节置换手术。

Query_Text_en: Robodoc .
Translation: 机器人医生

Query_Text_en: And although the good robodoctor has not had any human patients yet , its developers are hoping that with U. S. Food and Drug Administration -LRB- FDA -RRB- approval in the offing Robotic could be performing its first human hip transplant surgery very soon .
Translation: 尽管这位优秀的机器人医生尚未接诊过人类患者，但其研发团队预计，随着美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的批准即将到来，该机器人很快就能实施首例人类髋关节置换手术。

Query_Text_en: Not bad for a machine born out of high-technology frustration .
Translation: 对于一台诞生于高科技挫折中的机器来说，这已属难能可贵。

Query_Text_en: California veterinarian Howard Paul , who doubles as a professor of orthopedics at the University of California at Davis , and Sacramento orthopedic surgeon William Bragger were frustrated by the fact that , while they could design a sophisticated cements titanium hip replacement using a state-he-art computer system , the procedure for inserting the replacement is to say the least , somewhat primitive .
Translation: 加州兽医兼戴维斯加州大学骨科教授霍华德·保罗与萨克拉门托骨科医生威廉·布拉格深感困扰：尽管他们能运用尖端计算机系统设计出精密的骨水泥钛合金髋关节假体，但植入手术的操作方法却仍显原始。

Query_Text_en: In preparation for replacing the hip , surgeons hammer a large spike into the femur in the shape of the implant , an inexact method in which the bone sometimes cracks from the pressure of the hammering .
Translation: 为准备髋关节置换手术，医生需将一根与植入体形状匹配的大型骨钉锤入股骨。这种传统方法精确度不足，锤击压力有时会导致骨裂。

Query_Text_en: Bragger , whose father was lifelong employee of International Business Machines Corp. -LRB- IBM -RRB- , took the idea to the company 's research division , which prickly decided to take on the project .
Translation: 布拉格的父亲是国际商业机器公司（IBM）的终身雇员，他将这一构想提交至公司研发部门，该部门经过审慎考量后决定承接该项目。

Query_Text_en: An engineering team headed by Bela Musits constructed the robot while Paul worked with computer programmers at IBM ' S Palo Alto , California , research center to develop the program that communicates with the robot .
Translation: 由贝拉·穆西茨领导的工程团队负责机器人硬件研发，与此同时保罗与IBM加州帕洛阿尔托研究中心的计算机程序员合作开发了与机器人交互的通信程序。

Query_Text_en: While Robodoc has yet to receive FDA approval for human hip replacement surgery , Paul and Bargar have used the machine to perform hip replacements on 18canines .
Translation: 尽管Robodoc尚未获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准用于人类髋关节置换手术，但保罗和巴格尔已使用该设备为18只犬类实施了髋关节置换术。

Query_Text_en: `` The results have been very good , '' Paul says . `` We are very pleased with how things are going .
Translation: "成果相当喜人，"保罗表示，"我们对当前进展非常满意。"

Query_Text_en: The procedure itself uses much of the same technology used by Zinreich and Drake .
Translation: 该手术本身采用了与津里希和德雷克相同的技术手段。

Query_Text_en: First , three calibrating pins are placed on the patient 's femur . Then a CAT scan provides the surgeons with a three-dimensional view of the bone on the computer screen .
Translation: 首先，在患者股骨上放置三根校准针。随后，计算机断层扫描将骨骼的三维图像呈现在手术医生的电脑屏幕上。

Query_Text_en: The surgeon can then use the computer program to help select an emollient of the correct size .
Translation: 随后，外科医生可借助计算机程序辅助选取尺寸适宜的栓塞剂。

Query_Text_en: The program enables the surgeon to view an image of the bone to be replaced and then digitally place the implant over the image to check its potential fit After choosing the right implant the surgeon can then open up the leg , remove the femur for the hip socket , saw off its head and replace the arthritic socket with a titanium one .
Translation: 该程序使外科医生能够查看待替换骨骼的影像，通过数字化方式将植入物覆盖在影像上以评估其适配度。选定合适植入物后，医生即可实施腿部手术：取出髋臼处的股骨，锯除股骨头，并用钛合金关节臼替换病变的髋臼部位。

Query_Text_en: Robodoc then clamps the patient ' s leg while its probe touches the calibrating pins , which , like Zinreich 's wand , allow the probe to locate itself in relation to the bone and the computer image .
Translation: 随后，机器人医生会固定住患者腿部，同时其探针接触校准定位针。这些定位针与津里奇使用的定位棒功能相同，能使探针根据骨骼位置和计算机图像实现精确定位。

Query_Text_en: Neat Robotic is fitted with a small high-speed drill , which bores out a hole using the computer diagram as its guide .
Translation: Neat Robotic配备了一台小型高速钻机，可根据计算机图示引导精准钻孔。

Query_Text_en: After the hole is drilled , the implant is inserted , a titanium ball is snapped on , and Robodoc heads out to play 18 holes of golf , none the worse for wear .
Translation: 钻孔完成后，植入体被置入，钛合金球头随即扣合。机器人医生完成操作后毫发无损地离开，还能去打上18洞高尔夫。

Query_Text_en: OK , so it does n't play golf .
Translation: 好的，所以它不打高尔夫。

Query_Text_en: What Robodoc 's creators do hope is that it not only will be useful in performing hip replacement surgery but will have other applications as well .
Translation: "Robodoc"研发团队的真正期望是，该机器人不仅能在髋关节置换手术中发挥作用，还能拓展至其他医疗应用领域。

Query_Text_en: `` We really are hoping that it can be adapted to do things like knee replacements and other sports-related medicine , '' says Paul .
Translation: 保罗表示："我们衷心希望这项技术能应用于膝关节置换等运动医学治疗领域。"

Query_Text_en: Paul and Bargar hope to get FDA approval soon .
Translation: 保罗和巴加尔希望尽快获得美国食品药品监督管理局的批准。

Query_Text_en: After that , they will begin placing Robodocs in various hospitals for clinical trials .
Translation: 此后，他们将开始在多家医院部署机器人医生进行临床试验。

Query_Text_en: `` One of the things that we are looking at is having different adaptations made for Robodoc at the different clinical sites where it will be located , '' Paul says .
Translation: 保罗表示："我们正在考虑的一个方案是，针对机器人医生将要入驻的不同临床站点，为其制定差异化的适配方案。"

Query_Text_en: Robodoc was introduced to other physicians at a recent meeting of the American Orthopedics Association in Anaheim , California .
Translation: 在加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市举行的美国骨科协会最近一次会议上，"机器人医生"系统向其他医师进行了推介。

Query_Text_en: Rather than being put off by the mechanical surgeon , Paul says that most of the doctors who saw Robodoc were quite impressed .
Translation: 保罗表示，目睹机器人医生操作的多数医师非但未感排斥，反而对其印象深刻。

Query_Text_en: `` We 've been showing it around for the first time , and the reaction has been very surprising to us , '' says Paul .
Translation: 保罗表示："这是我们首次对外展示，各方的反响令我们倍感意外。"

Query_Text_en: `` A lot of doctors really are responding very positively toward it .
Translation: 许多医生对此反应确实非常积极。

Query_Text_en: Not too surprisingly considering the statistics .
Translation: 考虑到统计数据，这一结果并不太令人意外。

Query_Text_en: Hip replacement surgery is the single most frequent joint replacement surgery in the United States , with about 160,000 done annually , according to Paul .
Translation: 据统计，保罗表示，髋关节置换术是美国最常见且年度手术量达到约16万例的关节置换手术。

Query_Text_en: Nearly 25,000 of those are repeat replacements -- -- repeats that could be avoided if a more accurate type of surgery were developed , and Robodoc may just provide what the doctor is looking for .
Translation: 其中近2.5万例属于重复置换手术——若能开发出更精准的手术方式，这类重复手术本可避免。而机器人医生或许正是医疗界梦寐以求的解决方案。

Query_Text_en: Paul is careful not to make unproven claims for Robodoc .
Translation: 保罗谨慎避免对机器人医生作出未经证实的断言。

Query_Text_en: But the device has been so successful that the bone has made contact with the artificial joint 97 percent of the time , with gaps between the bone and replacement measuring only 0.05 millimeter , a very good fit by any standard .
Translation: 然而该装置成效卓著，骨骼与人工关节的接触率达到97%，骨关节与置换体间隙仅为0.05毫米，这一适配精度在任何标准下都堪称完美。

Query_Text_en: What robots like those developed by Zinreich and Paul have as yet been unable to do is soft tissue surgery .
Translation: 齐恩赖希和保罗研发的这类机器人迄今仍无法完成软组织手术。

Query_Text_en: The current computer-aided imaging systems need a bony structure to create their three-dimensional images .
Translation: 现有计算机辅助成像系统需依赖骨性结构生成三维图像。

Query_Text_en: However , many say that the innovations necessary for such surgery to be assisted or performed by robots are only a few years off .
Translation: 然而，许多人认为，实现机器人辅助或实施此类手术所需的技术突破仅需数年即可达成。

Query_Text_en: In the meantime , the use of robotics in medicine is likely to expand into other areas .
Translation: 与此同时，机器人技术在医疗领域的应用有望拓展至其他领域。

Query_Text_en: For more than 30 years , individual enthusiasts have been searching for signals from other intelligent life .
Translation: 三十余年来，众多民间爱好者一直在搜寻来自其他智慧生命的信号。

Query_Text_en: Now , NASA is throwing its technological might behind the effort .
Translation: 如今，美国国家航空航天局正全力投入这项技术攻关。

Query_Text_en: Next Monday , two large radio telescopes connected to powerful computers will simultaneously be pointed towards an obscure star in the constellation Ophiuchus .
Translation: 下周一，两台连接着高性能计算机的大型射电望远镜将同步对准蛇夫座中一颗不起眼的恒星。

Query_Text_en: This event is the start of NASA 's 10-year programme to pick up the first radio signals from an alien civilization NASA researchers believe contact with other intelligent life will be one of the most significant events in the history of the human race .
Translation: 此次事件标志着美国国家航空航天局（NASA）一项为期十年的探测计划正式启动，旨在捕捉外星文明发出的首批无线电信号。NASA研究人员认为，与其他智慧生命建立联系将成为人类历史上最具里程碑意义的事件之一。

Query_Text_en: SETI , the $ 100-million search for extra-terrestrial intelligence , is the culmination of three decades of smaller scale searches that have been funded largely from university grants and private donations Frank Drake , an American radio astronomer , made the first SETI observations in 1960 .
Translation: 耗资1亿美元的"搜寻地外文明计划"（SETI）是三十年来主要由大学拨款和私人捐助支持的小规模探索的巅峰成果。美国射电天文学家弗兰克·德雷克于1960年首次开展了该计划的观测工作。

Query_Text_en: He looked at radio signals from two nearby stars while studying interstellar gas with a radio telescope at Greenbank , West Virginia .
Translation: 他在西弗吉尼亚州格林班克用射电望远镜研究星际气体时，观测了来自附近两颗恒星的无线电信号。

Query_Text_en: Ten years later , John Billing ham from NASA ' S Ames Research Center near San Francisco convened a workshop on SETI .
Translation: 十年后，美国宇航局位于旧金山附近的艾姆斯研究中心的约翰·比林汉姆召开了一次关于搜寻地外文明计划的研讨会。

Query_Text_en: Barney Oliver , a vice-president of the American computer company Hewlett-Packard , led the team which devised Project Cyclops : a set of 1000 linked radio telescopes , which would have cost over $ 6 billion .
Translation: 美国惠普公司副总裁巴尼·奥利弗领衔设计了"独眼巨人计划"——该方案拟建造1000台互联射电望远镜阵列，预算超过60亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Although Cyclops was too expensive to be funded , BILLINGHAM AND Oliver spent the following two decades persuading and cajoling scientists and politicians to take SETI seriously .
Translation: 尽管"独眼巨人计划"因耗资过高未能获得资助，但比林厄姆与奥利弗仍耗费了二十年时间，不断游说科学家与政界人士，力图使地外文明搜寻计划获得严肃对待。

Query_Text_en: The outcome is the current project , which NASA soberly calls the High Resolution Microwave Survey to avoid associations with flying saucers and little green men .
Translation: 最终成果就是现在的项目——美国国家航空航天局为避免与飞碟、外星人等概念产生关联，谨慎地将其命名为"高分辨率微波巡天计划"。

Query_Text_en: In the meantime , other researchers have undertaken more than 40 searches .
Translation: 与此同时，其他研究人员已开展了40余次搜寻行动。

Query_Text_en: Shortly after the Cyclops workshop , Bob Dixon of Ohio State University began a full-time search that is now the world 's longest .
Translation: 俄亥俄州立大学的鲍勃·迪克森在"独眼巨人"项目研讨会结束后不久，便启动了这项专职搜寻工作，至今已成为全球持续时间最长的地外文明搜寻行动。

Query_Text_en: He started by searching at the 1.42 gigahertz frequency emitted by hydrogen atoms -LRB- often known by its wavelength as the `` 21-centimetre line '' -RRB- .
Translation: 他最初搜寻的是氢原子释放的1.42千兆赫兹频率信号（该频段因其波长特性常被称为"21厘米谱线"）。

Query_Text_en: As hydrogen is the most abundant element in the universe , SETI researchers believe bather intelligence would logically choose this frequency to communicate .
Translation: 鉴于氢是宇宙中含量最丰富的元素，地外文明搜寻计划（SETI）的研究人员认为，高等智慧生命理应会选择这一频段进行星际通讯。

Query_Text_en: Dixon has now widened his search to cover a range of frequencies from 1.4 to 1.7 gigahertz .
Translation: 迪克森现已将搜索范围扩大至1.4至1.7千兆赫兹的频段。

Query_Text_en: The upper end of this range coincides with radiation from the hydroxyl radical .
Translation: 这一范围的上限与羟基自由基的辐射相吻合。

Query_Text_en: Because hydrogen and hydroxyl combine to make water , this frequency range is known as the cosmic water bole .
Translation: 由于氢与羟基结合会生成水，这一频段被称为宇宙水带。

Query_Text_en: The other major pioneer of SETI is Paul Horowitz of Harvard University .
Translation: 哈佛大学的保罗·霍洛维茨是搜寻地外文明计划的另一位主要先驱。

Query_Text_en: Since 1983 , he has been building receivers that tune in to only one or two `` magic frequencies '' , such as the hydrogen signal , but split the frequencies up into very narrow bands .
Translation: 自1983年起，他便致力于研制仅能接收一两个"神奇频率"（如氢信号）的接收器，并将这些频率分割成极窄的频带。

Query_Text_en: This should help him to pick out signals from intelligent life from the background of natural hydrogen emissions .
Translation: 这将有助于他从自然氢辐射背景中识别出智慧生命发出的信号。

Query_Text_en: Artificial radio signals should cover a narrow band of frequencies much smaller than l hertz .
Translation: 人工无线电信号应覆盖小于1赫兹的极窄频段。

Query_Text_en: Horowitz 's receiver splits the signals into bands 0.05 hertz in width .
Translation: 霍洛维茨的接收器将信号分割为宽度0.05赫兹的频段。

Query_Text_en: The new NASA initiative is on a much grander scale .
Translation: 美国宇航局的新计划规模更为宏大。

Query_Text_en: The team devised silicon chips which can analyse millions of frequencies simultaneously , and has developed software to search for the different kinds of signal that ET might send .
Translation: 该团队研发出可同步分析数百万频率的硅芯片，并开发出能搜寻外星文明可能发送各类信号的软件系统。

Query_Text_en: The SETI Continuous Wave Signal Detection Computer can make one billion tests per second for intelligent signals . This is equivalent to scanning the entire Encyclopaedia Britannica in one second , and picking out a specific three-word phrase .
Translation: "地外文明搜寻计划"连续波信号探测计算机每秒可执行十亿次智能信号检测，其数据处理能力相当于在一秒内完整扫描《大英百科全书》全书，并精准定位某个特定三词短语。

Query_Text_en: Researchers at Ames are making a `` targeted search '' of 1000 nearby stars , while a team at NASA ' s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena is undertaking a sky survey .
Translation: 埃姆斯研究中心正对1000颗邻近恒星进行"定向搜索"，而位于帕萨迪纳的美国宇航局喷气推进实验室团队则在进行全天区巡天观测。

Query_Text_en: The targeted search begins next week at the world ' s largest radio telescope , at Arecibo in Puerto Rico The telescope is a dish of mesh ,305 metres across , hung in a hollow in the hills .
Translation: 全球最大的射电望远镜——位于波多黎各阿雷西博的射电望远镜将于下周启动定向搜索。该望远镜采用网状抛物面设计，直径达305米，悬挂于群山环抱的凹地之中。

Query_Text_en: The dish reflects radio waves to an antenna suspended at its focus 150 metres above .
Translation: 该抛物面天线将无线电波反射至悬于其焦点上方150米处的接收天线。

Query_Text_en: Cables take the signals to a van that contains the SETI receiver .
Translation: 电缆将信号传输至装有SETI接收器的厢式货车内。

Query_Text_en: It analyses a huge band of frequencies , including the cosmic water hole , from 1 to 3 gigahertz , splitting them into two billion channels , each l hertz wide .
Translation: 该系统可分析1至3千兆赫范围内的宽广频段（包括宇宙水洞频段），并将其分割为20亿个通道，每个通道宽度仅为1赫兹。

Query_Text_en: After six weeks at Arecibo the receiver will go back to Ames in California to be tested .
Translation: 在阿雷西博工作六周后，接收器将返回加利福尼亚州艾姆斯研究中心接受检测。

Query_Text_en: The team will then fly it to the 64-metre Parkes radio telescope in Australia from where it will survey the southern part of the sky for the next decade .
Translation: 随后，研究团队将把该设备运往澳大利亚64米口径的帕克斯射电望远镜，未来十年间它将在此对南天区开展巡天观测。

Query_Text_en: For the northern part of the sky , the SETI team will shift between Arecibo and a 42-metre telescope in Greenbank until a new 100-metre radio telescope is completed there in 1996 .
Translation: 在北半球天空的观测中，SETI团队将交替使用阿雷西博射电望远镜和绿岸42米射电望远镜，直至1996年当地新建的100米射电望远镜建成投用。

Query_Text_en: The 42 metre telescope will then be freed to concentrate on SETI .
Translation: 届时，这台42米口径的望远镜将专门用于搜寻地外文明计划。

Query_Text_en: The targeted search assumes that intelligent civilizations are so common that we may find out nearest neighbors within 80 light years of the Sun .
Translation: 定向搜索基于这样一种假设：智慧文明在宇宙中如此普遍，我们甚至可能在距太阳80光年范围内找到最近的邻居。

Query_Text_en: If this is where the sky survey comes in the Galaxy , however , the nearest is probably hundreds or even thousands of light years away .
Translation: 然而，若此处即为银河系巡天所及之处，则最近者恐在数百乃至数千光年之外。

Query_Text_en: This is where the sky survey comes in .
Translation: 这正是天空勘测发挥作用之处。

Query_Text_en: The researchers from the Jet Propulsion Laboratory have been testing their sky surfer equipment since last January , so the `` switch on '' next week is something of a formality .
Translation: 美国喷气推进实验室的研究人员自去年1月起就开始测试其空中滑翔设备，因此下周的"启动"更多是一种程序性安排。

Query_Text_en: The receiver is connected to a 34-mmetre radio telescope at the Gladstone complex of telescopes in the Mojave Desert in California .
Translation: 该接收器与加利福尼亚州莫哈韦沙漠格莱斯顿望远镜阵列中一台34米射电望远镜相连接。

Query_Text_en: By the beginning of the next century , SETI telescopes may have to be built on the far side of the Moon if they are to have any chance of hearing our interstellar neighbors through the noise .
Translation: 到下世纪初，如果还想有机会在干扰中接收到星际邻居的信号，射电望远镜可能就不得不建造在月球背面了。

Query_Text_en: Oliver reckons this could bump up the cost of SETI from $ 100 million to $ 100 billion .
Translation: 奥利弗估算，这将使地外文明搜寻计划的成本从1亿美元激增至1000亿美元。

Query_Text_en: I feel like a bug in an empty soup bowl . It 's a bright , sunny day in southwest New Mexico and I 've climbed a white maze of stairways to stand in the 82-foot-diameter dish of a giant new radio telescope .
Translation: 我仿佛一只误入空汤碗的甲虫。新墨西哥州西南部阳光明媚，我沿着白色阶梯迷宫攀爬而上，最终站在了这个直径82英尺的新型巨型射电望远镜的抛物面反射器中央。

Query_Text_en: From my advantage point on the rim of this 10-story 240-ton antenna , I see mountains in three directions . But I ca n't see the rest of the telescope -- really , nine more telescopes spread across the Western Hemisphere , from Hawaii to the Virgin Islands . Together , they make up the Very Long Beaseline Array .
Translation: 站在这座10层楼高、重达240吨的天线边缘，我眺望三面环山。然而望远镜的其他部分却不在视野之内——实际上，另有九台望远镜分布在从夏威夷到维尔京群岛的西半球各地。它们共同构成了"超长基线阵列"观测系统。

Query_Text_en: The array works like a single 5,000-mile-wide eye on the sky .
Translation: 该阵列犹如一只横跨5000英里的巨眼，时刻凝视着苍穹。

Query_Text_en: For decades , astronomers have patched together networks of radio telescopes to achieve the high resolution ability to distinguish fine detail of long baseline astronomy .
Translation: 数十年来，天文学家通过组建射电望远镜网络，实现了长基线天文观测的高分辨率能力，从而能够辨识精细天体结构。

Query_Text_en: But now they have a full time dedicated tool , one with tremendous speed and flexibility and more resolving power than anything on Earth or in space .
Translation: 但如今他们拥有了一款全天候专用工具，其速度与灵活性无与伦比，解析能力更远超地球及太空现有的一切设备。

Query_Text_en: With an instrument this powerful , a person on the East Coast could read a newspaper on the West Coast .
Translation: 凭借如此强大的仪器，东海岸的人甚至能看清西海岸的报纸。

Query_Text_en: An astronomer using the array can peer deep into the core of a quasar some 12 billion light-years distant for an unparalleled close-up of jets of matter shooting out at speeds approaching that of light .
Translation: 借助该阵列，天文学家能够深入观测120亿光年外类星体的核心区域，以空前清晰的视角捕捉到物质以近光速喷发而出的高能喷流。

Query_Text_en: This super-observatory probes nearby galaxies for black holes , objects whose gravitational intensity is so strong that they capture all light .
Translation: 这座超级天文台致力于探测邻近星系中的黑洞——这些天体的引力强度极大，能吞噬所有光线。

Query_Text_en: While no telescope can `` see '' a black hole by definition , the array recently provided the most compelling evidence yet for the existence of the phenomenon ; it spotted a group of water masers , the radio equivalent of lasers , whirling around a mysterious invisible object of staggering gravitational strength in a galaxy 21 million light-years away .
Translation: 虽然从定义上讲任何望远镜都无法直接"看见"黑洞，但这个阵列最近提供了迄今为止最有力的证据：它在2100万光年外的星系中，发现一组水脉泽（相当于激光的无线电波）正围绕着一个引力惊人的神秘不可见物体旋转。

Query_Text_en: `` For us to find something like this so early on in the life of the array is a great and big surprise , '' raves radio astronomer Phillip Diamond .
Translation: "我们能在阵列运行初期就发现此类现象，实在是一个巨大惊喜，"射电天文学家菲利普·戴蒙德赞叹道。

Query_Text_en: The array is now scrutinizing a small , phenomenally powerful object just 11,000 light-years away , a potential black hole in our galactic backyard .
Translation: 目前，该阵列正在观测一个距地球仅1.1万光年的高能天体——这个位于银河系"后院"的神秘物体体积虽小却蕴含惊人能量，极可能是一个黑洞。

Query_Text_en: Closer to home , the arrar , helps confirm satellite orbit locations for the Global Positioning System , or GPS and aids in earthquake research .
Translation: 在国内应用方面，该阵列有助于确定全球定位系统（GPS）卫星的轨道位置，并为地震研究提供支持。

Query_Text_en: Using distant quasars as beacons , the antenna positions are triangulated for measurements within a centimeter , sometimes even within millimeters .
Translation: 通过以遥远类星体作为定位信标，天线位置的三角测量精度可达厘米级，甚至毫米级。

Query_Text_en: This helps corroborate GPS satellite status and gives geodetic scientists a new way to gauge tectonic plate movement .
Translation: 这有助于验证全球定位系统卫星状态，并为大地测量科学家提供监测构造板块运动的新方法。

Query_Text_en: All the antennas are controlled from headquarters at the Array Operations Center in Socorro , New Mexico .
Translation: 所有天线均由位于新墨西哥州索科罗的阵列操作中心总部统一控制。

Query_Text_en: With observations synchronized by atomic clocks , the data gathered by each antenna are recorded on special magnetic tapes , then shipped to Socorro to be computer-processed and made into astronomical images .
Translation: 在原子钟同步校准下，各天线采集的数据被记录于专用磁带上，随后运送至索科罗进行计算机处理，最终生成天文图像。

Query_Text_en: For some research , the Very Long Baseline Array can work with other radio observatories , such as the Very Large Array in New Mexico or the 330-foot-diameter dish now being built in Green Bank , West Virginia , a highly specialized instrument for close-up zooming .
Translation: 在某些研究中，甚长基线阵列可与新墨西哥州的甚大阵列或西弗吉尼亚州格林班克正在建造的330英尺直径射电望远镜等观测设备协同工作——后者是专为高精度近距离观测设计的精密仪器。

Query_Text_en: When Japan launches a 33-foot radio dish into orbit next year the world 's first space radio telescope will use the Very Long Baseline Array 's correlator in Socorro as its `` brain , '' and will tie in with the array for joint observations .
Translation: 日本将于明年将一台33英尺射电天线送入轨道，届时全球首台太空射电望远镜将以索科罗超长基线阵列的相关处理器作为其"大脑"，并与该阵列联网开展联合观测。

Query_Text_en: Maybe they 'll call it Very , Very Long Baseline astronomy .
Translation: 或许他们会将其命名为"超超长基线天文观测"。

Query_Text_en: Virtual realily technology is poised to transform science , education , and entertainment .
Translation: 虚拟现实技术将彻底改变科学、教育和娱乐领域。

Query_Text_en: It 's Saturday afternoon and you would love to play a few rounds of golf , but fret that you might not get enough tee time at the closest public links .
Translation: 周六下午，您本想打几轮高尔夫球，却担心最近的公共球场可能排不上开球时间。

Query_Text_en: Instead , you decide to go down to the athletic club a few blocks away .
Translation: 相反，你决定去几个街区外的体育俱乐部。

Query_Text_en: There , you enter a private room , press a button , and look at the large screen on the wall in front of you .
Translation: 在那里，您进入一个私密房间，按下按钮，即可观看前方墙上的大屏幕。

Query_Text_en: The screen flickers , blinks , and presto ! -- you are suddenly on one of the world 's great golf courses , perhaps St. Andrews in Scotland , or Pebble Beach in Monterey , California , U. S. A , or Quinta do Lago in Portugal .
Translation: 屏幕闪烁几下，倏忽间——你已置身全球顶级高尔夫球场之一，或许是苏格兰圣安德鲁斯，亦或是美国加州蒙特雷的圆石滩，也可能是葡萄牙的金塔多拉戈。

Query_Text_en: You tee off on the plastic turf whacking your ball against the screen .
Translation: 你挥杆击打塑料草皮上的球，球撞向屏幕。

Query_Text_en: A blurred facsimile of the ball slices or hooks down the fairway .
Translation: 球道上，一个模糊的球影划出左曲或右曲的弧线。

Query_Text_en: Computers , infrared beams , and photo-optical detectors track the ball 's spin , velocity , and direction .
Translation: 计算机、红外光束和光电探测器可追踪球的旋转、速度及方向。

Query_Text_en: You are totally immersed in the three-dimensional computer generated world .
Translation: 你完全沉浸在这个计算机生成的三维虚拟世界中。

Query_Text_en: `` Virtual reality is created by using display and control technology to surround its users with an artificial environment that mimics real life , '' explains Dr. Hasan Alkhatib , professor of computer engineering at Santa Clara University in California , U.S.A.
Translation: 美国加州圣克拉拉大学计算机工程学教授哈桑·阿尔卡提比博士解释道："虚拟现实技术通过运用显示与控制技术，将使用者包裹在模拟真实生活的人造环境中。"

Query_Text_en: `` Through the use of visual and sound effects , things that do n't exist can be made to appear to exist .
Translation: 通过运用视觉和音效，可以让不存在的事物呈现出真实存在的效果。

Query_Text_en: Virtual reality allows users to manipulate objects on the screen so they can become full participants in the three-dimensional setting that envelops them . ''
Translation: 虚拟现实技术使用户能够操控屏幕中的物体，从而完全融入环绕其身的立体环境中。

Query_Text_en: Dr. Mark Fishman , professor of computer science at Eckerd College in St. Petersburg , Florida , U. S. A , and a leading authority on artificial intelligence and artificial reality , says virtual reality 's effect can be powerful .
Translation: 美国佛罗里达州圣彼得堡埃克德学院计算机科学教授、人工智能与人工现实领域权威专家马克·费什曼博士指出，虚拟现实技术将产生深远影响。

Query_Text_en: `` Put people in a virtual room and have them walk on a tread mill . They will not want to walk into the abyss they see in front of them , even though they know perfectly well their body is in the real world .
Translation: 将人们置于虚拟房间中，让他们在跑步机上行走。即便他们完全清楚自己身处现实世界，也不会愿意踏入眼前所见的深渊。

Query_Text_en: They fall right into the illusion , and the illusion is getting better and better . ''
Translation: 他们完全陷入了幻觉，而且这种幻觉正变得越来越逼真。

Query_Text_en: While this technology 's most advanced applications at the moment are in entertainment such as virtual reality golf and the virtual reality arcade game rooms sprouting up all over the world , researchers say its potential is enormous .
Translation: 尽管目前该技术最先进的应用集中于娱乐领域——例如虚拟现实高尔夫和全球涌现的虚拟现实街机游戏厅，但研究人员表示其发展潜力不可限量。

Query_Text_en: They see it impacting everything , from education to medicine and science to business and government .
Translation: 他们认为，这一技术将深刻影响教育、医疗、科学、商业乃至政府治理等各个领域。

Query_Text_en: `` The common perception of virtual reality is that it 's some kind of sophisticated computer game in an arcade , '' explains Dr. Jack Goldfeather , professor of mathematics and computer science at Carleton College in Minnesota , U. S. A , and a designer of hardware and software for three dimensional computer animation .
Translation: 美国明尼苏达州卡尔顿学院数学与计算机科学教授、三维计算机动画软硬件设计师杰克·戈德费瑟博士解释道："人们普遍认为虚拟现实不过是街机厅里某种复杂的电子游戏。"

Query_Text_en: `` I do n't really know if the public realizes how many uses it 's being applied to . ''
Translation: "我不太确定公众是否真正了解它被应用到了多少领域。"

Query_Text_en: Professor Fishman says that virtual reality has the potential to accelerate scientific advancement .
Translation: 费什曼教授指出，虚拟现实技术有望推动科学进步提速。

Query_Text_en: `` It could be an intellectual tool that can study some of the diseases and problems threatening mankind 's well being , such as AIDS and global warming . ''
Translation: "它可以作为一种研究工具，用于探究威胁人类福祉的疾病和问题，例如艾滋病和全球变暖。"

Query_Text_en: Already , virtual reality systems have many practical applications .
Translation: 目前，虚拟现实系统已具备诸多实际应用场景。

Query_Text_en: Most notably , the technology is being used to make simulations of cars or buildings during the design phase , to provide instruction in technical subjects like engineering , and to introduce new surgical techniques .
Translation: 尤为显著的是，该技术正被应用于汽车和建筑物的设计阶段模拟、工程等专业技术学科的教学指导，以及新型外科手术技术的引入。

Query_Text_en: `` Virtual reality offers another window , but one that a scientist can climb through to interact directly with scientific abstractions , '' says Howard Rheingold , author of `` Virtual Reality '' . `` Virtual reality has the potential to become a microscope of the mind . ''
Translation: 《虚拟现实》一书作者霍华德·莱茵戈德指出："虚拟现实提供了又一扇窗口，但科学家能通过这扇窗口直接与科学抽象概念互动。虚拟现实有望成为思维的显微镜。"

Query_Text_en: The idea of using computers to render artificial but useful environments began as early as the 1960s , but the computer power needed to generate 3-D graphics was so costly that only government agencies such as the U.S. National Aeronautics and Space Administration -LRB- NASA -RRB- or the Defense Department , along with a few university labs , could afford it .
Translation: 早在20世纪60年代，人们就开始尝试利用计算机构建虚拟但实用的环境。然而当时生成三维图形所需的计算能力成本极其高昂，仅有美国国家航空航天局（NASA）、国防部等政府机构及少数高校实验室能够承担。

Query_Text_en: The field began to grow in the mid 1980s when one-time computer hacker Jaron Lanier coined the term virtual reality and founded VPI Research Inc. in Redwood City , California , the first high-tech company dedicated to the virtual reality field .
Translation: 20世纪80年代中期，计算机黑客出身的杰伦·拉尼尔首创"虚拟现实"一词，并在加利福尼亚州红木城创立了首家专注于虚拟现实领域的高科技企业VPI研究公司，由此推动该领域开始蓬勃发展。

Query_Text_en: Since then companies worldwide have come to recognize the technology 's commercial potential and have entered the market .
Translation: 此后，全球企业逐渐认识到该技术的商业潜力，纷纷进军这一市场。

Query_Text_en: In the U. S. for example , the aerospace giant Boeing has organized a company-wide steering committee to explore virtual reality 's potential applications , while Caterpillar , based in Peoria , Illinois , bas started testing virtual reality models of its earth movers to improve performance and driver visibility .
Translation: 以美国为例，航空巨头波音公司已成立跨部门指导委员会，专门研究虚拟现实技术的潜在应用；而总部位于伊利诺伊州皮奥里亚的卡特彼勒公司，则开始测试其推土设备的虚拟现实模型，以提升设备性能并改善驾驶员视野。

Query_Text_en: Current virtual reality research shows numerous potential applications of the interactive technology :
Translation: 当前虚拟现实研究表明，这项交互技术具有广泛的应用前景：

Query_Text_en: EDUCATION : Educators say virtual reality can offer alternatives to the way students learn .
Translation: 教育领域：教育工作者指出，虚拟现实技术能为学生学习方式提供创新选择。

Query_Text_en: Some educators , in fact , are already using virtual reality Systems in the classroom .
Translation: 事实上，部分教育工作者已在课堂中应用虚拟现实系统。

Query_Text_en: At Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute , architectural students move around in an animated image of the Parthenon , examining that noble structure 's roof and columns .
Translation: 在伦斯勒理工学院，建筑系学生通过动态影像技术置身于帕特农神庙的虚拟场景中，细致考察这座宏伟建筑的屋顶与立柱结构。

Query_Text_en: At the University of Washington 's Interface Technology Laboratory , scientist William Brichen is developing a virtual universe in which objects are controlled by algebra and not physical laws .
Translation: 华盛顿大学界面技术实验室的科学家威廉·布里肯正在开发一个虚拟宇宙，其中的物体由代数而非物理定律控制。

Query_Text_en: Working in an artificial universe , students will be able to move city blocks around in various configurations provided they do n't violate algebraic laws .
Translation: 在一个虚拟的人工宇宙中，只要不违反代数法则，学生们可以任意调整城市街区的布局组合。

Query_Text_en: DESIGN : Researchers from several universities and corporations around the world are working hard to develop a wide range of virtual reality applications in this area , with designs on everything from automobiles to household appliances .
Translation: 设计领域：全球多所高校和企业的研究人员正致力于开发各类虚拟现实应用，其设计对象涵盖从汽车到家用电器等广泛产品。

Query_Text_en: In Detroit , Michigan , powerful computers and graphics stations are letting designers create new car models in 3-D .
Translation: 在密歇根州底特律市，强大的计算机和图形工作站正助力设计师们以三维方式打造新型汽车模型。

Query_Text_en: Boeing uses a virtual reality tunnel to test airplane models .
Translation: 波音公司采用虚拟现实风洞技术测试飞机模型。

Query_Text_en: The company says the computer-created model should significantly reduce the time and money Spent craftig new models .
Translation: 该公司表示，这种计算机生成的模型将大幅缩短新车型研发周期并降低开发成本。

Query_Text_en: Architects are expected to be the biggest users of virtual reality design applications .
Translation: 建筑师预计将成为虚拟现实设计应用的最大用户群体。

Query_Text_en: One experimental system now allows an architect to move through the design of a virtual hospital in a virtual wheelchair to test access to doors , hallways , light switches , and other design elements .
Translation: 目前，一套实验性系统能让建筑师以虚拟轮椅模式穿行于医院设计方案中，从而测试门廊、走廊、照明开关等设计元素的通行便利性。

Query_Text_en: The California-based software company Autodesk has developed a computer program that allows architects to take clients on a `` walk '' through a house or building before construction starts .
Translation: 总部位于加利福尼亚州的软件公司欧特克开发出一款计算机程序，使建筑师能够在施工开始前带领客户对房屋或建筑进行"虚拟漫游"。

Query_Text_en: `` Some of the computer models are so good that you actually feel you 're inside the building , not just looking at a monitor , '' says William Jenks .
Translation: 威廉·詹克斯表示："部分计算机模型如此逼真，让你仿佛置身建筑内部，而非仅仅面对显示器屏幕。"

Query_Text_en: INVESTING : Computer 3-D graphics are being used to give investors more data than they can possibly absorb from a spreadsheet .
Translation: 投资领域：计算机三维图形技术正被用于向投资者提供海量数据，其信息量远超电子表格所能承载的极限。

Query_Text_en: Money managers for TIAA-CREF , the $ 106 billion college and university teachers pension fund , use a system called Capri to track stocks and bonds .
Translation: 美国TIAA-CREF教师退休金基金管理规模达1,060亿美元，其投资经理使用名为Capri的系统追踪股票和债券行情。

Query_Text_en: Capri can be designed for any portfolio .
Translation: 卡普里模式可适配任何投资组合。

Query_Text_en: `` Some of my colleagues have been working for years on creating a 3-D image of the stock market , '' Professor Fishman reveals .
Translation: 费什曼教授透露："我的一些同事多年来一直致力于构建股票市场的三维图像。"

Query_Text_en: `` It will happen .
Translation: 这必将实现。

Query_Text_en: That 's why virtual reality has enormous potential for the financial market . ''
Translation: 正因如此，虚拟现实技术在金融市场具有巨大发展潜力。

Query_Text_en: MEDICINE : Virtual reality is giving scientists the ability to work surrounded by images of molecules and other objects - that once required an electronic microscope study .
Translation: 医学领域：虚拟现实技术使科学家能够在分子及其他微观物体的三维影像环境中开展研究，这些研究对象过去必须借助电子显微镜才能观测。

Query_Text_en: Researchers predict that surgeons in training will be able to practice on electronic cadavers while experienced surgeons will benefit from new techniques developed from virtual reality applications .
Translation: 研究人员预测，受训外科医生将能够在电子解剖体上进行手术练习，而经验丰富的外科医生则能受益于虚拟现实应用开发的新技术。

Query_Text_en: `` The medical impact is limitless , '' says Professor Goldfeather .
Translation: 戈德费瑟教授表示："其医学影响不可估量。"

Query_Text_en: The organs will be modeled inside a computer , but it will seem as if you are actually inside the body . ''
Translation: 这些器官将在计算机内建模，但会让你感觉仿佛真实置身于人体之中。

Query_Text_en: The technology is hindered right now by the fact that today 's computers are simply not fast enough , a quite remarkable revelation given that computer speed is doubling every 18 months to two years .
Translation: 当前技术发展受阻的原因在于现有计算机的运算速度仍显不足——这一发现颇为引人深思，因为计算机处理能力正以每18至24个月翻一番的速度持续提升。

Query_Text_en: Computer scientists say a massive amount of processing is required to create the various components of an image .
Translation: 计算机科学家指出，生成图像的各个组成部分需要耗费巨大的算力。

Query_Text_en: Researchers expect a major break-through within the next five to 10 years .
Translation: 研究人员预计未来五到十年内将取得重大突破。

Query_Text_en: `` Computing speed will increase to such levels that we will be able to create more sophisticated images , '' predicts Professor Fishman .
Translation: 菲什曼教授预测："计算速度将提升至如此高度，使我们能够生成更为精密的图像。"

Query_Text_en: And as the computing power increases , the speed prices of virtual reality systems are expected to drop .
Translation: 随着计算能力的提升，虚拟现实系统的价格预计将加速下降。

Query_Text_en: IN THIS ARTICLE : A spacecraft orbiting Mars as part of the Mars Global Surveyor mission will be sending back data to Earth for two years .
Translation: 本文要点：作为"火星全球勘测者"计划的重要组成部分，一艘环绕火星运行的航天器将在未来两年持续向地球传回探测数据。

Query_Text_en: The information from this survey of `` the red planet '' as Mars is called , will help scientists to understand more about our planet Earth , as well reveal new facts about Mars .
Translation: 这项对"红色星球"——即火星的勘测所获信息，不仅将揭示有关火星的新事实，更能帮助科学家加深对地球的认识。

Query_Text_en: In November 1996 , the National Aeronautics and Space Administration -LRB- NASA -RRB- and the Jet Propulsion Laboratory -LRB- JPL -RRB- began America 's return to Mars after a 20-year absence by launching the Mars Global Surveyor -LRB- MGS -RRB- spacecraft .
Translation: 1996年11月，美国国家航空航天局（NASA）与喷气推进实验室（JPL）发射"火星全球勘测者号"（MGS）航天器，标志着美国在中断20年后重启火星探测计划。

Query_Text_en: This $ US154 million mission will usher in a new and exciting era of scientific missions to study Mars .
Translation: 这项耗资1.54亿美元的任务将开启火星科学探测的新纪元，令人振奋。

Query_Text_en: Over the course of a full Martian year , Surveyor will return an unprecedented amount of data regarding Mars ' surface features , atmosphere , and magnetic properties .
Translation: 在完整一个火星年期间，"勘测者号"将传回关于火星地表特征、大气层及磁特性的海量数据，其规模将创下历史纪录。

Query_Text_en: Scientists will use the data gathered from this mission both to learn about the Earth by comparing it to Mars , and to build a comprehensive data set to aid in planning future missions .
Translation: 科学家将通过此次任务收集的数据，既用于以火星为参照研究地球，也将建立完整数据集为未来任务规划提供支持。

Query_Text_en: The Surveyor spacecraft was launched from the Cape Canaveral Air Station in Florida on 7 November 1996 aboard a Delta-7925 rocket .
Translation: 1996年11月7日，"勘测者号"航天器搭载德尔塔-7925运载火箭，从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角空军基地发射升空。

Query_Text_en: The 1062-kilogram spacecraft , built by Lockheed Martin Astronautics , travelled nearly 750 million kilometres -LRB- 466 million miles -RRB- over the course of a 300-day cruise to reach Mars on 12 September 1997 .
Translation: 这艘重达1062公斤的航天器由洛克希德·马丁航天公司建造，在历时300天的航行中飞行了近7.5亿公里（4.66亿英里），最终于1997年9月12日抵达火星。

Query_Text_en: Upon reaching Mars , Surveyor fired its main rocket engine for the 25-minute Mars orbit insertion -LRB- MOD burn . This manoeuvre slowed the spacecraft and allowed the planet 's gravity to capture it into orbit . Surveyor began to whirl around `` the red planet '' , as Mars is known , in a highly elliptical orbit that took 48 hours to complete . After orbit insertion , Surveyor began to perform a series of or - bit changes to lower the low point of its orbit into the upper fringes of the Martian atmosphere at an altitude of about 110 kilometres . During every atmospheric pass , the spacecraft began to slow down by a slight amount because of air resistance . This slowing causes the spacecraft to lose altitude on its next pass through the orbit 's high point .
Translation: 火星轨道进入阶段，勘测者号启动主火箭引擎实施了25分钟的点火制动（MOI燃烧）。这一操作使航天器减速，得以被火星引力捕获进入环火轨道。自此，勘测者号开始环绕这颗被称为"红色星球"的天体运行，其初始轨道为周期48小时的高椭圆轨道。完成轨道捕获后，勘测者号通过一系列轨道调整，逐步将远火点降低至距火星表面约110公里的大气层边缘区域。每次穿越大气层时，航天器都会因空气阻力产生轻微减速，这种减速效应导致其在后续轨道运行中逐渐降低远火点高度。

Query_Text_en: Surveyor is using this innovative `` aerobraking '' technique over a period of four months to lower the high point of its orbit from 56,000 kilometres to altitudes near 400 kilometres .
Translation: "勘测者"号探测器正采用这种创新的"空气制动"技术，在四个月时间内将其轨道远地点从5.6万公里降至约400公里的高度。

Query_Text_en: The mapping phase of the mission was to begin in mid-March 1998 .
Translation: 该任务的测绘阶段原定于1998年3月中旬启动。

Query_Text_en: During mapping operations , the spacecraft circles Mars once every 118 minutes at an average altitude of 378 kilometres .
Translation: 在测绘作业期间，该航天器以平均378公里的高度每118分钟绕火星运行一周。

Query_Text_en: For 687 Earth days , Surveyor will utilize this orbital vantage point to collect scientific data on a continuous basis .
Translation: "勘测者号"将在687个地球日内，持续利用这一轨道制高点开展科学数据采集工作。

Query_Text_en: Many scientific instruments will be at work in the survey .
Translation: 此次勘测将启用多台科学仪器。

Query_Text_en: The camera will produce a daily wide-angle image of Mars similar to weather photographs of the Earth shown on nightly television news .
Translation: 该摄像机将每日拍摄火星广角图像，类似于电视晚间新闻中播放的地球气象照片。

Query_Text_en: In addition , the narrow-angle lens will capture images of objects as small as 1.5 meters across .
Translation: 此外，窄角镜头可拍摄直径小至1.5米物体的图像。

Query_Text_en: The laser altimeter will bounce beams of light off of the surface to measure the heights of mountains and depths of valleys .
Translation: 激光高度计将通过发射光束测量地表反射信号，精确测定山脉高度与谷地深度。

Query_Text_en: The thermal emission spectrometer will scan for heat emitted from Mars to study the atmosphere and to map the mineral composition of the surface .
Translation: 热辐射光谱仪将通过扫描火星散发的热量来研究其大气层，并绘制地表矿物成分分布图。

Query_Text_en: The magnetometer will study the magnetic properties of Mars to gain insight into the interior of the planet .
Translation: 磁力仪将研究火星的磁性特征，以深入了解该行星的内部结构。

Query_Text_en: After mapping finishes in late January 2000 , the spacecraft will function as a communications satellite to relay data back to Earth from surface vehicles which will be landed on the planet as part of future Mars missions .
Translation: 2000年1月下旬完成测绘任务后，该航天器将作为通信卫星运行，为未来火星任务中登陆火星的地面探测器向地球回传数据提供中继服务。

Query_Text_en: One of the most important results of the Mars Global Surveyor mission is that a comparison of Mars and Earth will allow scientists to understand Earth 's history and possibly its future .
Translation: 火星全球勘测任务最重要的成果之一在于，通过比较火星与地球的异同，科学家将能更深入地理解地球的历史，并可能预测其未来走向。

Query_Text_en: At the time of their formation several billion years ago , Mars and Earth shared similar conditions .
Translation: 数十亿年前形成之初，火星与地球的环境条件极为相似。

Query_Text_en: Both planets harboured vast quantities of surface water , thick atmospheres , and climates warmer than at present .
Translation: 这两颗行星都曾拥有大量的地表水、稠密的大气层，以及比现在更为温暖的气候。

Query_Text_en: Today , Earth is a lush world filled with a countless number of animals and plant species .
Translation: 如今的地球是一个生机盎然的星球，孕育着无数动植物物种。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , data gathered from Mars over the last 30 years shows that the planet lies trapped in conditions reminiscent of a global ice age .
Translation: 相比之下，过去30年从火星收集的数据显示，这颗行星仍深陷于类似地球冰河时期的全球性严寒环境中。

Query_Text_en: The dry and seemingly lifeless Martian surface makes the Sahara Desert look like an ocean in comparison , and average daily temperatures make Antarctica seen balmy . Comparing the history and evolution of the two planets will yield clues into Earth 's past and possibly its future .
Translation: 火星干燥荒芜的地表让撒哈拉沙漠相形之下宛如汪洋，其日均气温更令南极洲显得温暖如春。通过对比两颗行星的历史与演化进程，我们将能窥见地球的过往，或许还能预见它的未来。

Query_Text_en: Despite its forbidding climate , surface temperatures on Mars resemble the Earth 's more than any other planet .
Translation: 尽管气候严酷，火星的表面温度却是所有行星中最接近地球的。

Query_Text_en: These similarities in temperature result in part from the fact that Mars orbits the Sun only slightly farther out than the Earth as compared to other planets .
Translation: 火星与地球温度相近的部分原因在于：相较于其他行星，火星绕太阳运行的轨道仅略远于地球。

Query_Text_en: For example , the ground at some locations near the equator may warm up to as high as 25 degree at noon .
Translation: 例如，赤道附近某些地区的地表在正午时分可能升温至25摄氏度之高。

Query_Text_en: However , daytime temperatures still average well below freezing , and night temperatures dip much lower .
Translation: 然而，白天气温仍普遍低于冰点，夜间气温则更低。

Query_Text_en: Martian temperatures may seem almost inviting to the seasoned outdoors explorer , but the composition of the atmosphere leaves much to be desired from a human perspective .
Translation: 对于经验丰富的户外探险者而言，火星温度或许尚可接受，但从人类生存角度看，其大气成分仍远未达标。

Query_Text_en: Most of the Martian air consists of carbon dioxide CO , similar to conditions on Venus .
Translation: 火星大气主要由二氧化碳构成，这一特征与金星环境相似。

Query_Text_en: If breathing carbon dioxide seems uninviting , the density of the air will appear worse .
Translation: 若吸入二氧化碳已令人不适，那么空气密度问题将更显严峻。

Query_Text_en: Average barometric pressures on Mars measure lower than that found at Earth 's sea level by a factor of more than 125 .
Translation: 火星的平均气压比地球海平面气压低125倍以上。

Query_Text_en: In other words , the air at the surface of Mars is thinner than that found on Earth at an altitude 19 times higher than Denver , Colorado .
Translation: 换言之，火星表面的空气密度比地球海拔相当于科罗拉多州丹佛市19倍高度处的大气更为稀薄。

Query_Text_en: The extremely thin Martian air contributes to the mystery of whether there is life on Mars , either in the past or present .
Translation: 火星大气极其稀薄，这为探究该星球过去或现在是否存在生命增添了谜团。

Query_Text_en: The reason is that almost all of the water lies trapped in the Martian polar ice caps or frozen beneath the surface .
Translation: 原因在于，火星上的水几乎全部被封存在极地冰盖中，或冻结在地表之下。

Query_Text_en: Liquid water can not exist on the surface because the thin atmosphere will cause melting ice to evaporate directly into water vapour .
Translation: 由于大气稀薄，融冰会直接蒸发为水蒸气，因此液态水无法在地表存续。

Query_Text_en: Scientists call this process `` sublimation . ''
Translation: 科学家将这一过程称为"升华"。

Query_Text_en: Although liquid water on Mars will quickly evaporate , photographs transmitted back to Earth by previous NASA missions to the planet reveal giant flood channels , dry river beds ï¼ and flood plains on the surface .
Translation: 尽管火星上的液态水会迅速蒸发，但美国宇航局此前火星任务传回地球的照片显示，其表面存在巨型洪水通道、干涸河床及冲积平原。

Query_Text_en: This evidence of past water on Mars leads some scientists to consider Mars as the prime location in the Solar System to search for extraterrestrial life .
Translation: 火星上存在过水的证据，使部分科学家将火星视为太阳系中搜寻地外生命的首选之地。

Query_Text_en: The speculation is that because Mars once possessed a thicker atmosphere and vast quantities of surface water billions of years ago , then the planet may have harboured conditions favourable to the formation of life despite its present forbidding climate .
Translation: 有推测认为，由于数十亿年前火星曾拥有更稠密的大气层和大量地表水，尽管如今气候恶劣，这颗星球可能曾具备孕育生命的有利条件。

Query_Text_en: Sensors aboard various NASA spacecraft launched to Mars over the last 30 years have shown that advanced life forms almost certainly do not exist on the planet today .
Translation: 过去30年间美国宇航局发射的多艘火星探测器搭载的传感器数据显示，当今火星上几乎不可能存在高等生命形态。

Query_Text_en: However , many feel that the planet may hide bacterial forms of life or their fossil remains .
Translation: 然而，许多人认为该行星可能蕴藏着细菌形态的生命或其化石遗迹。

Query_Text_en: Although Mars Global Surveyor will not conduct a search for life on Mars , it will gather detailed data that will help in understanding the mystery of the missing water .
Translation: 尽管火星全球勘测者号不会执行寻找火星生命的任务，但它将收集详细数据，助力破解火星水源消失之谜。

Query_Text_en: This type of study will provide important background data that will help scientists in their search for Martian life on future missions .
Translation: 此类研究将为科学家在未来任务中寻找火星生命提供重要的基础数据。

Query_Text_en: Geologically , Mars is also one of the most interesting planets in the Solar System .
Translation: 从地质学角度看，火星也是太阳系中最引人注目的行星之一。

Query_Text_en: This small , red-colored , rocky planet ranks in size as twice as large as the Moon , but only half as large as Earth .
Translation: 这颗红色的小型岩石行星体积约为月球的两倍，但仅为地球的一半大小。

Query_Text_en: Despite the planet 's small size , it contains large water and carbon dioxide ice caps at the poles , a canyon much deeper than the Grand Canyon and longer than the United States , crater valleys as large as the western United States , and a handful of monstrous volcanoes that make Mount Everest or Chomolungma appear tiny in comparison .
Translation: 尽管这颗行星体积不大，其两极却蕴藏着巨大的水冰与干冰极冠，拥有比美国大峡谷更深、长度超过美国本土的巨型峡谷，分布着相当于美国西部面积的陨石坑谷地，更矗立着数座令珠穆朗玛峰相形见绀的巨型火山。

Query_Text_en: A study of Martian geology is crucial toward revealing clues into the history of the Earth .
Translation: 研究火星地质对揭示地球历史线索至关重要。

Query_Text_en: The reason is that Mars is the only planet in the solar system that both has an atmosphere , and contains surface features that cover almost the entire range of history .
Translation: 原因在于，火星是太阳系中唯一既拥有大气层，又具备几乎涵盖整个演化史地表特征的星球。

Query_Text_en: On Earth , pristine rocks and other surface features from the first billion years of our planet 's existence do not exist because geological events , weather , and life have caused drastic alterations .
Translation: 在地球上，由于地质活动、气候变化及生命演化的剧烈改造作用，形成于行星诞生最初十亿年的原始岩石及其他地表特征已荡然无存。

Query_Text_en: Because Earth and Mars shared similar conditions near the time of their formation , an exploration of Mars will allow us to take a peek into Earth 's past in a way not possible by studying the Earth by itself .
Translation: 由于地球和火星在形成初期的环境条件相似，探索火星将使我们得以窥见地球的过往，这是仅研究地球本身所无法实现的。

Query_Text_en: In order to talk about the nature of the universe and to discuss questions such as whether it has a beginning or an end , you have to be clear about what a scientific theory is .
Translation: 要探讨宇宙的本质，并讨论诸如宇宙是否有起点或终点这类问题，必须首先明确科学理论的定义。

Query_Text_en: I shall take the simpleminded view that a theory is just a model of the universe , or a restricted part of it , and a set of rules that relate quantities3 in the model to observations that we makiae .
Translation: 我将秉持一种朴素的见解：理论不过是宇宙或其局部受限部分的模型，以及一套将该模型中各变量与我们实际观测数据相关联的规则体系。

Query_Text_en: It exists only in our minds and does not have any other reality -LRB- whatever that might mean -RRB- .
Translation: 它仅存在于我们的意识中，除此之外并无其他现实存在（无论现实一词作何解）。

Query_Text_en: A theory is a good theory if it satisfies two requirements : It must accurately describe a large class of observations on the basis of a model that contains only a few arbitrary elements , and it must make definite predictions about the results of future observations .
Translation: 一个好的理论必须满足两项要求：首先，它必须基于仅含少数任意性要素的模型，精确描述大量观测现象；其次，必须对未来观测结果作出明确预测。

Query_Text_en: For example , Aristotle 's theory that everything was made out of four elements , earth , air , fire , and water , was simple enough to qualify , but it did not make any definite predictions .
Translation: 例如，亚里士多德提出的万物由土、气、火、水四种元素构成的理论，其简洁性足以符合标准，但该理论未能作出任何明确预测。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , Newton 's theory of gravity was based on an even simpler model , in which bodies attracted each other with a force that was proportional to a quantity called their mass and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them . Yet it predicts the motions of the sun , the moon , and the planets to a high degree of accuracy .
Translation: 另一方面，牛顿的万有引力理论则建立在更为简洁的模型之上——该理论认为物体间通过一种力相互吸引，这种力与被称为质量的物理量成正比，与两者距离的平方成反比。然而该理论却能以极高精度预测太阳、月球及行星的运行轨迹。

Query_Text_en: Any physical theory is always provisional , in the sense that it is only a hypothesis : you can never prove it .
Translation: 任何物理理论本质上都只是假说，因而始终具有暂时性——你永远无法证实它。

Query_Text_en: No matter how many times the results of experiments agree with some theory , you can never be sure that the next time the result will not contradict the theory .
Translation: 无论实验结果与某一理论吻合多少次，都无法确保下一次结果不会与之相悖。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , you can disprove a theory by finding even a single observation that disagrees with the predictions of the theory .
Translation: 另一方面，只要发现一个与理论预测相悖的观测结果，便可推翻该理论。

Query_Text_en: As philosopher of science Karl Popper has emphasized , a good theory is characterized by the fact that it makes a number of predictions that could in principle be disproved or falsified by observation .
Translation: 正如科学哲学家卡尔·波普尔所强调的，优秀理论的标志在于它能提出一系列原则上可被观测证伪或否定的预测。

Query_Text_en: but if ever a new observation is found to disagree , we have to abandon or modify the theory .
Translation: 但若新观测结果与理论相悖，我们就必须摒弃或修正该理论。

Query_Text_en: At least that is what is supposed to happen , but you can always question the competence of the person who carried out the observation .
Translation: 至少理论上是这样，但执行观测者的专业能力始终值得商榷。

Query_Text_en: In practice , what often happens is that a new theory is devised that is really an extension of the previous theory .
Translation: 实践中常见的情况是，新提出的理论实质上是对原有理论的延伸。

Query_Text_en: For example , very accurate observations of the planet Mercury revealed a small difference between its motion and the predictions of Newton 's theory of gravity .
Translation: 例如，对水星运行轨迹的精确观测显示，其实际运动与牛顿万有引力理论的预测值之间存在微小差异。

Query_Text_en: Einstein 's general theory of relativity predicted a slightly different motion from Newton 's theory .
Translation: 爱因斯坦的广义相对论预言的运动轨迹与牛顿理论略有差异。

Query_Text_en: The fact that Einstein 's predictions matched what was seen , while Newton 's did not , was one of the crucial confirmations of the new theory .
Translation: 爱因斯坦的预言与观测结果相符，而牛顿的理论则未能做到，这一事实成为新理论的关键验证之一。

Query_Text_en: However , we still use Newton 's theory for all practical purposes because the difference between its predictions and those of general relativity is very small in the situations that we normally deal with .
Translation: 然而，在实际应用中我们仍采用牛顿理论，因为在常规情况下，其预测结果与广义相对论的差异微乎其微。

Query_Text_en: -LRB- Newton 's theory also has the great advantage that it is much simpler to work with than Einstein 's ! -RRB-
Translation: （牛顿理论还具有一个巨大优势：其运用过程远比爱因斯坦理论更为简便！）

Query_Text_en: The eventual goal of science is to provide a single theory that describes the whole universe .
Translation: 科学的终极目标是构建一个能够完整描述宇宙的统一理论。

Query_Text_en: However , the approach most scientists actually follow is to separate the problem into two parts .
Translation: 然而，大多数科学家实际采用的方法是将问题分解为两个部分。

Query_Text_en: First , there are the laws that tell us how the universe changes with time .
Translation: 首先，存在揭示宇宙随时间演变规律的自然法则。

Query_Text_en: -LRB- If we know what the universe is like at any one time , these physical laws tell us how it will look at any later time . -RRB- Second , there is the question of the initial state of the universe .
Translation: （如果我们知道宇宙在某一时刻的状态，这些物理定律就能告诉我们它在未来任何时刻的模样。）其次，是关于宇宙初始状态的问题。

Query_Text_en: they regard the question of the initial situation as a matter for metaphysics or religion .
Translation: 他们认为初始状态问题属于形而上学或宗教范畴。

Query_Text_en: They would say that God , being omnipotent , could have started the universe off any way he wanted .
Translation: 他们会说，全能的上帝本可以随心所欲地创造宇宙。

Query_Text_en: Yet it appears that he chose to make it evolve in a very regular way according to certain laws .
Translation: 然而他似乎选择让事物按照特定规律以极其规律的方式演进。

Query_Text_en: It therefore seems equally reasonable to suppose that there are also laws governing the initial state .
Translation: 因此，假设存在支配初始状态的规律似乎同样合理。

Query_Text_en: It turns out to be very difficult to devise a theory to describe the universe all in one go .
Translation: 事实证明，要构建一套完整描述宇宙的理论体系绝非易事。

Query_Text_en: Instead , we break the problem up into bits and invent a number of partial theories .
Translation: 相反，我们将问题分解为若干部分，并提出了若干局部理论。

Query_Text_en: Each of these partial theories describes and predicts a certain limited class of observations , neglecting the effects of other quantities , or representing them by simple sets of numbers .
Translation: 这些局部理论各自描述并预测某一有限范畴的观测现象，或忽略其他变量的影响，或将其简化为若干组数值加以表征。

Query_Text_en: It may be that this approach is completely wrong .
Translation: 这一做法或许完全错误。

Query_Text_en: If everything in the universe depends on everything else in a fundamental way , it might be impossible to get close to a full solution by investigating parts of the problem in isolation .
Translation: 若宇宙万物皆存在根本性的相互依存关系，那么孤立地研究问题的局部或许永远无法趋近完整答案。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , it is certainly the way that we have made progress in the past .
Translation: 然而，这确实是我们过去取得进展的方式。

Query_Text_en: The classic example again is the Newtonian theory of gravity , which tells us that the gravitational force between two bodies depends only on one number associated with each body , its mass , but is otherwise independent of what the bodies are made of .
Translation: 牛顿的万有引力理论就是一个经典例证。该理论指出，两个物体之间的引力仅取决于与每个物体相关的一个数值——即其质量，而与物体的构成物质无关。

Query_Text_en: Thus one does not need to have a theory of the structure and constitution of the sun and the planets in order to calculate their orbits .
Translation: 因此，无需掌握太阳与行星的结构构成理论，亦可计算其运行轨道。

Query_Text_en: Today scientists describe the universe in terms of two basic partial theories -- the general theory of relativity and quantum mechanics .
Translation: 如今，科学家们用两大基础性局部理论来描述宇宙——广义相对论与量子力学。

Query_Text_en: They are the great intellectual achievements of the first half of this century .
Translation: 它们是本世纪上半叶最伟大的思想成就。

Query_Text_en: The general theory of relativity describes the force of gravity and the large-scale structure of the universe , that is , the structure on scales from only a few miles to as large as a million million million million -LRB- 1 with twenty-four zeros after it -RRB- miles , the size of the observable universe .
Translation: 广义相对论阐述了引力作用原理及宇宙宏观结构，即从数英里到10^24英里（可观测宇宙范围）尺度上的空间构造。

Query_Text_en: Quantum mechanics , on the other hand , deals with phenomena on extremely small scales , such as a millionth of a millionth of an inch .
Translation: 而量子力学研究的则是极小尺度的现象，例如百万分之一英寸的百万分之一。

Query_Text_en: Unfortunately , however , these two theories are known to be inconsistent with each other -- they can not both be correct . One of the major endeavors in physics today , is the search for a new theory that will in - corporate them both -- a quantum theory of gravity .
Translation: 然而众所周知，这两种理论彼此矛盾——它们不可能同时成立。当今物理学界的主要努力方向，就是寻求一种能统一二者的新理论——量子引力理论。

Query_Text_en: We do not yet have such a theory , and we may still be a long way from having one , but we do already know many of the properties that it must have .
Translation: 我们尚未建立这一理论，可能仍任重道远，但对其必须具备的诸多特性已了然于胸。

Query_Text_en: It is very difficult to trace the origin of the science of physics , just as it is difficult to trace the origin of many great rivers .
Translation: 正如难以追溯诸多大江大河的源头，物理学的起源同样难以考证。

Query_Text_en: a few small brooks and creeks running gaily down the mountain slopes and uniting to form rivulets which in turn unite to form streams big enough to deserve the name ' river ' .
Translation: 几条欢快的小溪从山坡奔流而下，汇成潺潺溪涧；这些溪涧又相互交融，最终形成足以被称为"河流"的宽阔水道。

Query_Text_en: The rivers grow broader and broader , being strengthened by numerous tributaries , and finally develop into mighty flows be it the Mississippi or the Volga , the Nile or the Amazon carrying their waters into the ocean .
Translation: 江河因众多支流的汇入而愈发宽广，最终无论密西西比河或伏尔加河，尼罗河或亚马逊河，皆发展为浩荡巨流，奔涌注入海洋。

Query_Text_en: The springs which gave birth to the great river of physical science were scattered all over the surface of the earth inhabited by Homo sapiens , i.e. , thinking man . It seems , however , that most of them were concentrated on the southern tip of the Balkan peninsula inhabited by the people now known as ' ancient Greeks ' ; or , at least , it seems so to us who inherited the culture of these early ' intellectuals ' .
Translation: 孕育自然科学这条大河的源泉，遍布于智人——即会思考的人类——所居住的地球各处。然而，这些源泉似乎大多集中于巴尔干半岛南端，即如今被称为"古希腊人"的族群聚居之地；至少在我们这些继承了早期"智者"文化的人看来是如此。

Query_Text_en: It is interesting to notice that whereas other ancient nations , such as Babylonia and Egypt , contributed a great deal to the early development of mathematics and astronomy , they were completely sterile in the development of physics .
Translation: 值得注意的是，虽然巴比伦、埃及等其他古代民族对数学和天文学的早期发展贡献卓著，但在物理学领域却毫无建树。

Query_Text_en: The possible explanation of that deficiency as compared with Greek science is that Babylonian and Egyptian gods lived high up among the stars , while the gods of the ancient Greeks lived at the elevation of only about 10,000 feet , at the top of Mount Olympus , and so were much closer to down-to-earth problems .
Translation: 相较于希腊科学，巴比伦与埃及科学之所以存在这一不足，可能的解释在于：巴比伦和埃及诸神高居星空之上，而古希腊诸神仅栖身于约一万英尺高的奥林匹斯山顶，因而更贴近尘世间的实际问题。

Query_Text_en: According to a legend the term ' magnetism ' originated from the name of a Greek shepherd , who was surprised to notice that the tip of his iron-shod staff was attracted by a stone ( magnetic iron ore ) lying along the roadside .
Translation: 相传，"磁力"一词源于一位希腊牧羊人的名字。他惊讶地发现，自己包铁手杖的顶端会被路边的石块（磁铁矿）吸引。

Query_Text_en: Whereas these legendary discoveries would hardly stand their ground in any legal priority suit , the discovery of the Greek philosopher Pythagoras , who lived in the middle of the 6th century B.C. , is well documented .
Translation: 然而，这些传奇发现若诉诸法律优先权之争恐难立足；相比之下，公元前6世纪中叶古希腊哲学家毕达哥拉斯的发现则有翔实文献为证。

Query_Text_en: Persuaded that the world is governed by number , he was investigating the relation between the lengths of the strings in the musical instruments which produce harmonic combinations of sound .
Translation: 他深信世界由数字支配，于是潜心研究乐器弦长与产生和谐乐音组合之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose he used the so-called monochord , i.e. , a single string which can be varied in length and subjected to different tensions caused by a suspended weight .
Translation: 为此，他使用了所谓的单弦琴——即一根可通过悬挂重物调节长度并施加不同张力的琴弦。

Query_Text_en: Using the same weight , and varying the length of the string , he found that the pairs of harmonic tones were obtained when the string 's lengths stood in simple numerical relations .
Translation: 他采用相同重物并改变弦长时发现，当弦长呈简单数值比例关系时，即可产生和谐音对。

Query_Text_en: The length ratio 2:1 corresponded to what was known as ' octave , ' the ratio 3:2 to a ' fifth ' , and the ratio 4:3 to a ' fourth ' .
Translation: 2:1的长度比对应"八度音程"，3:2对应"五度音程"，4:3对应"四度音程"。

Query_Text_en: This discovery was probably the first mathematical formulation of a physical law , and can be well considered as the first step in the development of what is now known as theoretical physics .
Translation: 这一发现很可能是物理定律的首次数学表述，完全可以视为当今理论物理学发展的第一步。

Query_Text_en: In modern physical terminology we may reformulate Pythagoras ' discovery by saying that the frequency , i.e. , the number of vibrations per second , of a given string subjected to a given tension is inversely proportional to its length .
Translation: 在现代物理学术语中，我们可以将毕达哥拉斯的发现重新表述为：在给定张力条件下，特定弦线的振动频率（即每秒振动次数）与其长度成反比。

Query_Text_en: Thus , if the second string is half as long as the first one , its vibration frequency will be twice as high .
Translation: 因此，若第二根弦的长度为第一根的一半，其振动频率将提高一倍。

Query_Text_en: If the two string lengths stand in the ratio of 3:2 or 4:3 , their vibration frequencies will stand in the ratios 2:3 or 3:4 .
Translation: 若两弦长度比为3:2或4:3，则其振动频率比为2:3或3:4。

Query_Text_en: Since the part of the human brain which receives the nerve signals from the ear is built in such a way that simple frequency ratios , as 3:4 , give ' pleasure ' whereas the complex ones , as 137:171 , ' displeasure ' ( it is for the brain physiologists of the future to explain that fact ! ) , the length of strings giving perfect accord must stand in simple numerical ratios .
Translation: 由于人类大脑接收耳部神经信号的结构特性——简单频率比（如3:4）能产生"愉悦感"，而复杂频率比（如137:171）则引发"不适感"（这一现象有待未来的脑生理学家解释！）——因此要达成完美和声，琴弦长度必须符合简单的整数比例关系。

Query_Text_en: Pythagoras tried to go one step further by suggesting that , since the motion of planets ' must be harmonious ' , their distances from the earth must stand in the same ratios as the lengths of the strings ( under equal tension ) which produce the seven basic tones produced by the lyre , the national Greek musical instrument .
Translation: 毕达哥拉斯试图更进一步，提出既然行星的运动"必然和谐"，那么它们与地球的距离比例，应当等同于希腊民族乐器里拉琴（在同等张力下）产生七种基本音调的琴弦长度之比。

Query_Text_en: Another important physical theory , which in modern terminology could be called ' a theory without any experimental foundation ' but which turned out to be a ' dream that came true ' , was proposed by another ancient Greek philosopher , Democritus , who lived , thought , and taught around the year 400 B.C. Democritus conceived the idea that all material bodies are aggregates of innumerable particles so small as to be unnoticeable by the human eye .
Translation: 另一项重要的物理理论由古希腊哲学家德谟克利特提出，他在公元前400年左右生活、思考并授业。该理论用现代术语可称为"毫无实验基础的理论"，但最终却成为"梦想成真"的典范。德谟克利特认为，一切物质实体都是由无数肉眼不可见的微小粒子聚合而成。

Query_Text_en: He called these particles atoms , or indivisibles in Greek , because he believed that they represented the ultimate stage of the division of material bodies into smaller and smaller parts .
Translation: 他将这些粒子称为"原子"，即希腊语中的"不可分割者"，因为他认为这些粒子代表着物质体不断细分至最小单位的终极形态。

Query_Text_en: He believed that there are four different kinds of atoms : the atoms of stone , dry and heavy ; the atoms of water , heavy and wet ; the atoms of air , cold and light ; and the atoms of fire , slippery and hot .
Translation: 他认为存在四种不同的原子：土原子干燥而沉重；水原子沉重而湿润；气原子寒冷而轻盈；火原子则滑腻而炽热。

Query_Text_en: By a combination of these four different kinds of atoms all known materials were supposed to be made .
Translation: 人们认为，所有已知物质都是由这四种不同原子组合而成。

Query_Text_en: The soil was a combination of stone and water atoms .
Translation: 这片土壤由石质与水态原子混合构成。

Query_Text_en: A plant growing from the soil under the influence of sun rays consisted of the stone and water atoms from the soil and the lire atoms from the sun .
Translation: 在阳光作用下从土壤中生长的植物，其构成既包含土壤中的石质原子与水原子，也吸收了太阳中的火元素原子。

Query_Text_en: That is why dry wood logs which have lost all their water atoms would burn , liberating fire atoms ( flame ) and leaving behind stone atoms ( ashes ) .
Translation: 正因如此，失去全部水分原子的干木柴才会燃烧，释放出火原子（火焰）并留下石原子（灰烬）。

Query_Text_en: When certain kinds of stones ( metallic ores ) were put in the flame , stone atoms united with the fire atoms producing the substances known as metals .
Translation: 当某些矿石（金属矿）置于火焰中时，其原子会与火原子结合，生成被称为金属的物质。

Query_Text_en: Cheap metals like iron contained very small amounts of fire atoms and therefore looked rather dull . Gold had the maximum amount of fire atoms and thus was brilliant and valuable .
Translation: 铁等廉价金属所含火原子极少，因而色泽晦暗。黄金因富含最多火原子，故光彩夺目且价值连城。

Query_Text_en: A student who would tell all that in his introductory chemistry examination would certainly get an F grade .
Translation: 在化学入门考试中如此作答的学生，必定会得到不及格的成绩。

Query_Text_en: But , although these particular examples of the nature of chemical transformation were certainly wrong , the fundamental idea of obtaining almost unlimited numbers of different substances by a combination of only a few basic chemical elements was undoubtedly correct and now represents the foundation of chemistry today .
Translation: 然而，尽管这些关于化学变化本质的具体例证确实存在谬误，但通过仅组合少数几种基本化学元素就能获得几乎无限多种不同物质的核心思想无疑是正确的，如今已成为现代化学的基石。

Query_Text_en: It took , however , twenty-two centuries from the time of Democritus to the time of Dalton to make things right .
Translation: 然而，从德谟克利特到达尔顿，人类耗费了二十二个世纪才真正厘清这一理论。

Query_Text_en: One of the giants of the ancient Greek world was a man named Aristotle , who became famous on two counts : first , because he was a real genius ; second , because he was a tutor and later a prot g of Alexander the Great of Macedonia .
Translation: 古希腊世界的伟人之一当属亚里士多德，其声名显赫源于两大缘由：其一，他乃旷世奇才；其二，他曾任马其顿亚历山大大帝的导师，后更成为其肱股之臣。

Query_Text_en: He was bom in 384 b.c. in the Greek colonial town Stagira on the Aegean Sea to a former court physician of the Macedonian royal family .
Translation: 他于公元前384年出生在爱琴海沿岸的希腊殖民城镇斯塔基拉，其父曾任马其顿王室御医。

Query_Text_en: At the age of 17 he came to Athens and joined the philosophical school of Plato , remaining an ardent student of Plato until his ( Plato 's ) death in 347 B . .
Translation: 17岁时，他来到雅典并加入柏拉图的哲学学派，始终以热忱追随者的身份师从柏拉图，直至后者于公元前347年辞世。

Query_Text_en: After this , there followed a period of extensive travel until he finally returned to Athens and founded a philosophical school known as Peripatetic which was held at the Lyceum .
Translation: 此后，他经历了漫长的游历生涯，最终重返雅典并创立了名为"逍遥学派"的哲学流派，该学派教学活动主要在吕克昂学园开展。

Query_Text_en: Most of the works of Aristotle preserved until our time are the ' treatises ' which probably represent the texts of lectures which he delivered in the Lyceum on various branches of science .
Translation: 流传至今的亚里士多德著作多为"讲义"性质，这些文本很可能是他在吕克昂学园讲授各类科学课程时的讲稿。

Query_Text_en: There are the treatises on logic and psychology of which he was the inventor , the treatises on political science , and on various biological problems , especially on classification of plants and animals .
Translation: 他开创了逻辑学与心理学论著，撰写了政治科学专著，并针对各类生物学问题——尤其是动植物分类学——进行了系统论述。

Query_Text_en: But , whereas in all these fields Aristotle made tremendous contributions which influenced human thought for two millennia after his death , probably his most important contribution in the field of physics was the invention of the name of that science which was derived by him from the Greek word which means nature .
Translation: 然而，尽管亚里士多德在这些领域均作出了影响后世两千年的巨大贡献，但他在物理学领域最重要的贡献或许是为这门学科命名——该名称源自希腊语中意为"自然"的词汇。

Query_Text_en: The shortcomings of Aristotelian philosophy in the study of physical phenomena should be ascribed to the fact that Aristotle 's great mind was not mathematically inclined as were the minds of many other ancient Greek philosophers .
Translation: 亚里士多德哲学在研究物理现象方面的缺陷，应归因于这位伟大思想家缺乏数学思维倾向——而这一特质正是古希腊其他许多哲学家所具备的。

Query_Text_en: His ideas concerning the motion of terrestrial objects and celestial bodies did probably more harm than service to the progress of science .
Translation: 他关于地球物体与天体运动的观点，对科学进步的阻碍或许更甚于推动。

Query_Text_en: At the rebirth of scientific thinking during the Renaissance , people like Galileo had to struggle hard to throw off the yoke of Aristotelian philosophy , which was generally considered at that time as ' the last word in knowledge ' , making further inquiries into the nature of things quite unnecessary .
Translation: 文艺复兴时期科学思想重获新生，伽利略等先驱者不得不奋力挣脱亚里士多德哲学体系的桎梏——这套被当时奉为"终极真理"的学说，使人们认为对事物本质的进一步探究纯属多余。

Query_Text_en: His most important work in pure mathematics was the discovery of the relation between the surface and volume of a sphere and its circumscribing cylinder ; in fact , in accordance with his desire , his tomb was marked with a sphere inscribed into a cylinder .
Translation: 他在纯数学领域最重要的贡献，是发现了球体表面积、体积与外接圆柱体之间的几何关系；根据其生前遗愿，其墓碑上特意镌刻了圆柱内接球体的图案以示纪念。

Query_Text_en: In his book entitled Psammites or Sandreckoner , he develops the method of writing very large numbers by ascribing to each figure in the row different ' order ' according to its position , and applying it to the problem of writing down the number of grains of sand contained within a sphere of the size of the earth .
Translation: 在其著作《数沙者》中，他开创了书写极大数字的方法：根据数字在序列中的位置赋予不同"量级"，并将此方法运用于计算地球体积大小的球体所能容纳沙粒数量的数学难题。

Query_Text_en: In his famous book On the Equilibrium of Planes ( in two volumes ) Archimedes develops the laws of lever and discusses the problem of finding the center of gravity of any given body .
Translation: 阿基米德在其名著《论平面平衡》（两卷本）中阐述了杠杆原理，并探讨了求解任意物体重心的方法。

Query_Text_en: For a modern reader , the style of Archimedes ' writings will sound rather heavy and long winded , resembling in many respects the style of Euclid 's books on geometry .
Translation: 对于现代读者而言，阿基米德著作的行文风格会显得颇为冗长沉闷，其行文风格在许多方面与欧几里得的几何学著作颇为相似。

Query_Text_en: In fact , at the time of Archimedes , Greek mathematics was almost entirely limited to geometry , algebra being invented much later by the Arabs .
Translation: 事实上，在阿基米德时代，希腊数学几乎完全局限于几何学领域，而代数则是由阿拉伯人在很久之后才创立的。

Query_Text_en: Thus , various proofs in the field of mechanics and other branches of physics were carried out by considering geometrical figures rather than , as we do now , writing algebraic equations .
Translation: 因此，在力学和物理学其他分支领域的诸多证明，都是通过几何图形而非代数方程来完成的——这与我们现今的论证方式截然不同。

Query_Text_en: As in Euclid 's Geometry , over which many a reader had sweated in his or her school days , Archimedes formulates the basic laws of ' statics ' ( i.e. , the study of equilibrium ) by formulating the ' postulates ' and deriving from them a number of ' propositions ' .
Translation: 正如欧几里得几何学曾让无数学子在求学时代绞尽脑汁那样，阿基米德通过构建"公设"并由此推导出若干"命题"，从而确立了静力学（即平衡研究）的基本法则。

Query_Text_en: Equal weights at equal distances are in equilibrium , and equal weights at unequal distances are not in equilibrium , but incline towards the weight which is at the greater distance .
Translation: 等距等重则平衡，不等距等重则失衡，且向距离较大之重物倾斜。

Query_Text_en: If , when weights at certain distances are in equilibrium , something is added to one of the weights , they are not in equilibrium , but incline towards the weight to which the addition is made .
Translation: 若两重物在特定距离上处于平衡状态，此时若在其中一方增加重量，则平衡即被打破，系统将向增重一方倾斜。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , if anything be taken away from one of the weights , they are not in equilibrium but incline towards the weight from which nothing was taken .
Translation: 同理，若从某一重物中减去部分重量，则天平不再平衡，而向未被减重的物体一侧倾斜。

Query_Text_en: If equal and similar plane figures coincide if applied to one another , their centers of gravity similarly coincide .
Translation: 若两个全等且相似的平面图形重合叠加，其重心亦将完全重合。

Query_Text_en: If figures are unequal but similar , the centcrs of gravity will be similarly situated .
Translation: 若图形不等但相似，则其重心位置亦相应相似。

Query_Text_en: By points similarly situated in relation to similar figures I mean points such that , if straight lines be drawn through them to the equal angles , they make equal angles with the corresponding sides .
Translation: 对于相对于相似图形处于相似位置的点，我指的是这样的点：若通过它们向相等角引直线，则这些直线与对应边构成相等的角。

Query_Text_en: If two weights at certain distances be in equilibrium , other two weights equal to them will be also in equilibrium at the same distances . ( Ai n't it clear ? >
Translation: 若在某距离上两重物能平衡，等重之两物置于同距亦当平衡。（岂非明矣？）

Query_Text_en: In any figure whose perimeter is concave in the same direction the center of gravity must be within the figure .
Translation: 对于任何周边均朝同一方向内凹的图形，其重心必位于图形内部。

Query_Text_en: These postulates are followed by fifteen propositions derived from them by straightforward logical arguments .
Translation: 这些假设之后是十五条命题，它们通过直接逻辑论证从假设中推导而出。

Query_Text_en: We give here the first five propositions , omitting their proof , and quote the exact proofs of the sixth proposition since it involves the fundamental law of lever .
Translation: 此处列出前五项命题（证明从略），并完整引用第六命题的证明过程，因其涉及杠杆基本原理。

Query_Text_en: If two equal weights have not the same center of gravity , the centcr of gravity of both taken together is the middle point of the line joining their centers of gravity ...
Translation: 若两等重物体重心不重合，则其联合重心必位于两重心连线之中点……

Query_Text_en: If three equal weights have their centers of gravity on the straight line at equal distances , the center of gravity of the system will coincide with that of the middle weight ...
Translation: 若三个等重物体的重心位于同一直线上且间距相等，则该系统的重心将与中间物体的重心重合......

Query_Text_en: Two weights balance at distances reciprocally proportional to the weights .
Translation: 两重物平衡时，其距离与重量成反比。

Query_Text_en: The discovery of the principle of lever and its various applications produced a sensation in the ancient world , as we can see from the description given by Plutarch in his book Life of Marcellus , a Roman general who captured Syracuse during the Second Punic War and who was partially responsible for the slaying of Archimedes , who contributed largely to the defense of the city by building ingenious war machines .
Translation: 杠杆原理的发现及其广泛应用在古代世界引发了巨大轰动，这一点我们可以从普鲁塔克所著《马塞勒斯传》中的记载得到印证。马塞勒斯是第二次布匿战争中攻陷锡拉库萨的罗马将军，他对阿基米德之死负有部分责任。而阿基米德正是通过设计精妙的战争器械，为保卫该城作出了重大贡献。

Query_Text_en: Hiero was astonished , and begged him to put his proposition into execution , and show him some great weight moved by a slight force .
Translation: 希罗大为惊讶，恳请他付诸实践，展示如何以微力撬动重物。

Query_Text_en: Archimedes therefore fixed upon a three-master merchantman of the royal fleet , which had been dragged ashore by the great labors of many men , and after putting on board many passengers and the customary freight , he seated himself at a distance from her , and without any great effort , but quietly setting in motion with his hand a system of compound pulleys , drew her towards him smoothly and evenly , as though she were gliding through the water .
Translation: 于是，阿基米德选定了一艘皇家舰队的三桅商船——这艘船此前由众人费尽气力才拖上岸。待乘客与常规货物悉数登船后，他在远处落座，仅以单手从容启动复合滑轮组，未费多大力气便使船体平稳匀速地滑向自己，宛如在水面航行一般。

Query_Text_en: The principle of lever plays a very important role in all walks of life from a farmer using a crowbar to move away a heavy boulder , to the intricate machinery used in modern engineering .
Translation: 杠杆原理在各行各业都发挥着至关重要的作用，从农民使用撬棍移开巨石，到现代工程中精密的机械设备，莫不如是。
