Query_Text_en: If the several breeds are not varieties , and have not proceeded from the rock-pigeon , they must have descended from at least seven or eight aboriginal stocks ; for it is impossible to make the present domestic breeds by the crossing of any lesser number : how , for instance , could a pouter be produced by crossing two breeds unless one of the parent-stocks possessed the characteristic enormous crop ?
Translation: 倘若这几个品种不算是变种，也不起源于岩鸽，那么它们必定至少源自七八个原始祖先。因为要使现存的家养品种通过杂交产生，少于这个数目是不可能实现的。例如，若没有一个亲本品种天生具有异常发达的嗉囊特征，如何能通过两个品种杂交培育出球胸鸽呢？

Query_Text_en: The supposed aboriginal stocks must all have been rock-pigeons , that is , they did not breed or willingly perch on trees .
Translation: 所谓原始种系必然皆为岩鸽，即不栖于树木繁殖或栖息者。

Query_Text_en: But besides C. livia , with its geographical sub-species , only two or three other species of rock-pigeons are known ; and these have not any of the characters of the domestic breeds .
Translation: 然而，除了原鸽及其地理亚种外，已知的岩鸽种类仅有两三种；且这些品种均不具备家养鸽类的任何特征。

Query_Text_en: Hence the supposed aboriginal stocks must either still exist in the countries where they were originally domesticated , and yet be unknown to ornithologists ; and this , considering their size , habits and remarkable characters , seems improbable ; or they must have become extinct in the wild state . But birds breeding on precipices , and good flyers , are unlikely to be exterminated ;
Translation: 因此，这些假定的原始品种要么仍存在于最初被驯化的地区，却尚未被鸟类学家发现——考虑到其体型、习性与显著特征，这种可能性微乎其微；要么已在野生状态下灭绝。但栖息于悬崖且善飞的鸟类，不太可能遭遇灭绝之灾。

Query_Text_en: and the common rock-pigeon , which has the same habits with the domestic breeds , has not been exterminated even on several of the smaller British islets , or on the shores of the Mediterranean .
Translation: 而习性相同的原种岩鸽，即便在英伦诸小岛或地中海沿岸亦未遭灭绝。

Query_Text_en: Hence the supposed extermination of so many species having similar habits with the rock-pigeon seems a very rash assumption .
Translation: 因此，认为与岩鸽习性相似的众多物种已遭灭绝的假设，实属极其轻率的推断。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , the several above-named domesticated breeds have been transported to all parts of the world , and , therefore , some of them must have been carried back again into their native country ; but not one has become wild or feral , though the dovecot-pigeon , which is the rock-pigeon in a very slightly altered state , has become feral in several places .
Translation: 此外，上述几种家鸽品种已被输往世界各地，其中一些必然曾被重新带回原产地。然而除鸽舍鸽（即仅发生极轻微变异的原鸽）在少数地区恢复野生状态外，其余品种均未出现野化或回归自然的现象。

Query_Text_en: Again , all recent experience shows that it is difficult to get wild animals to breed freely under domestication ;
Translation: 此外，近期所有经验表明，要让野生动物在驯养条件下自由繁殖并非易事；

Query_Text_en: yet on the hypothesis of the multiple origin of our pigeons , it must be assumed that at least seven or eight species were so thoroughly domesticated in ancient times by half-civilized man , as to be quite prolific under confinement .
Translation: 然而，若假设家鸽存在多源起源，则必须推定至少有七八个鸽种在古代已被半开化人类彻底驯化，以至于在圈养条件下仍能保持旺盛的繁殖力。

Query_Text_en: An argument of great weight , and applicable in several other cases , is , that the above-specified breeds , though agreeing generally with the wild rock-pigeon in constitution , habits , voice , coloring , and in most parts of their structure , yet are certainly highly abnormal in other parts ;
Translation: 一个极具说服力且适用于其他多个案例的论点是：上述特定品种虽然在体质、习性、鸣叫、羽色及身体大部分结构上与野生原鸽基本一致，但某些部位确实存在显著异常。

Query_Text_en: we may look in vain through the whole great family of Columbidae for a beak like that of the English carrier , or that of the short-faced tumbler , or barb ; for reversed feathers like those of the Jacobin ; for a crop like that of the pouter ; for tail-feathers like those of the fantail .
Translation: 纵览整个鸽科大家族，我们或许难以找到如英国信鸽般的喙，或是短面翻飞鸽、须鸽那样的嘴型；也寻不见如雅各宾鸽般的逆羽，如球胸鸽般的嗉囊，又如扇尾鸽般的尾羽。

Query_Text_en: Hence it must be assumed , not only that half-civilized man succeeded in thoroughly domesticating several species , but that he intentionally or by chance picked out extraordinarily abnormal species ; and further , that these very species have since all become extinct or unknown .
Translation: 因此必须假定，半开化的人类不仅成功驯化了若干物种，而且有意或无意地选择了极其特殊的异常物种；更甚者，这些特定物种此后均已灭绝或湮没无闻。

Query_Text_en: So many strange contingencies are improbable in the highest degree .
Translation: 诸多离奇的偶然事件，其发生概率微乎其微。

Query_Text_en: Some facts in regard to the coloring of pigeons well deserve consideration .
Translation: 关于鸽子羽色的若干事实颇值得关注。

Query_Text_en: but the Indian sub-species , C. intermedia of Strickland , has this part bluish .
Translation: 但印度亚种——斯特里克兰所称的C. intermedia——该部位羽毛呈蓝色。

Query_Text_en: Some semi-domestic breeds , and some truly wild breeds , have , besides the two black bars , the wings chequered with black .
Translation: 某些半家养品种及纯野生品种的鸽子，除两道黑斑外，翅膀上还布满黑色方格斑纹。

Query_Text_en: These several marks do not occur together in any other species of the whole family .
Translation: 在整个科属中，其他任何物种都不具备这些特征的同时出现。

Query_Text_en: Now , in every one of the domestic breeds , taking thoroughly well-bred birds , all the above marks , even to the white edging of the outer tail-feathers , sometimes concur perfectly developed .
Translation: 如今，在家养的各个品种中，只要选取血统纯正的优良个体，上述所有特征——甚至包括外侧尾羽的白边——有时都能完美呈现。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , when birds belonging to two or more distinct breeds are crossed , none of which are blue or have any of the above-specified marks , the mongrel offspring are very apt suddenly to acquire these characters .
Translation: 此外，当两个或多个不同品种的鸟类杂交时，若亲本均非蓝色且不携带上述特征标记，其杂交后代往往会出现这些性状的突然显现。

Query_Text_en: To give one instance out of several which I have observed : I crossed some white fantails , which breed very true , with some black barbs and it so happens that blue varieties of barbs are so rare that I never heard of an instance in England ; and the mongrels were black , brown and mottled .
Translation: 我曾观察过多个案例，现举一例说明：我将几只纯种白色扇尾鸽与黑色巴巴里鸽杂交，而巴巴里鸽的蓝色变种极为罕见，我在英格兰从未听闻此类实例；杂交后代羽色呈黑色、棕色及杂斑色。

Query_Text_en: We can understand these facts , on the well-known principle of reversion to ancestral characters , if all the domestic breeds are descended from the rock-pigeon .
Translation: 如果我们承认所有家鸽品种都源自岩鸽，那么根据众所周知的返祖遗传原理，这些事实便不难理解。

Query_Text_en: But if we deny this , we must make one of the two following highly improbable suppositions .
Translation: 但若否认这一点，我们就必须作出以下两种极不可能的假设之一。

Query_Text_en: Either , first , that all the several imagined aboriginal stocks were colored and marked like the rock-pigeon , although no other existing species is thus colored and marked , so that in each separate breed there might be a tendency to revert to the very same colors and markings .
Translation: 其一，最初设想的若干原始鸽种，其羽色与斑纹均与现今岩鸽相同，尽管现存其他鸽种均无此类特征；因此每个独立品种在遗传过程中都可能存在恢复完全相同羽色与斑纹的倾向。

Query_Text_en: Or , secondly , that each breed , even the purest , has within a dozen , or at most within a score , of generations , been crossed by the rock-pigeon : I say within a dozen or twenty generations , for no instance is known of crossed descendants reverting to an ancestor of foreign blood , removed by a greater number of generations .
Translation: 或者，第二点，每个品种，即使是最纯的，也曾在十几代或最多二十代内与岩鸽杂交过。我之所以说十几代或二十代，是因为从未发现杂交后代在超过这个世代数后，还能重现外来血统祖先的特征。

Query_Text_en: In a breed which has been crossed only once the tendency to revert to any character derived from such a cross will naturally become less and less , as in each succeeding generation there will be less of the foreign blood ;
Translation: 在仅经过一次杂交的品种中，随着每一代外来血统的逐渐减少，其返祖至杂交特征的倾向自然也会日益减弱。

Query_Text_en: but when there has been no cross , and there is a tendency in the breed to revert to a character which was lost during some former generation , this tendency , for all that we can see to the contrary , may be transmitted undiminished for an indefinite number of generations .
Translation: 然而，当杂交未曾发生且该物种存在恢复某一祖先已消失特性的倾向时，就我们迄今所知，这种倾向仍可能毫无衰减地传递无数世代。

Query_Text_en: These two distinct cases of reversion are often confounded together by those who have written on inheritance .
Translation: 论及遗传问题的著述者，常将这两种截然不同的返祖现象混为一谈。

Query_Text_en: Lastly , the hybrids or mongrels from between all the breeds of the pigeon are perfectly fertile , as I can state from my own observations , purposely made , on the most distinct breeds .
Translation: 最后，根据我对差异最显著品种的专门观察，所有鸽种间的杂交或混种后代都具有完全可育性。

Query_Text_en: Now , hardly any cases have been ascertained with certainty of hybrids from two quite distinct species of animals being perfectly fertile .
Translation: 目前，几乎无法确切证实两种截然不同的动物杂交后代具有完全可育性的案例。

Query_Text_en: Some authors believe that long-continued domestication eliminates this strong tendency to sterility in species .
Translation: 有学者认为，长期持续的驯化过程能够消除物种间这种强烈的不育倾向。

Query_Text_en: From the history of the dog , and of some other domestic animals , this conclusion is probably quite correct , if applied to species closely related to each other .
Translation: 从狗和其他一些家养动物的历史来看，若将这一结论应用于彼此亲缘关系密切的物种，或许是完全正确的。

Query_Text_en: But to extend it so far as to suppose that species , aboriginally as distinct as carriers , tumblers , pouters , and fantails now are , should yield offspring perfectly fertile , inter se , seems to me rash in the extreme .
Translation: 然而，若将这一观点推演至极，竟认为那些原本差异就极大的物种——如现今的传信鸽、翻飞鸽、球胸鸽和扇尾鸽——彼此杂交后应能产生完全可育的后代，在我看来实属极端轻率之论。

Query_Text_en: From these several reasons , namely , the improbability of man having formerly made seven or eight supposed species of pigeons to breed freely under domestication these supposed species being quite unknown in a wild state , and their not having become anywhere feral these species presenting certain very abnormal characters , as compared with all other Columbidae , though so like the rock-pigeon in most other respects the occasional reappearance of the blue color and various black marks in all the breeds , both when kept pure and when crossed and lastly , the mongrel offspring being perfectly fertile from these several reasons , taken together , we may safely conclude that all our domestic breeds are descended from the rock-pigeon or Columba livia with its geographical sub-species .
Translation: 基于以下几点原因：其一，人类不太可能曾将七八种假定的鸽子物种驯化至完全家养状态，因为这些所谓物种在野生环境中全然未见踪迹，且未在任何地区重新野化；其二，与其他鸠鸽科鸟类相比，这些物种虽在多数特征上与岩鸽极为相似，却表现出某些显著异常性状；其三，所有品种无论纯种繁殖还是杂交培育时，都会偶尔重现蓝色羽毛与各类黑色斑纹；其末，杂交后代均具有完全可育性——综合这些因素，我们可以确凿断定：所有家鸽品种皆源自岩鸽（Columba livia）及其地理亚种。

Query_Text_en: In favor of this view , I may add , firstly , that the wild C. livia has been found capable of domestication in Europe and in India ; and that it agrees in habits and in a great number of points of structure with all the domestic breeds .
Translation: 支持这一观点的理由，首先在于野生原鸽在欧洲和印度均已被证实具备驯化可能；其次，其生活习性及大量结构特征与所有家鸽品种完全吻合。

Query_Text_en: so we can in some other cases , but not with all the breeds .
Translation: 因此，我们能在某些其他情况下做到，但并非适用于所有品种。

Query_Text_en: Thirdly , those characters which are mainly distinctive of each breed are in each eminently variable , for instance , the wattle and length of beak of the carrier , the shortness of that of the tumbler , and the number of tail-feathers in the fantail ; and the explanation of this fact will be obvious when we treat of selection .
Translation: 第三，各品种间最具区别性的特征往往表现出极强变异性，例如传信鸽的肉垂与喙长、翻飞鸽的短喙、扇尾鸽的尾羽数量；当我们讨论选择原理时，这一现象的原因将不言自明。

Query_Text_en: They have been domesticated for thousands of years in several quarters of the world ;
Translation: 它们在世界上多个地区已被驯化数千年之久；

Query_Text_en: the earliest known record of pigeons is in the fifth Aegyptian dynasty , about 3000 B.C. , as was pointed out to me by Professor Lepsius ;
Translation: 据莱普修斯教授向我指出，关于鸽子的最早记载见于埃及第五王朝，约公元前3000年。

Query_Text_en: but Mr. Birch informs me that pigeons are given in a bill of fare in the previous dynasty .
Translation: 但伯奇先生告知我，前朝菜单中确有鸽肉之记载。

Query_Text_en: In the time of the Romans , as we hear from Pliny , immense prices were given for pigeons ; nay , they are come to this pass , that they can reckon up their pedigree and race .
Translation: 据普林尼记载，罗马时代鸽价极其昂贵，甚至发展到能追溯其血统世系的地步。

Query_Text_en: Pigeons were much valued by Akber Khan in India , about the year 1600 ; never less than 20,000 pigeons were taken with the court .
Translation: 约在1600年，印度阿克巴汗王对鸽子极为珍视，宫廷随行鸽群从未少于两万只。

Query_Text_en: The monarchs of Iran and Turan sent him some very rare birds ; and , continues the courtly historian , His Majesty , by crossing the breeds , which method was never practiced before , has improved them astonishingly .
Translation: 伊朗与图兰的君主进献了一批珍禽异鸟。据宫廷史官记载：陛下首创杂交育种之法，使禽鸟品质获得惊人提升，此法实乃前无古人之举。

Query_Text_en: About this same period the Dutch were as eager about pigeons as were the old Romans .
Translation: 大约同一时期，荷兰人对鸽子的热衷程度丝毫不亚于古罗马人。

Query_Text_en: The paramount importance of these considerations in explaining the immense amount of variation which pigeons have undergone , will likewise be obvious when we treat of selection . We shall then , also , see how it is that the several breeds so often have a somewhat monstrous character .
Translation: 在探讨选择机制时，这些因素对于解释鸽子品种何以呈现如此巨大变异所起的决定性作用，也将变得显而易见。届时我们还将理解，为何诸多品种往往具有某种畸形特征。

Query_Text_en: It is also a most favourable circumstance for the production of distinct breeds , that male and female pigeons can be easily mated for life ; and thus different breeds can be kept together in the same aviary .
Translation: 此外，雌雄鸽易于终身配对这一特性，对培育纯种鸽极为有利，因而可在同一鸽舍内混养不同品种。

Query_Text_en: I have discussed the probable origin of domestic pigeons at some , yet quite insufficient , length ;
Translation: 关于家鸽的起源问题，我虽已作过若干探讨，然论述尚欠充分。

Query_Text_en: because when I first kept pigeons and watched the several kinds , well knowing how truly they breed , I felt fully as much difficulty in believing that since they had been domesticated they had all proceeded from a common parent , as any naturalist could in coming to a similar conclusion in regard to the many species of finches , or other groups of birds , in nature .
Translation: 因为当我最初饲养鸽子并观察其多个品种时，虽然深知它们繁殖之纯正，却仍难以相信这些家鸽皆源自同一祖先——这种困惑，正如任何博物学家面对自然界中众多雀科或其他鸟类物种得出类似结论时所经历的认知困境。

Query_Text_en: One circumstance has struck me much ; namely , that nearly all the breeders of the various domestic animals and the cultivators of plants , with whom I have conversed , or whose treatises I have read , are firmly convinced that the several breeds to which each has attended , are descended from so many aboriginally distinct species .
Translation: 有一桩事曾使我大感惊奇，即几乎所有饲养各类家畜和栽培植物的人士——我曾与之交谈或读过其论著者——都坚信他们所培育的诸多品种源自若干原本不同的物种。

Query_Text_en: Ask , as I have asked , a celebrated raiser of Hereford cattle , whether his cattle might not have descended from Long-horns , or both from a common parent-stock , and he will laugh you to scorn .
Translation: 试问一位知名的赫里福德牛育种专家——正如我曾请教过的那样——他的牛群是否可能并非源自长角牛，抑或两者同出一脉，他定会对此嗤之以鼻。

Query_Text_en: I have never met a pigeon , or poultry , or duck , or rabbit fancier , who was not fully convinced that each main breed was descended from a distinct species .
Translation: 我从未见过哪个鸽子、家禽、鸭子或兔子的爱好者，不深信每个主要品种都源自不同的物种。

Query_Text_en: When the child takes pencil and paper and makes his first attempt to write , he is beginning a long course of training in the particular form of learning which we call sensorimotor .
Translation: 当孩子拿起纸笔初次尝试书写时，他便开启了感觉运动这一特定学习形式的漫长训练历程。

Query_Text_en: Writing does not require in any large degree the exercise of memory , of imagination , or of reasoning .
Translation: 写作并不需要过多运用记忆力、想象力或推理能力。

Query_Text_en: It requires , as the term sensorimotor
Translation: 这需要，正如术语"感觉运动"所暗示的

Query_Text_en: In learning to read , on the other hand , movements play a minor part compared with the acquirement of the ability to recognize quickly and correctly the combinations of letters as they appear in words , and to give them their true meaning .
Translation: 另一方面，在学习阅读的过程中，与快速准确识别单词中字母组合并理解其真实含义的能力相比，动作发挥的作用较小。

Query_Text_en: The understanding of number requires that one shall disregard most of the qualities of objects and pay attention only to their number .
Translation: 理解数字需要人们忽略物体的大部分属性，而仅关注其数量。

Query_Text_en: Accordingly , we say that learning number involves the process of abstraction .
Translation: 因此，我们认为数字学习是一个抽象化的过程。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , other subjects of the curriculum furnish illustrations of other forms of learning .
Translation: 同样，课程中的其他科目也提供了不同学习形式的例证。

Query_Text_en: There is a great deal of variation in the efficiency with which these various kinds of learning are carried on in the school .
Translation: 各类学习活动在学校中的开展效率存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Some children learn rapidly , others slowly . Some waste effort , others economize it . Some reach a high degree of proficiency ; others remain permanently at a low level .
Translation: 有的孩子学得快，有的学得慢；有的费劲，有的省力；有的能学到很高的水平，有的始终停留在低水平。

Query_Text_en: If we compare , not individual children , but different classes or schools or school systems doing the same work , large differences in efficiency still appear .
Translation: 若我们对比的不是个别学生，而是从事相同教学任务的不同班级、学校或教育体系，仍会显现出显著的效率差异。

Query_Text_en: A certain proportion of the differences between individual children , and even between different classes or schools , may be attributed to differences in native ability , but in large measure a child learns economically and well , or the reverse , according as his learning is supervised well or poorly . The child may stumble along and by blind trial learn how to improve .
Translation: 个体儿童之间，乃至不同班级或学校之间的差异，固然有部分可归因于天赋能力的差别，但更主要的是取决于学习指导的优劣——指导得当则学习事半功倍，指导不善则成效不彰。儿童虽可通过盲目试错跌撞前行，逐步掌握改进之道。

Query_Text_en: In some forms of learning , in fact , random trial forms a fairly large part of the method . But when the child 's efforts are not intelligently guided , the amount of blind trial is larger than necessary , and much time is wasted in consequence .
Translation: 事实上，在某些学习形式中，随机尝试构成了方法的重要组成部分。然而，若缺乏对儿童学习行为的智能引导，盲目尝试的比重就会超出必要范围，从而导致大量时间被浪费。

Query_Text_en: Experiments in supervised study have shown that , even in the high school , the pupil needs considerable help from the teacher to show him how to go about his work in its more general aspects , and to meet the special difficulties of each subject .
Translation: 监督学习的实验表明，即便在高中阶段，学生仍需教师提供大量指导，以掌握各学科通用学习方法并应对具体科目中的特殊难点。

Query_Text_en: How much more is the elementary-school pupil in need of skilled supervision :
Translation: 小学生更需要多少专业指导？

Query_Text_en: In order to supervise the child 's learning most effectively , it is necessary to know what mental changes take place in the different forms of learning which he undertakes .
Translation: 要最有效地监督孩子的学习，就必须了解他在各类学习过程中发生的心理变化。

Query_Text_en: Merely to know the result which is aimed at is not sufficient important as this is . One can learn in a short time to distinguish between good and poor writing , between an adequate and an inadequate understanding of history or geography , or between different degrees of proficiency in the pursuit of a science . A clerk can correct examination papers in arithmetic or spelling . These forms of discrimination make up the art of the examiner . When carried to a high degree of perfection in the development of standard tests of attainment , this art becomes more difficult , and it becomes possible to use the results in directing the pupil 's efforts . But in the main the art of the teacher is the far more delicate one of following the changes which take place in the mind of the pupil , and of bringing to bear his influence upon them to produce the highest degree of improvement with the least expenditure of effort . In order to understand the process which is going on in the child 's mind when he learns the various branches , it is necessary to have a conception of the typical learning processes which are involved in these branches .
Translation: 仅了解预期目标尚不足够。人们可在短期内学会区分文章优劣、判断历史地理理解是否充分，或辨识科学研究的熟练程度差异。文员能批改算术拼写试卷——此类鉴别构成了考官的艺术。当发展至学业水平标准化测试的高度完善阶段，这项技艺将更趋精妙，其测评结果可有效指导学生学习。但教师艺术之精微更在于：洞察学生心智变化轨迹，施加精准影响，以最小努力获取最大进步。要理解儿童学习各科时的思维过程，必须把握这些学科所蕴含的典型学习机制。

Query_Text_en: It might be supposed that , having gone through the learning processes himself as a child , the teacher would have sufficient insight into their nature from his memory of his own efforts , without making any further study of them . This memory of one 's early struggles , however , is not sufficient .
Translation: 人们或许认为，教师既然亲身经历过儿童时期的学习过程，只需回忆自身努力经历便足以洞察学习本质，无需再作专门研究。然而，仅凭对早年奋斗经历的回忆是远远不够的。

Query_Text_en: In the first place , memory has become very dim with time .
Translation: 首先，随着时间流逝，记忆已变得十分模糊。

Query_Text_en: From great familiarity with the tasks which the child has to meet , one becomes subject to the illusion that they are easy , and that the only requisite for their performance is good-will .
Translation: 由于对孩子必须完成的任务过于熟悉，人们容易产生一种错觉，认为这些任务很简单，只要怀有良好意愿就能胜任。

Query_Text_en: Let the teacher try one or two of the tasks which are suggested in the following pages as illustrations of learning of a sensorimotor or a perceptual sort , such as writing with the left hand or the toes , or gaining a correct apprehension of the figure shown in chapter III , and he will get something of the baffled , helpless feeling which possesses the child which will set him to searching for some way to help the child to find out how to meet the demands which are laid upon him .
Translation: 让教师尝试以下章节中列举的一两项感知运动类或知觉类学习任务——例如用左手或脚趾书写，或正确理解第三章所示图形——他就能体会到那种困扰着儿童的挫败与无助感，这将促使他寻求方法帮助儿童学会如何应对眼前的要求。

Query_Text_en: A second reason why the teacher 's early experience is not enough to fit him for the task of guiding the child in his learning is that the learning attitude and the teaching attitude are different .
Translation: 教师早期经验不足以胜任指导儿童学习任务的第二个原因在于：学习态度与教学态度存在本质差异。

Query_Text_en: The learner is absorbed mainly in the result which he wishes to accomplish , and he does not make much analysis of the means by which he reaches his goal . In fact , he sometimes will reach his goal more quickly if he does not analyze the process very much .
Translation: 学习者主要专注于其希望达成的结果，而不会过多分析实现目标的手段。事实上，有时不过多分析过程反而能更快达成目标。

Query_Text_en: But the teacher must have the analytical attitude . He must be continually thinking about how the act which he is teaching can best be performed .
Translation: 但教师必须具备分析的态度，必须不断思考如何最优地完成他所教授的行为。

Query_Text_en: For example , the child in writing does not pay attention to the movement so as to know what simple movements compose it and how they work together , but this information helps the teacher to give the child exercises which will emphasize the proper components .
Translation: 例如，儿童在书写时不会关注动作本身，以了解构成该动作的简单动作及其协同方式，但这些信息有助于教师设计针对性练习，强化正确动作要素。

Query_Text_en: While the analysis of the learning process in the common branches , which occupies the following chapters , does not go into the details of the methods of teaching , the constant aim is to give practical assistance to the teacher by giving the basis for an intelligent use of methods .
Translation: 尽管后续章节对基础学科学习过程的分析未深入教学方法细节，但其始终致力于为教师提供方法论运用的理性依据，从而给予切实可行的教学辅助。

Query_Text_en: The different school subjects taken together furnish a pretty comprehensive set of examples of the various kinds of learning of which the human mind is capable . The subjects are so arranged that and less intellectual forms of learning come first , and the higher types in their order .
Translation: 各类学科课程共同构成了人类心智所能掌握的各种学习形式的全面范例。这些课程经过精心安排，由浅入深——基础认知形式的学习内容先行展开，高阶知识类型则依序递进呈现。

Query_Text_en: The topics taken together furnish a fairly complete account of psychology in its active or functional aspect , apart from the instincts and emotions .
Translation: 这些议题综合起来，相当全面地阐述了心理学在能动或功能层面的内涵，而不涉及本能与情绪方面。

Query_Text_en: The sensorimotor form of learning of which handwriting is an example has for its purpose the development of a motor habit , A motor habit exists when such a connection has been formed between a set of stimuli and the movements which are made in response to them , that the movements follow readily upon the stimulus without the necessity of being guided and directed in detail .
Translation: 以书写为代表的感知运动学习形式，其目的在于培养运动习惯。当特定刺激与相应动作之间建立起稳固联系，使得动作能无需详细指引即可对刺激作出自如反应时，即形成了运动习惯。

Query_Text_en: Thus , when a person wishes to write a word , it is not necessary to think about the movements of the fingers or the arm which produce the letters , nor is it necessary to think of the details of the letters themselves .
Translation: 因此，当一个人想要书写一个词时，既无需考虑手指或手臂产生字母的动作，也不必思考字母本身的细节。

Query_Text_en: This is true of all sorts of sensorimotor habits .
Translation: 各类感觉运动习惯皆是如此。

Query_Text_en: The problems of teaching writing are concerned very largely with the development of an efficient movement .
Translation: 写作教学的问题在很大程度上与培养高效写作能力密切相关。

Query_Text_en: We may , then , turn first to a consideration of the composition of the writing movement and of the way in which it is developed .
Translation: 那么，我们可以首先探讨书写动作的构成及其发展方式。

Query_Text_en: The writing movement is a very complex one .
Translation: 这场写作运动极其错综复杂。

Query_Text_en: It is composed of a great many elementary or simple movements .
Translation: 它由大量基础或简单动作构成。

Query_Text_en: In the first place , there is the movement of the fingers and of the hand .
Translation: 首先，手指和手部会产生动作。

Query_Text_en: Even if the letters are not formed by finger movements , the fingers must be employed in holding the pen .
Translation: 即便手指无需移动来书写字母，执笔时仍需用手指握持。

Query_Text_en: In doing this the first and second fingers are separated in their action from the third and fourth . The first two fingers with the thumb hold the pen , while the third and fourth fingers support the weight of the hand .
Translation: 此时，食指与中指的动作需与无名指及小指分开。拇指与食指、中指共同执笔，而无名指和小指则负责支撑手掌重量。

Query_Text_en: This division among the fingers is something which is more or less artificial ;
Translation: 这种手指间的分工多少有些人为因素。

Query_Text_en: that is , it is not the natural manner in which the child grasps objects .
Translation: 也就是说，这并非儿童抓握物体的自然方式。

Query_Text_en: The most primitive method of grasping an object , which is seen not merely in the child but also in the monkey , is to fold the four fingers about it without using the thumb .
Translation: 无论是儿童还是猿猴，抓握物体的最原始方式都是仅用四指合拢而不用拇指。

Query_Text_en: The ability to place the thumb against the tips of the fingers in grasping an object is a distinctly human one and one which develops later in the child than the other form .
Translation: 拇指能够与其他指尖对握抓取物体，这是人类特有的能力，且儿童掌握这一能力的时间要晚于其他抓握方式。

Query_Text_en: The mere act of holding the pen in the conventional manner , then , is a matter of considerable difficulty to the child .
Translation: 那么，仅仅以常规方式握笔这一动作，对孩子来说已是相当困难。

Query_Text_en: In addition to the adjustments or the movements of the fingers there are movements of the various arm joints .
Translation: 除手指的调节或动作外，各臂关节也有动作。

Query_Text_en: The wrist is frequently moved from side to side during the writing of the letters of a word .
Translation: 书写单词时，手腕会随着字母的书写频繁左右摆动。

Query_Text_en: This is not a movement which is commonly approved by writing masters , but it is very generally used .
Translation: 这种写法虽不为书法教师普遍认可，却在实际应用中颇为盛行。

Query_Text_en: The hand also is carried along the line by the movement of the elbow and of the shoulder , together with the wrist .
Translation: 手部动作由肘部、肩部及腕部协同带动完成。

Query_Text_en: Whether the greater part of the movement is made at the elbow joint or at the shoulder will depend on the height to which the arm is raised .
Translation: 手臂动作主要由肘关节还是肩关节完成，取决于手臂抬升的高度。

Query_Text_en: If the arm hangs at the side , none of the movement is made at the elbow .
Translation: 手臂垂于体侧时，肘部不会产生任何动作。

Query_Text_en: The movement by which the letters are formed may also be made partly at the shoulder joint .
Translation: 字母的书写动作也可部分通过肩关节完成。

Query_Text_en: This movement is sometimes called the forearm movement , but it is not , as a matter of fact , made by the forearm . It may be made with the arm resting on the muscle pad of the forearm , but the muscles which produce the movement are at the shoulder .
Translation: 这一动作有时被称为前臂运动，但实际上并非由前臂完成。虽然手臂可依托前臂肌肉垫进行该动作，但驱动运动的肌肉群实际位于肩部。

Query_Text_en: The muscles in the forearm , on the contrary , control the movements of the fingers , as may be readily verified by placing the other hand on the forearm and then closing the fingers .
Translation: 相反，前臂肌肉控制手指运动，只需将另一只手放在前臂上并握紧手指，即可轻松验证这一点。

Query_Text_en: These component movements cooperate in the total movement .
Translation: 这些分项运动共同构成了整体运动。

Query_Text_en: The writing movement to be most efficient should be made up of a combination of these various component movements , since each of them is particularly suited to carry on some part of the whole task .
Translation: 要使书写运动达到最高效率，必须综合运用各类分解动作，因为每个动作都特别适合完成整体任务中的特定环节。

Query_Text_en: The side-to-side movement of the forearm , revolving about the muscle pad as a center , should carry the hand along from the left to the right side of the paper ; and this movement should go on while the letters are being formed so that the writing does not have to be interrupted . The movement of the whole arm from the shoulder resting on the muscle pad of the forearm is well suited to carry the hand up and down so as to play the chief part in making the upward and downward strokes . It is probable that this large movement produces a rhythm and regularity in the writing and a smoothness of stroke which gives the written page a good appearance . Furthermore , it is probable that if a considerable part of the movement is made with the arm , it is not so fatiguing as when the fingers do the whole work .
Translation: 前臂以肌肉垫为中心左右摆动时，应带动手部从纸张左侧移至右侧；这一动作需在字母书写过程中持续进行，以确保书写连贯不中断。整个手臂以肘部肌肉垫为支点从肩部发力的运动，能有效带动手部上下移动，从而在笔画的纵向运笔中发挥主导作用。这种大幅度的动作很可能使书写产生节奏感和规律性，形成流畅的笔画，令整页文稿呈现出美观效果。此外，若以手臂运动承担主要书写动作，相比仅靠手指完成全部工作，其疲劳程度很可能显著降低。

Query_Text_en: The finer parts of the letters can most easily be made with the fingers . Although the attempt is commonly made entirely to exclude finger movement , it rarely succeeds , and the most rational course is to recognize that the fingers , as well as the arm , have their own part to play .
Translation: 字母的精细部分最易用手指完成。尽管人们常试图完全避免手指动作，却鲜有成功。最合理的做法是承认手指与手臂一样，各有其不可替代的作用。

Query_Text_en: Overslant at the end of the line may be corrected by pronation .
Translation: 线路末端的过度倾斜可通过旋前动作予以矫正。

Query_Text_en: Besides these components of the writing movement which produce the words , there is one which is sometimes used to correct a fault resulting from the mechanical conditions of writing .
Translation: 除却这些构成书写动作的运笔方式外，还有一种笔法专用于修正因书写机械条件限制而产生的瑕疵。

Query_Text_en: As the hand is moved forward by the rotation of the forearm about the muscle pad or the elbow as a center , the pen points more and more to the right .
Translation: 当前臂以肌肉垫或肘部为中心旋转带动手部前移时，笔尖会逐渐向右偏转。

Query_Text_en: This is illustrated in Figure 1 .
Translation: 图1对此进行了说明。

Query_Text_en: This causes , unless it is corrected , an overslant of the writing at the right end of the line .
Translation: 若不加以修正，会导致行末文字向右倾斜。

Query_Text_en: In order to correct this overslant , some writers turn the hand and wrist over to the left , as it moves along the line , so that the palm is more turned-down or prone and the penholder is more nearly vertical .
Translation: 为矫正这一过度倾斜，部分书写者在运笔过程中会将手和手腕向左翻转，使掌心更趋朝下或俯卧，笔杆则更接近垂直状态。

Query_Text_en: This movement is called
Translation: 这一趋势被称为

Query_Text_en: Turning the hand down in pronation , therefore , tends to correct the overslant of the writing at the end of the line .
Translation: 因此，手掌向下内旋的动作有助于矫正行末字迹过度倾斜的问题。

Query_Text_en: There are also adjustments of the eyes and of the body .
Translation: 眼睛和身体也需要调整。

Query_Text_en: It will thus be seen that all the chief parts of the hand and arm are used in writing , but this does not exhaust the list of movements which are made or of adjustments which must be maintained .
Translation: 由此可见，书写过程中手部和臂部的主要部位均参与运作，但这并未涵盖所有动作或需持续保持的协调姿态。

Query_Text_en: The eye moves in order to follow the writing of the letters and to guide the movement .
Translation: 眼睛移动以跟随字母书写并引导动作。

Query_Text_en: This must not be regarded as an unimportant part of the whole activity .
Translation: 切不可将此视为整体活动中无足轻重的环节。

Query_Text_en: It is so important that it has been largely due to the recognition of the eye movements that important changes in the teaching of writing have been made .
Translation: 正是由于认识到眼动的重要性，写作教学才得以实现重大变革。

Query_Text_en: In order that the arm may be free to move and may have a solid support , the body must be held in position .
Translation: 为使手臂能自由活动并获得稳固支撑，身体必须保持固定姿势。

Query_Text_en: The position which is taken will have an important effect upon the ease and fluency of the movement .
Translation: 所采取的姿势将对动作的流畅度产生重要影响。

Query_Text_en: This also has an important bearing upon the practical determination of the type of writing which ought to be taught .
Translation: 这也对实际确定应教授何种写作类型具有重要影响。

Query_Text_en: Health demands good posture .
Translation: 健康需要良好体态。

Query_Text_en: The correct posture in writing is also determined by the demands of health .
Translation: 正确的书写姿势也是出于健康的需要。

Query_Text_en: In order that the eyes shall not be subjected to strain , the writer must face the desk squarely and the paper must be near the middle line of the body so as to bring the two eyes the same distance from the writing .
Translation: 为避免眼睛疲劳，书写者须正对书桌，纸张应置于身体中线附近，使双眼与书写内容的距离保持均等。

Query_Text_en: In order that the spine shall not be twisted and bent to the side , both arms should rest on the desk .
Translation: 为确保脊柱不发生侧向扭曲和弯曲，双臂应平放于桌面。

Query_Text_en: In order that the lungs , stomach , and other vital organs shall have sufficient room , the body should be erect .
Translation: 为确保肺部、胃部及其他重要器官获得充足空间，人体应保持直立姿态。

Query_Text_en: The application of correct posture to the position of arm and paper .
Translation: 正确掌握手臂与纸张的摆放姿势。

Query_Text_en: It was formerly thought that these conditions necessitated vertical writing .
Translation: 过去人们认为，这些条件决定了必须采用竖排书写方式。

Query_Text_en: Such is not the case , but it is necessary that the body or the head should not be turned or twisted . The paper may be tilted about thirty degrees to the left so that the line on the page is about at right angles to the line of the forearm .
Translation: 事实并非如此，但必须确保身体或头部不得转动或扭曲。可将纸张向左倾斜约30度，使页面上的线条与前臂线条大致呈直角。

Query_Text_en: This will enable the arm to carry the hand along the line . The writing will then naturally have a slant from the perpendicular by about the amount to which the paper is tilted , as is shown in Figure 2 .
Translation: 如此可使手臂带动手腕沿书写线移动。此时笔迹会自然形成与垂直线约呈纸张倾斜角度的斜度，如图2所示。

Query_Text_en: This is based upon the fact that the upward and downward strokes of the writing naturally fall approximately in the direction perpendicular to the edge of the desk . Writing which has an angle of sixty to seventy degrees to the base-line is , then , the best suited to meet the requirements for an easy movement and at the same time to satisfy the demands of hygiene .
Translation: 这一结论基于以下事实：书写时的上下笔划自然与桌沿大致呈垂直方向。因此，与基线呈60至70度夹角的书写方式，既能满足运笔流畅的要求，又可符合卫生规范。

Query_Text_en: More particular specifications of method must be left to discussions of the teaching of writing .
Translation: 关于写作教学方法的更具体细则，有待后续专题探讨。

Query_Text_en: The first process in motor learning is the selection of the appropriate movements .
Translation: 运动技能学习的首要环节是选择恰当的动作。

Query_Text_en: When the child first attempts to write , he is deficient in that he is not able to select just the movements which will be appropriate to produce the desired result .
Translation: 儿童初学写字时存在不足，因其尚无法精准选择能产生预期效果的运笔动作。

Query_Text_en: The first point , then , concerns the selection of the appropriate movements .
Translation: 首先，关键在于选择合适的行动方案。

Query_Text_en: The child by the time he begins to learn to write has sufficient general control over his bodily activities so that he can in a general way call into action the groups of muscles which are to be used in such an act as writing .
Translation: 儿童开始学习写字时，已具备对身体活动的基本控制能力，能够大体调动书写动作所需的肌肉群协同运作。

Query_Text_en: If he sees somebody else write , he can imitate very roughly the manner of holding the pen and of making the movements .
Translation: 若见他人书写，他亦能粗略模仿执笔运笔之法。

Query_Text_en: But his attempt does not result in the contraction of just the muscles which produced particular strokes . Many useless movements are made . It may be seen from the observation of the child in the earlier stages of his learning that this extension to unnecessary movements is widespread .
Translation: 但他的尝试并不仅限于收缩产生特定笔画的肌肉，还会引发许多无意义的动作。从观察初学阶段儿童的书写过程可见，这种向非必要动作的延伸现象普遍存在。

Query_Text_en: He contracts the muscles of the face , twists the body into unnatural positions , perhaps clenches the left hand , and presents the spectacle of general muscular tension .
Translation: 他面部肌肉紧绷，身体扭曲成不自然的姿势，左手可能紧握，呈现出全身肌肉紧张的状态。

Query_Text_en: This preliminary stage in the development of movement is called
Translation: 这一运动发展的初始阶段被称为

Query_Text_en: Learning consists , then , in the first place , in confining the nervous energy , so far as possible , to the particular muscles which are needed to produce the effect .
Translation: 因此，学习首先在于尽可能地将神经能量集中于产生特定效果所需的肌肉群。

Query_Text_en: Selection means also inhibition .
Translation: 选择即意味着舍弃。

Query_Text_en: This selection of the appropriate movements or the reduction of diffusion involves the inhibition or the prevention of the contrary movements .
Translation: 选择适当的运动或减少扩散，需要抑制或阻止相反的运动。

Query_Text_en: There are two possible methods of attempting this selection .
Translation: 有两种方法可尝试进行此项遴选。

Query_Text_en: We may think particularly of the movement which is to be made or we may fix our mind upon the movements which are to be inhibited .
Translation: 我们或许会特别关注即将采取的行动，也可能专注于那些需要抑制的行为。

Query_Text_en: In some cases , it is not well to think of the movements at all , but only of the result which is to be obtained by them , in this case the formation of the letters on the paper .
Translation: 在某些情况下，我们无需考虑书写动作本身，而只需关注其最终呈现的效果——即纸上形成的字迹。

Query_Text_en: Whichever object is in the attention , the same principle holds .
Translation: 无论关注何种对象，这一原则同样适用。

Query_Text_en: This principle is that it is better to fix the attention upon the movements which are to be made or upon the result which is desired , rather than upon the movements which are to be eliminated or the result which is not desired .
Translation: 这一原则的核心在于：应当将注意力集中于需要做出的动作或期望达成的结果，而非需要避免的动作或不希望出现的结果。

Query_Text_en: A stock illustration of this principle may be taken from learning to ride a bicycle .
Translation: 这一原理的典型例证可以从学骑自行车中获取。

Query_Text_en: When a person thinks of the obstruction in the road or of the ditch at the side , he is very likely to run into the obstruction or fall into the ditch .
Translation: 当一个人总想着路上的障碍或路旁的沟壑时，他很可能就会撞上障碍或跌入沟中。

Query_Text_en: His salvation consists in keeping his mind fixed upon the path along which he wishes to travel .
Translation: 他的救赎之道在于将心神专注于欲行之路。

Query_Text_en: Application . The application of this principle to writing is that the child should not be made anxious concerning the useless or superfluous movements which he makes .
Translation: 这一原则在写作中的应用体现为：不应因儿童做出无用或多余的动作而使其产生焦虑。

Query_Text_en: In its application to the form of the letters , he should be thinking chiefly of the form which he wishes to produce rather than of those forms which he wishes to avoid .
Translation: 在运用于字母形态时，他应主要考虑希望呈现的形态，而非力求规避的样式。

Query_Text_en: It is , of course , necessary for him to examine his own writing so that he may detect the faults in it in contrast with the correctly formed letters .
Translation: 当然，他必须仔细检查自己的书写，以便发现其中与正确字形不符的错误。

Query_Text_en: He is apt , if this is not done , to fail entirely to see the faults in his writing ; but after the fault has been detected , his attention is then to be fixed on the correct form which is to be substituted for the incorrect one .
Translation: 若不采取这一步骤，他很可能完全察觉不到自己写作中的错误；而一旦发现错误，就应将其注意力集中于用以替代错误形式的正确表达上。

Query_Text_en: Along with the selection of the appropriate movements goes the organization of these separate movements into the total or combined movements .
Translation: 在选定适当动作的同时，还需将这些独立动作整合为整体或组合动作。

Query_Text_en: This building together of movements is called coordination .
Translation: 这种行动的统一配合被称为协调。

Query_Text_en: The failure to have them properly adjusted may be seen from the results of an experiment in which the pressure exerted by the thumb and the two fingers was measured .
Translation: 一项测量拇指与双指施压的实验结果表明，若未能妥善调节压力，其效果将不尽如人意。

Query_Text_en: It was found that in a straight downward stroke the index finger , as one should expect , exerts the chief pressure , while the second finger and the thumb guide the movement .
Translation: 研究发现，在垂直下笔时，如预期所示，食指施加主要压力，而中指与拇指则起引导作用。

Query_Text_en: If , now , the downward stroke curves to the left , it is because the middle finger exerts an undue amount of pressure .
Translation: 若下笔向左偏斜，则因中指施力过重所致。

Query_Text_en: The successive movements must also follow one another in the proper time .
Translation: 各项运动亦须适时有序推进。

Query_Text_en: The smoothness and ease of movement will depend very largely upon whether or not the successive parts thus follow one another as they should .
Translation: 行动能否顺畅自如，很大程度上取决于各环节是否如预期般环环相扣。

Query_Text_en: There are certain gymnastic feats , for example , which are not difficult , provided one makes the movement or exerts the effort at the proper time , but which are impossible if this is not done .
Translation: 例如某些体操动作，只要在适当时机发力就能轻松完成，但若错过时机则无法实现。

Query_Text_en: A simple illustration of the failure to time the writing movements correctly is taken from the relationship of the movements of the arm in carrying the hand across the page and the movements of the fingers in forming the letters .
Translation: 手臂带动手掌在纸面上移动的动作与手指书写字母的动作未能协调配合，是书写时机把握不当的典型例证。

Query_Text_en: Some writers alternate these two movements . They use the fingers extensively in the formation of several letters and then interrupt the finger movement to lift the hand and carry it forward .
Translation: 某些书写者会交替运用这两种动作。他们先大量运用手指完成多个字母的书写，随后中断手指动作，抬腕带动整个手部向前移动。

Query_Text_en: Rhythm is an important aid in timing the movements ;
Translation: 节奏是协调动作的重要辅助手段。

Query_Text_en: the best means of bringing about the correct timing of the component movements of coordination is to make the whole movement rhythmical .
Translation: 实现协调运动中各环节动作精准同步的最佳方式，是使整个动作具有节奏性。

Query_Text_en: When the movement is carried on so that certain prominent strokes are made at regular intervals of time , as in marching to music , all of the elements of the movement are apt to fall into place at the proper time and with the proper force .
Translation: 当动作以特定显著节拍按固定时间间隔进行时——例如跟随音乐行进——所有动作要素都会在恰当时刻以恰当力度协调到位。

Query_Text_en: This principle is used in writing when a class writes to count or to music It has been found by experiment that the use of rhythm which is suited to the age and training of the pupils increases the speed and improves the quality of their writing . If too rapid a rate is used , the quality becomes poorer . Not all the children of a class can profitably use the rate which is suited to the majority and a few are deficient in the sense of rhythm , but if due provision is made for the exceptional cases the use of rhythm is a valuable means of teaching writing , or in fact any form of motor coordination .
Translation: 这一原则被运用于书写教学中，即让学生按照节拍或音乐节奏进行书写练习。实验表明，采用符合学生年龄和训练水平的节奏，能有效提升书写速度并改善书写质量。若节奏过快，书写质量则会下降。虽然并非全班学生都能从适合多数人的节奏中同等获益，且个别学生存在节奏感欠缺的情况，但只要对特殊个案作出适当安排，节奏训练仍是教授书写技能——乃至任何动作协调训练——的高效教学手段。

Query_Text_en: A movement is learned through repetition .
Translation: 动作通过反复练习习得。

Query_Text_en: The method by which the coordination is formed through the selection of movements and their organization is the frequent repetition of trials .
Translation: 通过筛选动作并加以组织来形成协调机制的方法，在于反复多次的试验。

Query_Text_en: The coordination can not be formed by telling the pupil how the movement is made . It is necessary that he find out for himself through making an attempt , noting the results of his attempt , and then endeavoring to improve his movement so as to retain these results which are the ones aimed at and eliminate those which are not the ones desired .
Translation: 仅靠向学生讲解动作要领是无法形成协调性的。他必须通过亲身尝试、观察动作效果，进而调整动作以保留预期成果、消除不良表现，方能实现动作的协调。

Query_Text_en: This method of learning is sometimes called the trial-and-error method and sometimes the trial-and-success method , according as we are thinking of the elimination of the wrong trials or the retaining of the correct ones .
Translation: 这种学习方法有时被称为"试错法"，有时则称为"试对法"，其称谓差异取决于我们关注的是剔除错误尝试还是保留正确方案。

Query_Text_en: The fact can not be too strongly emphasized that the only method by which such a form of learning can succeed is through practice .
Translation: 必须着重强调，这种学习方式要取得成功，唯一的方法就是通过实践。

Query_Text_en: The child may be assisted in taking the correct position by being instructed , or being shown how , and his attention may be directed toward his mistakes . In a variety of ways verbal instruction as to how the movement should be made is of great value to the learner , but it only supplements the trials which he makes and can never be a substitute for them . Moreover , it is necessary that frequent trials be made .
Translation: 可以通过指导或示范帮助儿童掌握正确姿势，并引导其注意错误所在。关于动作要领的言语指导对学习者具有重要价值，但这类指导仅能作为其实际练习的补充，而无法替代练习本身。此外，必须保证练习的频次。

Query_Text_en: The mistake is sometimes made , though not so often as formerly , of requiring the pupil to make a few copies only at each practice period and to make each one slowly and laboriously . A much better method is to require him to make a large number of copies somewhat more fluently , endeavoring to improve in each case over his preceding trial .
Translation: 过去虽时有发生，但如今已不多见的一种错误做法是：要求学生在每次练习时仅临摹少量字帖，且每字都写得缓慢费力。更佳的方法是让学生以相对流畅的速度完成大量临摹，并力求在每次练习中超越前次表现。

Query_Text_en: As learning progresses , attention is freed from the details of the movement .
Translation: 随着学习的深入，注意力逐渐从动作细节中解放出来。

Query_Text_en: As the child learns better to coordinate the movements , a change takes place in his mental attitude toward his bodily response .
Translation: 随着儿童更熟练地协调肢体动作，其对身体反应的心理态度也会发生相应转变。

Query_Text_en: At the beginning it was necessary to think of each separate movement and each stage in the making of a letter . As he becomes more skilled , he is able to make a series of movements or to form a letter or a word , thinking only of the whole group of movements or of strokes .
Translation: 起初必须考虑每个单独的动作和书写字母的每个步骤。随着技能提升，他能够仅着眼于整套动作或笔画组合，就能完成一系列动作或写出字母乃至单词。

Query_Text_en: The recognition of the movement becomes simplified and the details are given over to the control of the nervous centers which produce the movement .
Translation: 对该动作的识别过程被简化，具体执行细节则交由产生该动作的神经中枢控制。

Query_Text_en: When this simplification of the recognition is carried far enough , we reach the automatic stage of the habit .
Translation: 当这种认知简化到一定程度时，我们就进入了习惯的自动化阶段。

Query_Text_en: This means that the attention is turned to the thought which is being expressed .
Translation: 这意味着注意力转向了正在表达的思想。

Query_Text_en: Increased skill makes possible the development of rhythm .
Translation: 技艺的提升使节奏感的培养成为可能。

Query_Text_en: As the child 's attention becomes freed from the details of the movements or of the letters , he is able to recognize more fully some of the more general features of the writing .
Translation: 当儿童的注意力从笔画或字母的细节中解放出来时，他便能更全面地把握书写的整体特征。

Query_Text_en: One of these general features which has already been mentioned is rhythm . The child can write rhythmically only when he does not have to stop to consider how to form the details of the letters or to adjust his hand or jBngers . Rhythm appears when the successive strokes are made in about the same time .
Translation: 前文已提及的总体特征之一便是书写节奏。只有当儿童无需停顿思考字母细节的写法或调整手部与手指动作时，方能实现有节奏的书写。当连续笔画以相近时间间隔完成时，节奏感自然显现。

Query_Text_en: Measurements have shown that this is true of the writing of the older child or the adult , even though the successive strokes differ greatly in length .
Translation: 测量结果表明，即便连续笔画的长度差异显著，年长儿童及成人的书写行为仍符合这一规律。

Query_Text_en: The age at which the writing becomes thus markedly rhythmical in the case of the majority of children is nine or ten . We may conclude from this fact that this is the age at which it is suitable to give the child writing drills which require a high degree of rhythm .
Translation: 大多数儿童在九至十岁时，其书写开始呈现出显著的节奏感。由此我们可以得出结论：这一年龄段是适宜对儿童进行高节奏性书写训练的时期。

Query_Text_en: Changes in speed within the letter are more determined by the mechanical ease or difficulty in adult than in children 's writing .
Translation: 成人书写中笔速变化更多取决于机械动作的难易程度，而儿童书写则不然。

Query_Text_en: Another significant fact which has been discovered by experiment and which indicates that the child 's attention is being withdrawn from the details of the letters is that in the writing of the older child and the adult the speed varies much more in the different parts of the letter than in the writing of the younger child .
Translation: 实验发现的另一重要现象是：相较于幼童书写，年长儿童及成人的书写速度在字母不同部位存在更显著波动，这表明其注意力已从字母细节中抽离。

Query_Text_en: Where the mechanical difficulties are considerable , as where there is an abrupt change in direction , the movement continues to be relatively slow , while where the mechanical difficulties are slight , as on a long , sweeping stroke , the speed increases .
Translation: 在机械难度较大的地方（如方向突变处），运动速度仍相对较慢；而在机械难度较小之处（如长弧线笔划），速度则会提升。

Query_Text_en: Attention can be given to uniformity .
Translation: 应注重统一性。

Query_Text_en: Another general feature of the writing besides rhythm to which the child can give attention after the details cease to trouble him is the uniformity of the words and letters . This includes uniformity of slant , of alinement or of spacing .
Translation: 除了韵律之外，儿童在摆脱细节困扰后还能关注的另一普遍书写特征，是字词与字母的形态一致性。这包括倾斜度、排列对齐以及间距的均匀性。

Query_Text_en: Young children commonly form their letters carefully , but their writing presents an uneven appearance .
Translation: 幼儿书写字母时通常小心翼翼，但字迹往往显得参差不齐。

Query_Text_en: The writing habit includes word and letter recognition as well as movement .
Translation: 书写习惯包括对字词的识别以及书写动作。

Query_Text_en: We are accustomed to think of such a habit as writing as being composed of movements .
Translation: 我们惯常认为书写这类习惯是由一系列动作构成的。

Query_Text_en: This is true , but movements are not all there is to the habit .
Translation: 诚然如此，但习惯的形成绝非仅靠行动本身。

Query_Text_en: The movements are made in response to the sight of letters and words .
Translation: 这些动作是对看到字母和单词的反应。

Query_Text_en: At the very beginning the writer looks at the letters and copies them , thus holding the form of the letters in mind for only a short time .
Translation: 作者最初通过观察字母并临摹书写，因而仅能在短时间内记住字母的形态。

Query_Text_en: Later on , the letters need not be seen , but must be present in imagination .
Translation: 此后，这些文字虽不必目之所及，却须常驻心间。

Query_Text_en: Later still , the form of the letters may largely drop out of mind , but even in this most advanced stage the thought of the word exists in the mind and is the stimulus to the movement . In the case of writing , then , we may separate two phases of habit , that of the movement and of the recognition of the stimulus .
Translation: 更进一步说，字母的形态可能已基本淡出意识，但即便在此最精熟的阶段，词语的意念仍存留于心并成为动作的诱因。就书写而言，我们可将习惯分为两个阶段：动作阶段与刺激识别阶段。

Query_Text_en: Writing stimulates a study of letter forms .
Translation: 书写促进了对字体形态的研究。

Query_Text_en: It is appropriate to say in this connection that the writing habit , considered as a form of movement , is of importance in the development of the recognition of the letters .
Translation: 就此而言，书写习惯作为一种动作形式，对于培养字母识别能力具有重要意义。

Query_Text_en: Before the child begins to write , it is necessary that he shall be able to distinguish the forms of the different letters roughly .
Translation: 儿童在开始书写前，必须能够大致辨别不同字母的形态。

Query_Text_en: He may , however , distinguish them sufficiently for reading , but not for writing .
Translation: 然而，他或许能勉强辨认字迹进行阅读，但尚无法达到书写程度。

Query_Text_en: As he tries to reproduce the forms which he perceives , he finds it necessary to pay more attention to the form than he has previously done .
Translation: 当他试图再现所感知的形态时，发现自己必须比以往更加专注于形态本身。

Query_Text_en: Writing furnishes a stimulus to a further study of the form of the letters .
Translation: 书写能激发对字母形态的进一步研究。

Query_Text_en: Writing also furnishes an additional experience which enriches the perception of form .
Translation: 写作还提供了另一种体验，它能丰富人们对形式的感知。

Query_Text_en: After a person has learned to write letters , his recognition of them is not merely a matter of sight .
Translation: 当一个人学会书写文字后，他对文字的认知便不再仅凭视觉。

Query_Text_en: There is a tendency , when the letters are seen , to make the movement of producing them .
Translation: 当看到这些字母时，人们往往会做出书写它们的动作。

Query_Text_en: There are numerous illustrations from our mental life which show that our recognition of objects includes the experience which we have had in handling them .
Translation: 我们的精神生活中有诸多例证表明，对物体的认知往往包含与之互动的体验。

Query_Text_en: If we lift two boxes which are the same in weight , but of different size , we are subject to an illusion .
Translation: 当我们提起两个重量相同但体积不同的箱子时，会产生一种错觉。

Query_Text_en: The smaller box appears to be much heavier than the large one .
Translation: 这个小盒子似乎比大盒子重得多。

Query_Text_en: This is because in looking at the boxes the sensation of sight produces an anticipatory contraction of the muscles which would be used in lifting the boxes . When , now , we do lift them , there is a strong contrast between the amount of force which is exerted in the case of the two hands , because we had anticipated the necessity of lifting the larger box more vigorously .
Translation: 这是因为在观察箱子时，视觉感知会引发肌肉的预期性收缩——这种收缩正是举起箱子时所需调动的肌群。当我们实际抬起箱子时，由于此前已预判需要更用力地抬起较大的箱子，双手实际施力程度便会产生显著差异。

Query_Text_en: This contrast causes the feeling of greater strain in lifting the small box which makes it appear heavier than the larger one .
Translation: 这种反差导致人们在提起小箱子时感受到更大的压力，使其显得比大箱子更重。

Query_Text_en: So also in our recognition of letter forms there is included something of the motor experience of making them .
Translation: 同样，在我们识别字母形态的过程中，也融入了书写这些字母时的动作体验。

Query_Text_en: The writing movement becomes the means of expressing meanings .
Translation: 书写运动成为表达意义的手段。

Query_Text_en: We have been discussing writing as a form of movement which becomes organized so that it becomes an effective means of producing the forms of letters and words on paper .
Translation: 我们一直将书写视为一种有序化的动作形式，通过系统组织最终成为在纸面上生成字母与文字形态的有效手段。

Query_Text_en: The true function of writing is fulfilled when , in addition to this , it becomes the expression of meanings .
Translation: 除此之外，当文字成为意义的表达时，其真正功能才得以实现。

Query_Text_en: Meanings are represented first in spoken words , and when we write we commonly say over and hear inwardly the words .
Translation: 意义首先通过口语词汇得以表达，当我们书写时，通常会在内心默念并聆听这些词语。

Query_Text_en: Because meaning was originally associated with the spoken and heard word , it is still embodied in internal speaking and hearing .
Translation: 由于意义最初与口头和听觉词汇相关联，它至今仍内化于内在的言语和听觉之中。

Query_Text_en: When writing advances to the stage at which it is a ready means of expressing meanings , it is carried on as a direct response to ideas embodied in these forms .
Translation: 当书写发展到能够自如表达含义的阶段时，其发展便直接源于对这些形式所蕴含思想的回应。

Query_Text_en: The consciousness of the movements or of the details of the form of the letters recedes to the background .
Translation: 对字母形态细节或书写动作的感知逐渐退居次要地位。

Query_Text_en: When this stage is reached writing has become automatic .
Translation: 至此阶段，书写已成自然。

Query_Text_en: The habit may become automatic too soon .
Translation: 这种习惯可能过早地形成惯性。

Query_Text_en: In the development of writing toward this automatic stage , there may be two opposite faults . The habit may become automatic at a stage when it is not sufficiently well developed ;
Translation: 在书写能力向自动化阶段发展的过程中，可能存在两种相反的缺陷。其一是书写习惯在尚未充分完善时就过早形成自动化；

Query_Text_en: that is , the person may learn to express his thoughts through a form of movement which is irregular and which produces illegible letters . The cure of this fault is to give attention to the habit until it becomes developed to the point at which the results of the writing are satisfactory .
Translation: 也就是说，此人可能学会通过一种不规则的运动形式来表达思想，从而写出难以辨认的字迹。纠正这一缺陷的方法，在于持续关注书写习惯的培养，直至书写效果达到令人满意的程度。

Query_Text_en: The results may be unsatisfactory either because the movement is awkward or because the writing is poor in quality .
Translation: 或因动作笨拙，或因书写质量低劣，结果可能不尽如人意。

Query_Text_en: Attention may be given to the details too long . The opposite fault also sometimes occurs .
Translation: 过分拘泥于细节的情况时有发生，但与之相反的失误亦不鲜见。

Query_Text_en: In this case a person never loses his consciousness of the writing movement or of the form of the letters which he is producing sufficiently to give his attention wholly or chiefly to the thought .
Translation: 在此情况下，书写者始终无法完全摆脱对书写动作或字母形态的注意，因而难以将精力全部或主要集中于思想表达。

Query_Text_en: Persons sometimes possess two styles of writing , one in which the habit is automatic and the writing is very poor , and another in which the writing is kept at a high grade through giving attention to it .
Translation: 人们有时会掌握两种书写风格：一种是习惯成自然、字迹潦草的日常书写；另一种则是全神贯注时保持的高水准书写。

Query_Text_en: This development of two sorts of habit , one which is used in the ready expression of thought and the other in producing pleasing forms , is unfortunate .
Translation: 这种将习惯分为两类的做法——一类用于即时表达思想，另一类用于创造悦目形式——实属不妥。

Query_Text_en: The child should develop his writing habit to a sufficient degree of perfection that he may produce good results , but it should then become automatic .
Translation: 儿童应充分培养书写习惯，直至达到娴熟程度，确保书写质量优良，最终形成自动化书写能力。

Query_Text_en: Movement and form both require attention .
Translation: 动势与形态皆需兼顾。

Query_Text_en: Different systems of teaching give different emphasis to the development of a good motor coordination as compared with the production of writing which presents a good appearance .
Translation: 不同的教学体系在培养良好运动协调能力与追求书写美观之间各有侧重。

Query_Text_en: Some teachers believe that if care is taken to develop good movement the form will take care of itself , or at least will not need much attention .
Translation: 部分教师认为，只要注重培养良好的动作习惯，姿势问题自然迎刃而解，至少无需过多刻意纠正。

Query_Text_en: It is true that writing is to be thought of as a movement habit , and that the principles which govern its development as a movement are those which must guide the teacher in the methods which he uses , as we have already seen in detail . But a movement is made in response to a stimulus , and it is to be judged by the accuracy with which it is adjusted to the stimulus .
Translation: 诚然，书写应被视为一种动作习惯，正如我们前文详述，教师所采用的教学方法必须遵循支配书写动作发展的原则。但动作乃是对刺激的反应，其优劣应取决于该动作与刺激源匹配的精确程度。

Query_Text_en: A movement is not judged merely according to its ease or smoothness . The handwriting movement , accordingly , may be smooth and easy , and yet the writing may not be legible because the letters are poorly formed or not well spaced .
Translation: 评判一项运动的标准不仅在于其流畅性或自如度。同理，书写动作或许流畅自如，但若字母结构不佳或间距不当，字迹仍可能难以辨认。

Query_Text_en: Form should be analyzed .
Translation: 形式必须加以分析。

Query_Text_en: One means by which the child may be helped to make such an analysis is to show him series of charts in which progressive degrees of excellence in each of the main elements of form are illustrated .
Translation: 帮助儿童进行此类分析的一种方法是向其展示系列图表，这些图表以渐进式范例呈现各类形式要素的卓越程度。

Query_Text_en: For example , one series of charts may show different degrees of uniformity in slant or alinement , another different quality of line or stroke , another different degree of excellence in letter formation , and another degree of excellence in spacing .
Translation: 例如，一组图表可能显示笔画倾斜或排列的均匀程度差异，另一组反映线条或笔触的质量差异，还有一组体现字母构形的优劣程度差异，最后一组则展示间距处理的精细程度差异。

Query_Text_en: By the study of such charts and an analysis of his own writing the child may gain a clearer recognition of the ways in which his writing deviates from the model .
Translation: 通过研究此类图表并分析自己的书写，孩子可以更清晰地认识到其书写与范本之间的差异。

Query_Text_en: The child can be guided in the development of the best movement .
Translation: 可以引导儿童发展最佳运动能力。

Query_Text_en: If some teachers emphasize movement to the neglect of form , others commit the opposite error .
Translation: 若有些教师重动作而轻姿势，另一些教师则恰恰相反。

Query_Text_en: It is clear from the whole trend of our discussion why this is a mistake .
Translation: 从我们讨论的整体趋势来看，这一错误的原因显而易见。

Query_Text_en: It is a far safer and more economical method to guide the child in the formation of those habits of movement which experience has shown to be the most efficient than to allow him to blunder into a form of movement without any assistance .
Translation: 引导儿童养成经验证明最高效的运动习惯，远比放任其自行摸索运动方式更为安全经济。

Query_Text_en: Substantially the same form may be produced in a variety of ways , and some of these are much better than others .
Translation: 同一基本形态可通过多种方式实现，其中某些方式远优于其他。

Query_Text_en: It is the business of the teacher to help the child to find these better ways as rapidly as possible .
Translation: 教师的职责在于帮助孩子尽快找到这些更好的方法。

Query_Text_en: The elements which can be acquired through instruction constitute good form .
Translation: 通过教导获得的要素构成了良好的形式。

Query_Text_en: It has been said in a former paragraph that the writing movement could not be learned through instruction , but must be developed through the trial and success method . This applies to what may be called the execution of the movement .
Translation: 前文已述，书写动作无法通过教导习得，而必须通过尝试与成功的实践来培养。这一原则同样适用于所谓动作的执行层面。

Query_Text_en: There are certain aspects of the movement , on the other hand , which may be partly learned through imitation or through instruction .
Translation: 另一方面，该运动的某些方面或许可以通过模仿或指导来部分习得。

Query_Text_en: The child may gain help through these methods in learning how to hold the pen , what position should be assumed by the hand and arm , and in a general way what parts to move in making the strokes .
Translation: 通过这些方法，孩子可以学会如何握笔、掌握手臂的正确姿势，并理解书写笔画时身体各部位的协调运动。

Query_Text_en: These aspects of the activity may be called form .
Translation: 活动的这些方面可称为形式。

Query_Text_en: Speed and quality should progress together .
Translation: 速度与质量应当齐头并进。

Query_Text_en: Another question of method is related to this issue between movement and form .
Translation: 方法论的另一问题涉及运动与形式之间的这一关系。

Query_Text_en: Those who emphasize movement to the exclusion of form often require the child to write very rapidly from the start , while those who emphasize form chiefly pay little attention to speed , particularly at the beginning .
Translation: 主张重动不重形者，往往要求儿童一开始就快速书写；而主张重形不重动者，则不太注重速度，尤其在初始阶段。

Query_Text_en: The practice of allowing the child to write excessively slowly was criticized above on the ground that it does not give the pupil sufficient practice . It may also be criticized on the ground that it does not give the pupil practice in connecting the elements of the movement to make a continuous process .
Translation: 前文已对允许儿童书写速度过慢的做法提出批评，理由是其无法为学生提供充分的练习机会。此外，这种做法还可被指摘未能训练学生将书写动作的各要素连贯起来，形成连续流畅的书写过程。

Query_Text_en: When the child makes the letters by a slow , drawing movement , he is not obtaining a sensation of the whole movement in such a way that he learns how it feels to write a letter or a word .
Translation: 当孩子以缓慢、描画的方式书写字母时，他无法获得对整个动作的完整感知，因而难以体会书写字母或单词时的肌肉记忆。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , if the child is required at the beginning to make the movement as rapidly as he will later , it is impossible for him to form the letters correctly .
Translation: 另一方面，如果一开始就要求孩子以日后所需的速度书写，他将无法正确掌握字母的书写规范。

Query_Text_en: As a consequence he is not learning to make the movements which he will later have to make .
Translation: 因此，他未能学会日后必须掌握的动作要领。

Query_Text_en: He is also forming habits of carelessness and is failing to get a clear and correct idea of the form of the letters .
Translation: 他正养成粗心大意的习惯，未能清晰准确地掌握字母的书写形态。

Query_Text_en: The solution of this question , then , is that the child should progress in accuracy and form together .
Translation: 因此，解决这一问题的关键在于儿童应同步提升表达的准确性与形式的规范性。

Query_Text_en: The child should be able to trace his own progress .
Translation: 儿童应能追踪自身发展进度。

Query_Text_en: It follows , from this analysis of the qualities of good writing , that the child should be able to trace his progress in both quality and speed .
Translation: 根据对优秀写作特质的这一分析，儿童应当能够在写作质量和速度两方面追踪自己的进步。

Query_Text_en: The more definite his attainment can be made , the more stimulus he will receive toward improvement .
Translation: 成就越明确具体，就越能激发进取动力。

Query_Text_en: The common method of grading the child 's attainments by comparing him with others in a rough , general way is very deficient , because it does not give him a sufficiently definite idea either of the degree of skill which he has attained or the direction in which his improvement should proceed .
Translation: 现行通用的评估方式，是将儿童的学习成果与其他学生进行粗略笼统的对比，这种方法存在严重缺陷。它既无法让儿童准确了解自身已达到的技能水平，也不能为其指明能力提升的具体方向。

Query_Text_en: The child should , then , be compared with his own past record rather than with that of other pupils , and this should be expressed in a form as definite as possible .
Translation: 因此，应当将儿童与其自身过往表现而非其他学生成绩进行对比，并尽可能以明确的形式呈现这一评估结果。

Query_Text_en: The speed may be measured by occasional tests and the quality by analyzing it by the method which was suggested above .
Translation: 可通过定期测试来衡量速度，并采用前文所述方法分析质量。

Query_Text_en: The correct habit should be practiced in all writing .
Translation: 所有文书写作都应养成正确规范的习惯。

Query_Text_en: We have already seen that a person 's writing habit may be of one sort when he is writing for the sake of good form and of another sort when he is writing to express thought .
Translation: 我们已注意到，当一个人为追求形式完美而书写时，其书写习惯可能是一种状态；而当其为表达思想而书写时，则可能呈现另一种状态。

Query_Text_en: The child should so develop his writing habit that much the same result appears in the ordinary work as in the writing lesson .
Translation: 儿童应培养这样的书写习惯：在日常作业中展现的书写效果，与书写课上达到的水平基本一致。

Query_Text_en: In order that this may be the case , it is necessary that some attention be paid to the writing which he produces in the rest of his school work . It would be well to do this throughout the latter part of the elementary school .
Translation: 为确保这一目标的实现，有必要对其在校期间其他课业所涉及的写作予以适当关注。这一做法宜在小学高年级阶段全面推行。

Query_Text_en: In the first three or four grades the child 's attention should not be distracted from the thought which he is expressing by the necessity of thinking much about the quality of the writing .
Translation: 在小学三、四年级阶段，不应因过度关注书写质量而分散儿童对表达思想的注意力。

Query_Text_en: He has great difficulty at the best in expressing his thoughts in writing at this time , since the unfamiliar habit distracts his mind ;
Translation: 眼下他极难用文字表达思想，因为这种生疏的方式令他分神。

Query_Text_en: but in the later grades it will not distract the child to exercise a little care in order that the writing shall not deteriorate .
Translation: 但在高年级阶段，适当注意书写质量以免字迹退步，并不会分散孩子的学习注意力。

Query_Text_en: It is well , then , to give the handwriting grade upon the quality of the work which is turned out in the other subjects as well as that which is produced in the writing lesson .
Translation: 因此，除书法课外，其他科目作业的书写质量也应纳入评分标准。

Query_Text_en: In fact , this should probably be the main stimulus to progress in writing in the upper grades .
Translation: 事实上，这很可能是推动高年级写作水平提升的主要动力。

Query_Text_en: Motor ability changes with age .
Translation: 运动能力随年龄而变化。

Query_Text_en: What has been said indicates that it is necessary to modify the method of teaching writing to suit the age and stage of development of the pupil .
Translation: 上述内容表明，有必要调整写作教学方法，使之适应学生的年龄与发展阶段。

Query_Text_en: Some methods of teaching writing which are in wide use take no account of the difference in ability of the child at different ages .
Translation: 当前广泛应用的某些写作教学方法，未能充分考虑儿童在不同年龄阶段的能力差异。

Query_Text_en: For example , the same speed in writing is required of the first-grade child as of the eighth-grade child .
Translation: 例如，对一年级学生和八年级学生的书写速度要求是相同的。

Query_Text_en: Studies of the motor ability of children at different ages indicate that there is a marked increase in the rapidity of movement and in the steadiness and precision of movement from the age of six to that of sixteen . A study of the ability of children in different grades in making a series of upward and downward strokes as rapidly as possible demonstrates the same fact .
Translation: 对不同年龄段儿童运动能力的研究表明，从6岁到16岁期间，儿童动作的速度、稳定性及精确性均有显著提升。一项针对各年级儿童快速连续上下划线的能力研究也印证了这一结论。

Query_Text_en: A survey of the rapidity of writing , in all the grades from the second to the eighth among over thirty thousand children , shows that on the average the first-grade pupil writes less than half as fast as the eighth-grade pupil .
Translation: 一项针对三万名二至八年级学生书写速度的调查显示，一年级学生的平均书写速度不足八年级学生的一半。

Query_Text_en: The fundamental and accessory movement theory .
Translation: 基本运动与附属运动理论

Query_Text_en: The difference in ability between the younger and the older child has sometimes been ascribed to the development from fundamental to accessory movements .
Translation: 幼童与长童之间的能力差异，有时被归因于从基础动作到辅助动作的发展过程。

Query_Text_en: The theory is that the younger child is able to make the so-called fundamental movements more readily than the accessory movements , and that improvement in ability is chiefly in gaining control over these accessory movements .
Translation: 理论认为，年幼儿童比年长儿童更容易掌握所谓的基础动作而非辅助动作，而能力提升主要体现在对这些辅助动作的控制上。

Query_Text_en: The distinction between the fundamental and accessory movements is not always clear .
Translation: 基本运动与附属运动的区分并非总是泾渭分明。

Query_Text_en: The fundamental movements are sometimes described as those which are old in the race , such as walking ; while the accessory movements are those which have been acquired in human life , such as manipulation .
Translation: 基本动作有时被描述为人类种族中固有的古老动作，如行走；而附属动作则是在人类生活中后天习得的动作，如精细操作。

Query_Text_en: Sometimes the distinction is made between the movements of the large muscles , or large movements , which are designated as fundamental ,
Translation: 有时人们会区分大肌肉运动（即大动作）与精细动作——前者被界定为基本动作能力。

Query_Text_en: In the problem of learning we are not concerned with instinctive movements , and other movements do not develop in any consistent way from central to peripheral or from large to small .
Translation: 在学习问题上，我们并不关注本能性动作，其他动作的发展也并非遵循从中心到边缘或从大到小的固定模式。

Query_Text_en: The suitability of movements for the child should be judged on the score of their rapidity , precision , and complexity .
Translation: 判断动作是否适合儿童，应以其速度、精确度和复杂度为标准。

Query_Text_en: A much more valid distinction between the movements which are suited to the younger child and the older child rests on the facts which have already been referred to . The young child is not capable of very rapid or precise movements .
Translation: 区分适合低龄儿童与高龄儿童运动方式的更有效依据，在于前文已提及的生理特征。幼童尚无法完成过于快速或精确的动作。

Query_Text_en: To this may be added the further fact that movements are difficult for him in proportion to their complexity . The combination of a large number of movements in one complicated coordination presents difficulties to the child in proportion to his deficiency in motor control .
Translation: 此外还需注意，动作越复杂，儿童完成起来就越困难。当需要将大量动作组合成一个复杂的协调系统时，儿童运动控制能力的不足会使这种协调面临相应程度的困难。

Query_Text_en: The difficulties should be lightened for the young child .
Translation: 应为幼儿减轻课业负担。

Query_Text_en: These characteristics of the child make the acquirement of handwriting a difficult matter for him and one which is attended with considerable nervous strain . Care must be taken , therefore , to ameliorate for him the difficulty of the task .
Translation: 儿童这些特点使得他们学习书写尤为困难，且伴随巨大的精神压力。因此必须采取措施，帮助他们缓解这一学习任务的难度。

Query_Text_en: This may be done by making the requirements for accuracy and rapidity low and by placing the handwriting period at a time when the child is not fatigued . The requirement for speed has already been discussed .
Translation: 可通过降低书写准确度与速度要求，并将书写练习安排在儿童非疲劳时段进行。关于书写速度要求前文已作论述。

Query_Text_en: The avoidance of undue accuracy of form may be reached by allowing the child to write very large . At the beginning the writing should be done on the blackboard .
Translation: 避免过分拘泥于书写形式的做法，可允许儿童书写较大字体。初期练习应在黑板上进行。

Query_Text_en: When the child first uses paper , he should write with large letters and with a pencil which offers little difficulty in its manipulation . The pencil should be fairly large and the lead smooth . The paper should also have such a surface that the mark is easily made upon it .
Translation: 儿童初习书写时，宜用铅笔在纸上写大字。铅笔须粗大易握，铅芯务求顺滑；所用纸张亦需质地适宜，确保运笔流畅。

Query_Text_en: As the child grows older and gains in skill , the writing may be gradually decreased in size and may become gradually more precise .
Translation: 随着儿童年龄增长、技能提升，其书写字体可逐步缩小，笔迹亦会日趋工整。

Query_Text_en: Individual differences . Besides these differences due to age , there are wide differences between individual children in this as in other forms of ability .
Translation: 个体差异。除了这些因年龄导致的差异外，儿童个体间在此类能力与其他能力形式上同样存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Some children are superior in their writing ability to the average of several grades above them , whereas others are equal only to the average of several grades below .
Translation: 部分儿童的写作能力远超其实际年级平均水平数级，而另一些则仅相当于低年级的平均水准。

Query_Text_en: These individual differences may be taken account of in several ways .
Translation: 这些个体差异可通过多种方式加以考量。

Query_Text_en: The ideal method would be to group children according to their ability in each separate kind of work , so that those of like ability are together and that those who have reached a certain standard might be relieved of further work in that subject . This , however , is not possible so long as the rigid grade system maintains , and the best that can be done is to recognize the differences among children of the same grade and to adjust the demand made upon the different children according to their various abilities . As was suggested above , each child should be judged on the basis of his past performances instead of by comparison with his classmates .
Translation: 理想的做法是根据儿童在每项具体课业中的能力进行分组，使能力相近者共同学习，达到既定标准者即可免修该科目。然而，只要僵化的年级制依然存在，这种分组就难以实现。当前最佳方案是承认同年级儿童的能力差异，根据其不同水平调整课业要求。如前所述，对每个儿童的评估应基于其既往表现，而非与同班同学横向比较。

Query_Text_en: In the speed of writing it is very desirable to have as many of the children as can comfortably do so engage in rhythmic exercises to music or to time marked in some other manner , but it is necessary that the children who do not naturally fit in with this rhythm should not be required to follow it .
Translation: 在速写训练中，应尽可能让适应节奏的孩子跟随音乐节拍或其他形式的计时进行韵律练习，但对于那些天生节奏感较弱的孩子，则不应强制要求其遵循此类节奏训练。

Query_Text_en: The length of practice periods .
Translation: 实践周期长度

Query_Text_en: In arranging the conditions so that the practice will be most effective in producing improvement , it is necessary to take account of the principles of economy in effort due to the arrangement of the periods of practice .
Translation: 为确保训练安排能最有效地促进能力提升，必须遵循因训练周期安排而产生的省力原则。

Query_Text_en: It has been found by experimental investigation that the length of period or the interval between the periods of practice affects the rapidity of learning . In the case of the development of a motor habit , such as handwriting , the same amount of time split up into rather short periods is more effective than if it is all expended in long periods .
Translation: 实验研究表明，练习周期的时长或间隔会影响学习速度。以书写等动作习惯的培养为例，将同等时间分配为多个较短练习周期，其效果优于集中进行长时间练习。

Query_Text_en: With the child in the earlier grades ten minutes is probably the best length of period and in the upper grades not over half an hour can be spent to the greatest advantage .
Translation: 低年级儿童的最佳专注时长约为十分钟，高年级学生则不宜超过半小时方能取得最佳学习效果。

Query_Text_en: In learning to write , the child develops habits of movement and acquires the recognition of form , but since the motor coordination is the more prominent element , writing is taken as an illustration of sensorimotor learning .
Translation: 在学习书写的过程中，儿童会形成动作习惯并掌握字形识别能力。但由于运动协调性在此阶段更为突出，书写通常被视为感觉运动学习的典型范例。

Query_Text_en: Drawing also includes both the recognition of form and its representation , but in this case the element of recognition is more prominent , and therefore drawing is taken as an illustration of perceptual learning .
Translation: 绘画既包含对形态的认知，也包含对其表现形式的呈现。但在绘画过程中，认知要素更为突出，因此绘画被视为感知学习的一种例证。

Query_Text_en: Drawing is commonly regarded as an illustration of the development of motor habits . The production of the form upon the paper is thought of as the chief element in the process .
Translation: 人们普遍认为绘画是运动习惯发展的体现。在这一过程中，纸上呈现的形态被视为创作的核心要素。

Query_Text_en: This , however , is a secondary part of the whole process as will be made clear by the following illustration .
Translation: 然而，正如以下示例所示，这只是整个流程中的次要环节。

Query_Text_en: In order that the reader may have in his experience a concrete illustration of the development of the recognition of form , the following simple experiment may be performed .
Translation: 为使读者能通过亲身体验直观理解形态认知的发展过程，可进行如下简易实验。

Query_Text_en: Upon page 36 will be found a figure ( Figure 5 ) which should not be looked at until the directions given below have been read and clearly understood .
Translation: 第三十六页载有一幅图表（图5），在阅读并明确理解下列说明之前，请勿查看该图。

Query_Text_en: The figure is to be observed for the brief interval of ten seconds , after which the attempt should be made to reproduce it .
Translation: 该图形需观察十秒的短暂时间，之后应尝试复现。

Query_Text_en: During the time the drawing is being reproduced , the book should be turned over so that it can not be seen .
Translation: 在图纸复制期间，应将书本翻转放置，使其内容不可见。

Query_Text_en: After the figure has been completed as well as possible , the paper should be folded so as to conceal the drawing and another attempt made in the same manner .
Translation: 图形绘制完成后，应将纸张对折以遮盖图案，再以同样方式重新绘制。

Query_Text_en: This process should be repeated until the experimenter is satisfied that the drawing is reproduced substantially in its correct form .
Translation: 这一过程应反复进行，直至实验者确认绘图已基本准确复现为止。

Query_Text_en: It is not necessary that it shall be minutely accurate , but only that the chief elements shall be present in about their true relations .
Translation: 无需苛求细节精确无误，只要确保核心要素大体符合其真实关联即可。

Query_Text_en: The act of drawing has produced completer recognition .
Translation: 绘画行为促成了更完整的认知。

Query_Text_en: After the drawing has been made , the reader should analyze his experience and test the correctness of the following account .
Translation: 图纸绘制完成后，读者应分析自身经验并验证下述说明的准确性。

Query_Text_en: The first question for examination concerns the difference between the perception of the figure after the figure has been drawn in the final trial in comparison with the type of recognition which existed before it had been mastered .
Translation: 首要考察的问题在于：最终试验中绘制图形后对该图形的感知，与掌握该图形前所存在的识别类型之间存在何种差异。

Query_Text_en: It is clear that , as a result of the study and the attempt to reproduce the figure , something has taken place which materially modifies the recognition of it .
Translation: 显而易见，经过研究和尝试重现该数据后，某些实质性改变其认知的情况已然发生。

Query_Text_en: This has not been in the nature of mental development in general , but has rather consisted in the development of the ability to recognize this particular figure .
Translation: 这并非一般智力发展的本质特征，而在于培养识别这一特定图形的能力。

Query_Text_en: Before the study , the figure was seen in a vague , indefinite manner .
Translation: 研究之前，这一数据呈现得模糊不清、难以界定。

Query_Text_en: In your schooldays most of you who read this book made acquaintance with the noble building of Euclid 's geometry , and you remember perhaps with more respect than love the magnificent structure , on the lofty staircase of which you were chased about for uncounted hours by conscientious teachers .
Translation: 求学时代，诸位读者大多曾领略过欧几里得几何学这座宏伟殿堂的风采。或许你们至今仍心怀敬畏——虽未必是喜爱——忆及那座巍峨建筑：在它高耸的阶梯上，尽责的师长们曾带领你们不知疲倦地攀登了无数时光。

Query_Text_en: By reason of our past experience , you would certainly regard everyone with disdain who should pronounce even the most out-of-the-way proposition of this science to be untrue .
Translation: 鉴于我们过去的经验，任何宣称这门学科中最离奇命题不实之人，都必将遭到您的轻蔑。

Query_Text_en: But perhaps this feeling of proud certainty would leave you immediately if someone were to ask you : ' What , then , do you mean by the assertion that these propositions are true ? '
Translation: 但是，倘若有人问你："那么，你断言这些命题为真究竟是什么意思呢？"——这种自豪的笃定感或许就会瞬间消散。

Query_Text_en: Let us proceed to give this question a little consideration .
Translation: 让我们就此问题稍作探讨。

Query_Text_en: Geometry sets out form certain conceptions such as ' plane ' , ' point ' , and ' straight line ' , with which we are able to associate more or less definite ideas , and from certain simple propositions ( axioms ) which , in virtue of these ideas , we are inclined to accept as ' true ' .
Translation: 几何学建立在若干基本概念之上，诸如"平面"、"点"和"直线"等——这些概念或多或少能与我们头脑中某些明确观念相联系；同时也基于若干简单命题（公理）——借助前述观念，我们倾向于承认这些命题的"真实性"。

Query_Text_en: Then , on the basis of a logical process , the justification of which we feel ourselves compelled to admit , all remaining propositions are shown to follow from those axioms , i.e. they are proven .
