Query_Text_en: The second maxim is , make an emphatic start . Surround yourself with every aid possible . Make it easy at first to perform the act and difficult not to perform it .
Translation: 第二条准则是：强势开局。要尽可能调动一切辅助手段。让行动在初期易于执行，同时使不行动变得困难。

Query_Text_en: For example , if you desire to form the habit of arising at six every morning , surround yourself with a number of aids . Buy an alarm clock , and tell someone of your decision .
Translation: 例如，若想养成每日清晨六点起床的习惯，需借助多重辅助手段。购置闹钟，并向他人告知这一决定。

Query_Text_en: Such efforts at the start will give your new beginning such a momentum that the temptation to break down will not occur as soon as it otherwise might ;
Translation: 起步阶段的这些努力将为你的新开端注入强劲动力，使半途而废的诱惑不会过早出现。

Query_Text_en: and every day during which a breakdown is postponed adds to the chances of its not occurring at all .
Translation: 而每推迟一天崩溃，就多一分彻底避免崩溃的可能。

Query_Text_en: Man has discovered the value of such devices during the course of his long history , and has evolved customs accordingly . When men decide to swear off smoking , they choose the opening of a new year when many other new things are being started ;
Translation: 人类在漫长的历史进程中，已认识到此类方式的价值，并据此形成了相应习俗。当人们决心戒烟时，往往会选择新年伊始——这个诸多新事物开始的时刻。

Query_Text_en: they make solemn promises to themselves , to each other , and finally to their friends .
Translation: 他们郑重地向自己、彼此，最终向朋友们许下承诺。

Query_Text_en: Such customs are precautions which help to bolster up the determination at the time when extraordinary effort and determination are required .
Translation: 这些习俗是一种预防措施，在需要非凡努力和坚定决心的时刻，它们有助于强化意志。

Query_Text_en: In forming the habits incidental to college life , take pains from the start to surround yourself with as many aids as possible .
Translation: 在养成大学生活应有的习惯时，从一开始就应着力为自己营造尽可能多的有利条件。

Query_Text_en: The third maxim is , never permit an exception to occur .
Translation: 第三条准则是，绝不允许出现任何例外情况。

Query_Text_en: Suppose you have a habit of saying ai nt which you wish to replace with a habit of saying isn ' . If the habit is deeply rooted , you have worn a pathway in the brain to a considerable depth , represented in the accompanying diagram by the Use A X B . Let us suppose that you have already started the new habit , and have said the correct word ten times . That means you have worn another pathway X C to a considerable depth .
Translation: 假设你习惯说"ai nt"，现在想改口说"isn't"。若这个旧习已根深蒂固，就意味着大脑中已形成较深的神经通路，图中以"使用A X B"表示。假定你已开始培养新习惯，并正确说出该词十次，这表明另一条神经通路X C也已形成相当深度。

Query_Text_en: During all this time , however , the old pathway is still open and at the slightest provocation will attract the nervous current .
Translation: 然而在此期间，原有神经通路依然保持畅通，稍有刺激便会重新引发电信号传导。

Query_Text_en: Your task is to deepen the new path so that the nervous current will flow into it instead of the old .
Translation: 你的任务是开辟新路径，让神经电流流向新通道而非旧径。

Query_Text_en: Now suppose you make an exception on some occasion and allow the nervous current to travel over the old path . This unfortunate exception breaks down the bridge which you had constructed at X from A to C . But this is not the only result .
Translation: 现在假设你在某个场合破例，允许神经电流沿着旧路径传导。这一不幸的例外会摧毁你已在X点搭建的从A到C的桥梁。但这并非唯一后果。

Query_Text_en: The nervous current , as it revisits the old path , deepens it more than it was before , so the next time a similar situation arises , the current seeks the old path that much greater readiness than before , and vastly more effort is required to overcome it . Someone has likened the effect of these exceptions to that produced when one drops a ball of string that is partially wound . By a single slip , more is undone than can be accomplished in a dozen windings .
Translation: 当神经电流再次流经原有路径时，其冲刷作用会使通道较先前更为深邃。因此当类似情境再现时，电流会以远胜从前的迅捷重循故道，此时若要扭转其流向则需付出极大努力。有人将这种例外情形的影响，比作不慎掉落半缠线团——仅一次失手导致的松散，便需十余次缠绕方能复原。

Query_Text_en: The fourth maxim is , seize every opportunity to act upon your resolution .
Translation: 第四条准则是：抓住一切机会，将决心付诸行动。

Query_Text_en: It is not in the moment of their forming , but in the moment of their producing motor effects , that resolves and aspirations communicate the new set to the brain .
Translation: 决心与抱负并非在形成之际，而是在产生实际驱动效应之时，才向大脑传递新的指令体系。

Query_Text_en: No matter how full a reservoir of maxims one may possess , and no matter how good one 's sentiments may be , if one has not taken advantage of every concrete opportunity to act , one 's character may remain entirely unaffected for the better . Particularly at time of emotional excitement one makes resolves that are very good , and a glow of fine feeling is present . Beware that these resolves do not evaporate in mere feeling . They should be crystallized in some form of action as soon as possible .  Let the expression be the least thing in the world speaking genially to one 's grandmother , or giving up one 's seat in a car , if nothing more heroic offers but let it not fail to take place . Strictly speaking you have not really completed a resolve until you have acted upon it .
Translation: 纵使胸中蕴藏万千格言，纵使心怀至善之意，若未把握每个付诸行动的切实契机，品性仍难有丝毫进益。尤其在情绪激昂之际，人们常立下美好誓言，澎湃着高尚情操。须谨防这些决心仅止于情感激荡，而应尽快转化为具体行动。即便只是亲切问候祖母，或在车厢中让座于人——若无更壮烈之举可施——也要让这些微末善行落地生根。严格而言，唯有践行之，方为真正达成所愿。

Query_Text_en: You may determine to go without lunch , but you have not consummated that resolve until you have permitted it to express itself by carrying you past the door of the dining-room . That is the crucial test which determines the strength of your resolve . Many repetitions will be required before a pathway is worn deep enough to be settled .
Translation: 你或许决心不吃午餐，但唯有当你真正走过餐厅门口而未入内时，这一决心才算真正达成。这正是检验你决心坚定与否的关键时刻。唯有经过反复实践，才能开辟出一条根深蒂固的行为路径。

Query_Text_en: Seize the very earliest opportunity to begin grooving it out , and seize every other opportunity for deepening it .
Translation: 抓住最早时机着手推进，并把握一切后续机遇深化落实。

Query_Text_en: After this view of the place in your life occupied by habit , you readily see its far-reaching possibilities for welfare of body and mind . Its most obvious , because most annoying , effects are on the side of its disadvantages . Bad habits secure a grip upon us that we are sometimes powerless to shake off . True , this ineradicableness need have no terrors if we have formed good habits . Indeed , as will be pointed out in the next paragraph , habit may be a great asset . Nevertheless , it may work positive harm , or at best , may lead to stagnation . The fixedness of habit tends to make us move in ruts unless we exert continuous effort to learn new things . If we permit ourselves to move in old grooves we cease to progress and become old fogy .
Translation: 在审视习惯于人生中所占据的地位后，你便能轻易洞悉其对身心福祉的深远影响。其最显著——亦最令人困扰——的效应往往体现在弊端方面。恶习会牢牢攫住我们，有时令人无力摆脱。诚然，若已养成良习，这种根深蒂固的特性便不足为惧。事实上，正如下一段将指出的，习惯可能成为巨大财富。然而它亦可能造成实质性危害，或充其量导致停滞不前。习惯的固化性易使我们陷入窠臼，除非持续努力汲取新知。若放任自身因循旧轨，我们将止步不前，沦为迂腐之人。

Query_Text_en: But the advantages of habit far outweigh its disadvantages .
Translation: 但习惯的益处远大于其弊端。

Query_Text_en: Habit helps the individual to be consistent and helps people to know what to expect from one . It helps society to be stable , to incorporate within itself modes of action conducive to the common good . For example , the respect which we all have for the property of others is a habit , and is so firmly intrenched that we should find ourselves unable to steal if we wished to . Habit is thus a very desirable asset and is truly called the enormous fly-wheel of society .
Translation: 习惯使人行为一贯，也让他人对其行为有稳定预期。它维系社会安定，将有益于公益的行为方式融入社会肌体。例如，我们尊重他人财产的习惯根深蒂固，纵使心起贪念也难以付诸偷窃。因此，习惯实为可贵禀赋，确可称为维系社会的巨大飞轮。

Query_Text_en: A second advantage of habit is that it makes for accuracy .
Translation: 习惯的第二个优势在于它能提升准确性。

Query_Text_en: Acts that have become habitualized are performed more accurately than those not habitualized .
Translation: 习惯性行为的执行准确度高于非习惯性行为。

Query_Text_en: Movements such as those made in typewriting and piano-playing , when measured in the psychological laboratory , are found to copy each other with extreme fidelity . The human body is a machine which may be adjusted to a high degree of nicety , and habit is the mechanism by which this adjustment is made .
Translation: 心理学实验室的测量数据显示，打字和弹钢琴这类动作能实现高度精确的相互复制。人体犹如一台可精密调校的机器，而习惯正是实现这种调校的机制。

Query_Text_en: A third advantage is that a stock of habits makes life easier . '
Translation: 第三个优势在于，习惯的积累能让生活更轻松。

Query_Text_en: The burden of living would be intolerable .
Translation: 生活重担将令人不堪承受。

Query_Text_en: The last advantage to be discerned in habit is economy .
Translation: 习惯可辨识的最后一个优势在于经济性。

Query_Text_en: Habitual acts do not have to be actively directed by consciousness . While they are being performed , consciousness may be otherwise engaged . The more of the details of our daily life we can hand over to the effortless custody of automatism , the more our higher powers of mind will be set free for their own proper work . While you are brushing your hair or tying your shoes , your mind may be engaged in memorizing poetry or calculating arithmetical problems .
Translation: 习惯性动作无需意识主动支配。执行这类行为时，意识可专注于其他事务。我们将日常生活细节越多地交由自动化机制无意识地处理，心智的高级能力就越能解放出来从事其本职工作。当你梳头或系鞋带时，大脑可能正在背诵诗歌或演算数学题。

Query_Text_en: Habit is thus a great economizer . The ethical consequences of habit are so striking that before leaving the subject we must give them acknowledgment .
Translation: 因此，习惯是极佳的经济调节器。其道德影响如此显著，在结束这一话题前我们必须予以确认。

Query_Text_en: Exercise : Point out an undesirable habit that you are determined to eradicate . Describe the desirable habit which you will adopt in its place .
Translation: 练习：指出一个你决心戒除的不良习惯，并描述你将用以替代它的良好习惯。

Query_Text_en: Give the concrete steps you will take in forming the new habit .
Translation: 列出你养成新习惯的具体步骤。

Query_Text_en: Mark down the date and refer back to it when you have formed the habit , to see how accurately you estimated .
Translation: 请记下这个日期，待习惯养成后再回头对照，看看当初的预估是否准确。

Query_Text_en: A VERY large part of the mental life of a student consists in the manipulation of images .
Translation: 学生精神生活的很大一部分在于对意象的驾驭。

Query_Text_en: By images we mean the revivals of things that have been impressed upon the senses .
Translation: 所谓意象，即那些曾作用于感官的事物在脑海中的再现。

Query_Text_en: Call to mind for the moment your house-number as it appears upon the door of your home . In so doing you mentally reinstate something which has been impressed upon your senses many times ; and you see it almost as clearly as if it were actually before you .
Translation: 此刻，请回想你家门牌号在门上的样子。通过这个心理活动，你正在脑海中重现一个曾多次印刻在你感官上的信息；你几乎能像亲眼所见一般清晰地看到它。

Query_Text_en: The mental thing thus revived is called an image .
Translation: 这种被重新唤醒的心理活动被称为意象。

Query_Text_en: The word image is somewhat ill-chosen ; for it usually signifies something connected with the eye , and implies that the stuff of mental images is entirely visual .
Translation: "意象"一词的选用稍欠妥当，因其通常指涉与视觉相关的事物，暗示心理意象的构成完全基于视觉感知。

Query_Text_en: he knows many other facts in geography , history , arithmetic , and the other branches of study , and many hundreds of other facts that he has not learned at school and that may not be in any organized branch of study .
Translation: 他通晓地理、历史、算术及其他学科领域的诸多知识，还掌握着数百项并非在校习得、可能不属于任何系统学科范畴的实用常识。

Query_Text_en: He has knowledge and habits that he did not possess before .
Translation: 他掌握了以往不具备的知识与行为习惯。

Query_Text_en: The results of learning , therefore , are knowledge and habits .
Translation: 因此，学习的成果体现为知识的积累与习惯的养成。

Query_Text_en: And from the point of view of its results , learning may be defined as the process of forming habits and acquiring knowledge .
Translation: 从成效角度来看，学习可定义为养成习惯与获取知识的过程。

Query_Text_en: This , however , is but a superficial statement of the facts . We must know the nature of knowledge and of habits before we can understand the nature of learning .
Translation: 然而，这仅是事实的表象陈述。唯有先理解知识与习惯的本质，方能真正把握学习的本质。

Query_Text_en: Habits . A habit is an act following with more or less regularity upon the presentation of a definite stimulus , to which it has become coupled through experience .
Translation: 习惯。习惯是一种行为，在特定刺激出现时，会以或多或少的规律性随之发生，这种行为通过经验与该刺激形成了关联。

Query_Text_en: Writing , reading , and spelling are such acts .
Translation: 书写、阅读和拼写均属此类行为。

Query_Text_en: In spelling , the stimulus is the idea of the word to be spelled . The response is the movements of the hand and arm in writing the word , or in oral spelling , the movements of the organs of speech as in reading .
Translation: 在拼写过程中，刺激源来自待拼单词的意象。反应则体现为书写时手部与臂部的动作，或口头拼读时发音器官的运动——这与阅读时的发声机制如出一辙。

Query_Text_en: In all habits , the stimulus is either a perception or an idea . The response is muscular movement .
Translation: 在所有习惯中，刺激源要么是感知，要么是观念。而反应则表现为肌肉运动。

Query_Text_en: When we say the stimulus is a perception or idea , we mean the cortical excitation which is the physiological correlate of the idea or perception . Throughout this book we shall speak of ideas in this way without committing ourselves to the doubtful theory of interactionism .
Translation: 当我们称刺激为知觉或观念时，指的是作为其生理对应物的大脑皮层兴奋。本书将始终采用这种表述方式讨论观念问题，而不涉及存疑的交互作用理论。

Query_Text_en: We believe that in a scientific psychology mental processes must not be used as elements in a causal series .
Translation: 我们认为，在科学的心理学中，心理过程不应被视为因果链条中的要素。

Query_Text_en: When we so use them it is for simplicity of statement , and with the understanding that the cause indicated is the brain action and not the mental process .
Translation: 我们采用这些表述仅为行文简洁，并明确所指的成因是大脑活动而非心理过程。

Query_Text_en: Knowledge . Knowledge is also a special form of organized experience .
Translation: 知识。知识也是一种特殊形式的系统化经验。

Query_Text_en: Suppose , for example , I am sitting at my desk writing and become cold . The idea comes to me that coal should be put into the furnace . I know that if coal is put into the furnace and the draft of the furnace is opened , the room will become warm and I will become warm . This knowledge is the result of experience . Just as in the case of habit , a definite response action follows upon a definite stimulus , so also in the case of knowledge , an idea follows upon another idea or upon a perception .
Translation: 举例而言，假设我正伏案写作时感到寒冷，便想到该往炉中添煤。我明白若将煤块投入炉膛并打开炉门通风，房间便会暖和起来，自己也能随之取暖。这种认知源自实践经验。正如习惯形成时特定刺激会引发特定反应动作，在认知过程中，某个观念也会紧随另一观念或感知接踵而至。

Query_Text_en: In both cases , the definite sequence is due to experience , and usually to repeated experience . At any rate , the repetition of the experience makes the sequence more probable .
Translation: 在这两种情形下，明确的因果关系均源于经验，且通常是反复验证的经验。无论如何，经验的重复会使这种因果关联更具确定性。

Query_Text_en: We may now define learning-as the process of coupling responses with stimuli , and ideas with ideas or perceptions . It is the establishing of definite sequences in the passage of stimuli into responses , or in the passage of perceptions or ideas to other ideas .
Translation: 我们现在可以将学习定义为将反应与刺激、观念与观念或感知相互联结的过程。这一过程实质上是建立明确的序列联系：或是将外部刺激转化为特定反应，或是将感知与观念转化为新的观念。

Query_Text_en: We have now to enquire concerning the nature of this connection .
Translation: 现在，我们需要探究这种联系的本质。

Query_Text_en: We have spoken of it above as a sequence , but have not explained the cause of the sequence .
Translation: 前文虽已论及其先后顺序，但尚未阐明此顺序之成因。

Query_Text_en: in the case of knowledge to internal observation .
Translation: 就知识而言，其指向的是内部观察。

Query_Text_en: Of course it may be said , and truly , that the sequence is determined by repetition of experience .
Translation: 当然可以说，而且确实如此，这种顺序是由经验的重复所决定的。

Query_Text_en: This is the cause of the sequence as one sees it on the outside by objective observation of behavior .
Translation: 这是通过客观观察行为表象所呈现出的因果序列。

Query_Text_en: Now a stimulus , in the simplest cases , is due to the excitation of some sense organ , and a response is a muscular contraction .
Translation: 在最简单的情形下，刺激源于某一感觉器官的兴奋，而反应则表现为肌肉收缩。

Query_Text_en: The excitation passes over a neuron or series of neurons to a muscle or group of muscles and brings about a contraction .
Translation: 兴奋通过一个或一系列神经元传递至肌肉或肌群，从而引发收缩。

Query_Text_en: The process of learning , in habit formation , consists in doing something that insures , with more or less certainty , that the stimulus shall go to a certain muscle rather than to some other .
Translation: 在习惯养成的学习过程中，关键在于采取特定行动，以确保刺激信号能够相对确定地传导至目标肌肉而非其他部位。

Query_Text_en: This doing something consists in reducing the resistance along the nervous route that leads to the proper muscle or group of muscles .
Translation: 这种行动在于减少通往相应肌肉或肌肉群的神经通路上的阻力。

Query_Text_en: Stimulation or excitation passing through the nervous system is guided and directed by nothing other than the various resistances offered by the parts of this system . And learning consists , physiologically , in building up and establishing preferential routes in the nervous system .
Translation: 神经系统中的刺激传导完全由该系统各部位提供的不同阻力所引导和调控。从生理学角度看，学习过程就是在神经系统中构建并确立优先传导路径。

Query_Text_en: A preferential route depends upon the fact that this route offers less resistance to the particular form of excitation than do other routes .
Translation: 优先传导路径的形成，源于该路径对特定兴奋形式产生的阻抗低于其他路径。

Query_Text_en: This smaller resistance is due in most part to previous passages of the same kind of excitation along the same route .
Translation: 这种较小的阻力主要源于先前同类激励沿相同路径的多次传导。

Query_Text_en: It must be pointed out that preferential agoutis are not fixed and static things , nor absolute and permanently definite .
Translation: 必须指出，优惠政策并非固定不变的事物，也非绝对且永久确定的。

Query_Text_en: It is always merely a matter of probability , for the reason that nervous resistance is subject to great variation , is influenced by many factors , such as fatigue , temporary blood supply in the paints involved , immediately preceding stimulation , other consultant stimulation , the feeling accompaniments , etc .
Translation: 这始终只是一个概率问题，因为神经抵抗性存在极大变数，受诸多因素影响，诸如疲劳程度、相关部位的瞬时供血状况、先前的即时刺激、其他伴随刺激以及情绪反应等。

Query_Text_en: In the light of these facts , we should say that learning , in habit-formation , consists in increasing the probability , other factors being equal , that a given stimulus will take a certain course .
Translation: 鉴于上述事实，我们可以认为：在习惯养成过程中，学习本质上是在同等条件下，提高特定刺激沿既定路径发展的概率。

Query_Text_en: Learning can probably sieve insure that a given stimulus will , in spite of all other factors , go over into a certain response .
Translation: 学习或许能确保特定刺激排除其他因素干扰，最终转化为特定反应。

Query_Text_en: As well as we know to say
Translation: 众所周知

Query_Text_en: The physiological basis of knowledge is precisely the same as that of habit .
Translation: 知识的生理基础与习惯的生理基础完全相同。

Query_Text_en: Knowledge is a matter of one idea following another idea .
Translation: 知识乃思想相继而生。

Query_Text_en: Now the reason that a certain idea , as x , follows idea a , is that the cerebral excitation underlying the idea a passes over and causes the excitation underlying the idea x .
Translation: 某一观念（如x）之所以紧随观念a出现，是因为观念a所对应的脑部神经兴奋传递至观念x对应的神经区域并引发其兴奋。

Query_Text_en: That the excitation takes this course rather than some other , and brings about the idea x rather than some other idea , as y or z , is due , as in habit , to preferential routes in the central nervous system .
Translation: 兴奋之所以沿此路径而非其他路径传导，并引发X而非Y或Z等其他观念，究其根源，正如习惯形成机制所示，在于中枢神经系统中存在优先传导通路。

Query_Text_en: From the point of view of the nervous system , there is no difference whatever between habit and knowledge .
Translation: 从神经系统的角度来看，习惯与知识之间并无任何本质区别。

Query_Text_en: From this point of view , all learning is the establishing of differential resistances in the central nervous system .
Translation: 由此可见，一切学习行为都是在中枢神经系统内建立差异化阻抗的过程。

Query_Text_en: The paths of smaller resistance have been called
Translation: 阻力较小的路径被称为

Query_Text_en: Securing the Initial Connection . Learning is connecting , but we must now ask how the connection is first secured .
Translation: 确保初始连接。学习即建立联系，但我们现在必须追问：这种联系最初是如何形成的。

Query_Text_en: Suppose we wish to couple the stimulus
Translation: 假设我们希望将刺激措施

Query_Text_en: He is able to say twenty-five when he wishes , and he can couple it to any stimulus of his own volition .
Translation: 他能够随心所欲地说出"二十五"这个数字，并能自主将其与任何刺激因素相关联。

Query_Text_en: He has long since mastered this response .
Translation: 他早已熟谙此道。

Query_Text_en: But suppose it is a very young child and we ask him to make the letter . We can show him the letter and tell him to make one like it .
Translation: 但假设这是一个年幼的孩子，我们要求他写出这个字母。我们可以向他展示这个字母，并让他照着写一个。

Query_Text_en: But the child can not immediately make the letter . This is a response which he has not yet mastered .
Translation: 但孩子无法立即写出这个字母。这一反应他尚未掌握。

Query_Text_en: How does he master it ? With pencil in hand he continues to make marks on the paper . The results of the first trials may have no resemblance to the letter a .
Translation: 他是如何掌握它的？手握铅笔，他不断在纸上留下痕迹。最初的尝试结果可能与字母“a”毫无相似之处。

Query_Text_en: The stimulus being maintained , the efforts continue .
Translation: 刺激政策持续发力，各项举措稳步推进。

Query_Text_en: Each time the response is somewhat different . Slowly the marks begin to resemble the copy .
Translation: 每次的回应都略有不同。渐渐地，笔迹开始与范本相似。

Query_Text_en: This form of learning has been named the trial and error method .
Translation: 这种学习方式被称为试错法。

Query_Text_en: It is the only method in habit-forming even the movement involved has not already been mastered and coupled with the idea of the movement as its stimulus .
Translation: 这是形成习惯的唯一方法，即使相关动作尚未熟练掌握，也能通过将动作概念作为刺激与之结合。

Query_Text_en: During the early years of infancy the child , by the trial and error method , is learning to make movements with all the muscles of his body .
Translation: 在婴儿早期阶段，孩子通过不断尝试与调整，逐步学会运用全身肌肉完成各种动作。

Query_Text_en: Especially is he getting control of legs and arms and hands and feet and of the vocal organs .
Translation: 他尤其注重掌控自己的四肢、双手、双脚以及发声器官。

Query_Text_en: In these early years he learns to make nearly all possible movements with his hands and vocal organs , and these movements are organized with the cortical substrate of their corresponding ideas as their adequate stimuli .
Translation: 在最初几年里，他学会了用手和发音器官完成几乎所有可能的动作，这些动作通过大脑皮层基底组织与其对应概念形成充分刺激的关联。

Query_Text_en: This learning is so far advanced when the child enters school , that he can make with some degree of precision , any kind of mark he is shown or told to make . He can also make any sounds he hears or is told to make .
Translation: 当孩子入学时，这种学习能力已发展到相当程度：他能较为精确地描摹任何示范或指定的符号，也能准确模仿听到或被告知发出的任何语音。

Query_Text_en: But most of the movements and vocal responses have been mastered , so that little trial and error learning is left to be done .
Translation: 但大部分动作和言语反应已熟练掌握，需要试错学习的环节所剩无几。

Query_Text_en: The method of perfecting them is the trial and error method .
Translation: 完善这些方法的过程就是不断试错的过程。

Query_Text_en: The fact is , that when a child enters school much learning has already taken place . He has partially mastered most of the responses that will ever be required of him .
Translation: 事实上，当儿童入学时，其学习历程早已开启。他已初步掌握未来所需的大部分行为反应。

Query_Text_en: What remains is to couple these responses to their appropriate stimuli , and this is done by what may be called the ideational method .
Translation: 剩下的工作是将这些反应与相应的刺激因素联系起来，这可以通过所谓的观念方法来实现。

Query_Text_en: This method is possible only after the movement involved has been attained by the trial and error method and connected with its idea as its adequate stimulus .
Translation: 唯有当相关动作通过反复试错得以掌握，并与作为其充分刺激源的理念建立联系后，此方法方可实施。

Query_Text_en: As previously explained , when we speak of an idea as a stimulus , we mean the cortical activity which is the neural correlate of the idea .
Translation: 如前所述，当我们称某种观念为刺激因素时，我们指的是作为该观念神经关联物的大脑皮层活动。

Query_Text_en: In the case of knowledge , the initial connection between the ideas is secured by simultaneous experience .
Translation: 就知识而言，观念之间的初始联系是通过同步经验建立的。

Query_Text_en: If we wish two ideas to be joined together in our minds , so that when one of the two ideas comes , the other follows , we must experience these two ideas together .
Translation: 若欲使两种观念在脑海中紧密关联，以致其一显现必引致其二相随，则须令二者于意识中同时呈现。

Query_Text_en: And the oftener the ideas are experienced together , the more surely will one arouse the other .
Translation: 观念相伴出现的频率越高，彼此唤起的确定性就越强。

Query_Text_en: Suppose I wish to teach a child the names of the parts of a flower and the functions of the essential parts of the flower . I show him a flower and tell him its name .
Translation: 假设我想教孩子认识花的各个部分名称及其主要功能。我向他展示一朵花，并告诉他花的名称。

Query_Text_en: The idea of the thing becomes associated with the name through simultaneous experience .
Translation: 事物的概念通过同步体验与名称相关联。

Query_Text_en: I then point out the different floral organs , the calyx , corolla , stamens and pistil .
Translation: 随后，我逐一指出花萼、花冠、雄蕊和雌蕊等不同花器结构。

Query_Text_en: As the child looks at each organ , I pronounce the name of the organ upon which his attention is fixed .
Translation: 当孩子注视每个器官时，我会说出他注意力集中的器官名称。

Query_Text_en: In this manner the things and their names become coupled together .
Translation: 由此，事物与其名称便紧密关联起来。

Query_Text_en: Then in a similar manner we couple the names of the parts with the functions of the parts .
Translation: 随后，我们以类似方式将部件名称与其功能对应起来。

Query_Text_en: In knowledge-getting in all its various fields , our only method of connecting ideas together is by experiencing those ideas together in a state of attention .
Translation: 在获取知识的各个领域中，我们联结观念的唯一方法，就是在专注状态下同时体验这些观念。

Query_Text_en: Since an idea can enter into any number of such connections , all of our knowledge becomes connected or related , so that we are able to go from any idea to any other idea through intermediary ideas .
Translation: 由于一个概念可以建立无数此类关联，我们所有的知识便相互联结、彼此关联，从而能够通过中介概念实现任意概念间的互通。

Query_Text_en: For example , horse is connected with buggy through simultaneous experience , similarly buggy with city , city with Athens , Athens with Homer , Homer with the Iliad , Iliad with school , school with a certain classmate , this classmate with death , death with heaven .
Translation: 譬如，马与马车因同时出现而关联，同理马车与城市、城市与雅典、雅典与荷马、荷马与《伊利亚特》、《伊利亚特》与学校、学校与某位同窗、同窗与死亡、死亡与天堂皆由此相连。

Query_Text_en: Similarly all the items of our experience are united so that we can go either directly or indirectly from any bit of experience to any other , although the only method of uniting these bits of experience is through simultaneous experience .
Translation: 同样，我们所有的经验片段都相互关联，使得我们能够直接或间接地从任一经验片段通达其他任何片段，尽管将这些经验片段联系起来的唯一途径是通过同时性体验。

Query_Text_en: The above account of the method by which stimuli are first connected with their responses and ideas with other ideas is objective and to some extent superficial .
Translation: 上述关于刺激最初如何与反应相连、观念如何与其他观念相连的论述是客观的，在某种程度上也是浅显的。

Query_Text_en: We have described merely what is seen on the outside . What goes on inside is not entirely clear .
Translation: 我们仅描述了表象，内在机理尚未完全明晰。

Query_Text_en: Why two cortical processes which underlie two ideas simultaneously experienced should be so related that when later one of these processes is revived it should revive the other , is not known .
Translation: 为何支撑两个同时体验的想法的两个皮层过程会如此关联，以至于当其中一个过程后来被重新激活时，另一个也会随之复苏，其原因尚不得而知。

Query_Text_en: Probably two simultaneous brain processes are to some extent one process , and flow into one another , so that they become more or less a unity .
Translation: 两种同时进行的大脑活动在某种程度上实为一体，彼此交融，从而或多或少形成一个统一体。

Query_Text_en: If such is the case , then later when one of the processes is revived it revives the other because it is really a part of the other , or rather they both constitute but one process .
Translation: 既然如此，那么当其中一个进程恢复时，它也会唤醒另一个进程，因为实质上它属于另一个进程的组成部分，更确切地说，二者共同构成了单一进程。

Query_Text_en: In the case of habit , it may well be asked very , when a child tries for the first time to make the letter a , whatever the first response , does he not continue to make the same marks over and over again instead of making somewhat different marks at each trial ? It is possible that the stimulus changes somewhat with each trial . The child sees that the first result is not the result desired , this very fact makes the stimulus for the second attempt a somewhat different stimulus . Moreover , the resistances along the various possible routes are doubtless not very different so that the slightest change in resistance makes the stimulus take a somewhat different route producing a different result .
Translation: 就习惯而言,我们很可能会提出一个疑问:当一个孩童初次尝试书写字母a时,无论首次反应如何,难道他不会反复书写相同的笔迹,而非在每次尝试时都写出略有差异的笔划吗?实则每次尝试时的刺激因素可能都存在细微变化。孩童观察到首个结果与预期不符,这个事实本身就使得第二次尝试的刺激与原初有所不同。更重要的是,各潜在神经通路的阻力值差异原本就极其微小,因此阻力的任何细微改变都会导致刺激信号选择略有差异的传导路径,最终产生不同的书写结果。

Query_Text_en: Probably the fatigue toxins are sufficient to change the resistance temporarily . Possibly also the physiological correlates of the feeling element involved have their effects in varying the resistances and shifting the direction of the excitation .
Translation: 疲劳毒素可能足以暂时改变抵抗力。此外，所涉情感要素的生理关联也可能通过改变抵抗力和转移兴奋方向产生影响。

Query_Text_en: These suggestions are entirely theoretical , and we must confess that we are ignorant of the nature of the neurological processes which constitute the causes which we are seeking .
Translation: 这些建议纯属理论推演，我们必须承认，对于构成我们所探寻原因的那些神经活动过程的本质，我们仍一无所知。

Query_Text_en: For the present we must be content with the objective statement of facts given above .
Translation: 目前，我们只能满足于上述对事实的客观陈述。

Query_Text_en: Fortunately this objective statement is sufficient for our practical purposes .
Translation: 所幸这一客观陈述足以满足我们的实际需求。

Query_Text_en: Function of Habits . Habit is the basis of efficiency .
Translation: 习惯的作用。习惯是效率的基础。

Query_Text_en: It insures , as much as anything can insure , that the right response follows upon the appropriate stimulus .
Translation: 它确保——在最大程度上确保——正确的反应紧随恰当的刺激而来。

Query_Text_en: Habit enables us to perform an act with greater accuracy , greater speed , less waste of energy , and consequently with less fatigue . Motor efficiency is impossible except through habit .
Translation: 习惯使我们能够更准确、更迅速、更省力地完成动作，从而减少疲劳。没有习惯，就不可能实现动作效率。

Query_Text_en: In whatever field our work may be , whether in carpentry , masonry , farming , blacksmithing , engineering , or cooking , we become efficient only through habituating the processes .
Translation: 无论从事何种行业，木工、石匠、耕作、铁艺、工程抑或烹饪，唯有熟能生巧方能臻于高效。

Query_Text_en: There is no other way .
Translation: 别无他法。

Query_Text_en: It is true that habituation resists change . Through habit we become set and fixed , but this is the price that we must pay for efficiency .
Translation: 诚然，积习难改。习惯使我们变得固执僵化，但这是为效率必须付出的代价。

Query_Text_en: If we consider the function of habit from the mental side , the subjective side , we find that habit removes actions to the control of lower cortical levels , relieving the higher levels which are thereby freed for other processes which may go on simultaneously .
Translation: 从心理层面即主观层面考察习惯的功能，我们会发现习惯将行为交由较低层级的大脑皮层控制，从而解放高级皮层区域，使其能够同时处理其他活动进程。

Query_Text_en: In other words , habit removes an act from the state of focal attention , leaving the higher attention levels for other processes .
Translation: 换言之，习惯使行为脱离焦点注意状态，从而将更高层级的注意力留给其他活动。

Query_Text_en: For example , when we are learning to run a typewriter , the operation of the machine demands all of our attention . After we have become expert in running the machine , the mere mechanical work demands little or no attention .
Translation: 例如，当我们学习使用打字机时，操作机器会占据我们全部注意力。而当我们熟练操作后，单纯的机械性工作几乎不需要或完全不需要集中精力。

Query_Text_en: Function of Knowledge . The chief function of knowledge is to put meaning into the world .
Translation: 知识的功能。知识的主要功能在于赋予世界以意义。

Query_Text_en: The getting of knowledge consists in learning the names of things and the functions of things .
Translation: 获取知识在于了解事物的名称及其功能。

Query_Text_en: It is only the fact that we live a social life and need to communicate with one another that makes it necessary to learn the names of things .
Translation: 正是由于我们过着社会生活且需要相互交流，才使得掌握事物名称成为必要。

Query_Text_en: If we lived an individual , solitary life , we should not need to know the names of things , therefore the essential thing in knowledge is the coupling of the thing with its functions .
Translation: 倘若我们过着离群索居的生活，便无需知晓事物的名称，因此认知的核心在于将事物与其功能相联系。

Query_Text_en: Now all things in the world are related , and through experience we learn the functions of things , or in other words , their characteristics , what they do , what we can do with them .
Translation: 世间万物皆相互关联，我们通过实践认知事物的功用，即其特性、作用及用途。

Query_Text_en: we learn the several uses to which the various things in our environment can be put .
Translation: 我们掌握了环境中各类事物的多种用途。

Query_Text_en: For example , we have experience with a substance which we name 17071 .
Translation: 例如，我们曾对一种编号为17071的物质进行过研究。

Query_Text_en: We learn that it is hard , tough , heavy , that it gets red when heated , white and malleable when heated still more . We learn that we can hammer it till it has a ship edge and then v/e can cut with it ; that we can mould it into various shapes and make it into a multitude of useful instruments and implements .
Translation: 我们了解到，铁质地坚硬、沉重；加热时会变红，温度更高时则转为白色且具有延展性。我们懂得可以将铁锻打出锋刃用以切割，能将其铸造成各种形态，制成众多实用的工具器械。

Query_Text_en: We come to know the world as it is .
Translation: 我们认识世界的本来面目。

Query_Text_en: This knowledge of the world gives us control of the world . The function of knowledge is , then , to put meaning into the world , and through this meaning to give us control of the world .
Translation: 对世界的认知赋予我们掌控世界的能力。知识的功用，在于为世界注入意义，并藉此意义使我们得以驾驭世界。

Query_Text_en: We build an inner , thought world , which corresponds to the outer world .
Translation: 我们构建了一个与外部世界相对应的内在思想世界。

Query_Text_en: The closeness of the correspondence between our inner world and the outer world indicates our approach to the truth .
Translation: 内心世界与外部世界的高度契合，标志着我们趋近真理的程度。

Query_Text_en: We can not use it because we do not really know it .
Translation: 我们无法使用它，因为我们并不真正了解它。

Query_Text_en: We do not have its true meaning .
Translation: 我们尚未领悟其真谛。

Query_Text_en: Plasticity . By plasticity as used here , we mean the ease with which we can be changed , more particularly the ease with which new bonds can be established in our central nervous system .
Translation: 可塑性。此处所指的可塑性，即我们发生改变的难易程度，更具体地说，是指我们中枢神经系统建立新连接的难易程度。

Query_Text_en: As we grow old we lose plasticity chiefly for the reason that in our earlier years definite responses are established for most of the situations of life .
Translation: 随着年龄增长，我们逐渐丧失可塑性，主要原因是早年生活中已对多数情境形成了固定反应模式。

Query_Text_en: The passage of the same excitation over the same set of neurons , time after time , producing the same action sets up a path which resists change .
Translation: 同一兴奋信号反复通过同一组神经元，持续产生相同行为反应，由此形成的神经通路会逐渐固化，难以改变。

Query_Text_en: forms of response more or less definite have been established for all of them . Therefore , in familiar situations we become more set with each succeeding year .
Translation: 针对各类情况，人们已形成或明确或模糊的应对模式。因此，面对熟悉情境时，我们逐年变得更为固守成规。

Query_Text_en: However , we do not lose plasticity in unfamiliar situations , as far as is known , until the decadence of the latter part of life sets in .
Translation: 然而，就目前所知，人类在陌生情境中不会丧失可塑性，直至生命后期机能衰退阶段来临。

Query_Text_en: But after we reach middle life there are not many unfamiliar fields .
Translation: 然而步入中年后，我们鲜少再遇陌生领域。

Query_Text_en: There are then very few situations which we do not approach with some bias or prejudice .
Translation: 我们处理事务时，鲜有不带任何先入之见或偏颇立场的情形。

Query_Text_en: Apart from the resistance of bonds already formed our ability to form new bonds increases up to maturity , and probably does not decrease till after middle age .
Translation: 除却既有关系形成的阻力外，我们建立新关系的能力会随着年龄增长而增强，直至成熟期达到顶峰，且很可能在中年之后才会开始衰退。

Query_Text_en: This statement is based on a comparison of the learning capacity of men and women in their forties with that of children of high school age and younger .
Translation: 本结论基于对四十余岁成年人与高中及以下学龄儿童学习能力的比较研究。

Query_Text_en: In fields wherein men and women are not incapacitated and hindered by virtue of prejudicial bonds already formed they learn as readily as do boys and girls , much more readily than young girls and boys .
Translation: 在那些男女不受既有偏见束缚而能力受限的领域，他们学习起来与男孩女孩同样轻松，甚至比年轻男女更为得心应手。

Query_Text_en: Man as the Result of His Learning . Let us now consider the importance to our lives of habits and knowledge .
Translation: 习以成性：论习惯与知识对人生之要义

Query_Text_en: Thomdike has truthfully said that the most important thing about human nature is that it can be changed .
Translation: 桑代克曾坦言，人性最可贵之处在于其可塑性。

Query_Text_en: Let us couple with this statement another common saying , namely , that a man is the sum of his tendencies . A careful consideration of these two facts gives us an idea of the importance of education .
Translation: 让我们将这一论述与另一句常言结合起来：人即其习性之总和。深入思考这两点，便能领会教育之重大意义。

Query_Text_en: What we are at maturity depends upon the habits and knowledge that we have .
Translation: 我们的成熟程度取决于我们养成的习惯与掌握的知识。

Query_Text_en: Acquiring these habits and getting this knowledge constitute our education .
Translation: 养成这些习惯并掌握这些知识，就是我们所受的教育。

Query_Text_en: Whether we are a Methodist , Presbyterian or Catholic depends upon our education . Whether we are a republican , democrat or socialist depends upon our education .
Translation: 我们信奉卫理宗、长老会还是天主教，取决于所受的教育；我们支持共和党、民主党还是社会党，同样取决于所受的教育。

Query_Text_en: Our ideals of life , of work , of duty depend upon our education .
Translation: 我们对生活、工作与责任的理想，皆源于所受的教育。

Query_Text_en: Briefly , all our skill , all our knowledge is merely the result of the bonds that have been formed in our central nervous systems .
Translation: 简言之，我们的一切技能与知识，都不过是中枢神经系统内形成的神经连接产物。

Query_Text_en: In a very true sense a man is made .
Translation: 从最本质的意义上说，人是被塑造而成的。

Query_Text_en: He is the product of all the forces that act upon him , particularly of those that act upon him in his earlier years .
Translation: 他是所有作用于他的力量——尤其是早年塑造他的力量——共同作用的产物。

Query_Text_en: We do not mean to minimize the importance of original nature .
Translation: 我们无意贬低先天禀赋的重要性。

Query_Text_en: The same forces do not make the same result out of two different children .
Translation: 同样的外力作用在两个不同的孩子身上，不会产生相同的结果。

Query_Text_en: We can not make the same kind of chair out of pine that we can out of oak , nor can Vivo make the same kind of man out of one child that we can out of another .
Translation: 正如松木无法打造出橡木椅的品质，维沃也无法将不同孩童塑造成同一类人。

Query_Text_en: What we are at maturity depends upon the modifications that have been wrought upon original nature .
Translation: 我们成年后的状态，取决于对原始本性的改造程度。

Query_Text_en: Bringing about these modifications constitutes our education , and education is important to the extent that these modifications are important .
Translation: 促成这些改变即构成我们的教育，而教育的重要性正取决于这些改变的重要性。

Query_Text_en: And they are of tremendous importance in the life of every individual .
Translation: 它们对每个人的生活都至关重要。

Query_Text_en: Upon these the forces of the environment , of home , school , companions , and the whole animate and inanimate world work , forming and molding and fashioning the individual into the thing that he is to be , namely a being with a background of feelings and passions and instincts , to which is added a multitude of acquired tendencies to act in definite ways to the various situations of life : a being with myriad ideas all interrelated , each idea coupled with others ;
Translation: 环境、家庭、学校、同伴以及整个有生命与无生命世界的力量作用于这些禀赋，塑造并雕琢着个体，使之成为特定存在——一个拥有情感、激情与本能背景的生命体，在此基础上又衍生出无数应对生活各种情境的习得性行为倾向；一个具备万千相互关联观念的思维体，每个观念都与其他观念紧密交织。

Query_Text_en: a being with ideals , ambitions , desires ; a lying of hates and loves and jealousies , all the resultant of the original tendencies provided by heredity and the forces of the environment that have acted upon the individual .
Translation: 一个拥有理想、抱负与欲望的生命体；交织着憎恨、热爱与嫉妒的谎言，这一切皆是遗传赋予的原始倾向与个体所处环境力量共同作用之产物。

Query_Text_en: The changes that are wrought in us constitute the results of learning .
Translation: 我们内在的转变正是学习成果的体现。

Query_Text_en: The investigation of their nature and of how they come about is the purpose of this book .
Translation: 探究这些现象的本质及其成因，正是本书的主旨所在。

Query_Text_en: Progress in learning is ordinarily shown by a curve .
Translation: 学习进度通常以曲线形式呈现。

Query_Text_en: We must now see how such curves are constructed , how they should be interpreted , notice the various types of curve , and the laws of learning which they exhibit .
Translation: 我们现在必须了解这些曲线的绘制方法、解读方式，注意各类曲线的特征及其所展现的学习规律。

Query_Text_en: We must study also the various factors which enter into them , and which determine their upper limit .
Translation: 我们还必须研究影响这些因素的各种变量，以及决定其上限的条件。

Query_Text_en: The Construction of a Learning Curve . The purpose of a learning curve is to show the increase in efficiency due to practice .
Translation: 学习曲线的构建旨在展示因实践积累而带来的效率提升。

Query_Text_en: It is customary to indicate the successive practices on the horizontal axis , as BC in . 1 . The scale for the scores is indicated on the vertical axis , AB . The scores are shown by the dots above the numbers on BC which represent the successive practices . The line DE joining these dots is the learning curve . Its rise indicates the increasing efficiency due to practice .
Translation: 通常将连续练习次数标注于横轴，如图1中的BC段所示。成绩分数标度则显示于纵轴AB。各次练习所得分数以BC轴上对应数字上方的圆点表示，连接这些圆点的DE线即为学习曲线。该曲线上升趋势表明：练习带来的效率正在持续提升。

Query_Text_en: Figure 1 .
Learning Curve .
Translation: 学习曲线

Query_Text_en: Card-sorting , fifteen boxes , live cards to the box , experiment continued five days , four sorting first day , eight sorting on each succeeding day , 12 subjects .
Translation: 卡片分类实验，共设15个箱子，将活动卡片放入箱中。实验持续五天：首日进行4次分类，之后每日完成8次分类，受试者共计12人。

Query_Text_en: Every sixth record is taken for the construction of the curve .
Translation: 每六条记录取一条用于构建曲线。

Query_Text_en: The records are in terms of cards sorted per minute .
Translation: 纪录以每分钟分拣卡片数量计算。

Query_Text_en: Figure 2 .
Data same as for Figure 1 .
Translation: 数据同图1所示。

Query_Text_en: Another method of constructing the curve is shown in Fig .  2 .
Translation: 另一种构建曲线的方法如图2所示。

Query_Text_en: The curve is constructed as follows : Instead of representing successive practices by points on the base , we represent them by successive distances .
Translation: 该曲线的构建方法如下：我们不再以底轴上的点来表征连续实践，而是改用连续距离来表示。

Query_Text_en: The scores are represented by horizontal lines , drawn at the proper height and of the same length as the distances on the base which indicate the practices .
Translation: 分数以水平线表示，其高度与基准线上表示实践的距离相对应，且两者长度一致。

Query_Text_en: Either of these forms of curve shows the facts as well as the other , but if curves are to be drafty with the same axes for purposes of comparison , the form of curve shown in Fig .  1 is more convenient .
Translation: 这两种曲线形式均能同等清晰地呈现数据，但若需采用相同坐标轴绘制曲线以便比较，则图1所示形式更为便利。

Query_Text_en: In figures 1 and 2 , increasing efficiency is shown by rise in the curves . The curves indicate the amounts of work done in successive equal periods of time .
Translation: 图1和图2中，曲线上升代表效率提高。这些曲线反映了在连续相等时间段内完成的工作量。

Query_Text_en: Another method of constructing the curve is to show the amount of time required to do successive equal amounts of work .
Translation: 另一种绘制曲线的方法是显示完成连续等量工作所需的时间。

Query_Text_en: By this method , increasing efficiency is shown by a fall in the curve .
Translation: 采用此法时，效率提升表现为曲线下降。

Query_Text_en: It may be illustrated by the same card-sorting data used in constructing the graphs in figures 1 and 2 . In the card-sorting experiment from which this data was obtained , seventy-five cards were sorted into fifteen pigeon holes or card trays .
Translation: 这一观点可通过构建图1和图2所用的相同卡片分类数据加以说明。在获取该数据的分类实验中，75张卡片被分拣至15个分类格或卡片托盘内。

Query_Text_en: Each tray was numbered , and the cards were numbered correspondingly , five to each tray .
Translation: 每个托盘均标有编号，卡片亦对应编号，每盘放置五张。

Query_Text_en: At each practice , all the seventy-five cards were distributed .
Translation: 每次演练时，七十五张卡片均会悉数分发。

Query_Text_en: With each practice the time required for sorting the cards became less and less .
Translation: 每次练习后，整理卡片所需的时间都逐渐减少。

Query_Text_en: This is shown in Fig. 3 .
Translation: 如图3所示。

Query_Text_en: Therefore figures 1 and 2 show the increasing number of cards sorted per minute in the successive practices , vehicle figure 3 shows the decreasing amount of time required to sort the seventy-five cards in the successive practices .
Translation: 因此，图1和图2显示了在连续练习中每分钟分类卡片数量的递增趋势，而图3则表明在连续练习中对75张卡片进行分类所需时间的递减情况。

Query_Text_en: In the discussion of learning curves which follows , we shall have in mind the types of curve shown in figures 1 and 2 , in which efficiency is shown by a rise in the curve .
Translation: 在接下来的学习曲线讨论中，我们将以图1和图2所示的曲线类型为参照。这类曲线以上升趋势表征效率提升。

Query_Text_en: Increase in efficiency from practice is due in general to three causes : ( 1 ) The establishing of the bond between stimulus and response .
Translation: 效率的提升通常源于三个因素：（1）刺激与反应之间关联的建立。

Query_Text_en: This bond , in physiological terms , is the shortest possible route between stimulus and response .
Translation: 从生理学角度而言，这种纽带是刺激与反应之间最直接的传导路径。

Query_Text_en: ( 2 ) The second factor is decreased resistance in the established neural bond or route .
Translation: 第二个因素是已建立的神经联结或通路的抵抗力下降。

Query_Text_en: ( 3 ) The third factor is the adaptation of the muscles to the special movements required .
Translation: 第三项因素是肌肉对特定动作的适应性调整。

Query_Text_en: In the present discussion , we are considering learning of the habit-forming type , and not ideational learning in which the motor element is unimportant .
Translation: 在当前的讨论中，我们关注的是习惯养成型学习，而非运动要素无关紧要的观念性学习。

Query_Text_en: We shall now illustrate the various learning factors from the card-sorting experiment .
Translation: 现在我们将通过卡片分类实验来说明各种学习要素。

Query_Text_en: We sit down to the experiment for the first time . We take the pack of cards in our left hand and remove a card with the right hand .
Translation: 我们首次进行这项实验。左手持牌叠，右手抽出一张牌。

Query_Text_en: Let us suppose the card is number seventeen . We look over the box numbers until we find number seventeen , and then deposit the card into this box .
Translation: 假设卡片编号为17号。我们逐一核对箱体编号，直至找到17号箱，随后将该卡片投入此箱中。

Query_Text_en: We take another card . Suppose it is number 20 . We must search for box number 20 , and so proceed until all the seventy-five cards are distributed .
Translation: 我们再取一张卡片。假设这张是20号。我们必须找到标号为20的盒子，依此类推，直至将全部七十五张卡片分配完毕。

Query_Text_en: When we have finished , we have put five cards into each box . The first card sorted was number 17 .
Translation: 工作完成后，每个票箱内已放置五张选票。首张分拣的选票编号为17号。

Query_Text_en: After a few seconds we came to another card numbered 17 . We may have remembered the location of this box , more likely we did not .
Translation: 几秒钟后，我们来到编号17的另一张卡片前。或许我们还记得这个盒子的位置，但更可能已经遗忘。

Query_Text_en: But before the first experiment was over we did learn the location of some of the boxes and did not have to search for them .
Translation: 但在首次实验结束前，我们确实掌握了部分箱子的位置信息，无需再行搜寻。

Query_Text_en: With each successive sorting , we remembered more and more of the boxes , until finally we knew the location of all of them and did not have to search for any of them .
Translation: 随着一次次分类整理，我们记起的箱子越来越多，最终掌握了所有箱子的位置，无需再逐一搜寻。

Query_Text_en: However , it must be pointed out that all learning is a matter of degree .
Translation: 然而必须指出，所有学习都是一个程度问题。

Query_Text_en: I have said that we come to know where all the boxes are . We do , but at first we know it poorly . The associations come slowly .
Translation: 我曾说过，我们终将摸清所有条条框框。确实如此，但起初我们对此知之甚少。各种关联总是逐渐显现的。

Query_Text_en: While we do not have to hunt for the boxes , the kinesthetic or visual idea of their location comes to us slowly , and the movements therefore follow slowly .
Translation: 虽然我们不必费力寻找这些盒子，但对它们位置的动觉或视觉概念在我们脑海中形成得缓慢，因此动作也随之迟缓。

Query_Text_en: With more practice , the movements follow their stimuli more quickly , more definitely , more surely .
Translation: 经过更多练习，动作对刺激的反应会更快、更明确、更稳定。

Query_Text_en: The associative processes run their course faster and faster .
Translation: 联想过程的发展速度越来越快。

Query_Text_en: This is because the bonds are only poorly established , and at any moment may break down and fail us .
Translation: 这是因为这些纽带尚未牢固建立，随时可能断裂失效。

Query_Text_en: With increasing practice , this failure of a particular association to run its proper course happens less and less , and the certainty that all the associations will take place quickly becomes greater and greater .
Translation: 随着练习的不断深入，特定联想无法顺利完成的情况会越来越少，而所有联想都能迅速建立的确信度则会越来越高。

Query_Text_en: But , as pointed out in Chapter I , this certainly is never absolute .
Translation: 但正如第一章所述，这种状况绝非绝对。

Query_Text_en: In the early practices , while the neuron-muscular coordinations are weakly established , the hand often starts the wrong way , but before it reaches the box , we recall the right place and have to make a second movement .
Translation: 在初期练习阶段，由于神经肌肉协调尚未稳固建立，手部常会出现起始方向错误。但在触及目标物之前，我们能够及时忆起正确位置，继而做出二次修正动作。

Query_Text_en: With increasing practice , these false movements become fewer and fewer .
Translation: 随着练习的增多，这些错误动作会越来越少。

Query_Text_en: With every day of practice , it becomes more and more certain that when we take a card from the pack , the hand will go unerringly and with no loss of time or waste of motion , to the appropriate box .
Translation: 随着每日练习的积累，我们愈发确信：当从牌堆中抽取一张卡片时，手部动作将精准无误地直达对应牌盒，既无时间损耗，亦无多余动作。

Query_Text_en: Figure 4 .
Learning Curve showing the effects of long continued practice .
Translation: 学习曲线展示了长期持续练习的效果。

Query_Text_en: Card-sorting , 30 boxes , five cards to the box .
Translation: 卡片分类，共30盒，每盒5张卡片。

Query_Text_en: The records from which the curve is made are the reciprocals of the scores in seconds . These reciprocals are made proportional to the number of cards per second . The practice was first for 20 successive days , five practices the first day ; seven , the second ; eight , the third and fourth ; nine , on the fifth , sixth , seventh , and eighth ; and ten on all succeeding days-Fourteen days later , the practice was resumed for two days , and seven days later , for four days . The records attended on these latter practices and indicated by the letters a , b , and c .
Translation: 绘制该曲线所依据的数据记录，是以秒为单位的得分倒数。这些倒数数值被转化为与每秒处理卡片数量成正比的指标。练习最初连续进行20天：首日练习5次，次日7次，第三、四日各8次，第五至八日每日9次，此后每日10次。间隔14天后恢复练习2天，再间隔7天后又练习4天。后续练习数据记录分别标注为a、b、c字母标识。

Query_Text_en: Practice was continued at intervals for four months longer , a record of 935 being reached , indicated by on the curve .
Translation: 此后又断断续续练习了四个月，曲线显示最高纪录达到了935次。

Query_Text_en: It is surprising to one unacquainted with work in the psychology of learning to discover how much improvement is possible after one has learned the location of all the boxes . In a few days one knows the boxes so that he does not have to hunt for them , but improvement will continue for months . This fact is illustrated in Fig. 4 .
Translation: 对于不熟悉学习心理学研究的人来说，当发现即使已掌握所有箱体位置后仍存在巨大提升空间时，往往会感到惊讶。短短数日即可熟记箱体方位而无需搜寻，但技能精进将持续数月之久。图4清晰呈现了这一规律。

Query_Text_en: Under the author 's direction . Miss Rose Ann Howe sorted cards for several months .
Translation: 在作者的指导下，罗丝·安·豪小姐进行了为期数月的卡片分类工作。

Query_Text_en: In her experiment , she sorted 150 cards into thirty boxes , five cards to the box .
Translation: 在她的实验中，她将150张卡片分装到30个盒子里，每个盒子放置5张卡片。

Query_Text_en: After a few days she knew the location of all the boxes , nevertheless improvement continued for several months .
Translation: 数日后她便熟记所有箱子的位置，但改进工作仍持续了数月之久。

Query_Text_en: This fact is even better illustrated by the substitution experiment , performed by the same subject .
Translation: 同一受试者进行的替代实验更清晰地印证了这一事实。

Query_Text_en: In this substitution experiment , letters were substituted for the nine digits .
Translation: 在此替换实验中，九个数字被字母所替代。

Query_Text_en: There were but nine bonds to form .
Translation: 仅需缔结九项契约。

Query_Text_en: However , improvement continues for twenty days , as shown in Fig. 5 .
Translation: 然而，如图5所示，改善态势持续了20天。

Query_Text_en: The experiment consisted in transcribing columns of numbers into letters according to a key furnished the subject .
Translation: 该实验要求受试者根据提供的对照表，将数字列转换为对应的字母。

Query_Text_en: Practice was continued for twenty-five minutes at a sitting each day .
Translation: 每日持续练习二十五分钟。

Query_Text_en: The key was learned during the first day 's practice .
Translation: 首日演练中已掌握要领。

Query_Text_en: On the second day the average score was 280 substitutions in five minutes .
Translation: 次日测试中，选手五分钟内平均完成280次替换操作。

Query_Text_en: The answer again is that learning is a matter of degree .
Translation: 答案依然是：学习是一个程度问题。

Query_Text_en: Figure 5 .
Digit-symbol Substitution , 20 days of practice , five practices a day , five minutes at a practice .
Translation: 数字符号替换训练，每日练习5次，每次5分钟，连续20天。

Query_Text_en: Records , average correct substitutions in five minutes for each day .
Translation: 每日五分钟平均正确替换次数记录。

Query_Text_en: The days are represented on the horizontal axis , the scores on the vertical .
Translation: 横轴表示日期，纵轴表示分数。

Query_Text_en: While the key was known by the end of the first day 's practice , it was known better on each succeeding day .
Translation: 尽管首日训练结束时已掌握要领，但此后每日皆更臻娴熟。

Query_Text_en: The bonds became better and better established with practice ;
Translation: 通过实践，这些纽带关系日益巩固；

Query_Text_en: the certainty that the proper association would come instantly became ever greater and greater .
Translation: 确信合适的联想会立即产生的把握变得越来越大。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , the muscles became adapted to their work .
Translation: 此外，肌肉也适应了其工作状态。

Query_Text_en: the muscles gained strength and facility in coordination .
Translation: 肌肉力量增强，协调能力提升。

Query_Text_en: Again we have the same three factors of explanation : forming the primary bonds , strengthening these bonds through use , and adapting the muscles to their work .
Translation: 我们再次看到相同的三个解释要素：形成初始联结、通过使用强化这些联结，以及使肌肉适应其工作。

Query_Text_en: In both the card-sorting and the substitution experiments , the neuron-muscular systems involved become organized so that the stimuli run their courses with the least possible obstruction and expenditure of energy .
Translation: 在卡片分类与替代实验中，相关神经肌肉系统会自发形成协调机制，使刺激传导过程能以最小阻力与最低能耗完成。

Query_Text_en: To summarize : Improvement show by the rise of the curve comes from establishing the proper bonds , eliminating the wrong or useless bonds , strengthening the established bonds through use , and the adapting of the muscles involved to the movements required in the habit .
Translation: 简言之，曲线上升所体现的进步源于以下因素：建立正确的联结、消除错误或无用的联结、通过实践强化已建立的联结，以及使相关肌肉适应习惯动作的要求。

Query_Text_en: We shall now give a further illustration of the whole procedure by the process of learning to add .
Translation: 现在，我们将以学习加法运算的过程为例，进一步阐释整个流程。

Query_Text_en: suppose we know merely how to count . We take six , count four more and have ten .
Translation: 假设我们仅懂得计数。取六，再数四个，得十。

Query_Text_en: We then count nine more and have nineteen , then seven more and have twenty-six .
Translation: 我们接着再数九个，得到十九，然后再数七个，得到二十六。

Query_Text_en: With practice we come to know that six and four are ten and then do not have to count , we look at six and four , and say
Translation: 通过练习，我们逐渐认识到六加四等于十，此后便无需再逐一计数——只需看到六和四，就能脱口而出答案。

Query_Text_en: In the early stages , we get the sums of the second and third columns by the slow process of counting , and the process of carrying from the first to the second and from the second to the third must be learned .
Translation: 在初始阶段，我们通过缓慢的计算过程得出第二列与第三列数值之和，同时必须掌握从第一列向第二列、以及从第二列向第三列的进位运算方法。

Query_Text_en: With practice , however , we can add two columns at once as fast as formerly we could add one column .
Translation: 然而通过练习，我们现在能同时计算两列数字的速度，已与过去计算一列相当。

Query_Text_en: We can also learn to add three columns at once with great speed and accuracy .
Translation: 我们还能学会快速准确地同时计算三列数字。

Query_Text_en: In adding , we first learn all the possible combinations of the nine digits .
Translation: 此外，我们首先掌握了九位数字的所有可能组合方式。

Query_Text_en: These are the primary bonds , the basis of all later schemes of adding .
Translation: 这些基础债券构成了后续所有增发方案的根本依据。

Query_Text_en: Through practice we come to eliminate all useless bonds , as in saying
Translation: 实践方能破除一切无谓之束缚，正所谓

Query_Text_en: We simply look at the six and four and say
Translation: 我们只需审视六和四，然后说

Query_Text_en: After we have learned all the primary combinations , practically unlimited improvement is still possible , through strengthening the primary bonds , and combining into unitary processes what are at first complex processes .
Translation: 在掌握所有基本组合后，我们仍可通过强化基础关联、将初始的复合流程整合为统一流程，实现近乎无限的进步空间。

Query_Text_en: As shown above , after we have practiced a while , 6+4 are not two things but one thing and mean
Translation: 如上所述，经过一段时间的实践后，"6+4"不再被视为两个独立事物，而是融为一体的统一概念。

Query_Text_en: With further practice , larger and larger groups of digits coalesce , become a unitary process , and mean their sum .
Translation: 随着练习的深入，越来越多的数字组合会逐渐融合，形成一个整体过程，最终呈现出它们的总和。

Query_Text_en: In general , the same factors are involved .
Translation: 一般而言，影响因素并无二致。

Query_Text_en: The illustrations given above are typical of the processes in all complex habits .
Translation: 上述例证是所有复杂习惯形成过程的典型代表。

Query_Text_en: Figure 6 .
Practice Curve , dealing 53 playing cards into a box , 10 times a day for 15 days .
Translation: 练习曲线：每天10次将53张扑克牌发入盒中，持续15天。

Query_Text_en: The records shown on the vertical axis are the daily averages , expressed in seconds . It will be seen that the time required to deal the pack of cards was reduced to less than a third of the time required on the first day .
Translation: 纵轴所示数据为每日平均值，以秒为单位。可以看出，完成整副牌处理所需时间已降至首日的不足三分之一。

Query_Text_en: The graphs show the records of two women , but of whom were used to dealing cards .
Translation: 图表显示了两名女性的记录，她们都曾以发牌为业。

Query_Text_en: The amount of improvement shored , for so simple a function , is very great .
Translation: 如此简单的功能，其改进效果却非常显著。

Query_Text_en: The Limit of Improvement . In a simple habit the limit is soon reached .
Translation: 改进的限度。对于简单的习惯，其改进的限度很快就能达到。

Query_Text_en: What this limit is , is determined by the subject 's reaction time .
Translation: 这一限制取决于受试者的反应时间。

Query_Text_en: Suppose that , instead of sorting cards , we take a pack and put all of them into the same box as quickly as possible . The neural bond is soon established and we reach a limit determined by the time required for the nervous impulse to travel along the necessary route .
Translation: 假设我们不再分拣卡片，而是迅速将整副牌放入同一个盒子。神经联结会迅速建立，而我们能达到的极限速度取决于神经冲动沿必要路径传导所需的时间。

Query_Text_en: Such a curve is shown in Fig. 6 .
Translation: 该曲线如图6所示。

Query_Text_en: In general , the more bonds involved in the habit , the longer it takes to perfect them .
Translation: 一般而言，习惯涉及的行为关联越多，形成完美习惯所需的时间就越长。

Query_Text_en: If the bonds required are many , say those involved in sorting cards into one hundred boxes , improvement would continue for many months .
Translation: 若所需建立的关联众多，比如将卡片分类放入一百个箱子这类任务，则能力提升将持续数月之久。

Query_Text_en: In such a process as addition , improvement is practically unlimited , for higher and higher orders or habits can be formed indefinitely .
Translation: 在加法运算这类过程中，提升空间实际上是无限的，因为可以无止境地形成更高阶的运算能力或运算习惯。

Query_Text_en: In such a case , improvement comes not merely from perfecting habits , but from developing more and more efficient habits .
Translation: 在这种情况下，进步不仅源于完善既有习惯，更在于培养日益高效的新习惯。

Query_Text_en: But in all cases in which the habit is definite and can not be supplanted by a more efficient habit , there is a limit which may be called the physiological limit .
Translation: 但凡某种习惯根深蒂固且无法被更高效的习惯所取代时，便存在一个可称之为生理极限的临界点。

Query_Text_en: This limit varies with different individuals , and , as above stated , depends upon their reaction times .
Translation: 这一限度因人而异，如前所述，取决于个体的反应时间。

Query_Text_en: In the card-sorting experiment , the correlation between reaction time and efficiency becomes higher and higher with succeeding practices .
Translation: 在卡片分类实验中，随着练习次数的增加，反应时间与效率之间的相关性逐渐增强。

Query_Text_en: Practical Limits . As pointed out by Thorndike 's few people in the ordinary pursuits of life , come anywhere near their possible limits . In typing , stenography , accounting , telegraphy , and the various other performances of the business and industrial world , workers reach a proficiency that enables them to do their work reasonably well and hold their jobs . They are not willing to put forth the effort that would carry them to a higher plane of efficiency . Most of the workers are working on an efficiency plane much below what is possible for them . One in a hundred , perhaps , puts forth such effort and passes up to a higher plane of performance . One in a thousand , having great ability and great ambition , puts forth the effort that places him among the leaders in his trade or profession .
Translation: 现实局限。正如桑代克所言，普通人在日常事业中鲜少接近其潜能极限。无论是打字、速记、会计、电报，还是工商界的各类工作，从业者仅达到胜任岗位所需的熟练程度。他们不愿付出更多努力以提升效率水平。多数人的工作效率远低于其可能达到的高度。百人中或有一人奋发进取，跃升至更高水平；千人中偶有兼具卓越才能与远大抱负者，通过不懈努力成为行业翘楚。

Query_Text_en: It is well that the young know this important fact , for not only do laborers and clerks work on a level far below their possible limit , but students , as a rule , are content to continue on a level that just barely enables them to
Translation: 年轻人应当明白这一重要事实：不仅普通职员和体力劳动者的工作表现远未达到其潜力上限，就连学生群体也普遍安于勉强及格的平庸状态。

Query_Text_en: The case is similar in science .
Translation: 科学领域的情况也大抵如此。

Query_Text_en: The student should have pointed out to him that the elements can be so mastered as to enable him to proceed to a higher level of achievement . Means of practice and drill should be devised to enable the student to pass to a higher level . There is no shortcut ; there is no easy way ; there is no substitute for drill , practice , repetition . Easy , confident , and efficient performance in any field comes only from complete habituation of the elementary processes .
Translation: 学生本应向他指出，只有熟练掌握基础要素，才能迈向更高层次的成就。必须设计系统的训练方法，帮助学生实现能力跃升。这里没有捷径可走，没有轻松之道，更无法用其他方式替代反复操练。任何领域要做到从容自信、高效精准，都源于对基础环节的彻底内化。

Query_Text_en: Different Forms of Curve . The form of the learning curve depends upon the nature of what is learned .
Translation: 曲线的不同形态。学习曲线的形态取决于所学内容的性质。

Query_Text_en: Usually , the initial rise is rapid , with slower increments later .
Translation: 通常，初期增长较为迅猛，随后增速逐步放缓。

Query_Text_en: This gives a curve convex on its upper side as in Fig. 5 . If learning is slow at first and faster later , the resulting learning curve is concave on its upper side as in Fig. 7 .
Translation: 由此得到的曲线上部呈凸形，如图5所示。若学习进程初期缓慢而后加快，则所得学习曲线的上部将呈凹形，如图7所示。

Query_Text_en: Whatever the form of the curve at first , it eventually becomes level or nearly so .
Translation: 无论初始曲线形态如何，最终都会趋于平缓或接近水平状态。

Query_Text_en: As we approach our limit in any particular habit , any improvement is at the cost of much greater effort than was the case in an earlier stage of habituation .
Translation: 当我们接近某项习惯的极限时，任何进步所需付出的努力都远大于习惯养成初期的投入。

Query_Text_en: Figure 7 .
Learning Curve , concave upward .
Translation: 学习曲线呈向上凹形。

Query_Text_en: Adapted from Swift Practice was in ball-tossing .
Translation: 改编自斯威夫特的练习项目是投球。

Query_Text_en: Scores shown on vertical axis represent successes . The successive days of practice are represented on the horizontal axis .
Translation: 纵轴数值代表成功次数，横轴则标示连续练习天数。

Query_Text_en: A concave learning curve indicates increasing increments from the effects of practice .
Translation: 凹形学习曲线表明实践效果带来的增量呈递增趋势。

Query_Text_en: In the psychological literature there has been much discussion of
Translation: 心理学文献中已有大量探讨

Query_Text_en: With some subjects and some work there is an initial spurt . Sometimes there is a final spurt , particularly if the subject knows that the end of the work period is near .
Translation: 某些学科和任务在初期会出现爆发式进展。临近截止期限时，尤其当受试者意识到工作时段即将结束，往往还会出现最后的冲刺效应。

Query_Text_en: At any time during a work period a spurt may appear , due to a combination of favorable circumstances .
Translation: 在工作周期的任何阶段，由于有利条件的综合作用，都可能出现突飞猛进的发展态势。

Query_Text_en: The relative amounts of work done at different parts of a work-ivied depend upon several factors , particularly upon the stage of habituation and how fatiguing the work is .
Translation: 工作在不同部位完成的相对工作量取决于多种因素，尤其是习惯化阶段以及工作的疲劳程度。

Query_Text_en: In the early stages of habituation , there are considerable practice effects during the work period which make the later records of , the period high .
Translation: 在适应初期，工作期间存在显著的练习效应，这使得该阶段后期的记录数值偏高。

Query_Text_en: If we are near the limits of practice , the practice effects during a work period will be slight . In the latter case any difference in the amounts of work done at different parts of the period will be due to the effects of fatigue and of warming up .
Translation: 若实践已接近极限水平，则工作时段内的实践效应将微乎其微。在此情况下，该时段不同阶段工作量的差异仅源于疲劳效应与热身效应。

Query_Text_en: In complicated motor performances , such as type-writing , the best record is not made at the first part of a work-period . Only after little practice can we do our best .
Translation: 在打字等复杂的动作表现中，最佳状态往往不会出现在工作时段初期。唯有经过短暂练习后，方能达到最佳水准。

Query_Text_en: In Miss Howe 's card-sorting experiment , cited above , for the 18th , 19th , and 20th days , the average efficiencies for each of the ten sorting made at a sitting were : 775 , 802 , 804 , 824 , 802 , 808 , 796 , 802 , 805 , 780 .
Translation: 如前文引述的豪女士卡片分类实验中，18至20日期间，每次连续完成十组分类的平均效率分别为：775、802、804、824、802、808、796、802、805、780。

Query_Text_en: Maximum efficiency was not reached till the fourth sorting , when the speed was 6.3 per cent , better than it was the first sorting . The record for the first sorting was the lowest of the ten .
Translation: 直到第四次分拣时，效率才达到最高水平，分拣速度为6.3%，优于首次分拣表现。首次分拣记录在十次作业中位列最低。

Query_Text_en: Figure 8 .
Card-sorting .
Translation: 卡片分类法

Query_Text_en: The upper graph shows the course of efficiency during an hour 's work in card sorting after the habits involved are well fixed .
Translation: 上图显示了卡片分类工作中习惯形成后一小时内效率的变化趋势。

Query_Text_en: It shows a period of warming-up leading to maximal efficiency on the fourth practice .
Translation: 这表明，经过一段适应期后，在第四次练习时效率达到峰值。

Query_Text_en: The lower curve indicates the course of efficiency during an hour 's practice before the habits are well fixed .
Translation: 下方曲线显示习惯尚未稳固时，一小时练习期间的效率变化轨迹。

Query_Text_en: Maximal efficiency is reached on the eight sorting .
Translation: 第八次分拣时达到最高效率。

Query_Text_en: In tilted latter case , the effects of practice raise the latter scores .
Translation: 在后一种倾斜情况下，实践效应会提升后续得分。

Query_Text_en: The last two scores fall because fatigue offsets the practice effects .
Translation: 最后两项得分因疲劳抵消了练习效果而下降。

Query_Text_en: In the former case , there is little improvement due to practice in the course of an hour .
Translation: 在前一种情况下，一小时的练习几乎不会带来任何进步。

Query_Text_en: Figure 9 ;
Efficiency Curve for Card-sorting .
Translation: 卡片分类效率曲线

Query_Text_en: Solid line from the actual data of one subject ;
Translation: 某受试者实测数据的实线轨迹；

Query_Text_en: broken line , a smoothed curve constructed from the same data , by averaging each record with the adjacent records . The first and last record were doubled , added to the one adjacent record , and the sum divided by three .
Translation: 虚线为基于相同数据构建的平滑曲线，其通过将每条记录与相邻记录取平均值获得。首尾两条记录均作双倍加权处理，与相邻单条记录相加后除以三得出均值。

Query_Text_en: The number of cards sorted per minute is indicated on the vertical axis .
Translation: 纵轴显示每分钟分拣的卡片数量。

Query_Text_en: On the 9th , 10th and 11th days , while improvement was still marked , the records for the ten practices at a sitting were 685 , 702 , 721 , 709 , 728 , 725 , 718 , 741 , 725 , 720 .
The highest record was made on the 8th sorting , when the speed was about 8 per cent , higher than on the first .
Translation: 最高纪录出现在第8次分拣时，其速度较首次操作提升约8%。

Query_Text_en: These facts are shown graphically in figure 8 .
Translation: 图8以图表形式直观呈现了这些数据。

Query_Text_en: Smoothing the Learning Curve . Ordinarily there are fluctuations in the rise of a learning curve . It rises fast , then perhaps more slowly ;
Translation: 平滑学习曲线。通常情况下，学习曲线的上升过程存在波动：先快速攀升，继而可能放缓；

Query_Text_en: it may even fall , for just as a combination of favorable factors makes it rise , so a combination of unfavorable circumstances may make it fall .
Translation: 甚至可能下跌，正如有利因素的综合作用会推高价格，不利条件的叠加同样会导致其回落。

Query_Text_en: There are always many independently variable factors that combine to produce a learning record .
Translation: 学习记录的形成往往由诸多独立变量因素共同作用所致。

Query_Text_en: These factors are variously combined at different moments of our procedure and produce a curve of fluctuating rises and falls .
Translation: 这些因素在我们的进程中不时以不同方式组合，形成一条起伏波动的曲线。

Query_Text_en: The general tendency of the curve is better shown if , instead of showing the actual records , we construct a smoothed curve .
Translation: 若以平滑曲线替代实际记录线，则能更清晰地呈现该曲线的总体走势。

Query_Text_en: There are various ways of doing this .
Translation: 实现这一目标有多种途径。

Query_Text_en: We can do it roughly by indicating the actual records on our coordinate paper by dots and then drawing a curve that throws as many of the dots on one side as on the other .
Translation: 我们可大致通过以下方式实现：先将实际记录以点状形式标注在坐标纸上，随后绘制一条曲线，使曲线两侧分布的点数尽可能均衡。

Query_Text_en: The dots show the actual records , the cuie shows the general tendency of the records .
Translation: 圆点表示实际记录数据，曲线则反映数据的总体变化趋势。

Query_Text_en: Another method is to eliminate the temporary fluctuations of the curve by averaging each record with the adjacent records above and below .
Translation: 另一种方法是通过将每条记录与其上下相邻记录取平均值，以消除曲线的临时波动。

Query_Text_en: The first and final records are doubled and combined with the one adjacent record , and the sum divided by three .
Translation: 首尾记录均加倍后与相邻记录相加，再以三除之。

Query_Text_en: Learning Plateaus . A plateau or level place in the learning curve indicates a period of no progress in learning .
Translation: 学习高原期。学习曲线中的平台期或平稳阶段，标志着学习进展停滞的时期。

Query_Text_en: Such plateaus nearly always appear in the actual work of learning , in school work as well as in laboratory experiments .
Translation: 这种停滞期几乎总是出现在实际学习过程中，无论是课堂学习还是实验室实验。

Query_Text_en: Various explanations for the appearance of the plateau have been given .
Translation: 关于这一稳定期的出现，各方给出了多种解释。

Query_Text_en: Bryan , in his early work on learning , suggested that plateaus were due to the fixing of lower order habits .
Translation: 布莱恩在其早期关于学习的研究中指出，学习高原现象的形成源于低阶习惯的固化。

Query_Text_en: Progress due to higher order habits could not come till the lower order habits were fixed .
Translation: 唯有先稳固基础习惯，方能实现高阶习惯带来的进步。

Query_Text_en: Book 's suggestion that the plateau is due to a flagging of interest , a letting up of effort , is doubtless nearer the truth for the plateau may appear in simple experiments involving a single definite habit . The fact seems to be that the plateau is not a necessity in learning , theoretically , although in practice it usually appears .
Translation: 该书认为高原现象源于兴趣减退和努力松懈，这一观点无疑更接近事实，因为即便在涉及单一明确习惯的简单实验中，也可能出现高原期。事实上，高原期理论上并非学习过程中的必然阶段，但在实践中却往往显现。

Query_Text_en: As long as a learner maintains a high degree of attention and puts forth maximum effort , he continues to improve till he reaches his limit .
Translation: 只要学习者保持高度专注并全力以赴，其能力就会持续提升直至极限。

Query_Text_en: But maintaining a high state of attention and putting forth maximum effort are impossible over long periods of time .
Translation: 但长期保持高度警觉并持续付出最大努力是不现实的。

Query_Text_en: The ordinary learner usually does his best for a time , then because of fatigue , or lack of attention , or loss of interest , he relaxes and works at a lower point of efficiency .
Translation: 普通学习者通常能坚持一段时间全力以赴，随后或因疲惫、注意力涣散，抑或兴趣减退，便会松懈下来，工作效率随之降低。

Query_Text_en: For a time , the records may actually fall below previous records .
Translation: 短期内，实际数据甚至可能低于历史记录。

Query_Text_en: This phenomenon may appear during the experiment of a single sitting and be a matter of minutes . It may appear in a long series of experiments and be a matter of days .
Translation: 该现象可能在单次实验中显现，仅持续数分钟；也可能在长期系列实验中出现，持续数日之久。

Query_Text_en: The plateau has much significance to education .
Translation: 该高原对教育事业具有重大意义。

Query_Text_en: When it is due to loss of interest and lack of attention , practice is not then profitable .
Translation: 若因兴趣丧失、注意力涣散，则练习无益。

Query_Text_en: At such a time , practice should stop or means be found to renew attention and effort .
Translation: 值此之际，要么中止实践，要么另辟蹊径重振专注与奋进之力。

Query_Text_en: Pauses in habit-formation are valuable not only because they lead to a renewed interest and effort when the work is taken up again , but according to some writers , they lead to a weakening of inhibitions which had interfered with the habit .
Translation: 习惯养成过程中的间歇期具有重要价值，这不仅因为当重新投入工作时会激发新的兴趣与努力，而且据某些学者所言，这些停顿还能削弱原先阻碍习惯形成的抑制因素。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , in habit-formation , time is an element which can not be ignored .
Translation: 此外，在习惯养成过程中，时间是一个不可忽视的要素。

Query_Text_en: Some sort of fixation goes on in the nervous system ; this fixation requires time and can not be unduly hurried .
Translation: 神经系统会形成某种固着状态；这种固着需要时间，且不可操之过急。

Query_Text_en: As shown in a later chapter , practice beyond a certain amount at one sitting is valueless .
Translation: 如后文所示，单次练习超过一定量便毫无价值。

Query_Text_en: And in practice extending over many days , only a certain amount of improvement is possible , no matter how hard we work .
Translation: 在实践中，即便我们竭尽全力，经过多日努力，所能实现的改进也终究有限。

Query_Text_en: All the principles discussed in this chapter should , as far as possible , be illustrated by experiments .
Translation: 本章所述各项原则均应尽可能通过实验加以验证。

Query_Text_en: Any learning experiment will suffice , but for economy of time , an experiment should be selected that will show rapid improvement .
Translation: 任何学习实验均可适用，但为节省时间，应选择能快速见效的实验方案。

Query_Text_en: Several experiments are described below . The instructor can select those suited to his needs , or devise others .
Translation: 以下列举若干实验项目，教师可根据教学需求选用或另行设计。

Query_Text_en: Class experiment . Material , Pyle 's Digit-symbol substitution test blanks .
Translation: 课堂实验。材料：派尔数字符号替换测试空白表格。

Query_Text_en: Method : Distribute about sixteen test sheets to each student , placing them face down before the student . Explain to the students that they are to substitute letters for the nine digits , in accordance with the key shown at the top of the test sheet , and that they are to work as fast as possible .
Translation: 方法：向每位学生分发约16张测试卷，正面朝下放置于学生面前。向学生说明，需按照试卷顶部所示字母数字对应表，将九位数字替换为相应字母，并要求他们尽可能快速完成。

Query_Text_en: Work in five-minute periods , and let the score be the number of substitutions correctly made in five minutes .
Translation: 以五分钟为一个工作周期，得分即为五分钟内正确完成的替换次数。

Query_Text_en: Eight such scores can probably be made in a one-hour period .
Translation: 一小时大约能完成八次这样的评分。

Query_Text_en: The scoring should be left till the experiment is finished .
Translation: 评分工作应待实验结束后进行。

Query_Text_en: From the data obtained in experiment 1 , construct individual learning curves similar to figures 1 and 2 .
Translation: 根据实验一所得数据，绘制类似图1和图2的个体学习曲线。

Query_Text_en: Construct a smoothed curve as described in the chapter .
Translation: 按照本章所述方法构建平滑曲线。

Query_Text_en: Construct a learning curve from the class averages for each five-minute period .
Translation: 根据每五分钟时段的班级平均成绩绘制学习曲线。

Query_Text_en: Laboratory experiment . Card-sorting . Material , ordinary playing cards .
Translation: 实验室实验。卡片分类。材料：普通扑克牌。

Query_Text_en: Method : Shuffle the cards , then sort them into four piles according to suit , .
Translation: 方法：洗牌后，按花色将牌分成四堆。

Query_Text_en: , hearts together , spades together , clubs together , and diamonds together .
Translation: 红桃归红桃，黑桃归黑桃，梅花归梅花，方片归方片。

Query_Text_en: Construct a cure similar to figure 3 .
Translation: 构建类似图3所示的解决方案。

Query_Text_en: Laboratory experiment . Material , card-sorting box and cards .
Translation: 实验室实验。材料、卡片分类盒及卡片。

Query_Text_en: The cards must be thoroughly shuffled before each sorting . Shuffling is facilitated if the cards are taken up after sorting , promiscuously , one at a time .
Translation: 每次分拣前必须彻底洗牌。若在分拣后逐张无序收牌，可便于洗牌操作。

Query_Text_en: Ten sorting can be finished in an hour .
Translation: 十项分类工作可于一小时内完成。

Query_Text_en: Construct individual learning curves similar to figure 3 .
Translation: 构建与图3类似的个体学习曲线。

Query_Text_en: By computing the number of cards sorted in a minute , curves can be made similar to figures 1 and 2 .
Translation: 通过计算每分钟分拣的卡片数量，可绘制出类似于图1和图2的曲线。

Query_Text_en: Elaborator experiment . Material , mirror-writing apparatus .
Translation: 精细实验。材料、镜像书写装置。

Query_Text_en: Method : The hand of the writer is to be covered from view . He is to see his hand as reflected in the mirror , which is vertical before him .
Translation: 方法：书写者需将手部遮挡不可见，仅能通过面前垂直放置的镜子观察手部动作。

Query_Text_en: The subject is to write in script in such a way that the letters appear in the mirror as they would on a sheet of paper held vertically before him . Let the subjects copy the material of the first paragraph in this chapter .
Translation: 本实验要求受试者以特定方式书写文字，确保当这些文字垂直置于镜前时，镜中呈现的影像与正常纸张上的书写效果一致。现需受试者抄录本章第一节段落内容。

Query_Text_en: While Hargreaves was still working on his `` spinning jenny , '' Richard Arkwright in 1769 invented a water-power machine .
Translation: 当哈格里夫斯还在改良"珍妮纺纱机"时，理查德·阿克莱特于1769年发明了水力纺纱机。

Query_Text_en: This device drew the carded cotton through a series of rollers , each set revolving at a greater velocity than the preceding set and thus turning out cotton thread strong enough for any purpose .
Translation: 该装置通过一系列滚筒牵伸梳理后的棉花，每组滚筒转速均高于前一组，从而纺出强度足以满足各种用途的棉纱。

Query_Text_en: The work of Hargreaves , Arkwright and others now made it possible to spin thread faster than the weavers could use it .
Translation: 哈格里夫斯、阿克莱特等人的发明使得纺纱速度超过了织布工人的用纱需求。

Query_Text_en: As far back as the days of ancient Egypt men had known that water turned into steam expanded to create power .
Translation: 早在古埃及时期，人类就已认识到水转化为蒸汽时会发生膨胀并产生动力。

Query_Text_en: The problem was to harness this power for the use of man , and to make it possible to locate a factory wherever it seemed desirable .
Translation: 问题在于如何驾驭这种力量为人类所用，并使工厂选址能够随心所欲。

Query_Text_en: He discovered how to save the steam and use it over and over , how the steam could be used to force a piston both ways , and how the backward and forward motion of the piston could be applied to the turning of wheels or the driving of a hammer .
Translation: 他发现如何储存蒸汽并循环利用，如何利用蒸汽推动活塞双向运动，以及如何将活塞的往复运动转化为轮轴旋转或锤击动力。

Query_Text_en: Soon with the aid of a wealthy English manufacturer he built steam engines on a commercial scale .
Translation: 不久，在一位富有的英国制造商资助下，他开始商业化规模生产蒸汽机。

Query_Text_en: Watt 's steam engine not only introduced a new era in mining by making it easy to pump out the water , but it freed manufacturing from water power .
Translation: 瓦特的蒸汽机不仅通过便捷的排水功能开创了采矿新时代，更使制造业彻底摆脱了对水力驱动的依赖。

Query_Text_en: In 1807 an American , Robert Fulton , first demonstrated the practicability of the steamboat in freight and passenger service when his boat , the Clermont , equipped with a Watt engine , ascended the Hudson from New York to Albany , a distance of 150 miles in 32 hours .
Translation: 1807年，美国人罗伯特·富尔顿首次证明了蒸汽船在货运和客运服务中的实用性。他装备了瓦特发动机的"克莱蒙特号"蒸汽船，以32小时完成了纽约至奥尔巴尼的哈德逊河150英里航程。

Query_Text_en: Although the Industrial Revolution came first in England , it was not long before Americans were contributing to the basic inventions which made this tremendous change possible .
Translation: 尽管工业革命率先在英国兴起，但不久后美国人便为促成这一重大变革的基础性发明做出了贡献。

Query_Text_en: The spinning jenny and the power loom had made it possible to turn the cotton fiber into cloth quickly .
Translation: 纺纱机和动力织布机的发明，使得棉纤维得以迅速织成布料。

Query_Text_en: Dr. Dani Bolognesi still remembers the afternoon in 1994 when one of his research colleagues , Tom Matthews , ran into his office at Duke University with some exciting news .
Translation: 丹尼·博洛尼亚博士至今仍记得1994年的那个下午，他的研究同事汤姆·马修斯冲进杜克大学的办公室，带来一个激动人心的消息。

Query_Text_en: While searching for something that might work as a vaccine against HIV , Matthews had stumbled upon a compound that blocked the AIDS Virus from binding to and thus infecting healthy cells .
Translation: 在寻找可能作为艾滋病疫苗的物质时，马修斯偶然发现了一种化合物，它能阻止艾滋病病毒与健康细胞结合，从而防止感染。

Query_Text_en: says Bolognesi , now CEO of the company he co-founded to explore-the compound 's commercial potential .
Translation: 博洛涅西现任该公司首席执行官，这家企业由他联合创立，旨在开发该化合物的商业价值。

Query_Text_en: It turns out that the compound Matthews identified does n't work as an AIDS vaccine , but it may still make a very good AIDS drag .
Translation: 事实证明，马修斯所鉴定的化合物虽不能作为艾滋病疫苗发挥作用，但仍可能成为疗效显著的抗艾药物。

Query_Text_en: It belongs to a family of molecules known as entry inhibitors that , as the name suggests , prevent HIV 's entry into healthy immune cells .
Translation: 它属于一类名为"进入抑制剂"的分子家族，顾名思义，这类物质能够阻止HIV病毒进入健康免疫细胞。

Query_Text_en: Bolognesi 's company , Trimeris , based in Durham , N. C. , collaborates with Hoffman LaRoche and is already in the final stages of human testing with one compound and in the earliest phases of testing with a second .
